				EraseProperty<double>(propName);
				if (notify && !double.IsNaN(quantityValue))
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged(propName);
				}
			}
			else if (double.IsNaN(quantityValue) || ValuesAreDifferent(newValue.Value, quantityValue))
			{
				SetProperty(propName, newValue.Value, notify, uom, byUser: false, pressureReference);
			}
		}

		public virtual void RecallFixUp()
		{
		}

		public virtual bool DataIsConsistent()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void Delete()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, _ProcessVarChangeAction> processVarChangeAction in _ProcessVarChangeActions)
			{
				AbstractProcessVariable value = null;
				if (Properties.TryGetValue(processVarChangeAction.Key, out value))
				{
					value.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(processVarChangeAction.Value);
				}
			}
			_ProcessVarChangeActions.Clear();
			if (Model != null)
			{
				Model.Delete();
			}
		}

		public virtual void UpdateDataPath(string path)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) && !string.Equals(Datapath, path))
			{
				if (_HostInterface.IsValueCreated)
				{
					_HostInterface.Value.Initialize(path, Simulator);
				}
				_datapath = path;
			}
		}

		void IBaseModel.UpdateDataPath(string path)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in UpdateDataPath
			this.UpdateDataPath(path);
		}

		public static bool ValuesAreClose(double d1, double d2, double relativeErrorThreshold = 1E-10, double zeroThreshold = 1E-10)
		{
			return !ValuesAreDifferent(d1, d2, relativeErrorThreshold, zeroThreshold);
		}

		protected static bool GetIsAspenPlusDirty(string refstrm, string nodeKey)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0089: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool result = true;
			try
			{
				if (!Information.IsNothing(refstrm))
				{
					CxsBatchRequestData val = new CxsBatchRequestData();
					val.AddRequest(new CxsBatchRequest(refstrm + ".Output.HMX_FLOW.MIXED", "value", "Watt"));
					val.AddRequest(new CxsBatchRequest(nodeKey + ".Input.REFSTRENTH", "value", "Watt"));
					val.AddRequest(new CxsBatchRequest(refstrm + ".Output.PRES_OUT.MIXED", "value", "Pa"));
					val.AddRequest(new CxsBatchRequest(nodeKey + ".Input.REFSTRPRS", "value", "Pa"));
					object[] array = new object[5];
					array = CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchGet(val);
					double d = Convert.ToDouble(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(array[0]));
					double d2 = Convert.ToDouble(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(array[1]));
					if (ValuesAreClose(d, d2, 1E-05))
					{
						double d3 = Convert.ToDouble(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(array[2]));
						d2 = Convert.ToDouble(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(array[3]));
						if (ValuesAreClose(d3, d2, 1E-05))
						{
							result = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected static void SetIsAspenPlusDirty(string refstrm, string nodeKey)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			try
			{
				if (!Information.IsNothing(refstrm))
				{
					CxsBatchRequestData val = new CxsBatchRequestData();
					val.AddRequest(new CxsBatchRequest(refstrm + ".Output.HMX_FLOW.MIXED", "value", "Watt"));
					val.AddRequest(new CxsBatchRequest(refstrm + ".Output.PRES_OUT.MIXED", "value", "Pa"));
					object[] array = new object[3];
					array = CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchGet(val);
					val = new CxsBatchRequestData();
					val.AddRequest(new CxsBatchRequest(nodeKey + ".Input.REFSTRENTH", "value", "Watt", RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(array[0])));
					val.AddRequest(new CxsBatchRequest(nodeKey + ".Input.REFSTRPRS", "value", "Pa", RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(array[1])));
					CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchSet(val);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
		}

		internal double[] GetOrificeSizes(ReliefDeviceType PrdType)
		{
			return (from x in GetOrifices(PrdType)
				select x.Area).ToArray();
		}

		public IEnumerable<OrificeSpecModel> GetOrifices(ReliefDeviceType PrdType)
		{
			return GetOrificeSettings().get_AvailableOrifices(PrdType);
		}

		protected _ProcessVarChangeAction _AddPropertyChangeAction(string propName, Action onChangedAction)
		{
			AbstractProcessVariable value = null;
			_ProcessVarChangeAction processVarChangeAction;
			if (Properties.TryGetValue(propName, out value))
			{
				processVarChangeAction = new _ProcessVarChangeAction(onChangedAction);
				value.AddAffectedProcessAction(processVarChangeAction);
				_ProcessVarChangeActions.Add(propName, processVarChangeAction);
			}
			else
			{
				processVarChangeAction = null;
			}
			return processVarChangeAction;
		}

		protected void _AddPropertyChangeAction(string propName, _ProcessVarChangeAction onChangedAction)
		{
			AbstractProcessVariable value = null;
			if (Properties.TryGetValue(propName, out value))
			{
				value.AddAffectedProcessAction(onChangedAction);
				_ProcessVarChangeActions.Add(propName, onChangedAction);
			}
		}

		protected _ProcessVarChangeAction _RemovePropertyChangeAction(string propName)
		{
			AbstractProcessVariable value = null;
			_ProcessVarChangeAction result;
			if (Properties.TryGetValue(propName, out value))
			{
				value.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(_ProcessVarChangeActions[propName]);
				result = _ProcessVarChangeActions[propName];
				_ProcessVarChangeActions.Remove(propName);
			}
			else
			{
				result = null;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		public double ELValveInSize
		{
			get
			{
				double valveInSize = mScenarioModel.ValveInSize;
				double property = GetProperty<double>(s_ELValveInSize);
				if (double.IsNaN(property))
				{
					SetProperty(s_ELValveInSize, valveInSize);
				}
				else if (ValuesAreDifferent(valveInSize, property))
				{
					SetProperty(s_ELValveInSize, valveInSize);
				}
				double num = GetProperty<double>(s_ELValveInSize);
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(s_ELValveInSize, value, notify: false);
				CalculateEquivalentLength();
			}
		}

		public double ELValveOutSize

		public bool CalcEquivLength
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty<bool>(s_CalcEquivLength);
			}
			set
			{
				bool calcEquivLength = CalcEquivLength;
				SetProperty(s_CalcEquivLength, (bool?)value, notify: true);
				if (value && !calcEquivLength)
				{
					double inEquivLength = mScenarioModel.InEquivLength;
					double outEquivLength = mScenarioModel.OutEquivLength;
					if (double.IsNaN(ELInGeomLength))
					{
						ELInGeomLength = inEquivLength;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(ELOutGeomLength))
					{
						ELOutGeomLength = outEquivLength;
					}
				}
				CalculateEquivalentLength();
			}
		}

		public bool ValuesAreDifferent(double val1, double val2)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(val1))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(val2))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(val2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			double num = Math.Max(Math.Abs(val1 * 1E-06), Math.Abs(val2 * 1E-06));
			if (Math.Abs(val1 - val2) > num)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CalculateEquivalentLength()
		{
			if (!CalcEquivLength)
			{
				return;
			}
			string msg = "";
			if (!IsReady(ref msg))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = default(double);
			if (ELOutID > 0.0)
			{
				num = ELOutID * 0.0254;
			}
			double num2 = default(double);
			if (ELInID > 0.0)
			{
				num2 = ELInID * 0.0254;
			}
			if (Operators.CompareString(ELUOMGeomLength, "m", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				_ = ELOutGeomLength;
				_ = ELInGeomLength;
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(ELUOMGeomLength, "ft", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				_ = ELOutGeomLength;
				_ = ELInGeomLength;
			}
			double num3 = ELContrID_1 * 0.0254;
			double num4 = ELContrID_2 * 0.0254;
			double num5 = ELValveInSize * 0.0254;
			double num6 = ELValveOutSize * 0.0254;
			double num7 = 0.0;
			if (ELGlobePerp_IN > 0 && ELGlobePerp_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELGlobePerp_Coeff * (double)ELGlobePerp_IN;
			}
			if (ELGlobeY_IN > 0 && ELGlobeY_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELGlobeY_Coeff * (double)ELGlobeY_IN;
			}
			if (ELAngle_IN > 0 && ELAngle_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELAngle_Coeff * (double)ELAngle_IN;
			}
			if (ELGate_IN > 0 && ELGate_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELGate_Coeff * (double)ELGate_IN;
			}
			if (ELBall_IN > 0 && ELBall_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELBall_Coeff * (double)ELBall_IN;
			}
			if (ELCheckConv_IN > 0 && ELCheckConv_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELCheckConv_Coeff * (double)ELCheckConv_IN;
			}
			if (ELCheckClear_IN > 0 && ELCheckClear_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELCheckClear_Coeff * (double)ELCheckClear_IN;
			}
			if (ELBfly_IN > 0 && ELBfly_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELBfly_Coeff * (double)ELBfly_IN;
			}
			if (EL3WS_IN > 0 && EL3WS_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * EL3WS_Coeff * (double)EL3WS_IN;
			}
			if (EL3WT_IN > 0 && EL3WT_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * EL3WT_Coeff * (double)EL3WT_IN;
			}
			if (EL90Std_IN > 0 && EL90Std_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * EL90Std_Coeff * (double)EL90Std_IN;
			}
			if (EL45Std_IN > 0 && EL45Std_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * EL45Std_Coeff * (double)EL45Std_IN;
			}
			if (EL90Lr_IN > 0 && EL90Lr_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * EL90Lr_Coeff * (double)EL90Lr_IN;
			}
			if (EL90Str_IN > 0 && EL90Str_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * EL90Str_Coeff * (double)EL90Str_IN;
			}
			if (EL45Str_IN > 0 && EL45Str_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * EL45Str_Coeff * (double)EL45Str_IN;
			}
			if (ELSqCorn_IN > 0 && ELSqCorn_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELSqCorn_Coeff * (double)ELSqCorn_IN;
			}
			if (ELTee3WS_IN > 0 && ELTee3WS_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELTee3WS_Coeff * (double)ELTee3WS_IN;
			}
			if (ELTee3WT_IN > 0 && ELTee3WT_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELTee3WT_Coeff * (double)ELTee3WT_IN;
			}
			if (ELEntrance_IN > 0 && ELEntrance_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELEntrance_Coeff * (double)ELEntrance_IN;
			}
			if (ELExit_IN > 0 && ELExit_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2 * ELExit_Coeff * (double)ELExit_IN;
			}
			double num8 = num2 * 1000.0;
			if (this.get_ELContr_1_IN(recalculate: true) > 0)
			{
				double num9 = num3 * 1000.0;
				num7 = ((!(num9 >= num8)) ? (num7 + Kappa_2(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_1_IN(recalculate: true)) : (num7 + Kappa_1(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_1_IN(recalculate: true)));
			}
			if (this.get_ELContr_2_IN(recalculate: true) > 0)
			{
				double num9 = num4 * 1000.0;
				num7 = ((!(num9 >= num8)) ? (num7 + Kappa_2(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_2_IN(recalculate: true)) : (num7 + Kappa_1(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_2_IN(recalculate: true)));
			}
			if (this.get_ELContr_3_IN(recalculate: true) > 0)
			{
				double num9 = num5 * 1000.0;
				if (num9 - num8 > 38.5 && Interaction.MsgBox("PSV Inlet Flange Larger than Inlet Line ! Do you want to continue ?", MsgBoxStyle.YesNo | MsgBoxStyle.Question, "Warning") == MsgBoxResult.No)
				{
					return;
				}
				num7 = ((!(num9 >= num8)) ? (num7 + Kappa_2(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_3_IN(recalculate: true)) : (num7 + Kappa_1(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_3_IN(recalculate: true)));
			}
			num7 += ELInGeomLength;
			double num10 = 0.0;
			if (ELGlobePerp_OUT > 0 && ELGlobePerp_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELGlobePerp_Coeff * (double)ELGlobePerp_OUT;
			}
			if (ELGlobeY_OUT > 0 && ELGlobeY_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELGlobeY_Coeff * (double)ELGlobeY_OUT;
			}
			if (ELAngle_OUT > 0 && ELAngle_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELAngle_Coeff * (double)ELAngle_OUT;
			}
			if (ELGate_OUT > 0 && ELGate_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELGate_Coeff * (double)ELGate_OUT;
			}
			if (ELBall_OUT > 0 && ELBall_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELBall_Coeff * (double)ELBall_OUT;
			}
			if (ELCheckConv_OUT > 0 && ELCheckConv_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELCheckConv_Coeff * (double)ELCheckConv_OUT;
			}
			if (ELCheckClear_OUT > 0 && ELCheckClear_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELCheckClear_Coeff * (double)ELCheckClear_OUT;
			}
			if (ELBfly_OUT > 0 && ELBfly_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELBfly_Coeff * (double)ELBfly_OUT;
			}
			if (EL3WS_OUT > 0 && EL3WS_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * EL3WS_Coeff * (double)EL3WS_OUT;
			}
			if (EL3WT_OUT > 0 && EL3WT_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * EL3WT_Coeff * (double)EL3WT_OUT;
			}
			if (EL90Std_OUT > 0 && EL90Std_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * EL90Std_Coeff * (double)EL90Std_OUT;
			}
			if (EL45Std_OUT > 0 && EL45Std_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * EL45Std_Coeff * (double)EL45Std_OUT;
			}
			if (EL90Lr_OUT > 0 && EL90Lr_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * EL90Lr_Coeff * (double)EL90Lr_OUT;
			}
			if (EL90Str_OUT > 0 && EL90Str_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * EL90Str_Coeff * (double)EL90Str_OUT;
			}
			if (EL45Str_OUT > 0 && EL45Str_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * EL45Str_Coeff * (double)EL45Str_OUT;
			}
			if (ELSqCorn_OUT > 0 && ELSqCorn_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELSqCorn_Coeff * (double)ELSqCorn_OUT;
			}
			if (ELTee3WS_OUT > 0 && ELTee3WS_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELTee3WS_Coeff * (double)ELTee3WS_OUT;
			}
			if (ELTee3WT_OUT > 0 && ELTee3WT_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELTee3WT_Coeff * (double)ELTee3WT_OUT;
			}
			if (ELEntrance_OUT > 0 && ELEntrance_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELEntrance_Coeff * (double)ELEntrance_OUT;
			}
			if (ELExit_OUT > 0 && ELExit_Coeff > 0.0)
			{
				num10 += num * ELExit_Coeff * (double)ELExit_OUT;
			}
			num8 = num * 1000.0;
			if (this.get_ELContr_1_OUT(recalculate: true) > 0)
			{
				double num9 = num3 * 1000.0;
				num10 = ((!(num9 >= num8)) ? (num10 + Kappa_2(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_1_OUT(recalculate: true)) : (num10 + Kappa_1(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_1_OUT(recalculate: true)));
			}
			if (this.get_ELContr_2_OUT(recalculate: true) > 0)
			{
				double num9 = num4 * 1000.0;
				num10 = ((!(num9 >= num8)) ? (num10 + Kappa_2(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_2_OUT(recalculate: true)) : (num10 + Kappa_1(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_2_OUT(recalculate: true)));
			}
			if (this.get_ELContr_4_OUT(recalculate: true) > 0)
			{
				double num9 = num6 * 1000.0;
				if (num9 - num8 > 38.5 && Interaction.MsgBox("PSV Outlet Flange Larger than Outlet Line ! Do you want to continue ?", MsgBoxStyle.YesNo | MsgBoxStyle.Question, "Warning") == MsgBoxResult.No)
				{
					return;
				}
				num10 = ((!(num9 >= num8)) ? (num10 + Kappa_2(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_4_OUT(recalculate: true)) : (num10 + Kappa_1(num8, num9) * (double)this.get_ELContr_4_OUT(recalculate: true)));
			}
			num10 += ELOutGeomLength;
			if (Operators.CompareString(ELUOMEquivLength, "m", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				num7 = num7;
				num10 = num10;
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(ELUOMEquivLength, "ft", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				num7 *= 3.28084;
				num10 *= 3.28084;
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(ELUOMEquivLength, "", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				Interaction.MsgBox("Please enter Equivalent Length UOM!", MsgBoxStyle.OkOnly, "Error");
				return;
			}
			mScenarioModel.InEquivLength = num7;
			mScenarioModel.OutEquivLength = num10;
			OnEquivLengthCalculated(null);
		}

		private double Kappa_1(double ELID, double ELContrID)
		{
			return Math.Pow(1.0 - Math.Pow(ELID / ELContrID, 2.0), 2.0) * 100.0 * ELID / 1000.0;
		}

		private double Kappa_2(double ELID, double ELContrID)
		{
			return Math.Pow(1.0 - Math.Pow(ELContrID / ELID, 2.0), 2.0) * 50.0 * ELContrID / 1000.0;
		}

		protected int GetIntProperty(string propName)
		{
			double property = GetProperty<double>(propName);
			if (double.IsNaN(property))
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			if (property > 2147483647.0)
			{
				return int.MaxValue;
			}
			if (property < -2147483648.0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return Convert.ToInt32(property);
		}

		{
			EquivLengthCalculated?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		{
			EquivalentLengthModelPropertyChanged?.Invoke(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(sender), new PropertyEventArgs(name));
		}

		private void _InitializeStreamPhases(IFlowStream stream, out IPhase vaporPhase, out IPhase liquidPhase)
		{
			vaporPhase = null;
			liquidPhase = null;
			IFlowStream val = stream;

			double num = _refStream.VaporFraction();

			{
				val.NumberOfPhases = 1;
				liquidPhase = val.GetPhaseByID(1);
			}
			else if (num >= 1.0)
			{
				val.NumberOfPhases = 1;
				vaporPhase = val.GetPhaseByID(1);
			}
			else
			{
				val.NumberOfPhases = 2;
				vaporPhase = val.GetPhaseByID(1);
				liquidPhase = val.GetPhaseByID(2);
			}
			if (vaporPhase != null)
			{
				vaporPhase.PhaseType = (PhaseType)3;
			}
			if (liquidPhase != null)
			{
				liquidPhase.PhaseType = (PhaseType)4;
			}
			val.CombinedLiquidPhase = liquidPhase;
			val = null;
			int numberOfPhases = stream.NumberOfPhases;
			checked
			{
				for (int i = 1; i <= numberOfPhases; i++)
				{
					IPhase phaseByID2 = stream.GetPhaseByID(i);
					if (phaseByID2.NumberOfCompounds == 0)
					{
						int num2 = -1;
						int num3 = _refNumberOfComponents - 1;
						for (int j = 0; j <= num3; j++)
						{
							if (_refComposition[j] > 0.0)
							{
								num2++;
								phaseByID2.AddComponent(phaseByID.GetComponent(num2));
							}
						}
					}
					phaseByID2 = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private int _RefStreamNonzeroComponents()
		{
			int num = 0;
			checked

				int num2 = _refStream.NumberOfComponents() - 1;

				{
					if (_refStream.get_Composition(i) > 0.0)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public string UOMPDrop => UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar;

		public double InPDrop
		{
			get
			{
				if (LineRating is RigorousLineRating rigorousLineRating)
				{
					return rigorousLineRating.InletPressureDrop.ValueIn(Units.bar);
				}
				if (LineRating is HomogeneousLineRating homogeneousLineRating)
				{
					return homogeneousLineRating.InletPressureDrop.ValueIn(Units.bar);
				}
				if (LineRating is SinglePhaseLineRating singlePhaseLineRating)
				{
					return singlePhaseLineRating.InletPressureDrop.ValueIn(Units.bar);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_inletPdropProperty))
				{
					SetProperty(_inletPdropProperty, value, notify: true, Units.bar);
				}
			}
		}

		public string UOMMaxPDrop => UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar;

		public double InMaxPDrop
		{
			get
			{
				if (LineRating == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && ((PSVValveModel)OwnerPRD).IsRemoteSensingPilot && !double.IsNaN(AppliedInletPressureDrop))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return LineRating.InletMaxPressureDrop.ValueIn(Units.bar);
			}

		}

		public double InPressDropFrac
		{
			get
			{
				double result = double.NaN;
				if ((this.get_SetPress(notify: true) > 0.0) & !double.IsNaN(this.get_SetPress(notify: true)))
				{
					result = InPDrop / this.get_SetPress(notify: true);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public double OutPressDropFrac
		{
			get
			{
				double result = double.NaN;
				if ((this.get_SetPress(notify: true) > 0.0) & !double.IsNaN(this.get_SetPress(notify: true)))
				{
					result = OutPDrop / this.get_SetPress(notify: true);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public string UOMUpratedFlow => UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh;

		public double UpratedFlow
		{
			get
			{
				if (PipeLineConstraintsDefinition == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				int? num = (int?)this.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					double num2 = PipeLineConstraintsDefinition.UpratedFlow.ValueIn(Units.kg_per_h);
					if ((num2 <= 0.0) | double.IsNaN(num2))
					{
						double scaling = RatingValveArea / SelectOrifice;
						num2 = GetDefaultLineSizingFlow(notify, scaling);
						SetProperty(s_UpratedFlow, num2, notify: false, Units.kg_per_h);
					}
					return num2;
				}
				UpdateLineSizingFlow(notify);
				return PipeLineConstraintsDefinition.UpratedFlow.ValueIn(Units.kg_per_h);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(s_UpratedFlow, value, notify, Units.kg_per_h);
			}
		}

			get

				{
					return this.get_UpratedFlow(notify: true);
				}
				if (PipeLineConstraintsDefinition == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return PipeLineConstraintsDefinition.UpratedFlow.ValueIn(Units.kg_per_h);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(s_CalcMassFlowrate, value, notify, Units.kg_per_h);
				UpdateLOverDPercOrificeUsed();
			}
		}

					UpdateLineSizingFlow(notify);

			}

		public MessageLevel LineSizingMessageLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (mLineSizingMessages != null)
				{
					PSVMessage lineSizingDisplayMessage = GetLineSizingDisplayMessage();
					if (lineSizingDisplayMessage != null)
					{
						return lineSizingDisplayMessage.MessageLevel;
					}
				}
				return MessageLevel.Ok;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<string> AllLineSizingMessages
		{
			get
			{
				IList<PSVMessage> list = mLineSizingMessages.ObjectMessages(this);
				List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
				foreach (PSVMessage item in list)
				{
					if (IsLineSizingMessage(item) || item.MessageLocation == MessageLocation.RDFlowResistance)
					{
						list2.Add(item.Message);
					}
				}
				return list2;
			}
		}

		public string LineSizingMessages
		{
			get
			{
				if (mLineSizingMessages != null)
				{
					PSVMessage lineSizingDisplayMessage = GetLineSizingDisplayMessage();
					if (lineSizingDisplayMessage != null)
					{
						return lineSizingDisplayMessage.Message;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public bool IsLineSizingRatingMode
		{
			get
			{
				return ((LineRating is RigorousLineRating rigorousLineRating) ? rigorousLineRating.InRatingMode.Value : ((bool?)null)) == true;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value && this.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) != LineSizingMethod.Rigorous)
				{
					PRDSystem.ChangeLineSizingType(this, LineSizingMethod.Rigorous, value, notify: true);
				}
				else if (LineRating is RigorousLineRating rigorousLineRating)
				{
					bool num = rigorousLineRating.InRatingMode.Specify(value, new UserSpecifier());
					((PRDModel)base.Owner).Model.SwitchPipingMode(value);
					if (num)
					{
						NotifyPropertyChanged("IsLineSizingRatingMode");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public double LineSizingCriticalPressure
		{
			get
			{
				if (LineRating is RigorousLineRating rigorousLineRating)
				{
					return rigorousLineRating.CriticalPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Absolute);
				}
				if (LineRating is SinglePhaseLineRating singlePhaseLineRating)
				{
					return singlePhaseLineRating.CriticalPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Absolute);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(s_LineSizingCriticalPressure, value, notify: true, Units.bar, byUser: true, PressureReference.Absolute);
			}
		}

		public string s_ScenarioDesc => s_GENScenarioDescr;

		public string s_RelievingFlow
		{
			get
			{
				OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
				switch (EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case EmergScenarioType.Blocked_Outlet:
					return s_BORelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Control_Valve_Failure:
					if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid)
					{
						return s_VFLRelievingFlow;
					}
					return "VFRelievingFlow";
				case EmergScenarioType.Cooling_Water_Failure:
					return s_CWFRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Exch_Tube_Rupture:
					return s_TRRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fan_Failure:
					return s_FFRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fire:
					if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor)
					{
						return "FIRECalcRelFlow";
					}
					return s_GENRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.General_Power_Failure:
					return s_GPFRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Reflux_Failure:
					if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor)
					{
						return s_RFRelievingFlow;
					}
					return s_GENRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Thermal_Expansion:
					if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid)
					{
						return s_TERelievingFlow;
					}
					return s_GENRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.User_Defined:
					return s_GENRelievingFlow;
				default:
					return s_GENRelievingFlow;
				}
			}
		}

		public string s_UOMRelievingFlow
		{
			get
			{
				OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
				switch (EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case EmergScenarioType.Blocked_Outlet:
					return s_BOUOMRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Control_Valve_Failure:
					if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3)
					{
						return s_VFLUOMRelievingFlow;
					}
					return "VFUOMRelievingFlow";
				case EmergScenarioType.Cooling_Water_Failure:
					return s_CWFUOMRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Exch_Tube_Rupture:
					return s_TRUOMRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fan_Failure:
					return s_FFUOMRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fire:
					if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor)
					{
						return "FIREUOMCalcRelFlow";
					}
					return s_GENUOMRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.General_Power_Failure:
					return s_GPFUOMRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Reflux_Failure:
					if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor)
					{
						return s_RFUOMRelievingFlow;
					}
					return s_GENUOMRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.Thermal_Expansion:
					if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3)
					{
						return s_TEUOMRelievingFlow;
					}
					return s_GENUOMRelievingFlow;
				case EmergScenarioType.User_Defined:
					return s_GENUOMRelievingFlow;
				default:
					return s_GENUOMRelievingFlow;
				}
			}
		}

		public ProcessDataSource RelFlowSource
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.MassFlowSource.Value ?? ProcessDataSource.Specified;
			}
			set
			{
				if (NeedFireVessels(EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault(), value))
				{
					CreateFireVessels();
				}
				if ((this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated) & (this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) != value))
				{
					if (EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
					{
						SetProperty(s_RelFlowSource, (ProcessDataSource?)value, notify: false, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null);
						ResetRelTempSource(notify: false);
						mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
						FluidPhaseRegime? value2 = base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.Phase.Value;
						UpdateReliefPhase(notify: false);
						if (notify)
						{
							NotifyPropertyChanged(s_RelFlowSource);
							NotifyPropertyChanged(s_RelTempSource);
							int? num = (int?)base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.Phase.Value;
							int? num2 = (int?)value2;
							if (((num.HasValue & num2.HasValue) ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() != num2.GetValueOrDefault()) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
							{
								NotifyPropertyChanged(s_Phase);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						SetProperty(s_RelFlowSource, (ProcessDataSource?)value, notify, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null);
					}
					ResetRelTempSource(notify);
				}
				else
				{
					SetProperty(s_RelFlowSource, (ProcessDataSource?)value, notify, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null);
				}
				double curValue = double.NaN;
				VerifyRelievingFlow(ref curValue, notify);
			}
		}

		public bool RelFlowCanBeCalculated
		{
			get
			{
				if (!EmergencyType.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault() switch
				{
					EmergScenarioType.Exch_Tube_Rupture => true, 
					EmergScenarioType.Control_Valve_Failure => true, 
					EmergScenarioType.Fan_Failure => true, 
					EmergScenarioType.Fire => true, 
					EmergScenarioType.Reflux_Failure => true, 
					EmergScenarioType.Thermal_Expansion => true, 
					_ => false, 
				};
			}
		}

		public double Coeff_Kd
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Model.OrificeSizing is PsvOrificeSizing psvOrificeSizing))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (KdSource.HasValue && KdSource.Value == ProcessDataSource.Reference && psvOrificeSizing.Kd.Specify(GetReferenceKd(), new CalculationSpecifier()) && notify)
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged("Coeff_Kd");
				}
				return psvOrificeSizing.Kd.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(base.Model.OrificeSizing is PsvOrificeSizing psvOrificeSizing))
				{
					return;
				}
				int? num;
				if (double.IsNaN(value))
				{
					num = (int?)KdSource;
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
					{
						KdSource = ProcessDataSource.Reference;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num = (int?)KdSource;
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
					{
						KdSource = ProcessDataSource.Specified;
					}
				}
				num = (int?)KdSource;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					psvOrificeSizing.Kd.Specify(value, new UserSpecifier());
					if (notify)
					{
						NotifyPropertyChanged("Coeff_Kd");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					this.get_Coeff_Kd(notify);
				}
			}
		}

		public ProcessDataSource? KdSource
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Model.OrificeSizing is PsvOrificeSizing psvOrificeSizing))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return psvOrificeSizing.KdSource.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Model.OrificeSizing is PsvOrificeSizing psvOrificeSizing)
				{
					psvOrificeSizing.KdSource.Specify(value, new UserSpecifier());
				}
			}
		}

		private string s_PhaseSpecific_Coeff_Kd
		{
			get
			{
				OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
				if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
				{
					return s_RDCoeff_Kd;
				}
				if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid)
				{
					return s_Coeff_Kd_liquid;
				}
				if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1 || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2 || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct)
				{
					return s_Coeff_Kd_2ph;
				}
				if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3)
				{
					return s_Coeff_Kd_2ph_B;
				}
				if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Steam)
				{
					return s_Coeff_Kd;
				}
				return s_Coeff_Kd_2ph_B;
			}
		}

		public bool IsValveApiValve
		{
			get
			{
				if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.Model?.DetailedReliefDevice?.ReliefOrifice?.IsBuiltInOrifice?.Value == true)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if ((base.Model?.DetailedReliefDevice?.ReliefOrifice?.Designation?.Value).HasValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{

		protected string APlusRefStreamPath
		{
			get
			{
				string result = null;
				string chosenStream = ChosenStream;
				checked
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(chosenStream))
					{
						int length = ScenarioNodeKey.LastIndexOf(".PSVScenario.");
						result = ScenarioNodeKey.Substring(0, length);
						string[] array = chosenStream.Split('.');
						int num = array.Length - 2;
						for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
						{
							result = result + ".Blocks." + array[i] + ".Data";
						}
						result = result + ".Streams." + array[array.Length - 1];
					}
					return result;
				}
			}
		}

		public double SpecifiedOverpressurePct
		{
			get
			{
				return this.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			}
			set
			{
				PRDModel pRDModel = (PRDModel)base.Owner;
				if (PRDSystem.OverallPRDModel != base.Owner && !PRDSystem.get_IsSplitPRDModelControlling(pRDModel))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal error: Trying to set UI overpressure for a valve that is neither the \"overall\" PRD nor the \"A\" PRD.");
				}
				if (PRDSystem.OverallPRDModel != base.Owner)
				{
					PRDSystem.OverallPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel().SpecifiedOverpressurePct = value;
					return;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				if (Math.Abs(value - GetDefaultOverpressurePct(EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault())) > 0.1)
				{
					PRDSystem.IsUsingAPIArrangement = false;
					UseCustomOverpressure = true;
				}
				else
				{
					if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(value, this.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true), 1E-06, 1E-06))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					UseCustomOverpressure = false;
				}
				bool flag2 = false;
				try
				{
					_overPressureChangeAction.IsEnabled = false;
					flag2 = SetProperty("OverPress", Fraction.FromPercent(value), notify: false);
				}
				finally
				{
					_overPressureChangeAction.IsEnabled = true;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					UpdateReliefPressure(notify: false);
				}
				PRDSystem.UpdateSplitOverpressures(this);
				if (flag2 || flag)
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged("OverPress");
				}
				if (pRDModel is PSVValveModel && (((PSVValveModel)pRDModel).ValveType ?? PsvType.Conventional) == PsvType.Conventional)
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged(s_MaxAllowBPPercent);
				}
				RaiseScenarioModelPropertyChangedEvent(null, "RelPress");
			}
		}

		public FireCalcMethod? FIRECalcMethod
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Model?.ReliefScenario?.ReliefLoad?.ReliefLoadCalculation is Fire fire)
				{
					return fire.CalculationMethod.Value;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(ReliefLoadCalculation is Fire))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (((value ?? FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted) == FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous) & (this.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) != LineSizingMethod.Homogeneous) & (this.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) != LineSizingMethod.Rigorous))
				{
					bool cancel = false;
					LineSizingMethodChanging?.Invoke(ref cancel);
					if (cancel)
					{
						RaiseScenarioDataChanged();
						return;
					}
				}
				bool flag = SetProperty("FIRECalcMethod", value, notify: false);
				checked
				{
					try
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							FreezeEventPublication++;
						}
						RegisterProperties();
						if (flag && value.HasValue)
						{
							EraseProperty<bool>("FireIsTwoPhaseRelief", byUser: false);
							UpdateReliefPhase(notify: false);
							if (value.GetValueOrDefault() != FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted && value != FireCalcMethod.NFPA30 && value != FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted)
							{
								_RestrictToSingleVessel();
							}
							SelectedFireMethodChanged?.Invoke();
							UpdateSizingMethod(notify: false);
						}
						if (flag && notify)
						{
							NotifyPropertyChanged("FIRECalcMethod");
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							FreezeEventPublication--;
							if (unchecked((long)FreezeEventPublication) == 0L)
							{
								PRDSystem.OnSystemUpdateRequired();
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

					return FireAreaStandard.NFPA30;
				}
				return FireAreaStandard.Api521;
			}
		}

		public string[] FIREComponentNames
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.ReliefLoadCalculation is Fire fire))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return fire.FireFlashManager?.ComponentNames?.Values;
			}
			set
			{
				FireFlashManager fireFlashManager = (base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.ReliefLoadCalculation as Fire)?.FireFlashManager;
				if (fireFlashManager != null)
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						fireFlashManager.ComponentNames.Specify(value, new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
					else
					{
						fireFlashManager.ComponentNames.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool FireCalculateDisengagement
		{
			get
			{
				return ((!(ReliefLoadCalculation is Fire fire)) ? ((bool?)null) : fire.CalculateDisengagement?.Value) == true;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ReliefLoadCalculation is Fire fire)
				{
					SetProperty((bool?)value, notify: false, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null, "FireCalculateDisengagement");
					if (value && fire.DisengagementFluid == null)
					{
						fire.VerifyDisengagementFluid();
						_RegisterDisengagementFluidProperties();
					}
					if (value)
					{
						_RestrictToSingleVessel();
					}
					else
					{
						FireVesselCountChanged?.Invoke();
					}
					NotifyPropertyChanged("FireCalculateDisengagement");
				}
			}
		}

		private bool _FireIsCustomVesselModel
		{
			get
			{
				int? num = (int?)FireDisengagementVesselFlowModel;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public double FireSelectedC0
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(ReliefLoadCalculation is Fire fire) || !FireDisengagementRegime.HasValue || !FireCalculateDisengagement)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (FireDisengagementRegime.GetValueOrDefault() == DisengagementRegime.ChurnTurbulent)
				{
					return fire.C0ChurnTurbulent.Value;
				}
				return fire.C0Bubbly.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ReliefLoadCalculation is Fire fire && FireDisengagementRegime.HasValue)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					if ((FireDisengagementRegime.GetValueOrDefault() != DisengagementRegime.ChurnTurbulent) ? fire.C0Bubbly.Specify(value, new UserSpecifier()) : fire.C0ChurnTurbulent.Specify(value, new UserSpecifier()))
					{
						NotifyPropertyChanged("FireSelectedC0");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<FireCalcMethod> FireValidMethods
		{
			get
			{
				switch (this.get_OpPhase(notify: true))
				{
				case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
				case FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical:
					if (FIREVesselList == null || FireVesselCount == 1)
					{
						return new FireCalcMethod[2]
						{
							FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted,
							FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous
						};
					}
					return new FireCalcMethod[1] { FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted };
				case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
				case FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase:
					if (FIREVesselList == null || FireVesselCount == 1)
					{
						return new FireCalcMethod[4]
						{
							FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted,
							FireCalcMethod.NFPA30,
							FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous,
							FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous
						};
					}
					return new FireCalcMethod[2]
					{
						FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted,
						FireCalcMethod.NFPA30
					};
				default:
					return Enumerable.Empty<FireCalcMethod>();
				}
			}
		}

		public int FireVesselCount => FIREVesselList.Where([SpecialName] (Vessel_FireCalcModel v) => v.get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false)).Count();

					switch (value)
					{
					case ProcessDataSource.Calculated:
						this.set_TECoeff_B_Method(notify: true, CubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod.Equation);
						break;
					case ProcessDataSource.Specified:
						this.set_TECoeff_B_Method(notify: true, CubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod.Specified);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public double TRFlowCoefficient
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(ReliefLoadCalculation is TubeRupture tubeRupture))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (!tubeRupture.TubeToShell.Value.HasValue)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (tubeRupture.TubeToShell.Value.Value)
				{
					return tubeRupture.FlowCoefficientToShell.Value;
				}
				return tubeRupture.FlowCoefficientToTube.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ReliefLoadCalculation is TubeRupture tubeRupture && tubeRupture.TubeToShell.Value.HasValue)
				{
					if (tubeRupture.TubeToShell.Value.Value)
					{
						tubeRupture.FlowCoefficientToShell.Specify(value, new UserSpecifier());
					}
					else
					{
						tubeRupture.FlowCoefficientToTube.Specify(value, new UserSpecifier());
					}
					NotifyPropertyChanged(s_TRFlowCoefficient);
				}
			}
		}

		public ControlValveSizingSource VFMassFlowCalcMethod
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(ReliefLoadCalculation is ControlValveFailure controlValveFailure) || !controlValveFailure.MassFlowCalculationMethod.Value.HasValue)
				{
					return ControlValveSizingSource.ISA;
				}
				return controlValveFailure.MassFlowCalculationMethod.Value.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			set
			{
				bool flag = false;
				try
				{
					checked
					{
						FreezeEventPublication++;
					}
					flag = SetProperty("VFMassFlowCalcMethod", (ControlValveSizingSource?)value, notify: true, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null);
					UpdateCvCg();
					UpdateVFFormEvent?.Invoke();
				}
				finally
				{
					checked
					{
						FreezeEventPublication--;
					}
					if (flag && (long)FreezeEventPublication == 0L)
					{
						PRDSystem.OnSystemUpdateRequired();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateLineSizingFlow(bool notify = true)
		{
			double num = RatingValveArea / SelectOrifice;
			if (PipeLine == null || PipeLineConstraintsDefinition == null || this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (this.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true).HasValue)
			{
				int? num2 = (int?)this.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
				if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2 == 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					this.set_LineSizingFlow(notify, this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true));
					return;
				}
				num2 = (int?)this.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
				if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					this.set_LineSizingFlow(notify, SelCapacity * num);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				this.set_LineSizingFlow(notify, GetDefaultLineSizingFlow(notify, num));
			}
		}

		internal void OnLineSizingMethodChanged(bool notify = true)

			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("LineSizingMethod");
			}
		}

		public void AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel level, string message, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.LineSizing)
		{
			mLineSizingMessages.AddMessage(level, message, this, location);
		}

		public void AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel level, string message, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.LineSizingConstraints)
		{
			mLineSizingMessages.AddMessage(level, message, this, location);
		}

		public void ClearLineSizingMessages(MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.LineSizing)
		{
			mLineSizingMessages.ClearMessages(this, location);
			ClearScenarioMessages(location);
			if (location != MessageLocation.LineSizingConstraints)
			{
				mLineSizingMessages.ClearMessages(this, MessageLocation.LineSizingConstraints);
				ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.LineSizingConstraints);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel level, string message, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.LineSizing)
		{
			mLineSizingMessages.RemoveMessage(level, message, location, null, this);
		}

		public PSVMessage GetLineSizingDisplayMessage()
		{
			PSVMessage pSVMessage = null;
			IList<PSVMessage> list = mLineSizingMessages.ObjectMessages(this);
			foreach (PSVMessage item in list)
			{
				if (IsLineSizingMessage(item) || item.MessageLocation == MessageLocation.RDFlowResistance)
				{
					if (pSVMessage == null)
					{
						pSVMessage = item;
					}
					else if (item.MessageLevel > pSVMessage.MessageLevel)
					{
						pSVMessage = item;
					}
				}
			}
			return pSVMessage;
		}

		internal static bool IsLineSizingMessage(PSVMessage message)
		{
			MessageLocation messageLocation = message.MessageLocation;
			return messageLocation == MessageLocation.LineSizing || messageLocation == MessageLocation.LineSizingConstraints;
		}

		public void NotifyLineSizingMessagesPropertyChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("LineSizingMessages");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SCLineSizingMessages");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("LineSizingMessageLevel");
		}

		private double GetDefaultLineSizingFlow(bool notify, double scaling = 1.0)
		{
			if (!this.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true).HasValue)
			{
				EmergScenarioType num = base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefDescription.EmergencyType.Value ?? EmergScenarioType.User_Defined;
				OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = base.Model.ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value ?? OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct;
				if (num == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
				{
					this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.Required);
				}
				else if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3)
				{
					this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.Required);
				}
				else
				{
					this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.RatedArea);
				}
			}
			int? num2 = (int?)this.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
			if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2 == 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
			{
				return this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
			}
			num2 = (int?)this.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
			if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
			{
				return RatedFlow * scaling;
			}
			double result = default(double);
			return result;
		}

		protected IEnumerable<LineSizingMethod> AllowedLineSizingModels(OrificeSizingMethod method)
		{
			List<LineSizingMethod> list = new List<LineSizingMethod>();
			if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && method == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				list.Add(LineSizingMethod.Rigorous);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(LineSizingMethod.Rigorous);
				if (method == OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor || method == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid || method == OrificeSizingMethod.Steam)
				{
					list.Add(LineSizingMethod.SinglePhase);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(LineSizingMethod.Homogeneous);
					if (PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && method != OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct)
					{
						list.Add(LineSizingMethod.Omega);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected LineSizingMethod DefaultLineSizingModel(OrificeSizingMethod method)
		{
			return LineSizingMethod.Rigorous;
		}

		public void ValidateLineSizingMethod(bool notify)
		{
			if (!AllowedLineSizingModels(this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true)).Contains(this.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true)))
			{
				PRDSystem.ChangeLineSizingType(this, DefaultLineSizingModel(this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true)), isRatingMode: false, notify);
			}
		}

		public void ForceCalculateRigorousLineSizing()
		{
			ClearLineSizingMessages();
			mPSVCalc.CalculateRigorousLineSize(force: true);
		}

			VB$AnonymousDelegate_0<MessageLevel, string> vB$AnonymousDelegate_ = [SpecialName] (MessageLevel level, string message) =>

			};
			PSVCalculation pSVCalculation = mPSVCalc;

			_IsLineSizingReady = pSVCalculation.IsLineSizingReady((vB$AnonymousDelegate_2 == null) ? null : new PSVCalculation.AddMessageDelegate(vB$AnonymousDelegate_2.Invoke));
		}

		public void Initialize(string psvNodeKey, string scenarioName, PsvKey scenarioKey, PRDModel owner, PrdConstraintsDefinition prdConstraintsDefinition, IPPPFluid fluid = null, PSVScenarioModel MasterScenarioModel = null, bool createAsFrozen = false)
		{
			base.Initialize(ref scenarioKey, "", owner, prdConstraintsDefinition);
			if (createAsFrozen)
			{
				FreezeEventPublication = 1u;
			}
			_prdType = prdConstraintsDefinition.ReliefDevice.ReliefDeviceType;
			mPPPFluid = fluid;
			RegisterProperties();
			mScenarioMessages.Initialize(prdConstraintsDefinition);
			_overPressureChangeAction = _AddPropertyChangeAction("OverPress", [SpecialName] () =>
			{
				if (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null)
				{
					UpdateReliefPressure(notify: false);
				}
				_UpdateSplitOverpressure(notify: false);
				RaiseScenarioModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "RelPress");
			});
			_AmbientChangeRecalculate = new _ProcessVarChangeAction([SpecialName] () =>
			{
				Calculate(isForced: true);
			});
			SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.AmbientPressure.AddAffectedProcessAction(_AmbientChangeRecalculate);
			_FireCompositionStorageChangeRecalculate = new _ProcessVarChangeAction([SpecialName] () =>
			{
				RecalculateSemidynamicFireForCompositions();
			});
			SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.StoreCompositionsForStepFireCalculations.AddAffectedProcessAction(_FireCompositionStorageChangeRecalculate);
			if (mRefMasterScenarioModel != this)
			{
				mRefMasterScenarioModel = MasterScenarioModel;
				if (mRefMasterScenarioModel != null)
				{
					mRefMasterScenarioModel.OrificeMethodChanging += OnOrificeMethodChanging;
					MasterScenarioModel.PropertyChanged += OnMasterPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				mRefMasterScenarioModel = null;
			}
			mPSVSettings = GetPsvSettings();
			mPSVSettings.PropertyChanged += PSVSettings_PropertyChanged;
			PRDSystem.SplitModelCountChanged += PRDSystemModel_SplitModelCountChanged;
			owner.PropertyChanged += OnOwnerPropertyChanged;
			PRDSystem.PropertyChanged += OnOwnerPropertyChanged;
			mRefSplitCount = PRDSystem.SplitPRDModels.Count;
			mRefOrigOverP = this.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			mScenarioSettings = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ScenarioSettingsModel>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			mPSVCalc = new PSVCalculation(this);
			mPSVCalc.PhysicalPropPkgFluid = mPPPFluid;
			if ((EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire) & (this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated))
			{
				CreateFireVessels();
				_CreateFireIterationResults();
			}
			if (this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct)
			{
				_CreateDirectIntegrationTable();
			}
			_psvNodeKey = base.Simulator.PSVNavigationStrings.ExtractPsvNodeKey(psvNodeKey);
			UpdateOpPhase(notify: false);
			ScenarioUpdates(EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault(), null, notify: false);
			SetBuiltUpBackpressure(notify: false);
			if (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null)
			{
				UpdateReliefPressure(notify: false);
			}
			Host = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).PSVHostType;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(scenarioName))
			{
				ScenarioName = scenarioName;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Fluid))
			{
				Fluid = ChosenStream;
			}
			mPSVCalc.RanCalculations += base.CatchRanCalculations;
			ValidateLineSizingMethod(notify: true);
			_RestoreLineSizingReady();
		}

		private void RegisterDetailedReliefDeviceProperties()
		{
			Properties.Remove(s_ValveInSize);
			Properties.Remove(s_ValveOutSize);
			Properties.Remove(s_ValveInRating);
			Properties.Remove(s_ValveOutRating);
			Properties.Remove(s_ValveDesignation);
			if (base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice != null)
			{
				Properties.Add(s_ValveInSize, base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter);
				Properties.Add(s_ValveOutSize, base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter);
				Properties.Add(s_ValveInRating, base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating);
				Properties.Add(s_ValveOutRating, base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating);
				if (base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice is PsvOrifice psvOrifice)
				{
					Properties.Add(s_ValveDesignation, psvOrifice.Designation);
				}
				if (base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice is RuptureDiskOrifice ruptureDiskOrifice)
				{
					Properties.Add(s_ValveDesignation, ruptureDiskOrifice.Designation);
				}
			}
		}

		public void EnsureLineSizingModelsExist()
		{
			base.Model.ReliefScenario.GetOrCreateLineRating(base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice.PipeLine);
			foreach (ReliefDevice reliefDevice in base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices)
			{
				base.Model.ReliefScenario.GetOrCreateLineRating(reliefDevice.PipeLine);
				base.Model.ReliefScenario.GetOrCreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinition(reliefDevice.PipeLine).UpdatePipeLineRatingModeSetting();
			}
			RegisterProperties();
		}

		public override void UpdateDataPath(string path)
		{
			base.UpdateDataPath(path);
			if (string.Equals(Host, "ASPENPLUS"))
			{
				int num = path.LastIndexOf(".Streams.");
				if (num != -1)
				{
					_psvNodeKey = path.Substring(0, num);
				}
			}
			UpdateFluidDataPath();
		}

		private void UpdateFluidDataPath()
		{
			IPSVCXSModel iPSVCXSModel = (IPSVCXSModel)mPPPFluid;
			if (iPSVCXSModel != null)
			{
				if (string.Equals(Host, "ASPENPLUS"))
				{
					iPSVCXSModel.CXSDataPath = ScenarioNodeKey;
				}
				else
				{
					iPSVCXSModel.CXSDataPath = ScenarioNodeKey + "." + base.Simulator.PSVNavigationStrings.ScenarioFluid;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshFluid()
		{
			mPPPFluid?.ReinitializeFluid();
		}

		internal void SetPrdType(ReliefDeviceType newType)
		{
			if (_prdType != newType)
			{
				_prdType = newType;
			}
		}

		public override bool DataIsConsistent()
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal void Unlink()
		{
			SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.AmbientPressure.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(_AmbientChangeRecalculate);
			_AmbientChangeRecalculate = null;
			SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.StoreCompositionsForStepFireCalculations.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(_FireCompositionStorageChangeRecalculate);
			_FireCompositionStorageChangeRecalculate = null;
			mPSVSettings.PropertyChanged -= PSVSettings_PropertyChanged;
			PRDSystem.SplitModelCountChanged -= PRDSystemModel_SplitModelCountChanged;
			mPSVCalc.RanCalculations -= base.CatchRanCalculations;
			((PRDModel)base.Owner).PropertyChanged -= OnOwnerPropertyChanged;
			PRDSystem.PropertyChanged -= OnOwnerPropertyChanged;
			if (mRefMasterScenarioModel != null)
			{
				mRefMasterScenarioModel.OrificeMethodChanging -= OnOrificeMethodChanging;
				mRefMasterScenarioModel.PropertyChanged -= OnMasterPropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		public override void Delete()
		{
			ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.Anywhere);
			Unlink();
			base.Delete();
		}

		public void CopyDataFrom(PSVScenarioModel sourceScenario)
		{
			if (sourceScenario == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PrdConstraintsDefinition model = sourceScenario.Model;
			string scenarioName = ScenarioName;
			if (!IsRatingCalc)
			{
				base.Model.ReliefScenario.CopyFrom(model.ReliefScenario, onlyUserSpecified: false);
				base.Model.ReliefScenario.Name.Specify(scenarioName, new UserSpecifier());
				base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefDescription.CopyFrom(model.ReliefScenario.ReliefDescription, onlyUserSpecified: false);
				base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.CopyFrom(model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad, onlyUserSpecified: false);
				IDictionary<ReliefLoadCalculationType, ReliefLoadCalculation> reliefLoadCalculations = model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.ReliefLoadCalculations;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<ReliefLoadCalculationType, ReliefLoadCalculation> reliefLoadCalculation in base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.ReliefLoadCalculations)
				{
					if (reliefLoadCalculations.ContainsKey(reliefLoadCalculation.Key))
					{
						reliefLoadCalculation.Value.CopyFrom(reliefLoadCalculations[reliefLoadCalculation.Key], onlyUserSpecified: false);
					}
				}
			}
			try
			{
				if (IsRatingCalc)
				{
					_overPressureChangeAction.IsEnabled = false;
				}
				base.Model.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				_overPressureChangeAction.IsEnabled = true;
			}
			if (IsRatingCalc)
			{
				_UpdateOverpressurePct(EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault(), null, notify: false, DoChainUpdates: false, force: true);
			}
			base.Model.ValidateOrificeSizingModelType();
			base.Model.SetReliefOrifice(model.DetailedReliefDevice?.ReliefOrifice, IsSizingCase);
			base.Model.OrificeSizing.CopyFrom(model.OrificeSizing, onlyUserSpecified: false);
			PipeLineConstraintsDefinition pipeLineConstraintsDefinition = base.Model.ReliefScenario.PipeLineConstraints[base.Model.ReliefDevice.PipeLine];
			PipeLineConstraintsDefinition pipeLineConstraintsDefinition2 = model.ReliefScenario.PipeLineConstraints[model.ReliefDevice.PipeLine];
			pipeLineConstraintsDefinition.CopyFrom(pipeLineConstraintsDefinition2, onlyUserSpecified: false);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<LineSizingMethod, LineRating> allLineRating in pipeLineConstraintsDefinition.AllLineRatings)
			{
				if (pipeLineConstraintsDefinition2.AllLineRatings.ContainsKey(allLineRating.Key))
				{
					allLineRating.Value.CopyFrom(pipeLineConstraintsDefinition2.AllLineRatings[allLineRating.Key], onlyUserSpecified: false);
				}
			}
			RegisterProperties();
			if (!NeedFireVessels(EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault(), this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true)))
			{
				return;
			}
			CreateFireVessels(sourceScenario.FIREVesselList.Count);
			if (IsRatingCalc)
			{
				return;
			}
			Fire fire = base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.ReliefLoadCalculation as Fire;
			Fire fire2 = model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.ReliefLoadCalculation as Fire;
			checked
			{
				if (fire != null && fire2 != null)
				{
					int num = fire2.Vessels.Count - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
					{
						fire.Vessels.ElementAt(i).CopyFrom(fire2.Vessels.ElementAt(i), onlyUserSpecified: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		}

		public bool NeedFireVessels(EmergScenarioType emergencyType, ProcessDataSource relSource)
		{
			if (relSource == ProcessDataSource.Calculated && emergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
			{
				if (FIREVesselList != null)
				{
					return FIREVesselList.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CreateFireVessels(int numberRequired = 1)
		{
			checked
			{
				if (base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.ReliefLoadCalculation is Fire fire)
				{
					for (int i = 1; i <= numberRequired; i++)
					{
						s_FIREVesselList = new _FireVesselList(uContainer, this, fire);
						s_FIREVesselList[i - 1].set_FIREVesselActive(notify: false, value: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void _CreateFireIterationResults()
		{
			Fire fire = base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.ReliefLoadCalculation as Fire;
			checked
			{
				if (fire?.FireFlashManager?.Iterations != null)
				{
					int num = fire.FireFlashManager.Iterations.Count - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
					{
						IterationResultRLCFireModel iterationResultRLCFireModel = new IterationResultRLCFireModel(uContainer);
						PsvKey dbKey = null;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.Initialize(ref dbKey, null, this, fire.FireFlashManager.Iterations[i]);
						s_FIREIterationList.Add(iterationResultRLCFireModel);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IterationResultRLCFireModel CreateIterationResult(int i, bool multiphase)
		{
			FireCalculationIteration dataModel = ((Fire)base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.ReliefLoadCalculation).FireFlashManager.CreateIteration();
			if (i == 1)
			{
				s_FIREIterationList = new List<IterationResultRLCFireModel>();
			}
			IterationResultRLCFireModel iterationResultRLCFireModel = new IterationResultRLCFireModel(uContainer);
			PsvKey dbKey = null;
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.Initialize(ref dbKey, "", this, dataModel);
			s_FIREIterationList.Add(iterationResultRLCFireModel);
			return iterationResultRLCFireModel;
		}

		}

		public void ValvePressureChanged(bool notify = true)
		{
			if (IsRatingCalc)
			{
				_UpdateOverpressurePct(EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault(), null, notify);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateReliefPressure(notify);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(this.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true)))
			{
				SetBuiltUpBackpressure(notify);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Model.CalculateBuiltupBackpressureIfNecessary();
			}
			CalculateTotBackPress(notify);
			if (notify)
			{
				ValveSetPressChanged?.Invoke();
				CatchRanCalculations(this, new RanCalculationsEventArgs(recalculateRatingModels: true));
			}
		}

		public void SetBuiltUpBackpressure(bool notify = true)
		{
			if (mPSVSettings.BuiltUpBackpressureSource == BuiltUpBackpressureSource.PctOfSet)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(this.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true)) && !double.IsNaN(mPSVSettings.BuiltUpBackPressurePctOfSet))
				{
					double value = this.get_SetPress(notify: true) * (mPSVSettings.BuiltUpBackPressurePctOfSet / 100.0);
					this.set_BuiltupBackPress(notify, value);
				}
			}
			else if (mPSVSettings.BuiltUpBackpressureSource == BuiltUpBackpressureSource.Fixed && double.IsNaN(this.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true)) && !double.IsNaN(mPSVSettings.BuiltUpBackPressureBar))
			{
				this.set_BuiltupBackPress(notify, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UOMBuiltupBackPress, mPSVSettings.BuiltUpBackPressureBar, "GaugePressure"));
			}
		}

		public void UpdateModelReference(PRDModel newOwner)
		{
			PrdConstraintsDefinition model = base.Model;
			if (base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.IndexOf(base.Model.ReliefDevice) == -1)
			{
				_ProcessVarChangeAction onChangedAction = _RemovePropertyChangeAction("OverPress");
				double value = this.get_RelFlow(notify: true);
				int legacyKey = base.Model.LegacyKey;
				base.Model.FixUpLegacyKey(checked(-legacyKey));
				SetModel(base.Model.ReliefScenario.PrdConstraints[base.Model.ReliefScenario.PressureProtectionRequirement.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice]);
				base.Model.FixUpLegacyKey(legacyKey);
				RegisterProperties();
				SetBuiltUpBackpressure(notify: false);
				UpdateOverpressure();
				ValidateLineSizingMethod(notify: false);
				this.set_RelFlow(notify: false, value);
				_AddPropertyChangeAction("OverPress", onChangedAction);
			}
			PrdConstraintsDefinition model2 = base.Model;
			mScenarioMessages.ReplaceSource(this, model, model2);
			((PRDModel)base.Owner).PropertyChanged -= OnOwnerPropertyChanged;
			_owner = newOwner;
			newOwner.PropertyChanged += OnOwnerPropertyChanged;
			ErasePRDResults();
			NotifyPropertyChanged("PRDType");
		}

		public void ChangeEmergencyScenario(EmergScenarioType selectedSce)
		{
			EmergScenarioType? emergencyType = EmergencyType;
			if (emergencyType.HasValue && selectedSce == emergencyType.GetValueOrDefault())
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				checked
				{
					FreezeEventPublication++;
					ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.Anywhere, LineSizingMessageLocations);
					double value = this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
					base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefDescription.EmergencyType.Specify(selectedSce, new UserSpecifier());
					RegisterProperties();
					if (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null)
					{
						PRDSystem.UpdateSplitPRDsForScenarioTypeChange(this);
					}
					this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
					if (!RelFlowCanBeCalculated & (this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated))
					{
						this.set_RelFlowSource(notify: false, ProcessDataSource.Specified);
					}
					else if (RelFlowCanBeCalculated)
					{
						this.set_RelFlowSource(notify: false, ProcessDataSource.Calculated);
					}
					if (this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
					{
						this.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, value);
					}
					ScenarioDescr = CalcNotes;
					if (selectedSce == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
					{
						_CreateFireIterationResults();
					}
					ScenarioUpdates(selectedSce, emergencyType, notify: true, doChainOverpressureUpdates: true);
					ResetRelTempSource(notify: false);
				}
				if (selectedSce != EmergScenarioType.Fire)
				{
					int? num = (int?)emergencyType;
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 14) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
					{
						goto IL_0157;
					}
				}
				UpdateReliefPressure(notify: false);
				UpdateReliefPhase(notify: false);
				goto IL_0157;
				IL_0157:
				if (selectedSce == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
				{
					FireVesselCountChanged?.Invoke();
				}
				ScenarioDataChanged?.Invoke();
				NotifyPropertyChanged("NoFire");
			}
			finally
			{
				checked
				{
					FreezeEventPublication--;
				}
				if ((long)FreezeEventPublication == 0L)
				{
					PRDSystem.OnSystemUpdateRequired();
				}
			}
		}

		public void ScenarioUpdates(EmergScenarioType selectedSce, EmergScenarioType? origSce = null, bool notify = true, bool doChainOverpressureUpdates = false)
		{
			if (!origSce.HasValue)
			{
				origSce = selectedSce;
			}
			if (selectedSce == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
			{
				if ((this.get_OpPhase(notify: true) == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor) | (this.get_OpPhase(notify: true) == FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical))
				{
					if (this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true).GetValueOrDefault() == FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted || this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) == FireCalcMethod.NFPA30 || this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) == FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous)
					{
						this.set_FIRECalcMethod(notify: false, (FireCalcMethod?)FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted);
					}
				}
				else if (((this.get_OpPhase(notify: true) == FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid) | (this.get_OpPhase(notify: true) == FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase)) && this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) == FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted)
				{
					this.set_FIRECalcMethod(notify: false, (FireCalcMethod?)FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted);
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(this.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true)))
			{
				set_OverPress(notify, doChainOverpressureUpdates, GetDefaultOverpressurePct(selectedSce));
			}
			else
			{
				_UpdateOverpressurePct(selectedSce, origSce, notify, doChainOverpressureUpdates);
			}
		}

		public void ResetRelTempSource(bool notify)
		{
			if (((this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Reference) | (this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Specified)) && ((this.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference) & (this.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Specified)))
			{
				this.set_RelTempSource(notify, mPSVSettings.NonCalculatedRelievingTemperatureSetting);
			}
			if (EmergencyType != EmergScenarioType.Fire && ((this.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference) | (this.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Specified)))
			{
				this.set_RelTempSource(notify, mPSVSettings.NonCalculatedRelievingTemperatureSetting);
			}
			if (EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire && this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated && this.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference)
			{
				this.set_RelTempSource(notify, ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated);
			}
		}

		internal void ValidateSizingMethod()
		{
			FluidPhaseRegime ePhaseRegime = EPhaseRegime;
			OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
			bool flag = false;
			if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct || (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod && CanExecuteKrMethodSizing && PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk))
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod && (!CanExecuteKrMethodSizing || PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk))
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			else
			{
				switch (ePhaseRegime)
				{
				case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
					flag = orificeSizingMethod != OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor && orificeSizingMethod != OrificeSizingMethod.Steam;
					break;
				case FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
				case FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical:
					flag = orificeSizingMethod != OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid && orificeSizingMethod != OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				base.Model.ValidateOrificeSizingModelType();
				RegisterProperties();
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeSizingMethod(PRDModel.GetModelType(ePhaseRegime, PRDSystem.SystemType, CanExecuteKrMethodSizing), isUserSelected: false);
			}
		}

		public bool ChangeSizingMethod(OrificeSizingMethod method, bool isUserSelected = true, bool notify = true)
		{
			if (this.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) != LineSizingMethod.Rigorous && !AllowedLineSizingModels(method).Contains(this.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true)) && isUserSelected)
			{
				bool cancel = default(bool);
				LineSizingMethodChanging?.Invoke(ref cancel);
				if (cancel)
				{
					RaiseScenarioDataChanged();
					return false;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				double referenceKd;
				checked
				{
					FreezeEventPublication++;
					referenceKd = GetReferenceKd();
					OrificeMethodChanging?.Invoke(method);
					base.Model.ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Specify(method, new UserSpecifier());
					base.Model.ValidateOrificeSizingModelType();
					RegisterProperties();
					ValidateLineSizingMethod(notify);
				}
				if (this.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Omega && (method == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1 || method == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2 || method == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3 || method == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct))
				{
					CalcEquivLength = false;
				}
				if (!RelFlowCanBeCalculated & (this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated))
				{
					this.set_RelFlowSource(notify, ProcessDataSource.Specified);
				}
				if (!MyMath.ValuesDiffer(referenceKd, this.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: false), 1E-10, 1E-10))
				{
					SetReferenceKd(notify: false);
				}
				if (notify)
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged("OrificeCalcModel");
				}
				RaiseScenarioModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "OrificeCalcModel");
				if (method == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
				{
					EraseProperty<double>("CalcRDDiam");
					EraseProperty<double>("CalcOrifice");
					IsLineSizingRatingMode = false;
				}
				_AssignSelectionToOrificeSizing(base.Model?.DetailedReliefDevice?.ReliefOrifice);
				if (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null)
				{
					PRDSystem.ValidateLineSizingMethod(this, notify);
					IUnityContainer obj = uContainer;
					if (obj != null)
					{
						IEventAggregator obj2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(obj, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
						if (obj2 != null)
						{
							((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingMethodChangedEventArgs>)obj2.GetEvent<SizingMethodChangedEvent>())?.Publish(new SizingMethodChangedEventArgs
							{
								IsKrMethod = (method == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod),
								RDName = PRDSystem.PRDSystemName
							});
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				checked
				{
					FreezeEventPublication--;
				}
				if ((long)FreezeEventPublication == 0L)
				{
					PRDSystem.OnSystemUpdateRequired();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnOrificeMethodChanging(OrificeSizingMethod newMethod)
		{
			double referenceKd = GetReferenceKd();
			int? num = (int?)KdSource;
			bool? flag = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() != 0) : ((bool?)null));
			if ((flag ?? true) && !MyMath.ValuesDiffer(referenceKd, this.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: false), 1E-10, 1E-10) && flag.HasValue)
			{
				this.set_Coeff_Kd(notify: false, GetReferenceKd(newMethod));
			}
		}

		public void VerifyRelievingFlow([Optional][DefaultParameterValue(double.NaN)] ref double curValue, bool notify = true)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(curValue))
			{
				if (IsRatingCalc)
				{
					curValue = this.get_RelFlow(notify: true);
				}
				else
				{
					curValue = this.get_TotalReliefLoad(notify: true);
				}
			}
			if (!IsRatingCalc && this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Reference)
			{
				double num = base.HostInterface.GetStreamMassFlow(RefStreamPath) ?? double.NaN;
				if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValuesAreDifferent(curValue, num))
				{
					curValue = num;
					this.set_RelievingFlow(notify, num);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Calculate(string propName, bool isForced = false, bool isSequenced = false)
		{
			_Calculate(propName, isForced, isSequenced);
		}

		public void Calculate(bool isForced = false)
		{
			_Calculate(null, isForced, isSequenced: false);
		}

		private void _Calculate(string propName, bool isForced, bool isSequenced)
		{
			if (isSequenced && !isForced)
			{
				isForced = ScenarioIsDirty;
			}
			if (isForced)
			{
				mPPPFluid?.ReinitializeFluid();
				if (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null)
				{
					PRDSystem.UpdateSplitFluids(this);
				}
			}
			if (isForced)
			{
				double curValue = double.NaN;
				VerifyRelievingFlow(ref curValue, notify: false);
				FluidPhaseRegime num = this.get_OpPhase(notify: true);
				UpdateOpPhase(notify: false);
				if (num != this.get_OpPhase(notify: true) && EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
				{
					ValidateFireMethod(notify: false);
				}
			}
			mPSVCalc.AutoRunCalculations(propName, isForced);
			if (isForced)
			{
				ScenarioIsDirty = false;
			}
		}

				if (this.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true) == LineRatingFlowSpec.Required)
				{
					EraseProperty<double>(s_UpratedFlow);
				}
			}
		}

		public PSVMessage GetDisplayMessage()
		{
			PSVMessage pSVMessage = null;
			IEnumerable<PSVMessage> enumerable = mScenarioMessages.ObjectMessages(this);
			foreach (PSVMessage item in enumerable)
			{
				if (!IsLineSizingMessage(item))
				{
					if (pSVMessage == null)
					{
						pSVMessage = item;
					}
					else if (item.MessageLevel > pSVMessage.MessageLevel)
					{
						pSVMessage = item;
					}
				}
			}
			return pSVMessage;
		}
