		internal void RecalculateSemidynamicFireForCompositions()
		{
			int? num = (int?)EmergencyType;
			bool? flag = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 14) : ((bool?)null));
			if (!(flag ?? true))
			{
				return;
			}
			num = (int?)this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) != true || !flag.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (mScenarioSettings.FireStoreStepCompositions)
			{
				mPSVCalc.AutoRunCalculations(null, force: true);
				return;
			}
			FIREComponentNames = null;
			foreach (IterationResultRLCFireModel fIREIteration in FIREIterationList)
			{
				fIREIteration.Compositions = null;
			}
		}

		private void RenameScenario(string newName)
		{
			newName = Strings.Trim(newName);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ScenarioName) & IsAllowedName(newName))
			{
				SetProperty(s_ScenarioName, newName);
				return;
			}
			if (!ScenarioNameIsUnique(newName))
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.ScenarioNameErrorPrompt_NotUnique, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
				return;
			}
			if (!IsAllowedName(newName))
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.ScenarioNameErrorPrompt_NONASCII, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).SetScenarioName(ScenarioNodeKey, newName);
			if (!flag)
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.ScenarioNameErrorPrompt_NONASCII, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				SetProperty(s_ScenarioName, newName);
				UpdateFluidDataPath();
				ScenarioDataChanged?.Invoke();
			}
		}

		protected bool ScenarioNameIsUnique(string name)
		{
			return (from s in base.Model.ReliefScenario.PressureProtectionRequirement.ReliefScenarios
				where Operators.CompareString(s.Name.Value, name, TextCompare: false) == 0 && s != base.Model.ReliefScenario
				select (s)).Count() == 0;
		}

		public bool NewOrificeSelectionRequired(double oldCalcOrif)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool UpdateReliefPhase(bool notify = true)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			double t = PSVCalculation.ConvertToHysysUnits("Temperature", this.get_RelTemp(notify: true), this.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true));
			double p = PSVCalculation.ConvertToHysysUnits("GaugePressure", this.get_RelPress(notify: true), this.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), AtmPress, this.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true));
			if ((mPPPFluid != null) & !double.IsNaN(this.get_RelPress(notify: true)))
			{
				if (this.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction && !double.IsNaN(this.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				FluidPhaseRegime fluidPhaseRegime;
				if ((EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire) & (this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated))
				{
					fluidPhaseRegime = ((FireIsTwoPhaseRelief && this.get_FireSelectedRelief(notify: true, byUser: true).GetValueOrDefault() != FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor) ? FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase : FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor);
				}
				else
				{
					double num = double.NaN;
					if (flag)
					{
						mPSVCalc.CalculateReliefTemperatureFromVF();
						if (double.IsNaN(this.get_RelTemp(notify)))
						{
							return false;
						}
						num = this.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false);
					}
					else if (this.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated && !double.IsNaN(this.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)))
					{
						num = this.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false);
					}
					else
					{
						if (double.IsNaN(this.get_RelTemp(notify)))
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (!mPPPFluid.TPFlash(t, p) || double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.Temperature()))
						{
							return false;
						}
						num = mPPPFluid.VaporFraction();
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(num))
					{
						return false;
					}
					fluidPhaseRegime = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(num);
				}
				if ((!base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.Phase.Value.HasValue || fluidPhaseRegime != EPhaseRegime) && SetProperty(s_Phase, (FluidPhaseRegime?)fluidPhaseRegime, notify, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null))
				{
					ValidateSizingMethod();
					this.get_Coeff_Kd(notify);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void UpdateOpPhase(bool notify = true)
		{
			mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
			double p = Pressure.Gauge(OperPress, Units.bar).ValueIn(Units.kPa, PressureReference.Absolute);
			mPPPFluid.TPFlash(OperTemp, p);
			this.set_OpPhase(notify, PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(mPPPFluid.VaporFraction()));
		}

		internal void UpdateReliefPressure(bool notify = true)
		{
			double value = (1.0 + this.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true) / 100.0) * this.get_SetPress(notify: true);
			bool flag = base.Model.ReliefScenario.ReliefPressure.Specify(value, Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge, new CalculationSpecifier());
			if (notify && flag)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("RelPress");
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCalcRDDiam(double d, bool notify = true)
		{
			if (base.Model.ReliefDevice.ReliefDeviceType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
			{
				this.set_CalcRDDiam(notify, Math.Sqrt(d * 4.0 / Math.PI));
			}
		}

		internal void SetReferenceKd(bool notify = true)
		{
			if (base.Model.OrificeSizing is PsvOrificeSizing psvOrificeSizing && psvOrificeSizing.Kd.Specify(GetReferenceKd(), new CalculationSpecifier()) && notify)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("Coeff_Kd");
			}
		}

		public double GetReferenceKd(OrificeSizingMethod? forMethod = null)
		{
			switch (forMethod ?? this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				return base.Model.ReliefDevice.GetReferenceKd(FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor, base.Model.OwnDetailedReliefDevice);
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				return base.Model.ReliefDevice.GetReferenceKd(FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid, base.Model.OwnDetailedReliefDevice);
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				return 0.62;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
				return base.Model.ReliefDevice.GetReferenceKd(FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase, base.Model.OwnDetailedReliefDevice);
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				return _GetReferenceKdByPhase();
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				return double.NaN;
			default:
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		private double _GetReferenceKdByPhase()
		{
			if (!base.Model.OrificeSizing.ReliefLoad.Phase.Value.HasValue)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			FluidPhaseRegime value = base.Model.OrificeSizing.ReliefLoad.Phase.Value.Value;
			return base.Model.ReliefDevice.GetReferenceKd(value, base.Model.OwnDetailedReliefDevice);
		}

		internal void OnSizingCaseChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsSizingCase");
			Calculate("IsSizingCase");
		}

		protected void TellEveryoneTheSizingCaseChanged()
		{
			SendBackValues();
			ScenarioDataChanged?.Invoke();
			if (!Information.IsNothing(uContainer))
			{
				SizingCaseChangedEventArgs e = new SizingCaseChangedEventArgs();
				e.ScenarioViewModel = this;
				e.RDName = PRDSystem.PRDSystemName;
				((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingCaseChangedEvent>()).Publish(e);
			}
		}

		protected void CalculateTotBackPress(bool notify = true)
		{
			double value = SuperImpConstBackPress + SuperImpVarBackPress + this.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true);
			this.set_TotBackPress(notify, Pressure.Absolute(value, Units.bar).ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge));
			AssignMaxAllowedBackPressure(notify);
		}

		private void _ResetSelectedValveModel(OrificeSizeSettingModel orificeSettings)
		{
			ReliefOrifice reliefOrifice = base.Model?.DetailedReliefDevice?.ReliefOrifice;
			if (reliefOrifice != null)
			{
				if (reliefOrifice.IsBuiltInOrifice.Value == true)
				{
					return;
				}
				OrificeSpecModel orificeSpecModel = orificeSettings.get_AvailableOrifices(PRDType).SingleOrDefault([SpecialName] (OrificeSpecModel o) => o.Model == reliefOrifice);
				if (orificeSpecModel != null)
				{
					if (orificeSpecModel.IsDirtyForOrificeSizing)
					{
						_SetSelectedValveModel(reliefOrifice);
					}
					else if (orificeSpecModel.IsDirtyForLineSizing)
					{
						base.Model.SetReliefOrifice(orificeSpecModel.Model, IsSizingCase);
						RegisterDetailedReliefDeviceProperties();
						CalculateLineSize();
					}
					else if (orificeSpecModel.IsDesignationDirty)
					{
						CheckOrificeSelection();
					}
					else if (orificeSpecModel.IsFlangeRatingDirty)
					{
						base.Model.SetReliefOrifice(orificeSpecModel.Model, IsSizingCase);
						RegisterDetailedReliefDeviceProperties();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (!double.IsNaN(SelCapacity) || !double.IsNaN(ValveInSize) || !double.IsNaN(ValveOutSize) || !double.IsNaN(ValveInRating) || !double.IsNaN(ValveOutRating))
			{
				_SetSelectedValveModel(null);
			}
		}

		private void _SetSelectedValveModel(ReliefOrifice orifice)
		{
			base.Model.SetReliefOrifice(orifice, IsSizingCase);
			RegisterDetailedReliefDeviceProperties();
			_AssignSelectionToOrificeSizing(orifice);
			NotifyPropertyChanged(s_ValveDesignation);
			NotifyPropertyChanged(s_SelectOrifice);
			if (orifice == null)
			{
				_EraseSelectedOrifice();
				return;
			}
			SelectedOrificeChanged();
			SendBackValues();
			ScenarioDataChanged?.Invoke();
			PRDSystem.SelectOrificeChanged(this);
		}

		private void _AssignSelectionToOrificeSizing(ReliefOrifice orifice)
		{
			if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
			{
				if (!(orifice is RuptureDiskOrifice ruptureDiskOrifice))
				{
					base.Model.OrificeSizing.SelectedDiameter.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				else
				{
					base.Model.OrificeSizing.SelectedDiameter.TrySpecifyFrom(ruptureDiskOrifice.Diameter);
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetSelectedValve(string valveName)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(valveName, SelectedOrificeName, TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				ReliefOrifice value = null;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(valveName))
				{
					SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.ReliefOrifices.TryGetValue(valveName, out value);
				}
				_SetSelectedValveModel(value);
			}
		}

		public void SetSelectedValve(OrificeSpecModel selected)
		{
			_SetSelectedValveModel(selected?.Model);
		}

		[Obsolete]
		public void SetSelectedValve(double areaInCm2)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(areaInCm2))
			{
				_SetSelectedValveModel(null);
				return;
			}
			OrificeSpecModel selectedValve = GetOrifices(PRDType).FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (OrificeSpecModel x) => !MyMath.ValuesDiffer(x.Area, areaInCm2, 1E-12, 1E-12));
			SetSelectedValve(selectedValve);
		}

		public void OnValveTypeChanged()
		{
			AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct();
			AssignMaxAllowedBackPressure();
		}

		public void AssignMaxAllowedBackPressure(bool notify = true)
		{
			ValveTypeEnum valueOrDefault = (ValveTypeEnum)ValveType.GetValueOrDefault();
			double absSetPress = this.get_SetPress(notify: true) + AtmPress;
			this.set_MaxAllowBP(notify, ValveUtilities.GetMaxAllowBackpressure(valueOrDefault, this.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true), absSetPress, SuperImpConstBackPress + SuperImpVarBackPress, AtmPress) - AtmPress);
		}

		public void AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct(bool notify = true)
		{
			if (!(base.Model.ReliefDevice is PressureSafetyValve pressureSafetyValve))
			{
				return;
			}
			int? num = (int?)pressureSafetyValve.PsvType.Value;
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() != 0) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
			{
				if (BackpressureLimitFractionSource == ProcessDataSource.Reference || BackpressureLimitFractionSource == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
				{
					this.set_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify, pressureSafetyValve.BackpressureLimitFractionOfSetPressure.Percent);
				}
			}
			else if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("MaxAllowBPPercent");
			}
		}

		public void AutoSelectOrifice()
		{
			if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				_Closure$__1252-0 arg = default(_Closure$__1252-0);
				_Closure$__1252-0 CS$<>8__locals6 = new _Closure$__1252-0(arg);
				CS$<>8__locals6.$VB$Me = this;
				CS$<>8__locals6.$VB$Local_calc = this.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true);
				OrificeSpecModel orificeSpecModel = null;
				IOrderedEnumerable<OrificeSpecModel> source = from p in GetOrifices(ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
					orderby p.Area
					select p;
				if (!double.IsNaN(CS$<>8__locals6.$VB$Local_calc) && CS$<>8__locals6.$VB$Local_calc > 0.0)
				{
					orificeSpecModel = source.Where([SpecialName] (OrificeSpecModel x) => CS$<>8__locals6.$VB$Local_calc < x.Area * CS$<>8__locals6.$VB$Me.LiftRestriction).FirstOrDefault();
				}
				else if (this.get_RelFlow(notify: true) == 0.0)
				{
					orificeSpecModel = source.Where([SpecialName] (OrificeSpecModel x) => x.Area > 0.0).FirstOrDefault();
				}
				if (orificeSpecModel == null)

					_SetSelectedValveModel(null);
					System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.NoOrificeLargeEnough, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
				}
				else
				{
					SetSelectedValve(orificeSpecModel);
				}
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			if (Operators.CompareString(UOMCalcRDDiam, "in", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				num = this.get_CalcRDDiam(notify: true);
			}
			else
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(UOMCalcRDDiam, "cm", TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength2_cm, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, this.get_CalcRDDiam(notify: true), "SmallLength2");
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && num > 0.0)
			{
				foreach (double rDSize in _RDSizes)
				{
					double num2 = rDSize;
					if (num2 > num)
					{
						SelRDDiam = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, UnitStrings.SmallLength2_cm, num2, "SmallLength2");
						return;
					}
				}
				SelRDDiam = double.NaN;
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.NoRDLargeEnough, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
			}
			if (this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) == 0.0)
			{
				SelRDDiam = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, UnitStrings.SmallLength2_cm, 0.5, "SmallLength2");
			}
		}

		public void SelectedOrificeChanged()
		{
			ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
			if (SelectOrifice != 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(SelectOrifice))
			{
				CheckOrificeSelection();
				if ((InID == double.NaN) & (OutID == double.NaN))
				{
					InND = ValveInSize;
					InSch = "STD";
					OutND = ValveOutSize;
					OutSch = "STD";
				}
				CatchRanCalculations(this, new RanCalculationsEventArgs(recalculateRatingModels: true));
				RaiseScenarioDataChanged();
			}
		}

		public void CheckOrificeSelection()
		{
			ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
			if (double.IsNaN(SelectOrifice) || SelectOrifice == 0.0 || double.IsNaN(LiftRestriction))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (EffectiveOrifice < this.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true))
			{
				if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
				{
					AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SelRDSmall, MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
				}
				else
				{
					if (LiftRestriction < 1.0)
					{
						AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OrificeUndersizedWithRestrictedLift, MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
					}
					else
					{
						AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SelOSmall, MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
					}
					DataStatus = FormResource.ResWarn;
				}
			}
			double setPressure_psig = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(this.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, this.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			double designTemperature_F = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMDesTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_F, DesTemp, "Temperature");
			double totalBackPressure_psig = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMTotBackPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, this.get_TotBackPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				ApiTables activeApiTables = SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveApiTables;
				bool num = ValveDesignation.HasValue && IsValveApiValve && activeApiTables.LegacyOrificeDesignate(setPressure_psig, designTemperature_F, ValveDesignation.GetValueOrDefault().ToString(), totalBackPressure_psig, (ValveTypeEnum)ValveType.GetValueOrDefault(), (PSVSizingEngine.ApiValveMaterial)ValveMaterial.GetValueOrDefault(), mPSVSettings.IncludeLightweightFlanges);
				bool flag = false;
				if (!num)
				{
					if (ValveDesignation.HasValue && IsValveApiValve)
					{
						AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoValveFound, MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
					}
					if (IsValveApiValve)
					{
						DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice = base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice;
						if (detailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User)
						{
							flag |= detailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.Specify(double.NaN, Units.inch, new CalculationSpecifier());
						}
						if (detailedReliefDevice.InletRating.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User)
						{
							detailedReliefDevice.InletRating.Specify(double.NaN, new CalculationSpecifier());
						}
						if (detailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User)
						{
							flag |= detailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.Specify(double.NaN, Units.inch, new CalculationSpecifier());
						}
						if (detailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User)
						{
							detailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.Specify(double.NaN, new CalculationSpecifier());
						}
						detailedReliefDevice = null;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice2 = base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice;
					if (detailedReliefDevice2.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User || detailedReliefDevice2.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.IsEmpty)
					{
						flag |= detailedReliefDevice2.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.Specify((double)activeApiTables.LegacyValveInSize, Units.inch, new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
					if (detailedReliefDevice2.InletRating.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User || detailedReliefDevice2.InletRating.IsEmpty)
					{
						detailedReliefDevice2.InletRating.Specify(activeApiTables.LegacyValveInRating, new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
					if (detailedReliefDevice2.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User || detailedReliefDevice2.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.IsEmpty)
					{
						flag |= detailedReliefDevice2.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.Specify((double)activeApiTables.LegacyValveOutSize, Units.inch, new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
					if (detailedReliefDevice2.OutletRating.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User || detailedReliefDevice2.OutletRating.IsEmpty)
					{
						detailedReliefDevice2.OutletRating.Specify(activeApiTables.LegacyValveOutRating, new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
					if (detailedReliefDevice2.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User || detailedReliefDevice2.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					detailedReliefDevice2 = null;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged("InEquivLength");
				}
			}
			else if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
			{
				DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice3 = base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice;
				int num2 = (int)(0u | (detailedReliefDevice3.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.Specify(SelRDDiam, Units.cm, new CalculationSpecifier()) ? 1u : 0u)) | (detailedReliefDevice3.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.Specify(SelRDDiam, Units.cm, new CalculationSpecifier()) ? 1 : 0);
				detailedReliefDevice3 = null;
				if (num2 != 0)
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged("InEquivLength");
				}
			}
			double num3 = EffectiveOrifice / this.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true) * this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
			if (this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				num3 = this.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true);
			}
			else if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && CapUncertFact > 0.0)
			{
				num3 *= CapUncertFact;
			}
			SelCapacity = num3;
			if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				UpdateLOverDPercOrificeUsed();
			}
			else if (SelectOrifice > 0.0)
			{
				PercOrificeUsed = this.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true) / EffectiveOrifice * 100.0;
				UpdatePercOrificeUsedMessage();
			}
			DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice4 = base.Model.DetailedReliefDevice;
			if (detailedReliefDevice4.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.IsEmpty || detailedReliefDevice4.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.IsEmpty)
			{
				AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoFlangeSizeForSelectedOrifice, MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
			}
			detailedReliefDevice4 = null;
		}

		public void UpdatePercOrificeUsedMessage()
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(PercOrificeUsed))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (PercOrificeUsed > 100.0)
			{
				if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
				{
					double num = ((this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod) ? UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, SelCapacity, "MassFlow") : UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, this.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true), "MassFlow"));
					double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
					string message = ((double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2)) ? FormResource.RDTooSmall : string.Format(FormResource.CalcIOFlowLessThanReq, Math.Round(num, 2), DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, Math.Round(num2, 2), DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit));
					AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, message, MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
				}
			}
			else if (PercOrificeUsed > 95.0)
			{
				AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Orifice95, MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
			}
			else if (mPSVSettings.DisplayStabilityWarning && PercOrificeUsed < mPSVSettings.StabilityPctRatedFlow && !OwnerPRD.IfSpare)
			{
				mRefPctRatedFlow = mPSVSettings.StabilityPctRatedFlow;
				if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.OrificeOversized, mPSVSettings.StabilityPctRatedFlow), MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
				}
				else
				{
					AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.OrificeOversizedRD, mPSVSettings.StabilityPctRatedFlow), MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateLOverDPercOrificeUsed()
		{
			if (!((PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk) & (this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = double.NaN;
			if ((!double.IsNaN(this.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true)) & !double.IsNaN(this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true))) && ((this.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true) > 0.0) & (this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) > 0.0)))
			{
				num = 100.0 * (this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) / this.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true));
				ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
				if (num > 100.0)
				{
					double value = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, this.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true), "MassFlow");
					double value2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
					string message = string.Format(FormResource.CalcIOFlowLessThanReq, Math.Round(value, 2), DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, Math.Round(value2, 2), DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit);
					AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, message, MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
				}
			}
			PercOrificeUsed = num;
		}

		public void ErasePRDResults()

		}

		protected double? GetValueFromReferenceStream(string propertyName, string unit)
		{
			string text = RefStreamPath;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				text = RefStreamPath + "." + propertyName;
			}
			if (!Information.IsNothing(text))
			{
				return CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchGet(text, "value", unit)));
			}
			double? result = default(double?);
			return result;
		}

		private void SetLineSizingRelFlowMethodByUpratedFlow(int dbMajor)
		{
			string propName = s_UpratedFlow;
			bool byUser = true;
			double property = GetProperty<double>(propName, null, ref byUser);
			if (this.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Omega)
			{
				this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: false, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.Required);
				return;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(property))
			{
				if (dbMajor < 30 && this.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Homogeneous)
				{
					this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: false, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.Required);
				}
				else
				{
					this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: false, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)null);
				}
				return;
			}
			double num = 5E-05 * property;
			if (Math.Abs(RatedFlow - this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true)) < num && Math.Abs(RatedFlow - property) < 2.0 * num)
			{
				FluidPhaseRegime ePhaseRegime = EPhaseRegime;
				if (EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire || ePhaseRegime == FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid || this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3)
				{
					this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: false, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.Required);
				}
				else
				{
					this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: false, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.RatedArea);
				}
			}
			else if (Math.Abs(RatedFlow - property) < num)
			{
				this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: false, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.RatedArea);
			}
			else if (Math.Abs(this.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) - property) < num)
			{
				this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: false, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.Required);
			}
			else
			{
				this.set_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: false, (LineRatingFlowSpec?)LineRatingFlowSpec.Manual);
			}
		}

		public void RaisePSVScenarioModelPropertyChangedEvent(object sender, string name)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(name, "CalcEquivLength", TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				PSVScenarioModelPropertyChanged?.Invoke(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(sender), new PropertyEventArgs(name));
			}
		}

		public new bool IsAllowedName(string name)
		{
			if (!base.IsAllowedName(name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((name != null) & (name.Length > 0)) && !char.IsLetterOrDigit(name.ElementAt(0)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void PSVSettings_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(e.PropertyName, "DisplayStabilityWarning", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				ClearAllStabilityMessages();
				if (mPSVSettings.DisplayStabilityWarning && !((PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk) & (this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)))
				{
					UpdatePercOrificeUsedMessage();
				}
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(e.PropertyName, "StabilityPctRatedFlow", TextCompare: false) == 0 && mPSVSettings.DisplayStabilityWarning)
			{
				ClearAllStabilityMessages();
				UpdatePercOrificeUsedMessage();
			}
			else if (_PassthroughSettingsProperties.Contains(e.PropertyName))
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged(e.PropertyName);
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(e.PropertyName, "Api526Edition", TextCompare: false) == 0 || Operators.CompareString(e.PropertyName, "IncludeLightweightFlanges", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				CheckOrificeSelection();
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(e.PropertyName, "MaxBackPress_BalBellow", TextCompare: false) == 0 || Operators.CompareString(e.PropertyName, "MaxBackPress_Pilot", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct();
				AssignMaxAllowedBackPressure();
			}
		}

		private void ClearAllStabilityMessages()
		{
			RemoveScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.OrificeOversized, mRefPctRatedFlow), MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
			RemoveScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.OrificeOversizedRD, mRefPctRatedFlow), MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
		}

		private void PRDSystemModel_SplitModelCountChanged()
		{
			_UpdateOverpressurePct(EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault());
			mRefSplitCount = PRDSystem.SplitPRDModels.Count;
		}

		private void _UpdateSplitOverpressure(bool notify = true)
		{
			_ = (PRDModel)base.Owner;
			if (PRDSystem.OverallPRDModel == base.Owner)
			{
				PRDSystem.UpdateSplitOverpressures(this, notify);
			}
		}

		public double GetFullFlowOverpressurePctForFire()
		{
			int count = PRDSystem.SplitPRDModels.Count;
			if (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null)
			{
				return (count > 1) ? mPSVSettings.MultipleValveOverpressurePct : mPSVSettings.SingleValveOverpressurePct;
			}
			double num = mRefMasterScenarioModel.get_SetPress(notify: true) * (1.0 + mRefMasterScenarioModel.GetFullFlowOverpressurePctForFire() / 100.0);
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(this.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), mRefMasterScenarioModel.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), this.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			return 100.0 * (num - num2) / num2;
		}

		private double GetDefaultOverpressurePct(EmergScenarioType SelectedSce, bool AsRefCount = false)
		{
			int num = (AsRefCount ? mRefSplitCount : PRDSystem.SplitPRDModels.Count);
			if (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null)
			{
				if (SelectedSce == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
				{
					return mPSVSettings.FireOverpressurePct;
				}
				if (num > 1)
				{
					return mPSVSettings.MultipleValveOverpressurePct;
				}
				return mPSVSettings.SingleValveOverpressurePct;
			}
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(this.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), mRefMasterScenarioModel.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), this.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			return 100.0 * (mRefMasterScenarioModel.get_RelPress(notify: true) - num2) / num2;
		}

		private void _UpdateOverpressurePct(EmergScenarioType SelectedSce, EmergScenarioType? OrigSce = null, bool notify = true, bool DoChainUpdates = false, bool force = false)
		{
			if (!OrigSce.HasValue)
			{
				OrigSce = SelectedSce;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(mRefSetPressure))
			{
				mRefSetPressure = this.get_SetPress(notify: true);
			}
			if (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null && Math.Abs(this.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true) - GetDefaultOverpressurePct(OrigSce.GetValueOrDefault(), AsRefCount: true)) > 0.01)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!force && !double.IsNaN(this.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true)))
			{
				int? num = (int?)OrigSce;
				bool? flag = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(SelectedSce != (EmergScenarioType)num.GetValueOrDefault()) : ((bool?)null));
				if ((!(flag ?? true) || (SelectedSce != EmergScenarioType.Fire && OrigSce != EmergScenarioType.Fire) || !flag.HasValue) && (mRefSplitCount == PRDSystem.SplitPRDModels.Count || (mRefSplitCount > 1 && PRDSystem.SplitPRDModels.Count != 1)) && (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null || (mRefSetPressure == this.get_SetPress(notify: true) && mRefMasterScenarioModel.get_RelPress(notify: true) == mRefRelPressure)))
				{
					goto IL_015c;
				}
			}
			set_OverPress(notify, DoChainUpdates, GetDefaultOverpressurePct(SelectedSce));
			goto IL_015c;
			IL_015c:
			mRefSetPressure = this.get_SetPress(notify: true);
			if (mRefMasterScenarioModel != null)
			{
				mRefRelPressure = mRefMasterScenarioModel.get_RelPress(notify: true);
			}
		}

		public void SetOverpressureToDefault()
		{
			set_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true, GetDefaultOverpressurePct(EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault()));
		}

		internal void UpdateOverpressure()
		{
			if (mRefMasterScenarioModel == null)
			{
				if (!UseCustomOverpressure)
				{
					SetOverpressureToDefault();
					UpdateReliefPressure();
				}
				else if (this.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true) == GetDefaultOverpressurePct(EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault()))
				{
					UseCustomOverpressure = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSelectedOrifices()
		{
			OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
			OrificeSizeSettingModel orificeSettings = GetOrificeSettings();
			if (orificeSettings.AllOrificesDirty && (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid || orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid))
			{
				mPSVCalc.AutoRunCalculations("OrificeList");
			}
			_ResetSelectedValveModel(orificeSettings);
			ValveDimensionsChanged?.Invoke();
		}

		}

			EraseProperty<double>(s_RelViscosity, byUser: false);

		}

		public void OnChangeReferenceStream()
		{
			UpdateFluidDataPath();
			if (ReliefLoadCalculation is ControlValveFailure)
			{
				UpdateVFInletPress_Rel(notify: false);
				UpdateVFInletTemp_Rel(notify: false);
			}
			else if (ReliefLoadCalculation is TubeRupture)
			{
				UpdateTROperPress(notify: false);
				UpdateTROperTemp(notify: false);
			}
			UpdateOpPhase(notify: false);
			if (EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
			{
				ValidateFireMethod(notify: false);
			}
			UpdateReliefPhase();
			Calculate(isForced: true);
			RaiseScenarioDataChanged();
		}

		private void _CreateDirectIntegrationTable()
		{
			PsvOrificeSizing psvOrificeSizing = base.Model.OrificeSizing as PsvOrificeSizing;
			checked
			{
				if (psvOrificeSizing?.IntegrationSteps != null)
				{
					int num = psvOrificeSizing.IntegrationSteps.Count - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
					{
						IterationResultDirectIntegrationStep iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep = new IterationResultDirectIntegrationStep(uContainer);
						PsvKey dbKey = null;
						iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep.Initialize(ref dbKey, null, this, psvOrificeSizing.IntegrationSteps[i]);
						s_DirectIntegrationSteps.Add(iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IterationResultDirectIntegrationStep CreateDirectIntegrationStep(int i, Mixed_Relief.DirectIntegrationStep? engineStep = null)
		{
			DirectIntegrationStep dataModel = ((PsvOrificeSizing)base.Model.OrificeSizing).CreateIntegrationStep();
			IterationResultDirectIntegrationStep iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep = new IterationResultDirectIntegrationStep(uContainer);
			PsvKey dbKey = null;
			iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep.Initialize(ref dbKey, null, this, dataModel);
			s_DirectIntegrationSteps.Add(iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep);
			if (engineStep.HasValue)
			{
				Mixed_Relief.DirectIntegrationStep valueOrDefault = engineStep.GetValueOrDefault();
				iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep.Pressure = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, valueOrDefault.Pressure, "AbsolutePressure");
				iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep.Temperature = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_F, UnitStrings.Temp_C, valueOrDefault.Temperature, "Temperature");
				iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep.VaporMassFraction = valueOrDefault.VapQualMass;
				iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep.Density = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, valueOrDefault.Density, "Density");
				iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep.Integrand = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Integrand_ft2s2, UnitStrings.Integrand_m2s2, valueOrDefault.Integrand, "Integrand");
				iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep.Summation = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Integrand_ft2s2, UnitStrings.Integrand_m2s2, valueOrDefault.Summation, "Integrand");
				iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep.MassFlux = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlux_lbsft2, UnitStrings.MassFlux_kghcm2, valueOrDefault.MassFlux, "MassFlux");
			}
			return iterationResultDirectIntegrationStep;
		}

		public void EraseDirectIntegrationSteps()
		{
			((PsvOrificeSizing)base.Model.OrificeSizing).ClearSteps();
			s_DirectIntegrationSteps = new List<IterationResultDirectIntegrationStep>();
		}

		public double MaxAllowBPByValues(double percent, double superVariableBP)
		{
			if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (!(base.Owner is PSVValveModel { ValveType: var valveType }))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			PsvType value = valveType.Value;
			double absSetPress = this.get_SetPress(notify: true) + AtmPress;
			double superImpConstBackPress = SuperImpConstBackPress;
			return ValveUtilities.GetMaxAllowBackpressure((ValveTypeEnum)value, percent, absSetPress, superImpConstBackPress + superVariableBP, AtmPress) - AtmPress;
		}

		public double CalculateKbByValues(double totalBackPressure)
		{
			string returnMsg = null;
			CalculationStatusEnum status = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			double lowSetPressLimit = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, 50.0, "GaugePressure");
			if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (!(base.Owner is PSVValveModel { ValveType: var valveType } pSVValveModel))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (valveType.Value != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			ValveTypeEnum value = (ValveTypeEnum)pSVValveModel.ValveType.Value;
			double setPress = this.get_SetPress(notify: true) + AtmPress;
			switch (this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				return double.NaN;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				return ValveUtilities.CalculateKb(value, setPress, this.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true), AtmPress, totalBackPressure, lowSetPressLimit, CriticalPressure, ref returnMsg);
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				return ValveUtilities.CalculateKb_figC2(value, setPress, AtmPress, totalBackPressure, ref returnMsg, ref status);
			default:
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double CalculateKwByValues(double totalBackPressure)
		{
			if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (!(base.Owner is PSVValveModel { ValveType: var valveType } pSVValveModel))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (valveType.Value != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			ValveTypeEnum value = (ValveTypeEnum)pSVValveModel.ValveType.Value;
			double setPress = this.get_SetPress(notify: true) + AtmPress;
			switch (this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				return ValveUtilities.CalculateKw(value, setPress, AtmPress, totalBackPressure);
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				return double.NaN;
			default:
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double CalculateKpByValues(double overpressurePct)
		{
			return ValveUtilities.CalculateKp(overpressurePct);
		}

		public void UpdateSizingMethod(bool notify)
		{
			if (((this.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated) & (EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire)) && this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) == FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous && this.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct)
			{
				ChangeSizingMethod(OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct, isUserSelected: false);
			}
		}

		private void _RestrictToSingleVessel()
		{

		}

		private void ValidateFireMethod(bool notify = true)
		{
			int? num;
			bool? flag;
			if (this.get_OpPhase(notify: true) == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor || this.get_OpPhase(notify: true) == FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical)
			{
				num = (int?)this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
				{
					num = (int?)this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 4) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
					{
						num = (int?)this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
						if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
						{
							num = (int?)this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
							flag = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 3) : ((bool?)null));
							if ((flag ?? true) && FireVesselCount > 1 && flag.HasValue)
							{
								this.set_FIRECalcMethod(notify, (FireCalcMethod?)FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted);
							}
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				this.set_FIRECalcMethod(notify, (FireCalcMethod?)FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted);
				return;
			}
			num = (int?)this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
			{
				this.set_FIRECalcMethod(notify, (FireCalcMethod?)FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted);
				return;
			}
			num = (int?)this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
			bool? flag3;
			bool? flag2 = (flag3 = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 3) : ((bool?)null)));
			bool? obj;
			if (!flag2.HasValue || flag3 != true)
			{
				num = (int?)this.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
				bool? flag4;
				flag2 = (flag4 = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)));
				obj = ((!flag2.HasValue) ? ((bool?)null) : ((flag4 == true) | flag3));
			}
			else
			{
				obj = true;
			}
			flag = obj;
			if ((flag ?? true) && FireVesselCount > 1 && flag.HasValue)
			{
				this.set_FIRECalcMethod(notify, (FireCalcMethod?)FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted);
			}
		}

		internal double GetUpdatedTETemperature(CubicalExpansionTemperatureType? TETemperatureSource, [CallerMemberName] string TemperatureProperty = null)
		{
			switch (TETemperatureSource ?? CubicalExpansionTemperatureType.Manual)
			{
			case CubicalExpansionTemperatureType.Manual:
			{
				TemperatureUnit c = Units.C;
				bool byUser = true;
				return GetProperty<double>(TemperatureProperty, c, ref byUser);
			}
			case CubicalExpansionTemperatureType.Operating:
				UpdateReferenceValue(PRDSystem.get_OperTemp(notify: true), TemperatureProperty, notify: true, Units.C);
				return PRDSystem.get_OperTemp(notify: true);
			case CubicalExpansionTemperatureType.Relief:
				UpdateReferenceValue(this.get_RelTemp(notify: true), TemperatureProperty, notify: true, Units.C);
				return this.get_RelTemp(notify: true);
			default:
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateTROperPress(bool notify = true)
		{
			if ((TROperPressSource ?? ProcessDataSource.Specified) == ProcessDataSource.Reference)
			{
				double? refStreamPressure = base.HostInterface.GetRefStreamPressure(RefStreamPath);
				double? newValue = default(double?);
				if (refStreamPressure.HasValue)
				{
					newValue = Pressure.Absolute(refStreamPressure.GetValueOrDefault(), Units.kPa).ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);
				}
				UpdateReferenceValue(newValue, s_TROperPress, notify, Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);
			}
		}

		{

		}

				double? refStreamPressure = base.HostInterface.GetRefStreamPressure(RefStreamPath);
				double? newValue = default(double?);

		protected void UpdateCvCg()
		{
			if (!VFShouldCalculateCvCg)
			{
				CVFCalcCvFromCg = false;
			}
			else if (CVFCalcCvFromCg)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(CVFCg) || double.IsNaN(CVFC1))
				{
					CVFCv_underTheHood = double.NaN;
				}
				else
				{
					CVFCv_underTheHood = CVFCg / CVFC1;
				}
			}
			else if (double.IsNaN(VFCV_100) || double.IsNaN(CVFC1))
			{
				CVFCg_underTheHood = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				CVFCg_underTheHood = CVFC1 * VFCV_100;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsRealAndPositive(double d)
		{
			if (d > 0.0)
			{
				return !double.IsNaN(d);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Type GetValveTypeEnum(ControlValveMaker valveMaker)
		{
			Type value = null;
			valveTypes.TryGetValue(valveMaker, out value);
			return value;
		}

		private int? _GetDefaultValveTypeVal()
		{
			return (!ControlValveFailure.ValveTypeRepository.GetValveTypes(CVFValveMaker).Any()) ? ((int?)null) : new int?(1);
		}

		public IEnumerable<(int EnumValue, string Name)> GetValveTypes()
		{
			return from thisType in ControlValveFailure.ValveTypeRepository.GetValveTypes(CVFValveMaker)
				select (thisType.CalcID, thisType.Name);
		}

		protected bool ValveTypeValueAllowed(int val)
		{
			if (val > 0)
			{
				return Enum.IsDefined(CVFValveTypeEnum, val);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class LineSizingBaseModel<TModelObject> : BaseModel<TModelObject> where TModelObject : BaseModel
	{
		private static bool _IsUnityRegistered = false;

		private static object _UnityRegLock = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(new object());

		protected static double? DoubleAsNullable(double d)
		{
			return (!double.IsNaN(d)) ? new double?(d) : ((double?)null);
		}

		public LineSizingBaseModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
		}

		protected TValue GetPropertyDirect<TValue>(AbstractProcessVariable pv, IUnitOfMeasure uom = null)
		{
			if (pv == null || pv.IsBeingDeleted)
			{
				return EmptyValueForType<TValue>();
			}
			if (pv.GetValue() is Pressure pressure)
			{
				if (uom == null)
				{
					uom = UnitTypes.Pressure.InnateUnit;
				}
				return Conversions.ToGenericParameter<TValue>(pressure.ValueIn(uom, pressure.Reference));
			}
			if (pv.GetValue() is IQuantity quantity)
			{
				if (uom == null)
				{
					uom = quantity.UnitType.InnateUnit;
				}
				return Conversions.ToGenericParameter<TValue>(quantity.ValueIn(uom));
			}
			if (pv.GetValue() is Fraction)
			{
				return Conversions.ToGenericParameter<TValue>(NewLateBinding.LateGet(pv.GetValue(), null, "Number", new object[0], null, null, null));
			}
			return Conversions.ToGenericParameter<TValue>(pv.GetValue());
		}

		private double _GetQuantityValue(IProcessVariable pv, IUnitOfMeasure uom, PressureReference? pressureReference)
		{
			if (pressureReference.HasValue)
			{
				return ((ProcessPressure)pv).ValueIn((PressureUnit)uom, pressureReference.Value);
			}
			return ((IQuantity)pv.GetValue()).ValueIn(uom);
		}

		protected bool SetPropertyDirect<TValue>(AbstractProcessVariable pv, TValue value, bool notify = true, string notifyName = null, IUnitOfMeasure uom = null, bool byUser = true, PressureReference? pressureReference = null)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (pv == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TValue propertyDirect = GetPropertyDirect<TValue>(pv, uom);
			bool flag2 = true;
			if ((propertyDirect == null) ? (value != null) : (!propertyDirect.Equals(value)))
			{
				flag = ForceSetProperty(pv, value, uom, byUser, pressureReference);
				if (notify && flag && notifyName != null)
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged(notifyName);
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected bool ForceSetProperty<TValue>(AbstractProcessVariable pv, TValue value, IUnitOfMeasure uom, bool byUser, PressureReference? pressureReference)
		{
			IVariableSpecifier specifier = ((!byUser) ? ((IVariableSpecifier)new CalculationSpecifier()) : ((IVariableSpecifier)new UserSpecifier()));
			ValidateForStorage(ref value);
			if (pv == null)
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					object obj = EmptyValueForType<TValue>();
					if (!value.Equals(obj))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException("INTERNAL ERROR: Property not found in object, or property was not convertible to a ProcessVariable.", "prop");
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (pv.GetValue() is Pressure)
			{
				Pressure pressure = new Pressure(new PressureDifference(Conversions.ToDouble(value), (PressureUnit)uom), pressureReference.Value);
				((ProcessPressure)pv).Specify(pressure, specifier);
				return true;
			}
			if (pv.GetValue() is IQuantity quantity)
			{
				if (uom == null && double.IsNaN(Conversions.ToDouble(value)))
				{
					uom = quantity.UnitType.InnateUnit;
				}
				RuntimeQuantity value2 = new RuntimeQuantity(Conversions.ToDouble(value), uom);
				((IProcessVar<IQuantity>)pv).Specify(value2, specifier);
			}
			else if (pv.GetValue() is Fraction)
			{
				Fraction value3 = ((!(value is double)) ? ((Fraction)(object)value) : Fraction.FromNumber(Conversions.ToDouble(value)));
				((IProcessVar<Fraction>)pv).Specify(value3, specifier);
			}
			else
			{
				((IProcessVar<TValue>)pv).Specify(value, specifier);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class DualModelObjectList<TInterface, TObject, TModelObject> : IReadOnlyList<TInterface> where TObject : BaseModel<TModelObject>, TInterface where TModelObject : BaseModel
	{
		protected readonly IUnityContainer _container;

		protected readonly List<TObject> _myList;

		protected readonly IReadOnlyList<TModelObject> _refList;

		public int Count => _refList.Count;

		public TInterface this[int index] => (TInterface)_myList[index];

		public DualModelObjectList(IUnityContainer container, IReadOnlyList<TModelObject> elements)
		{
			_myList = new List<TObject>();
			_container = container;
			_refList = elements;
			foreach (TModelObject element in elements)
			{
				_myList.Add(_CreateMyElement(element));
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator<TInterface> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new DualModelObjectListIterator<TInterface>(this);
		}

		IEnumerator<TInterface> IEnumerable<TInterface>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in GetEnumerator
			return this.GetEnumerator();
		}

		private IEnumerator IEnumerable_GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new DualModelObjectListIterator<TInterface>(this);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in IEnumerable_GetEnumerator
			return this.IEnumerable_GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected TObject _CreateMyElement(TModelObject element)
		{
			TObject val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<TObject>(_container, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			PsvKey dbKey = null;
			val.Initialize(ref dbKey, null, null, element);
			return val;
		}
	}
	internal class DualModelObjectListIterator<TInterface> : IEnumerator<TInterface>
	{
		private int _position;

		private IReadOnlyList<TInterface> _collection;

		private bool disposedValue;

		public TInterface Current => _collection[_position];

		private object IEnumerator_Current => _collection[_position];

		public DualModelObjectListIterator(IReadOnlyList<TInterface> collection)
		{
			_position = -1;
			_collection = collection;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			checked
			{
				_position++;
				return _position < _collection.Count;
			}
		}

		bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in MoveNext
			return this.MoveNext();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_position = -1;
		}

		void IEnumerator.Reset()
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in Reset
			this.Reset();
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposedValue)
			{
			}
			disposedValue = true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in Dispose
			this.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public interface ILineSizingDiameter
	{
		double NominalDiameter { get; set; }

		string Schedule { get; set; }

		double InnerDiameter { get; }

		double OuterDiameter { get; }

		double WallThickness { get; }

		void SpecifySizeAsSchedulePipe(double innerDiameter, double wallThickness);

		void SpecifySizeAsActualSize(double innerDiameter, double wallThickness);
	}
	internal class LineSizingDiameter : LineSizingBaseModel<PipeDiameter>, ILineSizingDiameter
	{
		public double NominalDiameter
		{
			get
			{
				return GetPropertyDirect<double>(base.Model.NominalDiameter, Units.inch);
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyDirect(base.Model.NominalDiameter, value, notify: true, null, Units.inch);
			}
		}

		public string Schedule
		{
			get
			{
				return GetPropertyDirect<string>(base.Model.Schedule);
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyDirect(base.Model.Schedule, value);
			}
		}

		public double InnerDiameter => GetPropertyDirect<double>(base.Model.InnerDiameter, Units.inch);

		public double OuterDiameter => GetPropertyDirect<double>(base.Model.OuterDiameter, Units.inch);

		public double WallThickness => 0.5 * (OuterDiameter - InnerDiameter);

		public LineSizingDiameter(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
		}

		private static double CalculateOuterDiameter(double innerDiameter, double wallThickness)
		{
			return innerDiameter + 2.0 * wallThickness;
		}

		public void SpecifySizeAsSchedulePipe(double innerDiameter, double wallThickness)
		{
			SetPropertyDirect(base.Model.InnerDiameter, innerDiameter, notify: true, null, Units.inch, byUser: false);
			SetPropertyDirect(base.Model.OuterDiameter, CalculateOuterDiameter(innerDiameter, wallThickness), notify: true, null, Units.inch, byUser: false);
		}

		void ILineSizingDiameter.SpecifySizeAsSchedulePipe(double innerDiameter, double wallThickness)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in SpecifySizeAsSchedulePipe
			this.SpecifySizeAsSchedulePipe(innerDiameter, wallThickness);
		}

		public void SpecifySizeAsActualSize(double innerDiameter, double wallThickness)
		{
			SetPropertyDirect(base.Model.InnerDiameter, innerDiameter, notify: true, null, Units.inch);
			SetPropertyDirect(base.Model.OuterDiameter, CalculateOuterDiameter(innerDiameter, wallThickness), notify: true, null, Units.inch);
		}

		void ILineSizingDiameter.SpecifySizeAsActualSize(double innerDiameter, double wallThickness)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in SpecifySizeAsActualSize
			this.SpecifySizeAsActualSize(innerDiameter, wallThickness);
		}
	}
	public interface ILineSizingMaterial
	{
		string Name { get; }

		double Roughness { get; }

		string Notes { get; }
	}
	internal class LineSizingMaterial : LineSizingBaseModel<AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Models.PipeMaterial>, ILineSizingMaterial
	{
		public string Name => GetPropertyDirect<string>(base.Model.Name);

		public double Roughness => GetPropertyDirect<double>(base.Model.Roughness, Units.mm);

		public string Notes => GetPropertyDirect<string>(base.Model.Notes);

		public LineSizingMaterial(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ILineSizingMaterial))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ILineSizingMaterial lineSizingMaterial = (ILineSizingMaterial)obj;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name) ^ string.IsNullOrEmpty(lineSizingMaterial.Name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name) && !Name.Equals(lineSizingMaterial.Name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !MyMath.ValuesDiffer(Roughness, lineSizingMaterial.Roughness, 1E-12, 1E-12);
		}
	}

				SetPropertyDirect(base.Model.DefaultPressureDropCalculationType, value);
			}
		}

			{
				flag = ((LineSizingPipeElementList)WorkingCopy).ReCreateElement(index);
			}

		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum ValidatePiping(RigorousLineRating rating, PSVCalculation.AddMessageDelegate messageHandler, string prefix)
		{
			CalculationStatusEnum result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			if (!IsDetailedPiping(rating))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(EquivalentLength))
				{
					string message = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.NoEquivalentLength);
					messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message);
					result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(ElevationChange))
				{
					string message2 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.NoElevationChange);
					messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message2);
					result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning;
				}
				if (MyMath.ValueExceeds(Math.Abs(ElevationChange), EquivalentLength, 1E-06, 1E-06))
				{
					string message3 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.InvalidElevationChange);
					messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message3);
					result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(ReferenceDiameter.InnerDiameter))
				{
					string message4 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.NoPipeID);
					messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message4);
					result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(Roughness))
				{
					string message5 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_MissingRoughnessError);
					messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message5);
					result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning;
				}
				return result;
			}
			_InstantiateElements();
			if (_Elements.Count == 0)
			{
				string message6 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_NeedPipe);
				messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message6);
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning;
			}
			if (IsInletPipe)
			{
				int? num = (int?)((LineSizingPipeElement)_Elements[0]).ElementType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 8) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					string message7 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_InletBeginsWithTeeError);
					messageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, message7);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
			}
			if (!IsInletPipe)
			{
				int? num = (int?)((LineSizingPipeElement)_Elements.Last()).ElementType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 4) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					string message8 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_OutletEndsWithSwageError);
					messageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, message8);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
			}
			double num2 = (IsInletPipe ? ((LineSizingPipeElement)_Elements[0]).FlowMultiplier : 1.0);
			double d = double.NaN;
			bool flag = false;
			int num3 = checked(_Elements.Count - 1);
			for (int i = 0; i <= num3; i = checked(i + 1))
			{
				LineSizingPipeElement lineSizingPipeElement = (LineSizingPipeElement)_Elements[i];
				if (double.IsNaN(lineSizingPipeElement.InnerDiameter))
				{
					string message9 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_MissingDiameter);
					messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message9);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				if (!BaseModel<Pipe>.ValueExceeds(lineSizingPipeElement.FlowMultiplier, 0.0, 1E-06))
				{
					string message10 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_ZeroMultiplier);
					messageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, message10);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(num2, lineSizingPipeElement.FlowMultiplier, 1E-06, 1E-12))
				{
					if (lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType != PipeElementType.Tee)
					{
						string arg = string.Format(FormResource.RigPipe_FlowMultiplierChangeError, num2, lineSizingPipeElement.FlowMultiplier);
						string message11 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, arg);
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, message11);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					}
					num2 = lineSizingPipeElement.FlowMultiplier;
				}
				int? num = (int?)lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					flag = true;
					if (double.IsNaN(lineSizingPipeElement.Roughness))
					{
						string message12 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_MissingRoughnessError);
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message12);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(lineSizingPipeElement.ActualLength) || lineSizingPipeElement.ActualLength <= 0.0)
					{
						string message13 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_MissingLength);
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message13);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(lineSizingPipeElement.ElevationChange))
					{
						string message14 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_MissingElevationChange);
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message14);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					}
					if (MyMath.ValueExceeds(Math.Abs(lineSizingPipeElement.ElevationChange), lineSizingPipeElement.ActualLength, 1E-06, 1E-06))
					{
						string arg2 = string.Format(FormResource.RigPipe_InvalidElevationChange, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, lineSizingPipeElement.ActualLength, "Length"), DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, lineSizingPipeElement.ElevationChange, "Length"), DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit);
						string message15 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, arg2);
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message15);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					}
					d = lineSizingPipeElement.Roughness;
					continue;
				}
				num = (int?)lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					flag = true;
					if (double.IsNaN(lineSizingPipeElement.Roughness))
					{
						string message16 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_MissingRoughnessError);
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message16);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					}
					bool num4 = !double.IsNaN(lineSizingPipeElement.K) && lineSizingPipeElement.K > 0.0;
					bool flag2 = !double.IsNaN(lineSizingPipeElement.LoverD) && lineSizingPipeElement.LoverD > 0.0;
					if (!num4 && !flag2)
					{
						string message17 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_MissingFittingType);
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message17);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					}
					if (lineSizingPipeElement.Quantity < 1)
					{
						string arg3 = string.Format(FormResource.RigPipe_InvalidQuantity, lineSizingPipeElement.Quantity);
						string message18 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, arg3);
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message18);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					}
					d = lineSizingPipeElement.Roughness;
					continue;
				}
				num = (int?)lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 8) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					flag = true;
					if (double.IsNaN(lineSizingPipeElement.Roughness))
					{
						string message19 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_MissingRoughnessError);
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message19);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					}
					d = lineSizingPipeElement.Roughness;
				}
			}
			if (flag & double.IsNaN(d))
			{
				string message20 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, FormResource.RigPipe_MissingRoughnessError);
				messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message20);
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			if (IsInletPipe && num2 != 1.0)
			{
				string arg4 = string.Format(FormResource.RigPipe_FlowMultiplierAtPRDError, num2);
				string message21 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, arg4);
				messageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, message21);
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum CheckPipingConstraints(RigorousLineRating rating, PSVCalculation.AddMessageDelegate messageHandler, string prefix)
		{
			if (_ownerPRD?.DetailedReliefDevice == null)
			{
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			}
			double num = _ownerPRD.DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.ValueIn(Units.inch);
			double num2 = _ownerPRD.DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.ValueIn(Units.inch);
			double num3;
			string format;
			string format2;
			if (IsInletPipe)
			{
				num3 = num;
				format = FormResource.RigPipe_InletDesignSmallerThanFlange;
				format2 = FormResource.RigPipe_InletPipeElementSmallerThanFlange;
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = num2;
				format = FormResource.RigPipe_OutletDesignSmallerThanFlange;
				format2 = FormResource.RigPipe_OutletPipeElementSmallerThanFlange;
			}
			checked
			{
				if (!IsDetailedPiping(rating))
				{
					if (BaseModel<Pipe>.ValueExceeds(num3, ReferenceDiameter.NominalDiameter))
					{
						string message = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, string.Format(format, ReferenceDiameter.NominalDiameter, num3));
						messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_InstantiateElements();
					if (_Elements.Count == 0)
					{
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
					}
					int num4 = _Elements.Count - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num4; i++)
					{
						LineSizingPipeElement lineSizingPipeElement = (LineSizingPipeElement)_Elements[i];
						if (!double.IsNaN(lineSizingPipeElement.NominalDiameter) && !(lineSizingPipeElement.FlowMultiplier < 1.0) && BaseModel<Pipe>.ValueExceeds(num3, lineSizingPipeElement.NominalDiameter))
						{
							string message2 = string.Format(FormResource.MessagePair, prefix, string.Format(format2, lineSizingPipeElement.NominalDiameter, num3));
							messageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, message2);
							return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning;
						}
					}
				}
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			}
		}

		internal double GetFirstInnerDiameter_m()
		{
			foreach (ILineSizingPipeElement element in Elements)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(element.InnerDiameter))
				{

			inletPortIdx = 0;
			prevHydra = (IUnitOp)(object)val4;
			prevPort = 1;
			if (val3 == null)
			{
				val3 = (UnitOp)(object)val4;
			}
			if (localElement != null)
			{
				HydraulicsFittingToMyFittingIndex[(SSUnitOp)(object)val5] = localElement;
			}
			return (InletOp: val3, OutletOp: val4);
		}
	}
	public interface ILineSizingPipeElement
	{

		PipeElementType? ElementType { get; }

	internal class LineSizingPipeElement : LineSizingBaseModel<PipeElement>, ILineSizingPipeElement
	{

		private LineSizingDiameter _OutletDiameter;

		private LineSizingMaterial _Material;

		private LineSizingFittingTemplate _Template;

		public string Name
		{
			get

				return GetPropertyDirect<string>(base.Model.Name);
			}
			set

		}

		{

			}
		}

				return GetPropertyDirect<double>(base.Model.FlowMultiplier);

		public LineSizingDiameter PipeDiameter
		{

					_PipeDiameter = new LineSizingDiameter(uContainer);
					LineSizingDiameter pipeDiameter = _PipeDiameter;
					PsvKey dbKey = null;

		public ILineSizingMaterial Material
		{
			get
			{
				PipeSegment pipeSegment = base.Model as PipeSegment;
				PipeFitting pipeFitting = base.Model as PipeFitting;
				Tee tee = base.Model as Tee;
				if (pipeSegment != null && pipeSegment.Material != null)
				{
					if (_Material == null || _Material.Model != pipeSegment.Material)
					{
						_Material = new LineSizingMaterial(uContainer);
						LineSizingMaterial material = _Material;
						PsvKey dbKey = null;
						material.Initialize(ref dbKey, null, this, pipeSegment.Material);
					}
				}
				else if (pipeFitting != null && pipeFitting.Material != null)
				{
					if (_Material == null || _Material.Model != pipeFitting.Material)
					{
						_Material = new LineSizingMaterial(uContainer);
						LineSizingMaterial material2 = _Material;
						PsvKey dbKey = null;
						material2.Initialize(ref dbKey, null, this, pipeFitting.Material);
					}
				}
				else if (tee != null && tee.Material != null)
				{
					if (_Material == null || _Material.Model != tee.Material)
					{
						_Material = new LineSizingMaterial(uContainer);
						LineSizingMaterial material3 = _Material;
						PsvKey dbKey = null;
						material3.Initialize(ref dbKey, null, this, tee.Material);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_Material = null;
				}
				return _Material;
			}
			set
			{
				PipeSegment pipeSegment = base.Model as PipeSegment;
				PipeFitting pipeFitting = base.Model as PipeFitting;
				Tee tee = base.Model as Tee;
				if (pipeSegment == null && pipeFitting == null && tee == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					if (value is LineSizingMaterial lineSizingMaterial)
					{
						if (pipeSegment != null)
						{
							pipeSegment.Material = lineSizingMaterial.Model;
						}
						else if (pipeFitting != null)
						{
							pipeFitting.Material = lineSizingMaterial.Model;
						}
						else if (tee != null)
						{
							tee.Material = lineSizingMaterial.Model;
						}
						_Material = lineSizingMaterial;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (pipeSegment != null)
					{
						pipeSegment.Material = null;
					}
					else if (pipeFitting != null)
					{
						pipeFitting.Material = null;
					}
					else if (tee != null)
					{
						tee.Material = null;
					}
					_Material = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public ILineSizingFittingTemplate Template
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Model is PipeFitting { PipeFittingTemplate: not null } pipeFitting)
				{
					if (_Template == null || _Template.Model != pipeFitting.PipeFittingTemplate)
					{
						_Template = new LineSizingFittingTemplate(uContainer);
						LineSizingFittingTemplate template = _Template;
						PsvKey dbKey = null;
						template.Initialize(ref dbKey, null, this, pipeFitting.PipeFittingTemplate);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_Template = null;
				}
				return _Template;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(base.Model is PipeFitting pipeFitting))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					if (value is LineSizingFittingTemplate lineSizingFittingTemplate)
					{
						pipeFitting.SetTemplate(lineSizingFittingTemplate.Model);
						_Template = lineSizingFittingTemplate;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					pipeFitting.SetTemplate(null);
					_Template = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public double K
		{
			get
			{
				ILineSizingFittingTemplate template = Template;
				if (template != null)
				{
					return template.K;
				}
				MultiDiameterElement multiDiameterElement = base.Model as MultiDiameterElement;
				PipeFitting pipeFitting = base.Model as PipeFitting;
				return multiDiameterElement?.K.Value ?? pipeFitting?.K.Value ?? double.NaN;
			}
			internal set
			{
				MultiDiameterElement multiDiameterElement = base.Model as MultiDiameterElement;
				PipeFitting pipeFitting = base.Model as PipeFitting;
				if (multiDiameterElement != null)
				{
					multiDiameterElement.K.Specify(value, new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				else if (pipeFitting != null && pipeFitting.PipeFittingTemplate == null)
				{
					pipeFitting.K.Specify(value, new UserSpecifier());
				}
			}
		}

		public double LoverD
		{
			get
			{
				ILineSizingFittingTemplate template = Template;

		public double Roughness
		{
			get
			{
				PipeSegment pipeSegment = base.Model as PipeSegment;
				PipeFitting pipeFitting = base.Model as PipeFitting;
				Tee tee = base.Model as Tee;
				if (pipeSegment != null)
				{
					if (pipeSegment.Material != null)
					{
						return GetPropertyDirect<double>(pipeSegment.Material.Roughness, Units.inch);
					}
					return GetPropertyDirect<double>(pipeSegment.Roughness, Units.inch);
				}
				if (pipeFitting != null)
				{
					if (pipeFitting.Material != null)
					{
						return GetPropertyDirect<double>(pipeFitting.Material.Roughness, Units.inch);
					}
					return GetPropertyDirect<double>(pipeFitting.Roughness, Units.inch);
				}
				if (tee != null)
				{
					if (tee.Material != null)
					{
						return GetPropertyDirect<double>(tee.Material.Roughness, Units.inch);
					}
					return GetPropertyDirect<double>(tee.Roughness, Units.inch);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
			set
			{
				PipeSegment pipeSegment = base.Model as PipeSegment;
				PipeFitting pipeFitting = base.Model as PipeFitting;
				Tee tee = base.Model as Tee;
				if (pipeSegment != null && pipeSegment.Material == null)
				{
					SetPropertyDirect(pipeSegment.Roughness, value, notify: true, null, Units.inch);
				}
				else if (pipeFitting != null && pipeFitting.Material == null)
				{
					SetPropertyDirect(pipeFitting.Roughness, value, notify: true, null, Units.inch);
				}
				else if (tee != null && tee.Material == null)
				{
					SetPropertyDirect(tee.Roughness, value, notify: true, null, Units.inch);
				}
			}
		}
