	public abstract class PRDModel : BaseModel<ReliefDevice>, INamedModel
	{
		public delegate void ScenarioUpdatedEventHandler();

		public delegate void ScenarioDeletedEventHandler(ScenarioDeletedEventArgs e);

		public delegate void ScenarioModelsCountChangedEventHandler(object sender, ScenarioCountChangedEventArgs e);

		private LineSizingPipe _InletPipe;

		private LineSizingPipe _OutletPipe;

		protected List<PSVScenarioModel> mScenarioModels;

		internal const string s_IsOverallModel = "IsOverallModel";

		internal const string s_SpareValve = "IsSparePRD";

		internal const string s_Suffix = "Suffix";

		internal const string s_SetPress = "SetPress";

		internal const string s_SuperImpConstBackPress = "SuperImpConstBackPress";

		internal const string s_UOMSuperImpConstBackPress = "UOMSuperImpConstBackPress";

		internal const string s_IsSetPressFromDesign = "IsSetPressFromDesign";

		internal const string s_PRDNotes = "PRDNotes";

		internal const string s_PRDType = "PRDType";

		private PSVMessageCollection mValveMessages;

		internal LineSizingPipe InletPipe
		{
			get
			{
				_InitializeInletPipe();
				return _InletPipe;
			}
		}

		internal LineSizingPipe OutletPipe
		{
			get
			{
				_InitializeOutletPipe();
				return _OutletPipe;
			}
		}

		public string PRDName
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Model.IsBeingDeleted)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				string text = base.Model?.PressureProtectionRequirement?.Name?.Value;
				if (Operators.CompareString(Suffix, "", TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					text = text + " " + Suffix;
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		public string FullName => PRDName;

		public bool IsOverallModel
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Model == base.Model.PressureProtectionRequirement?.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration?.TotalOrifice;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public bool IfSpare
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Model.PressureProtectionRequirement.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices.Contains(base.Model);
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public string Suffix
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Model.DeviceName.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if ((string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) & !IsOverallModel) | !SuffixIsUnique(value))
				{
					System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.PRD_NonUniqueSuffix, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
				}
				else if (SetProperty("Suffix", value))
				{
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("FullName");
				}
			}
		}

		private ReliefDeviceType? PRDType => base.Model.ReliefDeviceType;

		public double SetPressure
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Model.SetPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);
			}
			internal set
			{
				double num = this.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true);
				if (!MyMath.ValuesDiffer(value, num, 1E-12, 1E-12))
				{
					return;
				}
				SetProperty("SetPress", value, notify: true, Units.bar, byUser: true, PressureReference.Gauge);
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel mScenarioModel in mScenarioModels)
				{
					mScenarioModel.ValvePressureChanged(notify: false);
					mScenarioModel.UpdateReliefPressure(notify: false);
				}
				if (recalculateOnChange && (!double.IsNaN(value) | !double.IsNaN(num)))
				{
					CalculateAllScenarios("SetPress");
				}
				NotifyScenariosPressureChanged(recalculateOnChange);
			}
		}

		public double OperPress => base.Model.PressureProtectionRequirement.OperatingPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);

		protected AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Models.DischargeLocation DischargeLocation => base.Model.PressureProtectionRequirement.DischargeLocation;

		public double ConstBackPress
		{
			get
			{
				return DischargeLocation.ConstantSuperimposedBackpressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Absolute);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != ConstBackPress)
				{
					DischargeLocation.ConstantSuperimposedBackpressure.Specify(Pressure.Absolute(value, Units.bar), new UserSpecifier());
					NotifyPropertyChanged("SuperImpConstBackPress");
					CalculateAllScenarios("SuperImpConstBackPress");
				}
			}
		}

		public string UOMSuperImpConstBackPress => UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA;

		public double SizingCaseRelFlow

					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (PipeLine.InletPipe.Material != null)
				{
					return PipeLine.InletPipe.Material.Roughness.ValueIn(Units.inch);
				}
				return PipeLine.InletPipe.Roughness.ValueIn(Units.inch);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(value, notify: true, Units.inch, byUser: true, null, "InRough");
			}
		}

		public double OutRough
		{
			get
			{
				if (PipeLine == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (PipeLine.OutletPipe.Material != null)
				{
					return PipeLine.OutletPipe.Material.Roughness.ValueIn(Units.inch);

			}
			set

				SetProperty(value, notify: true, Units.inch, byUser: true, null, "OutRough");
			}
		}

		public MessageLevel ValveMessageLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Information.IsNothing(mValveMessages))
				{
					PSVMessage displayMessage = GetDisplayMessage();
					if (displayMessage != null)
					{
						return displayMessage.MessageLevel;
					}
				}
				return MessageLevel.Ok;
			}
		}

		public string ValveMessages
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Information.IsNothing(mValveMessages))
				{
					PSVMessage displayMessage = GetDisplayMessage();
					if (displayMessage != null)
					{
						return displayMessage.Message;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

		public event ScenarioUpdatedEventHandler ScenarioUpdated;

		public event ScenarioDeletedEventHandler ScenarioDeleted;

		public event ScenarioModelsCountChangedEventHandler ScenarioModelsCountChanged;

		private void _InitializeInletPipe()
		{
			if (_InletPipe == null)
			{
				Pipe inletPipe = base.Model.PipeLine.InletPipe;
				if (inletPipe != null)
				{
					_InletPipe = new LineSizingPipe(uContainer);
					_InletPipe.Initialize(this, inletPipe, base.Model, isInletPipe: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void _InitializeOutletPipe()
		{
			if (_OutletPipe == null)
			{
				Pipe outletPipe = base.Model.PipeLine.OutletPipe;
				if (outletPipe != null)
				{
					_OutletPipe = new LineSizingPipe(uContainer);
					_OutletPipe.Initialize(this, outletPipe, base.Model, isInletPipe: false);
				}
			}
		}

		public ILineSizingPipe GetInletPipeForEdit()
		{
			if (_InletPipe == null)
			{
				_InitializeInletPipe();
				if (_InletPipe == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (_InletPipe.IsWorking)
			{
				return null;
			}
			_InletPipe.CreateWorkingCopy();
			return _InletPipe;
		}

		private void _AcceptInletPipeChanges()
		{
			if (_InletPipe == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Attempting to accept changes without a valid inlet pipe.");
			}
			if (!_InletPipe.IsWorking)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Attempting to accept changes but inlet pipe is not currently in an editable state.");
			}
			_InletPipe.ResolveWorkingCopy();
		}

		private void _CancelInletPipeChanges()
		{
			if (_InletPipe == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Attempting to cancel changes without a valid inlet pipe.");
			}
			if (!_InletPipe.IsWorking)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Attempting to cancel changes but inlet pipe is not currently in an editable state.");
			}
			_InletPipe.DiscardWorkingCopy();
		}

		public ILineSizingPipe GetOutletPipeForEdit()
		{
			if (_OutletPipe == null)
			{
				_InitializeOutletPipe();
				if (_OutletPipe == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (_OutletPipe.IsWorking)
			{
				return null;
			}
			_OutletPipe.CreateWorkingCopy();
			return _OutletPipe;
		}

		private void _AcceptOutletPipeChanges()
		{
			if (_OutletPipe == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Attempting to accept changes without a valid outlet pipe.");
			}
			if (!_OutletPipe.IsWorking)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Attempting to accept changes but outlet pipe is not currently in an editable state.");
			}
			_OutletPipe.ResolveWorkingCopy();
		}

		private void _CancelOutletPipeChanges()
		{
			if (_OutletPipe == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Attempting to cancel changes without a valid outlet pipe.");
			}
			if (!_OutletPipe.IsWorking)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Attempting to cancel changes but outlet pipe is not currently in an editable state.");
			}
			_OutletPipe.DiscardWorkingCopy();
		}

		public void BeginEditPipes(ref ILineSizingPipe inletPipe, ref ILineSizingPipe outletPipe)
		{
			inletPipe = GetInletPipeForEdit();
			outletPipe = GetOutletPipeForEdit();
		}

		public void AcceptPipeChanges()
		{
			_AcceptInletPipeChanges();
			_AcceptOutletPipeChanges();
			InvalidatePipes();
		}

		public void CancelPipeChanges()
		{
			_CancelInletPipeChanges();
			_CancelOutletPipeChanges();
		}

		public void InvalidatePipes()
		{
			_InletPipe = null;
			_OutletPipe = null;
			NotifyPropertyChanged("InEquivLength");
		}

		public PRDModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			_InletPipe = null;
			_OutletPipe = null;
			mScenarioModels = new List<PSVScenarioModel>();
			mValveMessages = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<PSVMessageCollection>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
		}

		public override void Initialize(ref PsvKey dbkey, string CXSDatapath, IBaseModel owner, ReliefDevice datamodel)
		{
			if (!(owner is PRDSystemModel))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Type of owner must be PRDSystemModel.", "owner");
			}
			base.Initialize(ref dbkey, CXSDatapath, owner, datamodel);
			mValveMessages.Initialize(datamodel);
			Properties.Add("Suffix", base.Model.DeviceName);
			Properties.Add("SetPress", base.Model.SetPressure);
			Properties.Add("IsSetPressFromDesign", base.Model.SetPressureFromDesignPressure);
			Properties.Add("PRDNotes", base.Model.Notes);
			if (PipeLine != null)
			{
				Properties.Add("InND", PipeLine.InletPipe.ReferenceDiameter.NominalDiameter);
				Properties.Add("InSch", PipeLine.InletPipe.ReferenceDiameter.Schedule);
				Properties.Add("OutND", PipeLine.OutletPipe.ReferenceDiameter.NominalDiameter);
				Properties.Add("OutSch", PipeLine.OutletPipe.ReferenceDiameter.Schedule);
				Properties.Add("InID", PipeLine.InletPipe.ReferenceDiameter.InnerDiameter);
				Properties.Add("OutID", PipeLine.OutletPipe.ReferenceDiameter.InnerDiameter);
				Properties.Add("InRough", PipeLine.InletPipe.Roughness);
				Properties.Add("OutRough", PipeLine.OutletPipe.Roughness);
				Properties.Add("InEquivLength", PipeLine.InletPipe.EquivalentLength);
				Properties.Add("OutEquivLength", PipeLine.OutletPipe.EquivalentLength);
				Properties.Add("InElevation", PipeLine.InletPipe.ElevationChange);
				Properties.Add("OutElevation", PipeLine.OutletPipe.ElevationChange);
			}
			Make("PRDName").ObservesProperty(() => Model.PressureProtectionRequirement.Name.Value).ObservesProperty(() => Suffix);
			_UpdateNoScenarioMessage(shouldClear: false);
			_UpdateSetPressureMessages(shouldClear: false);
		}

		public override void Delete()
		{
			DeleteAllScenarios();
			ClearValveMessages(MessageLocation.Anywhere);
			base.Delete();
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(IBaseModel source)
		{
			PRDModel pRDModel = (PRDModel)source;
			if (pRDModel != null)
			{
				CopyFromHelper(pRDModel);
			}
		}

		private void CopyFromHelper(PRDModel source)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(source);
			base.Model.CopyFrom(source.Model, onlyUserSpecified: false);
		}

		public override void UpdateDataPath(string path)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) || string.Equals(base.Datapath, path))
			{
				return;
			}
			base.UpdateDataPath(path);
			if (Information.IsNothing(ScenarioModels))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel in ScenarioModels)
			{
				scenarioModel.PSVNodeKey = path;
			}
		}

		protected bool SuffixIsUnique(string suffix)
		{
			ReliefDeviceConfiguration selectedReliefDeviceConfiguration = base.Model.PressureProtectionRequirement.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration;
			return !(from rd in selectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Concat(selectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices)
				where (Operators.CompareString(rd.DeviceName.Value, suffix, TextCompare: false) == 0) & (rd != base.Model)
				select (rd)).Any();
		}

		public void UpdateSystemSetPressure(double newSetPressure_barG)
		{
			PRDSystem.UpdateSystemSetPressures(newSetPressure_barG, notify: true);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateSetPressure(double userValue)
		{
			if (this.get_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: true))
			{
				this.set_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true, PRDSystem.DesignPress);
			}
			else
			{
				this.set_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true, userValue);
			}
		}

		protected void OnScenarioUpdated()
		{
			ScenarioUpdated?.Invoke();
		}

		private FluidPhaseRegime GetPhaseType(ref IPPPFluid fluid)
		{
			return PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(fluid.VaporFraction());
		}

		public static OrificeSizingMethod GetModelType(FluidPhaseRegime phaseRegime, ReliefDeviceType PRDType, bool canExecuteKrMethodSizing)
		{
			OrificeSizingMethod result = phaseRegime switch
			{
				FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor => OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor, 
				FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid => OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid, 
				_ => OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct, 
			};
			if (PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && canExecuteKrMethodSizing)
			{
				result = OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void CalculateOneScenario(PSVScenarioModel refScenario)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel mScenarioModel in mScenarioModels)
			{
				if (mScenarioModel.MasterScenarioModel == refScenario)
				{
					mScenarioModel.Calculate(isForced: true);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				UpdateValveMessages();
				OnScenarioUpdated();
			}
		}

		public void CalculateAllScenarios(string propname, bool isForced = false, bool isSequenced = false)
		{
			_CalculateAllScenarios(propname, isForced, isSequenced);
		}

		public void CalculateAllScenarios(bool isForced = false)
		{
			_CalculateAllScenarios(null, isForced, isSequenced: false);
		}

		private void _CalculateAllScenarios(string propName, bool isForced, bool isSequenced)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (string.Compare(propName, "SetPress", ignoreCase: true) == 0)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel mScenarioModel in mScenarioModels)
			{
				if (!flag || !mScenarioModel.IsRatingCalc)
				{
					mScenarioModel.Calculate(propName, isForced, isSequenced);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					mScenarioModel.ValvePressureChanged();
				}
			}
			UpdateValveMessages();
			OnScenarioUpdated();
		}

		internal void ForceCalculateLineSize()
		{
			GetSizingCaseModel()?.CalculateLineSize(force: true);
		}

		public void NotifyScenariosPressureChanged(bool notify = true)
		{
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel mScenarioModel in mScenarioModels)
			{
				mScenarioModel.ValvePressureChanged(notify);
			}
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel GetSizingCaseModel()
		{
			if (base.Model.PressureProtectionRequirement == null || base.Model.PressureProtectionRequirement.BindingOrificeScenario == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (from s in ScenarioModels
				where s.Model.ReliefScenario == base.Model.PressureProtectionRequirement.BindingOrificeScenario
				select (s)).SingleOrDefault();
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel GetScenarioModel(PsvKey dbRow)
		{
			PSVScenarioModel result = null;
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel mScenarioModel in mScenarioModels)
			{
				if (mScenarioModel.DBKey == dbRow)
				{
					result = mScenarioModel;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel GetScenarioModel(PrdConstraintsDefinition datamodel)
		{
			return mScenarioModels.SingleOrDefault([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel scn) => scn.Model == datamodel);
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel GetScenarioModel(PSVScenarioModel refScenario)
		{
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel mScenarioModel in mScenarioModels)
			{
				if (mScenarioModel == refScenario)
				{
					return mScenarioModel;
				}
				if (mScenarioModel.RefScenarioModel != null && mScenarioModel.RefScenarioModel == refScenario)
				{
					return mScenarioModel;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel CreateScenario(ref IPPPFluid fluid, string scenarioName, ReliefDeviceType prdType, ReliefScenario reliefScenario)
		{
			InitializeFluidProperties(fluid);
			FluidPhaseRegime phaseType = GetPhaseType(ref fluid);
			bool canHostExecuteKrMethodSizing = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).CanHostExecuteKrMethodSizing;
			OrificeSizingMethod modelType = GetModelType(phaseType, prdType, canHostExecuteKrMethodSizing);
			PrdConstraintsDefinition totalOrificeConstraints = reliefScenario.TotalOrificeConstraints;
			reliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Specify(modelType, new UserSpecifier());
			totalOrificeConstraints.ValidateOrificeSizingModelType();
			PSVDBKey key = new PSVDBKey(eRecordType.OrificeCalc, totalOrificeConstraints.LegacyKey);
			PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = AddScenarioModel(key, fluid, scenarioName, totalOrificeConstraints, null, createAsFrozen: true);
			pSVScenarioModel.Fluid = pSVScenarioModel.ChosenStream;
			pSVScenarioModel.Calculate(isForced: true);
			pSVScenarioModel.SendBackValues();
			return pSVScenarioModel;
		}

		public void InitializeFluidProperties(IPPPFluid fluid)
		{
			if (string.Equals(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).PSVHostType, "ASPENPLUS") && !(double.IsNaN(fluid.Temperature()) | double.IsNaN(fluid.Pressure())))
			{
				fluid.TPFlash(fluid.Temperature(), fluid.Pressure());
			}
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel AddScenarioModel(PsvKey key, IPPPFluid fluid, string scenarioName, PrdConstraintsDefinition prdConstraints, PSVScenarioModel masterScenarioModel = null, bool createAsFrozen = false)
		{
			PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = new PSVScenarioModel(uContainer);
			pSVScenarioModel.Initialize(base.Datapath, scenarioName, key, this, prdConstraints, fluid, masterScenarioModel, createAsFrozen);
			int count = mScenarioModels.Count;
			mScenarioModels.Add(pSVScenarioModel);
			int count2 = mScenarioModels.Count;
			ScenarioCountChangedEventArgs e = new ScenarioCountChangedEventArgs();
			e.OldCount = count;
			e.NewCount = count2;
			OnScenarioModelsCountChanged(e);
			pSVScenarioModel.ScenarioDataChanged += UpdateValveMessages;
			pSVScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged += OnBaseModelChanged;
			return pSVScenarioModel;
		}

		public void DeleteAllScenarios()
		{
			List<PSVScenarioModel> list = new List<PSVScenarioModel>();
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel mScenarioModel in mScenarioModels)
			{
				list.Add(mScenarioModel);
			}
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel item in list)
			{
				PSVScenarioModel scenario = item;
				DeleteScenario(ref scenario);
			}
		}

		public void DeleteScenario(ref PSVScenarioModel scenario)
		{
			if (scenario != null && (object)scenario.DBKey != null)
			{
				ScenarioDeletedEventArgs e = new ScenarioDeletedEventArgs();
				e.IsSizingCase = scenario.IsSizingCase;
				e.Key = scenario.DBKey;
				scenario.Delete();
				mScenarioModels.Remove(scenario);
				scenario.ScenarioDataChanged -= UpdateValveMessages;
				scenario.BaseModelChanged -= OnBaseModelChanged;
				OnScenarioDeleted(e);
			}
		}

		internal void UnlinkScenarios()
		{
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel mScenarioModel in mScenarioModels)
			{
				mScenarioModel.ScenarioDataChanged -= UpdateValveMessages;
				mScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged -= OnBaseModelChanged;
				mScenarioModel.Unlink();
			}
		}

		protected void OnScenarioModelsCountChanged(ScenarioCountChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.HostInterface.InvokeOnUi(this, (VB$AnonymousDelegate_1<ScenarioCountChangedEventArgs>)([SpecialName] (ScenarioCountChangedEventArgs args) =>
			{
				RaiseCountChanged(args);
			}), e);
		}

		protected void OnScenarioDeleted(ScenarioDeletedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.HostInterface.InvokeOnUi(this, (VB$AnonymousDelegate_1<ScenarioDeletedEventArgs>)([SpecialName] (ScenarioDeletedEventArgs args) =>
			{
				ScenarioDeleted?.Invoke(args);
			}), e);
		}

		private void RaiseCountChanged(ScenarioCountChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ScenarioModelsCountChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateValveMessages()
		{
			ClearValveMessages();
			_UpdateSetPressureMessages(shouldClear: false);
			if (double.IsNaN(ConstBackPress))
			{
				AddValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SuperImpConstBackPress);
			}
			_UpdateNoScenarioMessage(shouldClear: false);
			if (!IfSpare && ScenarioModels.Count > 0)
			{
				PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = GetSizingCaseModel();
				if (sizingCaseModel == null)
				{
					AddValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoSizingCase);
				}
				else if (double.IsNaN(sizingCaseModel.SelectOrifice) & !double.IsNaN(sizingCaseModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true)))
				{
					if (PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
					{
						AddValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoSelectedOrifice);
					}
					else
					{
						AddValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoSelectedRd);
					}
				}
			}
			SendSimulatorStatusMessages();
			NotifyValveMessagesPropertyChanged();
		}

		private void _UpdateNoScenarioMessage(bool shouldClear = true)
		{
			if (IsOverallModel && !IfSpare)
			{
				if (ScenarioModels.Count < 1)
				{
					AddValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoEmergencyScenario);
				}
				else if (shouldClear)
				{
					_RemoveValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoEmergencyScenario);
				}
			}
		}

		private void _UpdateSetPressureMessages(bool shouldClear = true)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(this.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true)))
			{
				AddValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SetPress);
				return;
			}
			if (shouldClear)
			{
				_RemoveValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SetPress);
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(OperPress) && BaseModel<ReliefDevice>.ValueExceeds(OperPress, this.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true)))
			{
				AddValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.PRD_SetLessThanOperPress);
			}
			else if (shouldClear)
			{
				_RemoveValveMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.PRD_SetLessThanOperPress);
			}
		}

		public void AddValveMessage(MessageLevel level, string message, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.SummaryForm)
		{
			mValveMessages.AddMessage(level, message, this, location);
			NotifyValveMessagesPropertyChanged();
		}

		private void _RemoveValveMessage(MessageLevel level, string message, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.SummaryForm)
		{
			mValveMessages.RemoveMessage(level, message, location, null, this);
			NotifyValveMessagesPropertyChanged();
		}

		public void SendSimulatorStatusMessages()
		{
			int num = 0;
			IList<PSVMessage> list = mValveMessages.ObjectMessages(this);
			checked
			{
				foreach (PSVMessage item in list)
				{
					num++;
					base.HostInterface.AddStatus(item.MessageLevel, num, item.Message);
				}
				PSVMessage displayMessage = GetDisplayMessage();
				if (displayMessage != null && (object)displayMessage.RefObject != this)
				{
					base.HostInterface.AddStatus(displayMessage.MessageLevel, num + 1, displayMessage.Message);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearValveMessages(MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.SummaryForm)
		{
			mValveMessages.ClearMessages(this, location);
			TellSimulatorForgetMessages();
		}

		public PSVMessage GetDisplayMessage()
		{
			PSVMessage pSVMessage = mValveMessages.GetHighestLevelMessage(this);
			PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = GetSizingCaseModel();
			if (sizingCaseModel != null)
			{
				IList<PSVMessage> list = mValveMessages.ObjectMessages(sizingCaseModel);
				foreach (PSVMessage item in list)
				{
					if (!PSVScenarioModel.IsLineSizingMessage(item) && (pSVMessage == null || item.MessageLevel > pSVMessage.MessageLevel))
					{
						pSVMessage = item;
					}
				}
			}
			return pSVMessage;
		}

		public void NotifyValveMessagesPropertyChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ValveMessages");
		}

		private void OnBaseModelChanged(IBaseModel sender, bool recalculateRatingModels)
		{
			OnScenarioUpdated();
		}
	}
	public class OrificeSizeSettingModel : BaseSettingsModel
	{
		private ObservableCollection<OrificeSpecModel> mAvailablePsvOrifices;

		private ObservableCollection<OrificeSpecModel> mAvailableRuptureDiscOrifices;

		public bool AllOrificesDirty { get; }

		public ObservableCollection<OrificeSpecModel> AvailableOrifices
		{
			get
			{
				if (PrdType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					return mAvailablePsvOrifices;
				}
				return mAvailableRuptureDiscOrifices;
			}
		}

		public void ResetDirty()
		{
			AllOrificesDirty = false;
			foreach (OrificeSpecModel item in mAvailablePsvOrifices.Where([SpecialName] (OrificeSpecModel o) => !o.IsBuiltInOrifice))
			{
				item.ResetDirty();
			}
		}

		public OrificeSizeSettingModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			AllOrificesDirty = false;
			mAvailablePsvOrifices = new ObservableCollection<OrificeSpecModel>();
			mAvailableRuptureDiscOrifices = new ObservableCollection<OrificeSpecModel>();
		}

		public void Initialize(IBaseModel owner, PsvKey PSVkey = null)
		{
			_InitializeOrificeSpecifications();
		}

		private void _InitializeOrificeSpecifications()
		{
			mAvailablePsvOrifices.Clear();
			mAvailableRuptureDiscOrifices.Clear();
			List<OrificeSpecModel> list = new List<OrificeSpecModel>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ReliefOrifice> reliefOrifice in SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.ReliefOrifices)
			{
				if (reliefOrifice.Value.IsBuiltInOrifice.Value ?? true)
				{
					OrificeSpecModel orificeSpecModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<OrificeSpecModel>(_container, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
					orificeSpecModel.Initialize(reliefOrifice.Value);
					list.Add(orificeSpecModel);
				}
			}
			foreach (DetailedReliefDevice customDetailedReliefDevice in SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.CustomDetailedReliefDevices)
			{
				OrificeSpecModel orificeSpecModel2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<OrificeSpecModel>(_container, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
				orificeSpecModel2.Initialize(customDetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice, customDetailedReliefDevice);
				list.Add(orificeSpecModel2);
			}
			list.Sort(new OrificeSpecModel.AreaComparison());
			foreach (OrificeSpecModel item in list)
			{
				if (item.Model is PsvOrifice)
				{
					mAvailablePsvOrifices.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					mAvailableRuptureDiscOrifices.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public OrificeSpecModel CreateCustomOrifice(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
		{
			string uniqueOrificeName = SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.GetUniqueOrificeName();
			DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice = SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.CreatePsvOrifice(uniqueOrificeName, null, new Area());
			OrificeSpecModel orificeSpecModel = new OrificeSpecModel(unityContainer);
			orificeSpecModel.Initialize(detailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice, detailedReliefDevice);
			mAvailablePsvOrifices.Add(orificeSpecModel);
			AllOrificesDirty = true;
			return orificeSpecModel;
		}

		public bool RemoveCustomOrifice(int index)
		{
			OrificeSpecModel orificeSpecModel = mAvailablePsvOrifices[index];
			if (!orificeSpecModel.IsBuiltInOrifice)
			{
				SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.RemoveReliefOrifice(orificeSpecModel.Model);
				mAvailablePsvOrifices.RemoveAt(index);
				AllOrificesDirty = true;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool RemoveCustomOrifice(OrificeSpecModel orifice)
		{
			if (orifice.IsBuiltInOrifice)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.RemoveReliefOrifice(orifice.Model);
			mAvailablePsvOrifices.Remove(orifice);
			AllOrificesDirty = true;
			return true;
		}

		public void OnSettingsLoaded()
		{
			_InitializeOrificeSpecifications();
			AllOrificesDirty = true;
		}

		public OrificeSpecModel GetRuptureDiskOrifice(double diameterInCm)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(diameterInCm))
			{
				return null;
			}
			RuptureDiskOrifice rdBuiltInReliefOrifice = SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.GetRdBuiltInReliefOrifice(new Distance(diameterInCm, Units.cm));
			if (rdBuiltInReliefOrifice == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			OrificeSpecModel orificeSpecModel = new OrificeSpecModel(_container);
			orificeSpecModel.Initialize(rdBuiltInReliefOrifice);
			return orificeSpecModel;
		}
	}
	public class OrificeSpecModel : BaseModel<ReliefOrifice>
	{
		internal class AreaComparison : IComparer<OrificeSpecModel>
		{
			public int Compare(OrificeSpecModel x, OrificeSpecModel y)
			{
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					if (x == null && y == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					if (x == null)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				if (!MyMath.ValuesDiffer(x.Area, y.Area, 1E-12, 1E-12))
				{
					if (x.IsBuiltInOrifice ^ y.IsBuiltInOrifice)
					{
						if (x.IsBuiltInOrifice)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						return -1;
					}
					return x.OrificeName.CompareTo(y.OrificeName);
				}
				return x.Area.CompareTo(y.Area);
			}

			int IComparer<OrificeSpecModel>.Compare(OrificeSpecModel x, OrificeSpecModel y)
			{
				//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in Compare
				return this.Compare(x, y);
			}
		}

			_DetailedDevice = device;
			Properties.Clear();
			Properties.Add("OrificeName", model.Name);
			Properties.Add("Designation", model.Designation);
			Properties.Add("Area", model.OrificeArea);
			Properties.Add("VaporKd", model.VaporKd);
			Properties.Add("LiquidKd", model.LiquidKd);
			Properties.Add("MixedKd", model.MixedKd);
			if (device != null)
			{
				Properties.Add("InletFlangeSize", _DetailedDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter);
				Properties.Add("InletFlangeRating", _DetailedDevice.InletRating);
				Properties.Add("OutletFlangeSize", _DetailedDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter);
				Properties.Add("OutletFlangeRating", _DetailedDevice.OutletRating);
			}
		}

					VerifyDesignPress(ref curValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public double SplitSetPressureIncrease
		{
			get
			{
				double result = double.NaN;
				if ((iPRD >= 0) & (iPRD < mSplitPRDModels.Count))
				{
					result = mSplitSetPressInc[iPRD] * 100.0;
				}
				return result;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!((iPRD >= 0) & (iPRD < mSplitPRDModels.Count)))
				{
					return;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				double num = Math.Round(value / 100.0, 6, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
				checked
				{
					if (iPRD > 0 && num < Math.Round(mSplitSetPressInc[iPRD - 1], 6, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (iPRD < mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1 && num > Math.Round(mSplitSetPressInc[iPRD + 1], 6, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						SplitPRDModels[iPRD].set_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true, mOverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true) * (1.0 + num));
						mSplitSetPressInc[iPRD] = num;
						if (!suppressRatingCalc)
						{
							CalculateRating(shouldUpdateSplitSetIncrease: false);
						}
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SplitSetPressureIncrease");
					}
					else
					{
						System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.PRDSystem_SetPressIncrease, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public double SpareSetPressureIncrease
		{
			get
			{
				double result = double.NaN;
				if ((iPRD >= 0) & (iPRD < mSparePRDModels.Count))
				{
					result = mSpareSetPressInc[iPRD] * 100.0;
				}
				return result;
			}
			set
			{
				if ((iPRD >= 0) & (iPRD < mSparePRDModels.Count))
				{
					double num = value / 100.0;
					SparePRDModels[iPRD].set_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true, mOverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true) * (1.0 + num));
					mSpareSetPressInc[iPRD] = num;
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SpareSetPressureIncrease");
				}
			}
		}

		public double FlowSplit
		{
			get
			{
				double result = double.NaN;
				if ((iPRD >= 0) & (iPRD < mSplitPRDModels.Count))
				{
					result = mFlowSplit[iPRD] * 100.0;
				}
				return result;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!((iPRD >= 0) & (iPRD < mSplitPRDModels.Count)))
				{
					return;
				}
				if ((mOverallPRDModel is PSVValveModel) & (mSplitPRDModels[iPRD] is PSVValveModel))
				{
					PSVValveModel pSVValveModel = (PSVValveModel)mSplitPRDModels[iPRD];
					PSVValveModel pSVValveModel2 = (PSVValveModel)mOverallPRDModel;
					double num = value / 100.0;
					if (pSVValveModel != null && pSVValveModel2 != null && pSVValveModel.GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
					{
						foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel2 in pSVValveModel2.ScenarioModels)
						{
							PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel = pSVValveModel.GetScenarioModel(scenarioModel2);
							if (scenarioModel != null)
							{
								scenarioModel.set_RelFlow(notify: true, scenarioModel2.get_RelFlow(notify: true) * num);
								scenarioModel.FlowFraction = num;
							}
						}
					}
					mFlowSplit[iPRD] = num;
				}
				else if ((mOverallPRDModel is RuptureDiskModel) & (mSplitPRDModels[iPRD] is RuptureDiskModel))
				{
					mSplitPRDModels[iPRD].set_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true, mOverallPRDModel.get_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true));
					mFlowSplit[iPRD] = 1.0;
				}
				_UpdateFlowSplitMessage();
				DataChanged?.Invoke();
			}
		}

		public double FlowAmountUsed
		{
			get
			{
				double result = 0.0;
				if (((iScenario >= 0) & (iScenario < mFlowAmountUsed.Count)) && ((iSplitPRD >= 0) & (iSplitPRD < mFlowAmountUsed[iScenario].Count)))
				{
					result = mFlowAmountUsed[iScenario][iSplitPRD];
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public double FlowAmountOfTotalFraction
		{
			get
			{
				double result = 0.0;
				double num = OverallScenarioModels[iScenario].get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
				if ((num != 0.0) & !double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					result = mFlowAmountUsed[iScenario][iSplitPRD] / num;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public double RatedFlowCapacity

					double num = GetSizingCaseModel().get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
					if ((num != 0.0) & !double.IsNaN(num))
					{
						result = SplitPRDModels[iSplitPRD].GetSizingCaseModel().RatedFlow / num;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public double TotalSelectedArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetSizingCaseModel() == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (SplitPRDModels.Count == 1)
				{
					return OverallPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel().SelectOrifice;
				}
				double num = 0.0;
				foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
				{
					if (splitPRDModel != OverallPRDModel)
					{
						PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = splitPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
						if (sizingCaseModel == null)
						{
							return double.NaN;
						}
						num += sizingCaseModel.SelectOrifice;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public PRDSystemModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			mSystemType = ReliefDeviceType.Psv;
			_IsFrozenForUpdates = false;
			mSplitSetPressInc = new List<double>();
			mSpareSetPressInc = new List<double>();
			mFlowSplit = new List<double>();
			mFlowAmountUsed = new List<List<double>>();
			mOrificeUsedFrac = new List<List<double>>();
			_InFlowSplitUpdate = false;
			mPRDSystemMessages = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<PSVMessageCollection>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			_isCreatingScenarioModels = false;
			_isSequencedCalculationInFlight = false;
		}

		public void Initialize(ReliefDeviceType prdTypes, ref PsvKey dbkey, string CXSDatapath, PressureProtectionRequirement dataModel)
		{
			base.Initialize(ref dbkey, CXSDatapath, null, dataModel);
			bool flag = base.Model.ReliefDevices.Count < 1;
			mPRDSystemMessages.Initialize(dataModel);
			_PressureChangeUpdater = new _ProcessVarChangeAction([SpecialName] () =>
			{
				_UpdateOperDesignSetPressureMessage();
			});
			if (base.Model.ReliefDeviceType.IsEmpty)
			{
				base.Model.ReliefDeviceType.Specify(prdTypes, new UserSpecifier());
			}
			Properties.Add("Name", base.Model.Name);
			Properties.Add("Service", base.Model.Service);
			Properties.Add("FluidDischarge", base.Model.DischargeLocation.Name);
			Properties.Add("FluidDischargeId", base.Model.DischargeLocation.NameId);
			Properties.Add("DesTemp", base.Model.DesignTemperature);
			Properties.Add("DesTempSource", base.Model.DesignTemperatureSource);
			Properties.Add("DesPress", base.Model.DesignPressure);
			Properties.Add("DesPressSource", base.Model.DesignPressureSource);
			Properties.Add("OperPress", base.Model.OperatingPressure);
			Properties.Add("OperPressSource", base.Model.OperatingPressureSource);
			Properties.Add("OperTemp", base.Model.OperatingTemperature);
			Properties.Add("OperTempSource", base.Model.OperatingTemperatureSource);
			Properties.Add("UseAPIArrangement", base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.UseApiArrangement);
			Properties.Add("RatingNotes", base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.RatingNotes);
			mSystemType = prdTypes;
			IPSVMessager iPSVMessager = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			Host = iPSVMessager.PSVHostType;
			string viewableName = iPSVMessager.GetViewableName(base.Datapath);
			PRDSystemName = viewableName;
			mPSVSettings = GetPsvSettings();
			mSplitPRDModels = new PrdList(base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices);
			mSparePRDModels = new PrdList(base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices);
			if (flag)
			{
				CreateOverallPRD();
				CreateSplitPRD();
			}
			else
			{
				CreateOverallPRD(base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice);
				foreach (ReliefDevice item in base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Where([SpecialName] (ReliefDevice r) => r != OverallPRDModel.Model))
				{
					AddSplitPRDModel(item);
				}
				foreach (ReliefDevice spareReliefDevice in base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices)
				{
					AddSparePRDModel(spareReliefDevice);
				}
				if (SplitPRDModels.Count < 1)
				{
					CreateSplitPRD();
				}
			}
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				_ = splitPRDModel;
				mFlowSplit.Add(0.0);
			}
			InitializeSetPressureIncrease();
			base.RaiseRunCalculations += [SpecialName] (string a0) =>
			{
				AutoRunCalculations(a0);
			};
			_AmbientPressureUpdater = new _ProcessVarChangeAction([SpecialName] () =>
			{
				double curValue = double.NaN;
				VerifyOperPress(ref curValue);
				curValue = double.NaN;
				VerifyDesignPress(ref curValue);
			});
			SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.AmbientPressure.AddAffectedProcessAction(_AmbientPressureUpdater);
			base.Model.OperatingPressure.AddAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
			base.Model.DesignPressure.AddAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
			_ProcessVarChangeAction action = new _ProcessVarChangeAction([SpecialName] () =>
			{
				_UpdateOperDesignTemperatureMessage();
			});
			base.Model.OperatingTemperature.AddAffectedProcessAction(action);
			base.Model.DesignTemperature.AddAffectedProcessAction(action);
			if (flag)
			{
				UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
			}
		}

		public override void RecallFixUp()
		{
			base.RecallFixUp();
			if (SplitPRDModels.Count < 1)
			{
				CreateSplitPRD();
			}
			foreach (PRDModel allPRDModel in AllPRDModels)
			{
				allPRDModel.RecallFixUp();
			}
			double curValue = double.NaN;
			VerifyDesignPress(ref curValue);
			curValue = double.NaN;
			VerifyOperPress(ref curValue, notify: false);
			curValue = double.NaN;
			VerifyOperTemp(ref curValue, notify: false);
		}

		public virtual void RecallFixUpSplitScenarios()
		{
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				if (splitPRDModel.IsOverallModel)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel in splitPRDModel.ScenarioModels)
				{
					if (scenarioModel.IsRatingCalc)
					{
						scenarioModel.RecallFixUp();
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
			{
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel2 in sparePRDModel.ScenarioModels)
				{
					scenarioModel2.RecallFixUp();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CleanEvents()
		{
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel in OverallScenarioModels)
			{
				overallScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged -= ScenarioChanged;
				overallScenarioModel.FireVesselCountChanged -= OnScenarioFireVesselCountChanged;
			}
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = splitPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
				if (sizingCaseModel != null)
				{
					sizingCaseModel.BaseModelChanged -= OnSplitScenarioChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Delete()
		{
			SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.AmbientPressure.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(_AmbientPressureUpdater);
			_AmbientPressureUpdater = null;
			CleanEvents();
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
			{
				sparePRDModel.Delete();
			}
			if (SplitPRDModels.Count == 1)
			{
				SplitPRDModels.Remove(mOverallPRDModel);
				mOverallPRDModel.Model.SetPressure.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
				mOverallPRDModel.Delete();
			}
			else
			{
				if (SplitPRDModels.Any())
				{
					SplitPRDModels[0].Model.SetPressure.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
				}
				foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
				{
					splitPRDModel.Delete();
				}
				mOverallPRDModel.Delete();
			}
			ClearPRDSystemMessages(MessageLocation.Anywhere);
			base.Delete();
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(IBaseModel source)
		{
			PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = (PRDSystemModel)source;
			if (pRDSystemModel != null)
			{
				CopyFromHelper(pRDSystemModel);
			}
		}

		private void CopyFromHelper(PRDSystemModel source)
		{
			string pRDSystemName = PRDSystemName;
			base.CopyFrom(source);
			base.Model.CopyFrom(source.Model, onlyUserSpecified: false);
			PRDSystemName = pRDSystemName;
			OperTempSource = source.OperTempSource;
			if (OperTempSource == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
			{
				this.set_OperTemp(notify: true, source.get_OperTemp(notify: true));
			}
			else
			{
				double curValue = double.NaN;
				VerifyOperTemp(ref curValue, notify: false);
			}
			DesTempSource = source.DesTempSource;
			if (DesTempSource == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
			{
				DesignTemp = source.DesignTemp;
			}
			else
			{
				double curValue = double.NaN;
				VerifyDesignTemp(ref curValue);
			}
			OperPressSource = source.OperPressSource;
			if (OperPressSource == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
			{
				this.set_OperPress(notify: true, source.get_OperPress(notify: true));
			}
			else
			{
				double curValue = double.NaN;
				VerifyOperPress(ref curValue, notify: false);
			}
			DesPressSource = source.DesPressSource;
			if (DesPressSource == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
			{
				DesignPress = source.DesignPress;
			}
			else
			{
				double curValue = double.NaN;
				VerifyDesignPress(ref curValue);
			}
			ValveService = source.ValveService;
			CalcCode = source.CalcCode;
			IsUsingAPIArrangement = source.IsUsingAPIArrangement;
			mOverallPRDModel.CopyFrom(source.OverallPRDModel);
			checked
			{
				if (source.SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
				{
					SplitPRDModels.Remove(mOverallPRDModel);
					mSplitSetPressInc.Clear();
					mFlowSplit.Clear();
					IsUsingAPIArrangement = source.IsUsingAPIArrangement;
					foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in source.SplitPRDModels)
					{
						ReliefDevice rd = base.Model.CreateReliefDevice(mSystemType);
						PRDModel pRDModel = AddSplitPRDModel(rd);
						mSplitSetPressInc.Add(source.get_SplitSetPressureIncrease(SplitPRDModels.Count - 1, suppressRatingCalc: false) / 100.0);
						mFlowSplit.Add(source.get_FlowSplit(SplitPRDModels.Count - 1) / 100.0);
						pRDModel.CopyFrom(splitPRDModel);
					}
				}
				foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in source.SparePRDModels)
				{
					CreateSparePRD().CopyFrom(sparePRDModel);
				}
				UpdatePRDSetPressures();
			}
		}

		public void CopyScenariosFrom(PRDSystemModel source, int NScen, string OldNames, string NewNames)
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			if (NScen > 0 && OldNames != null && NewNames != null && string.Equals(Host, "ASPENPLUS"))
			{
				string[] array = OldNames.Split(' ');
				string[] array2 = NewNames.Split(' ');
				int num = 0;
				string[] array3 = array;
				foreach (string key in array3)
				{
					dictionary.Add(key, array2[num]);
					num = checked(num + 1);
				}
			}
			string text = null;
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel in source.OverallScenarioModels)
			{
				text = null;
				if (string.Equals(Host, "ASPENPLUS") && NScen > 0)
				{
					text = dictionary[overallScenarioModel.ScenarioName];
				}
				DuplicateScenario(overallScenarioModel, base.Datapath, text);
			}
			checked
			{
				if (SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
				{
					int num2 = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
					{
						PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = SplitPRDModels[j].GetSizingCaseModel();
						PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel2 = source.SplitPRDModels[j].GetSizingCaseModel();
						if (sizingCaseModel != null && sizingCaseModel2 != null)
						{
							sizingCaseModel.CopyDataFrom(sizingCaseModel2);
						}
						mFlowSplit[j] = source.get_FlowSplit(j) / 100.0;
						sizingCaseModel?.CheckOrificeSelection();
					}
					ClearRatingResults();
					int num3 = OverallScenarioModels.Count - 1;
					for (int k = 0; k <= num3; k++)
					{
						int num4 = SplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
						for (int l = 0; l <= num4; l++)
						{
							mFlowAmountUsed[k][l] = source.get_FlowAmountUsed(k, l);
							mOrificeUsedFrac[k][l] = source.get_OrificeUsedFraction(k, l);
						}
					}
				}
				if (SparePRDModels.Count > 0)
				{
					int num5 = mSparePRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int m = 0; m <= num5; m++)
					{
						this.set_SpareSetPressureIncrease(m, source.get_SpareSetPressureIncrease(m));
						PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel3 = SparePRDModels[m].GetSizingCaseModel();
						PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel4 = source.SparePRDModels[m].GetSizingCaseModel();
						if (sizingCaseModel3 != null && sizingCaseModel4 != null)
						{
							sizingCaseModel3.CopyDataFrom(sizingCaseModel4);
						}
					}
				}
				RunCalculations(force: true);
			}
		}

		public bool VerifyDesignTemp([Optional][DefaultParameterValue(double.NaN)] ref double curValue, bool notify = true)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(curValue))
			{
				curValue = base.Model.DesignTemperature.ValueIn(Units.C);
			}
			if (DesTempSource == ProcessDataSource.Reference)
			{
				double? num = base.HostInterface.GetStreamTemperature();
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					num = double.NaN;
				}
				if (BaseModel<PressureProtectionRequirement>.ValuesAreDifferent(num.Value, curValue))
				{
					curValue = num.Value;
					SetProperty("DesTemp", num.Value, notify, Units.C, byUser: false);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool VerifyDesignPress([Optional][DefaultParameterValue(double.NaN)] ref double curValue, bool notify = true)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(curValue))
			{
				curValue = base.Model.DesignPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);
			}
			if (DesPressSource == ProcessDataSource.Reference)
			{
				double num = Pressure.Absolute(base.HostInterface.GetStreamPressure() ?? double.NaN, Units.kPa).ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);
				if (BaseModel<PressureProtectionRequirement>.ValuesAreDifferent(num, curValue))
				{
					curValue = num;
					SetProperty("DesPress", num, notify, Units.bar, byUser: false, PressureReference.Gauge);
					if (OverallPRDModel.get_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: true))
					{
						UpdateSystemSetPressures(num, notify);
					}
					RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "DesignPress");
					DePressChanged?.Invoke();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void UpdateSystemSetPressures(double newSetPressure_barG, bool notify)
		{
			OverallPRDModel.set_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: false, newSetPressure_barG);
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel in OverallScenarioModels)
			{
				overallScenarioModel.UpdateReliefPressure(notify);
			}
			UpdatePRDSetPressures(recalculateOnChange: false);
			if (notify)
			{
				OverallPRDModel.NotifyScenariosPressureChanged();
				OverallPRDModel.CalculateAllScenarios("SetPress");
			}
		}

		public void RaiseDesignPressureChangedEvent()
		{
			DePressChanged?.Invoke();
		}

		public void RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(object sender, string name)
