			PRDSystemModelPropertyChanged?.Invoke(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(sender), new PropertyEventArgs(name));
		}

		public void RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, propertyName);
		}

		public bool VerifyOperTemp([Optional][DefaultParameterValue(double.NaN)] ref double curValue, bool notify = true)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(curValue))
			{
				TemperatureUnit c = Units.C;
				bool byUser = true;
				curValue = GetProperty<double>("OperTemp", c, ref byUser);
			}
			if (OperTempSource == ProcessDataSource.Reference)
			{
				double? num = base.HostInterface.GetStreamTemperature();
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					num = double.NaN;
				}
				if (BaseModel<PressureProtectionRequirement>.ValuesAreDifferent(num.GetValueOrDefault(), curValue, 1E-09))
				{
					curValue = num.GetValueOrDefault();
					SetProperty("OperTemp", num.Value, notify, Units.C);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool VerifyOperPress([Optional][DefaultParameterValue(double.NaN)] ref double curValue, bool notify = true)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(curValue))
			{
				curValue = base.Model.OperatingPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);
			}
			if (OperPressSource == ProcessDataSource.Reference)
			{
				double num = Pressure.Absolute(base.HostInterface.GetStreamPressure() ?? double.NaN, Units.kPa).ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);
				if (!BaseModel<PressureProtectionRequirement>.ValuesAreClose(num, curValue))
				{
					curValue = num;
					SetProperty("OperPress", num, notify, Units.bar, byUser: true, PressureReference.Gauge);
					RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "OperatingPress");
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void InitializeSetPressureIncrease()
		{
			mSplitSetPressInc.Clear();
			mSplitSetPressInc.Clear();
			double num = double.NaN;
			checked
			{
				if (mSplitPRDModels.Count == 1)
				{
					mSplitSetPressInc.Add(0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num2; i++)
					{
						num = (SplitPRDModels[i].get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true) - mOverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true)) / mOverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true);
						mSplitSetPressInc.Add(num);
					}
				}
				int num3 = mSparePRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int j = 0; j <= num3; j++)
				{
					num = (SparePRDModels[j].get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true) - mOverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true)) / mOverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true);
					mSpareSetPressInc.Add(num);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePRDSetPressures(bool recalculateOnChange = true, bool excludeOverallModel = false)
		{
			checked
			{
				int num = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					if (!excludeOverallModel || SplitPRDModels[i] != OverallPRDModel)
					{
						SplitPRDModels[i].set_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange, mOverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true) * (1.0 + mSplitSetPressInc[i]));
					}
				}
				int num2 = mSparePRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
				{
					SparePRDModels[j].set_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange, mOverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true) * (1.0 + mSpareSetPressInc[j]));
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSplitOverpressures(PSVScenarioModel refScenario, bool notify = true)
		{
			checked
			{
				if (OverallScenarioModels.Contains(refScenario))
				{
					int num = ((SplitPRDModels.Any() && SplitPRDModels[0] == OverallPRDModel) ? 1 : 0);
					int num2 = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
					{
						SplitPRDModels[i].GetScenarioModel(refScenario)?.ValvePressureChanged(notify);
					}
					int num3 = mSparePRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int j = 0; j <= num3; j++)
					{
						SparePRDModels[j].GetScenarioModel(refScenario)?.ValvePressureChanged(notify);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePRDRelFlows()
		{
			checked
			{
				int num = mSparePRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(mOverallPRDModel.get_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true)))
					{
						mSparePRDModels[i].set_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true, 0.0);
					}
				}
				if (mSplitPRDModels.Count < 2)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num2 = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
				{
					if ((mOverallPRDModel is PSVValveModel) & (mSplitPRDModels[j] is PSVValveModel))
					{
						PSVValveModel pSVValveModel = (PSVValveModel)mSplitPRDModels[j];
						PSVValveModel pSVValveModel2 = (PSVValveModel)mOverallPRDModel;
						if (unchecked(pSVValveModel != null && pSVValveModel2 != null))
						{
							((PRDModel)pSVValveModel).set_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true, ((PRDModel)pSVValveModel2).get_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true) * mFlowSplit[j]);
						}
					}
					else if ((mOverallPRDModel is RuptureDiskModel) & (mSplitPRDModels[j] is RuptureDiskModel))
					{
						mSplitPRDModels[j].set_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true, mOverallPRDModel.get_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSplitPRDsForScenarioTypeChange(PSVScenarioModel refScenario)
		{
			checked
			{
				int num = mSparePRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					mSparePRDModels[i].GetScenarioModel(refScenario)?.RegisterProperties();
				}
				if (mSplitPRDModels.Count >= 2)
				{
					int num2 = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
					{
						mSplitPRDModels[j].GetScenarioModel(refScenario)?.RegisterProperties();
					}
					CheckScenarioConsistency(refScenario);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ValidateLineSizingMethod(PSVScenarioModel refScenario, bool notify)
		{
			refScenario.ValidateLineSizingMethod(notify);
			foreach (PRDModel mSplitPRDModel in mSplitPRDModels)
			{
				mSplitPRDModel.GetScenarioModel(refScenario)?.ValidateLineSizingMethod(notify);
			}
			foreach (PRDModel mSparePRDModel in mSparePRDModels)
			{
				mSparePRDModel.GetScenarioModel(refScenario)?.ValidateLineSizingMethod(notify);
			}
		}

		public double GetStoredFlowSplit(PRDModel iPRDModel)
		{
			checked
			{
				int num = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					if (mSplitPRDModels[i] == iPRDModel)
					{
						return mFlowSplit[i];
					}
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		private void _UpdateOperDesignSetPressureMessage(bool shouldClear = true)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(this.get_OperPress(notify: true)) & !double.IsNaN(DesignPress))
			{
				if (BaseModel<PressureProtectionRequirement>.ValueExceeds(this.get_OperPress(notify: true), DesignPress))
				{
					AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OperPressTooHigh);
				}
				else if (shouldClear)
				{
					_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OperPressTooHigh);
				}
			}
			if (SplitPRDModels.Count == 1)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(DesignPress) && mOverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true) > DesignPress)
				{
					AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.PRD_SetGreatThanDesPress);
				}
				else if (shouldClear)
				{
					_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.PRD_SetGreatThanDesPress);
				}
			}
		}

		private void _UpdateOperDesignTemperatureMessage(bool shouldClear = true)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(this.get_OperTemp(notify: true)) & !double.IsNaN(DesignTemp))
			{
				if (BaseModel<PressureProtectionRequirement>.ValueExceeds(this.get_OperTemp(notify: true), DesignTemp))
				{
					AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OperTempTooHigh);
				}
				else if (shouldClear)
				{
					_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OperTempTooHigh);
				}
			}
		}

		private void _UpdateFlowSplitMessage(bool shouldClear = true)
		{
			if (!_InFlowSplitUpdate && SplitPRDModels.Count > 1 && GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
			{
				if (!IsFlowSplitNormalized())
				{
					AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.warn_MultiValve_NormFlowSplit);
				}
				else if (shouldClear)
				{
					_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.warn_MultiValve_NormFlowSplit);
				}
			}
		}

		private void _UpdateNoScenarioMessage(bool shouldClear = true)
		{
			if (SplitPRDModels.Count > 1 && !OverallScenarioModels.Any())
			{
				AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoEmergencyScenario);
			}
			else if (shouldClear)
			{
				_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoEmergencyScenario);
			}
		}

		private void _UpdateRatingMessages(bool shouldClear = true)
		{
			if (GetSizingCaseModel() == null)
			{
				if (shouldClear)
				{
					_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SizingCaseNotLargest);
					_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.PRDSystem_SystemUndersized);
					_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.PRDSystem_CapacityWarning);
				}
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel in OverallScenarioModels)
			{
				if ((!double.IsNaN(overallScenarioModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true)) & (overallScenarioModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true) > 0.0)) && overallScenarioModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true) > num)
				{
					num = overallScenarioModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true);
				}
			}
			if (GetSizingCaseModel().get_CalcOrifice(notify: true) < num)
			{
				AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SizingCaseNotLargest);
			}
			else if (shouldClear)
			{
				_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SizingCaseNotLargest);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (SplitPRDModels.Count > 1 && IsRatingCalculationReady())
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				using (IEnumerator<PSVScenarioModel> enumerator2 = OverallPRDModel.ScenarioModels.GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator2.MoveNext() && !enumerator2.Current.IsSizingCase)
					{
						num2 = checked(num2 + 1);
					}
				}
				if (!IsPRDSystemSizedOK(num2))
				{
					AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.PRDSystem_SystemUndersized);
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (!IsPRDSystemCapacityOK(num2))
				{
					AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.PRDSystem_CapacityWarning);
					flag2 = true;
				}
			}
			if (shouldClear)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.PRDSystem_SystemUndersized);
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					_RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.PRDSystem_CapacityWarning);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePRDSystemMessages()
		{
			ClearPRDSystemMessages();
			_UpdateOperDesignSetPressureMessage(shouldClear: false);
			_UpdateOperDesignTemperatureMessage(shouldClear: false);
			_UpdateNoScenarioMessage(shouldClear: false);
			_UpdateRatingMessages(shouldClear: false);
			_UpdateFlowSplitMessage(shouldClear: false);
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				splitPRDModel.UpdateValveMessages();
			}
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
			{
				sparePRDModel.UpdateValveMessages();
			}
			SendSimulatorStatusMessages();
			NotifyPRDSystemMessagesPropertyChanged();
		}

		public void AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel level, string message, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.SummaryForm)
		{
			mPRDSystemMessages.AddMessage(level, message, this, location);
			RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent("PRDSystemMessages");
		}

		private void _RemovePRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel level, string message, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.SummaryForm)
		{
			mPRDSystemMessages.RemoveMessage(level, message, location, null, this);
			RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent("PRDSystemMessages");
		}

		public void SendSimulatorStatusMessages()
		{
			int num = 0;
			IList<PSVMessage> list = mPRDSystemMessages.ObjectMessages(this);
			checked
			{
				foreach (PSVMessage item in list)
				{
					num++;
					base.HostInterface.AddStatus(item.MessageLevel, num, item.Message);
				}
				PSVMessage pSVMessage = _GetDisplayMessageObject();
				string message = _GetDisplayMessageText();
				if (pSVMessage != null && (object)pSVMessage.RefObject != this)
				{
					base.HostInterface.AddStatus(pSVMessage.MessageLevel, num + 1, message);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearPRDSystemMessages(MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.SummaryForm)
		{
			mPRDSystemMessages.ClearMessages(this, location);
			TellSimulatorForgetMessages();
		}

		private PSVMessage _GetDisplayMessageObject()
		{
			PSVMessage pSVMessage = mPRDSystemMessages.GetHighestLevelMessage(this);
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				PSVMessage displayMessage = splitPRDModel.GetDisplayMessage();
				int? num = (int?)displayMessage?.MessageLevel;
				int? num2 = (int?)pSVMessage?.MessageLevel;
				if (((num.HasValue & num2.HasValue) ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() > num2.GetValueOrDefault()) : ((bool?)null)) == true || (displayMessage != null && pSVMessage == null))
				{
					pSVMessage = displayMessage;
				}
			}
			return pSVMessage;
		}

		private string _GetDisplayMessageText()
		{
			PSVMessage pSVMessage = mPRDSystemMessages.GetHighestLevelMessage(this);
			string result = pSVMessage?.Message;
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				PSVMessage displayMessage = splitPRDModel.GetDisplayMessage();
				int? num = (int?)displayMessage?.MessageLevel;
				int? num2 = (int?)pSVMessage?.MessageLevel;
				if (((num.HasValue & num2.HasValue) ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() > num2.GetValueOrDefault()) : ((bool?)null)) == true || (displayMessage != null && pSVMessage == null))
				{
					pSVMessage = displayMessage;
					result = splitPRDModel.PRDName + ": " + displayMessage.Message;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private MessageLevel _GetDisplayMessageLevel()
		{
			PSVMessage pSVMessage = mPRDSystemMessages.GetHighestLevelMessage(this);
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				PSVMessage displayMessage = splitPRDModel.GetDisplayMessage();
				int? num = (int?)displayMessage?.MessageLevel;
				int? num2 = (int?)pSVMessage?.MessageLevel;
				if (((num.HasValue & num2.HasValue) ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() > num2.GetValueOrDefault()) : ((bool?)null)) == true || (displayMessage != null && pSVMessage == null))
				{
					pSVMessage = displayMessage;
				}
			}
			return pSVMessage?.MessageLevel ?? MessageLevel.Ok;
		}

		public void NotifyPRDSystemMessagesPropertyChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDSystemMessages");
		}

		private void ChangeSystemType(ReliefDeviceType newType)
		{
			if (SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			_FreezeAllScenarios();
			mSystemType = newType;
			IPSVMessager iPSVMessager = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = GetSizingCaseModel();
			iPSVMessager.SetSystemDeviceType(base.Datapath, newType);
			PRDModel pRDModel = mOverallPRDModel;
			bool value = pRDModel.get_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: true);
			double userValue = pRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true);
			pRDModel.Model.SetPressure.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
			base.Model.ReliefDeviceType.Specify(newType, new UserSpecifier());
			PRDModel pRDModel2 = CreateOverallPRD(base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice);
			pRDModel2.Model.SetPressure.AddAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
			pRDModel2.set_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: false, value);
			pRDModel2.UpdateSetPressure(userValue);
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel in pRDModel.ScenarioModels)
			{
				pRDModel2.ScenarioModels.Add(scenarioModel);
				scenarioModel.SetPrdType(newType);
				scenarioModel.UpdateModelReference(pRDModel2);
				scenarioModel.ValidateSizingMethod();
			}
			pRDModel.ScenarioModels.Clear();
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
			{
				sparePRDModel.UnlinkScenarios();
			}
			mSparePRDModels = new PrdList(base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices);
			foreach (ReliefDevice spareReliefDevice in base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices)
			{
				AddSparePRDModel(spareReliefDevice);
			}
			base.Model.SetSizingCase(null);
			ReliefScenario sizingCase = null;
			if (sizingCaseModel != null)
			{
				sizingCase = sizingCaseModel.Model.ReliefScenario;
				sizingCaseModel.EnsureLineSizingModelsExist();
			}
			base.Model.SetSizingCase(sizingCase);
			mSplitPRDModels = new PrdList(base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices);
			CreateSplitPRD();
			_UnfreezeAllScenarios();
			mSplitSetPressInc.Clear();
			mSpareSetPressInc.Clear();
			InitializeSetPressureIncrease();
			UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
			object objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)base.Model).DataModel);
			List<object> objectRecords = new List<object>
			{
				RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue),
				RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)mSplitPRDModels[0].Model).DataModel)
			};
			((CompositePresentationEvent<ActiveSafetyObjectChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<ActiveSafetyObjectChangedEvent>()).Publish(new ActiveSafetyObjectChangedEventArgs(objectRecords, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue)));
			SystemTypeChanged?.Invoke();
		}

		public PRDModel CreateOverallPRD(ReliefDevice rd = null)
		{
			bool? obj;
			if (rd != null)
			{
				int? num = (int?)base.Model.ReliefDeviceType.Value;
				int num2 = (int)mSystemType;
				obj = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() != num2) : ((bool?)null));
			}
			else
			{
				obj = true;
			}
			bool? flag = obj;
			if (flag == true)
			{
				rd = base.Model.CreateReliefDevice(mSystemType);
				base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice = rd;
			}
			switch (mSystemType)
			{
			case ReliefDeviceType.Psv:
				mOverallPRDModel = new PSVValveModel(uContainer);
				break;
			case ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk:
				mOverallPRDModel = new RuptureDiskModel(uContainer);
				break;
			}
			PRDModel pRDModel = mOverallPRDModel;
			PsvKey dbkey = null;
			pRDModel.Initialize(ref dbkey, base.Datapath, this, rd);
			mOverallPRDModel.Model.SetPressure.AddAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
			if (flag == true)
			{
				mOverallPRDModel.set_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: false, value: true);
			}
			return mOverallPRDModel;
		}

		private void CopyPRDData(ref PRDModel targetPRD, ref PRDModel sourcePRD)
		{
			if (!((targetPRD != null) & (sourcePRD != null)))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!Common.IsSameValue(targetPRD.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true), sourcePRD.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true)))
			{
				targetPRD.set_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true, sourcePRD.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true));
			}
			if (targetPRD.get_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: true) != sourcePRD.get_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: true))
			{
				targetPRD.set_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: false, sourcePRD.get_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: true));
			}
			if (!Common.IsSameValue(targetPRD.ConstBackPress, sourcePRD.ConstBackPress))
			{
				targetPRD.ConstBackPress = sourcePRD.ConstBackPress;
			}
			if (mSystemType != ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				return;
			}
			PSVValveModel pSVValveModel = (PSVValveModel)targetPRD;
			PSVValveModel pSVValveModel2 = (PSVValveModel)sourcePRD;
			if (pSVValveModel != null && pSVValveModel2 != null)
			{
				pSVValveModel.ValveType = pSVValveModel2.ValveType;
				pSVValveModel.ValveMaterial = pSVValveModel2.ValveMaterial;
				pSVValveModel.RuptDisk = pSVValveModel2.RuptDisk;
				if (!Common.IsSameValue(pSVValveModel.Coeff_Kc, pSVValveModel2.Coeff_Kc))
				{
					pSVValveModel.Coeff_Kc = pSVValveModel2.Coeff_Kc;
				}
			}
		}

		private void _FreezeAllScenarios()
		{
			_IsFrozenForUpdates = true;
			checked
			{
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel in OverallPRDModel.ScenarioModels)
				{
					scenarioModel.FreezeEventPublication++;
				}
				foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
				{
					if (splitPRDModel == OverallPRDModel)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel2 in splitPRDModel.ScenarioModels)
					{
						scenarioModel2.FreezeEventPublication++;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void _UnfreezeAllScenarios()
		{
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel in OverallPRDModel.ScenarioModels)
			{
				scenarioModel.FreezeEventPublication = 0u;
			}
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel2 in splitPRDModel.ScenarioModels)
				{
					scenarioModel2.FreezeEventPublication = 0u;
				}
			}
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SystemUpdatedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SystemUpdatedEvent>()).Publish(new SystemUpdatedEventArgs(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)base.Model).DataModel)));
			_IsFrozenForUpdates = false;
		}

		public PRDModel CreateSplitPRD()
		{
			if ((mSystemType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk) & (SplitPRDModels.Count > 0))
			{
				string message = "Splitting rupture disks is not allowed.";
				AddPRDSystemMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message);
				return null;
			}
			PRDModel pRDModel = null;
			PRDModel pRDModel2 = null;
			checked
			{
				if (SplitPRDModels.Count == 0)
				{
					pRDModel = mOverallPRDModel;
					mSplitPRDModels.Add(pRDModel);
					pRDModel.PropertyChanged += _PrdPropertyChanged;
				}
				else
				{
					_FreezeAllScenarios();
					bool flag = false;
					if (SplitPRDModels.Count == 1)
					{
						flag = true;
						if (SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
						{
							((PSVValveModel)mOverallPRDModel).IsRestrictedLift = false;
						}
						mSplitPRDModels.Remove(mOverallPRDModel);
						mOverallPRDModel.PropertyChanged -= _PrdPropertyChanged;
						mOverallPRDModel.Model.SetPressure.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
						ReliefDevice reliefDevice = base.Model.CreateReliefDevice(mSystemType);
						pRDModel2 = AddSplitPRDModel(reliefDevice);
						pRDModel2.Model.SetPressure.AddAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
						reliefDevice.CopyFrom(mOverallPRDModel.Model, onlyUserSpecified: false);
						if (!IsUsingAPIArrangement)
						{
							this.set_FlowSplit(SplitPRDModels.Count - 1, 100.0);
						}
						pRDModel2.Suffix = GetUniqueSplitSuffix();
						DisplayedReliefDevice = pRDModel2;
					}
					ReliefDevice reliefDevice2 = base.Model.CreateReliefDevice(mSystemType);
					if (flag)
					{
						reliefDevice2.CopyFrom(mOverallPRDModel.Model, onlyUserSpecified: false);
					}
					else
					{
						reliefDevice2.CopyFrom(SplitPRDModels.Last().Model, onlyUserSpecified: false);
					}
					pRDModel = AddSplitPRDModel(reliefDevice2);
					pRDModel.Suffix = GetUniqueSplitSuffix();
					double item = mSplitSetPressInc.Last();
					mSplitSetPressInc.Add(item);
					mFlowSplit.Add(0.0);
					if (IsUsingAPIArrangement)
					{
						UseAPIArrangement(isFromRatingCalc: true);
					}
					else
					{
						this.set_FlowSplit(SplitPRDModels.Count - 1, 0.0);
						if (SplitPRDModels.Count == 2)
						{
							this.set_SplitSetPressureIncrease(SplitPRDModels.Count - 1, suppressRatingCalc: false, 5.0);
						}
						else
						{
							this.set_SplitSetPressureIncrease(SplitPRDModels.Count - 1, suppressRatingCalc: false, this.get_SplitSetPressureIncrease(SplitPRDModels.Count - 2, suppressRatingCalc: false));
						}
					}
					RecallFixUpSplitScenarioModels(isForNewPrd: true);
					if (pRDModel2 != null)
					{
						pRDModel2.CalculateAllScenarios(string.Empty, isForced: true);
						mOverallPRDModel.CalculateAllScenarios("OverPress");
					}
					pRDModel.CalculateAllScenarios(string.Empty, isForced: true);
					CalculateRating(shouldUpdateSplitSetIncrease: false);
					_UnfreezeAllScenarios();
				}
				SplitModelCountChanged?.Invoke();
				return pRDModel;
			}
		}

		private bool IsPRDSuffixUnique(string newSuffix)
		{
			foreach (PRDModel allPRDModel in AllPRDModels)
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(allPRDModel.Suffix.ToUpper(), newSuffix.ToUpper(), TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string GetUniqueSplitSuffix()
		{
			checked
			{
				int num = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
				string text = Conversions.ToString(Strings.ChrW(65 + num));
				while (!IsPRDSuffixUnique(text))
				{
					num++;
					text = Conversions.ToString(Strings.ChrW(65 + num));
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		private string GetUniqueSpareSuffix()
		{
			checked
			{
				int num = mSparePRDModels.Count - 1;
				string text = FormResource.PRDSystem_SpareSuffix + " " + Conversions.ToString(Strings.ChrW(65 + num));
				while (!IsPRDSuffixUnique(text))
				{
					num++;
					text = FormResource.PRDSystem_SpareSuffix + " " + Conversions.ToString(Strings.ChrW(65 + num));
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		public PRDModel AddSplitPRDModel(ReliefDevice rd)
		{
			PRDModel pRDModel = null;
			switch (mSystemType)
			{
			case ReliefDeviceType.Psv:
				pRDModel = new PSVValveModel(uContainer);
				break;
			case ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk:
				pRDModel = new RuptureDiskModel(uContainer);
				break;
			}
			if (pRDModel != null)
			{
				PRDModel pRDModel2 = pRDModel;
				PsvKey dbkey = null;
				pRDModel2.Initialize(ref dbkey, base.Datapath, this, rd);
				CreateSplitAndSpareScenarios(pRDModel);
				mSplitPRDModels.Add(pRDModel);
				pRDModel.PropertyChanged += _PrdPropertyChanged;
			}
			_UpdateNoScenarioMessage();
			return pRDModel;
		}

		public void DeleteSplitPRD(ref PRDModel splitPRD)
		{
			_FreezeAllScenarios();
			PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = splitPRD.GetSizingCaseModel();
			if (sizingCaseModel != null)
			{
				sizingCaseModel.BaseModelChanged -= OnSplitScenarioChanged;
			}
			checked
			{
				mFlowSplit.RemoveAt(mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1);
				mSplitSetPressInc.RemoveAt(mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1);
				mSplitPRDModels.Remove(splitPRD);
				splitPRD.PropertyChanged -= _PrdPropertyChanged;
				splitPRD.Delete();
				if (mSplitPRDModels.Count == 1)
				{
					PRDModel pRDModel = mSplitPRDModels[0];
					mSplitPRDModels.Remove(pRDModel);
					pRDModel.PropertyChanged -= _PrdPropertyChanged;
					pRDModel.Model.SetPressure.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
					pRDModel.Delete();
					mSplitPRDModels.Add(mOverallPRDModel);
					mOverallPRDModel.PropertyChanged += _PrdPropertyChanged;
					mOverallPRDModel.Model.SetPressure.AddAffectedProcessAction(_PressureChangeUpdater);
					mFlowSplit[0] = 1.0;
					DisplayedReliefDevice = OverallPRDModel;
					mOverallPRDModel.CalculateAllScenarios("OverPress");
				}
				if (IsUsingAPIArrangement)
				{
					UseAPIArrangement();
				}
				_UnfreezeAllScenarios();
				SplitModelCountChanged?.Invoke();
				_UpdateNoScenarioMessage();
			}
		}

		public PRDModel CreateSparePRD()
		{
			_FreezeAllScenarios();
			ReliefDevice reliefDevice = base.Model.CreateReliefDevice(mSystemType);
			base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices.Add(reliefDevice);
			PRDModel targetPRD = AddSparePRDModel(reliefDevice);
			if (!Information.IsNothing(targetPRD))
			{
				CopyPRDData(ref targetPRD, ref mOverallPRDModel);
				targetPRD.IfSpare = true;
				targetPRD.Suffix = GetUniqueSpareSuffix();
				mSpareSetPressInc.Add(0.0);
				this.set_SpareSetPressureIncrease(checked(SparePRDModels.Count - 1), 0.0);
				RecallFixUpSpareScenarioModels(isForNewPrd: true);
				SplitModelCountChanged?.Invoke();
			}
			_UnfreezeAllScenarios();
			return targetPRD;
		}

		public void RecallFixUpSpareScenarioModels(bool isForNewPrd = false, bool isForNewScenario = false)
		{
			try
			{
				_isCreatingScenarioModels = true;
				int num = 0;
				foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
				{
					foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel in OverallScenarioModels)
					{
						PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = _GetOrCreateModelForExistingRatingScenario(sparePRDModel, overallScenarioModel, shouldAddHandler: true, isForNewPrd || isForNewScenario);
						if (pSVScenarioModel != null && pSVScenarioModel.IsSizingCase && isForNewPrd)
						{
							sparePRDModel.Model.SetSizingCase(pSVScenarioModel.Model.ReliefScenario);
						}
						if (isForNewPrd && pSVScenarioModel != null)
						{
							if (!double.IsNaN(overallScenarioModel.get_RelFlow(notify: true)))
							{
								pSVScenarioModel.set_RelFlow(notify: true, 0.0);
							}
							pSVScenarioModel.FlowFraction = 0.0;
						}
					}
					num = checked(num + 1);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_isCreatingScenarioModels = false;
			}
		}

		public PRDModel AddSparePRDModel(ReliefDevice rd)
		{
			PRDModel pRDModel = null;
			switch (mSystemType)
			{
			case ReliefDeviceType.Psv:
				pRDModel = new PSVValveModel(uContainer);
				break;
			case ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk:
				pRDModel = new RuptureDiskModel(uContainer);
				break;
			}
			if (pRDModel != null)
			{
				PRDModel pRDModel2 = pRDModel;
				PsvKey dbkey = null;
				pRDModel2.Initialize(ref dbkey, base.Datapath, this, rd);
				CreateSplitAndSpareScenarios(pRDModel);
				mSparePRDModels.Add(pRDModel);
			}
			return pRDModel;
		}

		public void DeleteSparePRD(ref PRDModel sparePRD)
		{
			_FreezeAllScenarios();
			if (sparePRD.Model.ModelKey != default(Guid))
			{
				mSpareSetPressInc.RemoveAt(checked(mSparePRDModels.Count - 1));
				mSparePRDModels.Remove(sparePRD);
				sparePRD.Delete();
			}
			_UnfreezeAllScenarios();
			SplitModelCountChanged?.Invoke();
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel GetSizingCaseModel()
		{
			return OverallPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
		}

		public void SetSizingCaseModel(PSVScenarioModel sizingScenario)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(sizingScenario, GetSizingCaseModel()))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<double> list = null;
			if (!IsUsingAPIArrangement)
			{
				list = new List<double>(mFlowSplit);
			}
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
			checked
			{
				if (mSplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
				{
					int num = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
					{
						list2.Add(mSplitPRDModels[i].GetSizingCaseModel()?.SelectedOrificeName);
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(list2[i]))
						{
							list2[i] = sizingScenario?.SelectedOrificeName;
						}
					}
				}
				base.Model.SetSizingCase(null);
				ReliefScenario sizingCase = null;
				if (sizingScenario != null)
				{
					sizingCase = sizingScenario.Model.ReliefScenario;
					sizingScenario.EnsureLineSizingModelsExist();
				}
				base.Model.SetSizingCase(sizingCase);
				CreateRatingCalcModels();
				if (!IsUsingAPIArrangement)
				{
					int num2 = mFlowSplit.Count - 1;
					for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
					{
						this.set_FlowSplit(j, list[j] * 100.0);
					}
				}
				if (mSplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
				{
					int num3 = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int k = 0; k <= num3; k++)
					{
						mSplitPRDModels[k].GetSizingCaseModel()?.SetSelectedValve(list2[k]);
					}
				}
				foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
				{
					foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel in splitPRDModel.ScenarioModels)
					{
						scenarioModel.OnSizingCaseChanged();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected void CreateRatingCalcModels()
		{
			PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = GetSizingCaseModel();
			if (sizingCaseModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
			{
				foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
				{
					mFlowSplit[SplitPRDModels.IndexOf(splitPRDModel)] = GetFlowSplit(splitPRDModel);
					PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel = splitPRDModel.GetScenarioModel(sizingCaseModel);
					if (scenarioModel != null)
					{
						scenarioModel.set_IsLineSizingCalculated(notify: true, value: true);
					}
				}
				UpdatePRDRelFlows();
			}
			else
			{
				mFlowSplit[0] = 1.0;
			}
			CalculateRating();
			if (double.IsNaN(sizingCaseModel.get_RelFlow(notify: true)))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
			{
				sparePRDModel.set_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true, 0.0);
			}
		}

		public void RecallFixUpSplitScenarioModels(bool isForNewPrd = false, bool isForNewScenario = false)
		{
			if (SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
			{
				try
				{
					_isCreatingScenarioModels = true;
					int num = 0;
					foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
					{
						foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel in OverallScenarioModels)
						{
							PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = _GetOrCreateModelForExistingRatingScenario(splitPRDModel, overallScenarioModel, shouldAddHandler: true, isForNewPrd || isForNewScenario);
							if (pSVScenarioModel != null && pSVScenarioModel.IsSizingCase)
							{
								if (IsUsingAPIArrangement)
								{
									UseAPIArrangement(isFromRatingCalc: true);
								}
								else if (mFlowSplit[num] == 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(pSVScenarioModel.FlowFraction) && !isForNewPrd)
								{
									mFlowSplit[num] = pSVScenarioModel.FlowFraction;
								}
								if (isForNewPrd)
								{
									splitPRDModel.Model.SetSizingCase(pSVScenarioModel.Model.ReliefScenario);
								}
							}
							bool? obj;
							if (!isForNewPrd)
							{
								bool? flag = pSVScenarioModel?.IsSizingCase;
								obj = (!flag) ?? flag;
							}
							else
							{
								obj = true;
							}
							bool? flag2 = obj;
							if ((flag2 ?? true) && pSVScenarioModel != null && flag2.HasValue)
							{
								pSVScenarioModel.set_RelFlow(notify: true, overallScenarioModel.get_RelFlow(notify: true) * mFlowSplit[num]);
								pSVScenarioModel.FlowFraction = mFlowSplit[num];
							}
						}
						num = checked(num + 1);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					_isCreatingScenarioModels = false;
				}
				_CopySizingCaseSelectedOrificeToAllScenarios();
			}
			else if (GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
			{
				mFlowSplit[0] = 1.0;
			}
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
			{
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel2 in OverallScenarioModels)
				{
					_GetOrCreateModelForExistingRatingScenario(sparePRDModel, overallScenarioModel2, shouldAddHandler: false, isForNewPrd);
				}
				sparePRDModel.set_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: false, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private void _CopySizingCaseSelectedOrificeToAllScenarios()
		{
			if (_isCreatingScenarioModels || SplitPRDModels.Count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = GetSizingCaseModel();
			if (sizingCaseModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel2 = splitPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
				if (sizingCaseModel2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel in OverallScenarioModels)
				{
					if (overallScenarioModel != sizingCaseModel)
					{
						splitPRDModel.GetScenarioModel(overallScenarioModel).SetSelectedValve(sizingCaseModel2.SelectedOrificeName);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private PSVScenarioModel _GetOrCreateModelForExistingRatingScenario(PRDModel prd, PSVScenarioModel scen, bool shouldAddHandler, bool shouldFreezeUpdates)
		{
			PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel = prd.GetScenarioModel(scen);
			checked
			{
				if (scenarioModel != null)
				{
					if (shouldFreezeUpdates)
					{
						scenarioModel.FreezeEventPublication++;
					}
					return scenarioModel;
				}
				bool isCreated = false;
				PrdConstraintsDefinition orCreatePrdConstraints = scen.Model.ReliefScenario.GetOrCreatePrdConstraints(prd.Model, out isCreated);
				PSVDBKey key = new PSVDBKey(eRecordType.OrificeCalc, orCreatePrdConstraints.LegacyKey);
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = prd.AddScenarioModel(key, scen.PhysicalPropPkgFluid, scen.ScenarioName, orCreatePrdConstraints, scen, shouldFreezeUpdates);
				if (isCreated)
				{
					pSVScenarioModel.CopyDataFrom(scen);
				}
				pSVScenarioModel.UseCustomOverpressure = true;
				if (pSVScenarioModel.IsSizingCase && string.IsNullOrEmpty(pSVScenarioModel.SelectedOrificeName))
				{
					pSVScenarioModel.SetSelectedValve(scen.SelectedOrificeName);
				}
				if (shouldAddHandler)
				{
					pSVScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged += OnSplitScenarioChanged;
				}
				return pSVScenarioModel;
			}
		}

		protected double GetFlowSplit(PRDModel prd)
		{
			double result;
			try
			{
				result = ((prd is PSVValveModel) ? (prd.get_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true) / GetSizingCaseModel().get_RelFlow(notify: true)) : ((!(prd is RuptureDiskModel)) ? double.NaN : (double.IsNaN(OverallPRDModel.get_SizingCaseRelFlow(notify: true)) ? double.NaN : 1.0)));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				result = double.NaN;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public PSVDBKey GetSizingReliefLoadID()
		{
			if (base.Model.BindingOrificeScenario == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new PSVDBKey(eRecordType.OrificeCalc, base.Model.BindingOrificeScenario.PrdConstraints[base.Model.SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice].LegacyKey);
		}

		private string[] SplitValveName(string concattedValveName)
		{
			string[] array = concattedValveName.Split(' ');
			if (array.Count() != 3)
			{
				Array.Resize(ref array, 3);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel CreateScenario(IPPPFluid fluid, string scenarioName, ReliefDeviceType prdType)
		{
			_FreezeAllScenarios();
			ReliefScenario reliefScenario = base.Model.CreateReliefScenario();
			PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = OverallPRDModel.CreateScenario(ref fluid, scenarioName, prdType, reliefScenario);
			pSVScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged += ScenarioChanged;
			pSVScenarioModel.FireVesselCountChanged += OnScenarioFireVesselCountChanged;
			RecallFixUpSplitScenarioModels(isForNewPrd: false, isForNewScenario: true);
			RecallFixUpSpareScenarioModels(isForNewPrd: false, isForNewScenario: true);
			if (mSplitPRDModels.Count > 1 || mSparePRDModels.Count > 0)
			{
				UpdateSplitOverpressures(pSVScenarioModel, notify: false);
			}
			CalculateRating();
			_UnfreezeAllScenarios();
			_UpdateNoScenarioMessage();
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				splitPRDModel.UpdateValveMessages();
			}
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
			{
				sparePRDModel.UpdateValveMessages();
			}
			return pSVScenarioModel;
		}

		public void CreateSplitAndSpareScenario(PRDModel prdModel, PSVScenarioModel masterScenario)
		{
			PrdConstraintsDefinition orCreatePrdConstraints = masterScenario.Model.ReliefScenario.GetOrCreatePrdConstraints(prdModel.Model);
			PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = prdModel.AddScenarioModel(null, masterScenario.PhysicalPropPkgFluid, masterScenario.ScenarioName, orCreatePrdConstraints, masterScenario);
			pSVScenarioModel.UseCustomOverpressure = true;
			pSVScenarioModel.CopyDataFrom(masterScenario);
			pSVScenarioModel.UpdateOpPhase();
			pSVScenarioModel.UpdateReliefPhase();
			if (!masterScenario.IsSizingCase && prdModel.GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
			{
				pSVScenarioModel.SetSelectedValve(prdModel.GetSizingCaseModel().SelectedOrificeName);
			}
			pSVScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged += OnSplitScenarioChanged;
			if (masterScenario.IsSizingCase)
			{
				prdModel.Model.SetSizingCase(pSVScenarioModel.Model.ReliefScenario);
			}
		}

		public void CreateSplitAndSpareScenarios(PRDModel prdModel)
		{
			if (prdModel.GetSizingCaseModel() == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel in OverallScenarioModels)
			{
				if (prdModel.GetScenarioModel(overallScenarioModel) == null)
				{
					CreateSplitAndSpareScenario(prdModel, overallScenarioModel);
				}
			}
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel AddScenarioModel(PsvKey row, IPPPFluid fluid, PrdConstraintsDefinition prdConstraints, string scenarioName = "")
		{
			PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = OverallPRDModel.AddScenarioModel(row, fluid, scenarioName, prdConstraints);
			if (!pSVScenarioModel.IsSizingCase)
			{
				pSVScenarioModel.UpdateReliefPressure();
				foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
				{
					if (splitPRDModel.GetScenarioModel(pSVScenarioModel) == null)
					{
						CreateSplitAndSpareScenario(splitPRDModel, pSVScenarioModel);
					}
				}
				foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
				{
					if (sparePRDModel.GetScenarioModel(pSVScenarioModel) == null)
					{
						CreateSplitAndSpareScenario(sparePRDModel, pSVScenarioModel);
					}
				}
			}
			pSVScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged += ScenarioChanged;
			pSVScenarioModel.FireVesselCountChanged += OnScenarioFireVesselCountChanged;
			_UpdateNoScenarioMessage();
			return pSVScenarioModel;
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel GetScenarioModel(PsvKey key)
		{
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel overallScenarioModel in OverallScenarioModels)
			{
				if (overallScenarioModel.DBKey == key)
				{
					return overallScenarioModel;
				}
			}
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel in splitPRDModel.ScenarioModels)
				{
					if (scenarioModel.DBKey == key)
					{
						return scenarioModel;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void DisposeAllScenarios()
		{
			CleanEvents();
			foreach (PRDModel allPRDModel in AllPRDModels)
			{
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel in allPRDModel.ScenarioModels)
				{
					scenarioModel.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public void DeleteScenario(ref PSVScenarioModel scenario)
		{
			if (scenario == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ReliefScenario reliefScenario = scenario.Model.ReliefScenario;
			if (mSplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
			{
				foreach (PRDModel mSplitPRDModel in mSplitPRDModels)
				{
					mSplitPRDModel.GetScenarioModel(scenario).BaseModelChanged -= OnSplitScenarioChanged;
					PSVScenarioModel scenario2 = mSplitPRDModel.GetScenarioModel(scenario);
					mSplitPRDModel.DeleteScenario(ref scenario2);
				}
			}
			foreach (PRDModel mSparePRDModel in mSparePRDModels)
			{
				PSVScenarioModel scenario2 = mSparePRDModel.GetScenarioModel(scenario);
				mSparePRDModel.DeleteScenario(ref scenario2);
			}
			OverallPRDModel.DeleteScenario(ref scenario);
			reliefScenario.Delete();
			_UpdateNoScenarioMessage();
			_UpdateRatingMessages();
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				splitPRDModel.UpdateValveMessages();
			}
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
			{
				sparePRDModel.UpdateValveMessages();
			}
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel DuplicateScenario(PSVScenarioModel scenario, string path, string NewScenarioName)
		{
			if (path == null)
			{
				path = base.Datapath;
			}
			bool flag = scenario.PRDSystem.DBKey != DBKey;
			bool flag2 = false;
			PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel;
			if (flag)
			{
				flag2 = base.HostInterface.PasteScenario(NewScenarioName, path);
				pRDSystemModel = scenario.PRDSystem;
			}
			else
			{
				flag2 = base.HostInterface.DuplicateScenario(scenario.DBKey, path);
				pRDSystemModel = this;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			base.Simulator.PSVCommands.WaitForScenarioConstruction(OverallPRDModel);
			PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = OverallPRDModel.ScenarioModels.Last();
			pSVScenarioModel.CopyDataFrom(scenario);
			checked
			{
				int num = mSparePRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel = pRDSystemModel.mSparePRDModels[i].GetScenarioModel(scenario);
					mSparePRDModels[i].GetScenarioModel(pSVScenarioModel).CopyDataFrom(scenarioModel);
				}
				int num2 = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
				{
					PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel2 = pRDSystemModel.mSplitPRDModels[j].GetScenarioModel(scenario);
					mSplitPRDModels[j].GetScenarioModel(pSVScenarioModel).CopyDataFrom(scenarioModel2);
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					pSVScenarioModel.Calculate(isForced: true);
				}
				else
				{
					if (scenario.IsSizingCase)
					{
						SetSizingCaseModel(pSVScenarioModel);
						ScenarioDuplicated?.Invoke();
					}
					pSVScenarioModel.Fluid = pSVScenarioModel.ChosenStream;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(NewScenarioName))
					{
						if (Operators.CompareString(pSVScenarioModel.ScenarioName, scenario.ScenarioName, TextCompare: false) != 0)
						{
							pSVScenarioModel.ScenarioName = scenario.ScenarioName;
						}
					}
					else if (Operators.CompareString(pSVScenarioModel.ScenarioName, NewScenarioName, TextCompare: false) != 0)
					{
						pSVScenarioModel.ScenarioName = NewScenarioName;
					}
				}
				return pSVScenarioModel;
			}
		}

		public void EqualizeFlowSplit()
		{
			checked
			{
				try
				{
					_InFlowSplitUpdate = true;
					int num = SplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
					{
						this.set_FlowSplit(i, 100.0 / (double)SplitPRDModels.Count);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					_InFlowSplitUpdate = false;
					_UpdateFlowSplitMessage();
					DataChanged?.Invoke();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsFlowSplitNormalized()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			checked
			{
				int num2 = SplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					num += this.get_FlowSplit(i);
				}
				if (Common.IsSameValue(num, 100.0))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void NormalizeFlowSplit()
		{
			checked
			{
				try
				{
					_InFlowSplitUpdate = true;
					double num = 0.0;
					int num2 = SplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num2; i++)
					{
						num += this.get_FlowSplit(i);
					}
					if (num > 0.0)
					{
						int num3 = SplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
						for (int j = 0; j <= num3; j++)
						{
							this.set_FlowSplit(j, this.get_FlowSplit(j) / num * 100.0);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					_InFlowSplitUpdate = false;
					_UpdateFlowSplitMessage();
					DataChanged?.Invoke();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UseAPIArrangement(bool isFromRatingCalc = false)
		{
			checked
			{
				if (SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
				{
					int num = SplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
					{
						if (i > 0)
						{
							this.set_SplitSetPressureIncrease(i, isFromRatingCalc, 5.0);
						}
					}
					EqualizeFlowSplit();
				}
				mOverallPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel()?.SetOverpressureToDefault();
			}
		}

		internal void ChangeLineSizingType(PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel, LineSizingMethod newType, bool isRatingMode, bool notify)
		{
			_ = (PRDModel)scenarioModel.Owner;
			ProcessEnum<LineSizingMethod> lineSizingCalculationMethod = scenarioModel.Model.ReliefScenario.LineSizingCalculationMethod;
			if (lineSizingCalculationMethod.Value.HasValue && lineSizingCalculationMethod.Value.GetValueOrDefault() == newType)
			{
				return;
			}
			checked
			{
				try
				{
					_IsFrozenForUpdates = true;
					scenarioModel.FreezeEventPublication++;
					lineSizingCalculationMethod.Specify(newType, new UserSpecifier());
					if (newType == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous && scenarioModel.LineRating is RigorousLineRating rigorousLineRating)
					{
						rigorousLineRating.InRatingMode.Specify(isRatingMode, new UserSpecifier());
					}
					PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = scenarioModel.RefScenarioModel;
					if (pSVScenarioModel == null)
					{
						pSVScenarioModel = scenarioModel;
					}
					foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
					{
						splitPRDModel.GetScenarioModel(pSVScenarioModel).OnLineSizingMethodChanged(notify: false);
					}
					foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
					{
						sparePRDModel.GetScenarioModel(pSVScenarioModel).OnLineSizingMethodChanged(notify: false);
					}
					pSVScenarioModel.OnLineSizingMethodChanged(notify);
				}
				finally
				{
					_IsFrozenForUpdates = false;
					scenarioModel.FreezeEventPublication--;
					if (unchecked((long)scenarioModel.FreezeEventPublication) == 0L)
					{
						object objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)base.Model).DataModel);
						object objectValue2 = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)scenarioModel.Model.ReliefScenario).DataModel);
						object objectValue3 = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)scenarioModel.Model.ReliefDevice).DataModel);
						((CompositePresentationEvent<ScenarioLineSizingMethodChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<ScenarioLineSizingMethodChangedEvent>()).Publish(new ScenarioLineSizingMethodChangedEventArgs(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue2), RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue3), RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue)));
						OnSystemUpdateRequired();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal void AutoRunCalculations(string propname, bool force = false, bool isSequencedCalculation = false)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (isSequencedCalculation)
			{
				_FreezeAllScenarios();
			}
			if (isSequencedCalculation)
			{
				double curValue = double.NaN;
				bool num = VerifyDesignPress(ref curValue, notify: false);
				curValue = double.NaN;
				bool flag2 = VerifyDesignTemp(ref curValue, notify: false);
				curValue = double.NaN;
				bool flag3 = VerifyOperPress(ref curValue, notify: false);
				curValue = double.NaN;
				bool flag4 = VerifyOperTemp(ref curValue, notify: false);
				if (num || flag2 || flag3 || flag4)
				{
					force = true;
				}
			}
			if (force || isSequencedCalculation || WouldAffectScenarioCalculation(propname))
			{
				foreach (PRDModel allPRDModel in AllPRDModels)
				{
					allPRDModel.CalculateAllScenarios(propname, force, isSequencedCalculation);
				}
			}
			if (force || isSequencedCalculation || WouldAffectRatingCalculation(propname))
			{
				CalculateRating();
			}
			if (isSequencedCalculation)
			{
				_UnfreezeAllScenarios();
			}
			if (!_IsFrozenForUpdates && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(propname) && !flag)
			{
				((CompositePresentationEvent<SystemUpdatedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SystemUpdatedEvent>()).Publish(new SystemUpdatedEventArgs(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)base.Model).DataModel)));
			}
		}

		public void RunCalculations(bool force)
		{
			try
			{
				_isSequencedCalculationInFlight = true;
				AutoRunCalculations(null, force, isSequencedCalculation: true);
			}
			finally
			{
				_isSequencedCalculationInFlight = false;
			}
		}

		public void AutoRunLineSizing()
		{
			foreach (PRDModel allPRDModel in AllPRDModels)
			{
				allPRDModel.ForceCalculateLineSize();
			}
		}

		private bool WouldAffectScenarioCalculation(string propname)
		{
			if (new List<string> { "DesTemp", "OperPress", "OperTemp" }.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool WouldAffectRatingCalculation(string propname)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void CheckScenarioConsistency(PSVScenarioModel refScenario)
		{
			if (refScenario.EmergencyType != EmergScenarioType.Fire)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel = splitPRDModel.GetScenarioModel(refScenario);
				if (scenarioModel != null && scenarioModel.NeedFireVessels(EmergScenarioType.Fire, ProcessDataSource.Calculated))
				{
					scenarioModel.CreateFireVessels();
				}
			}
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
			{
				PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel2 = sparePRDModel.GetScenarioModel(refScenario);
				if (scenarioModel2 != null && scenarioModel2.NeedFireVessels(EmergScenarioType.Fire, ProcessDataSource.Calculated))
				{
					scenarioModel2.CreateFireVessels();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ScenarioChanged(IBaseModel sender, bool recalculateRatingModels)
		{
			UpdatePRDRelFlows();
			if (_isSequencedCalculationInFlight)
			{
				return;
			}
			PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = sender as PSVScenarioModel;
			if (recalculateRatingModels)
			{
				if (SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
				{
					foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
					{
						if (pSVScenarioModel != null)
						{
							splitPRDModel.CalculateOneScenario(pSVScenarioModel);
						}
						else
						{
							splitPRDModel.CalculateAllScenarios(isForced: true);
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in SparePRDModels)
				{
					if (pSVScenarioModel != null)
					{
						sparePRDModel.CalculateOneScenario(pSVScenarioModel);
					}
					else
					{
						sparePRDModel.CalculateAllScenarios(isForced: true);
					}
				}
			}
			CalculateRating();
			UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
			DataChanged?.Invoke();
		}

		private void OnSplitScenarioChanged(IBaseModel sender, bool recalculateRatingModels)
		{
			DataChanged?.Invoke();
		}

		{
			if (!_IsFrozenForUpdates)
			{
				((CompositePresentationEvent<SystemUpdatedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SystemUpdatedEvent>()).Publish(new SystemUpdatedEventArgs(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)base.Model).DataModel)));
			}
		}

		public void SelectOrificeChanged(PSVScenarioModel changedScenario = null)
		{
			if (changedScenario == null || changedScenario.IsSizingCase)
			{
				_CopySizingCaseSelectedOrificeToAllScenarios();
				CalculateRating();
				DataChanged?.Invoke();
			}
		}

		private bool IsRatingCalculationReady()
		{
			if (GetSizingCaseModel() == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			checked
			{
				int num = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					PRDModel pRDModel = mSplitPRDModels[i];
					if (pRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel() == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(pRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true)))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (pRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel().get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) > 0.0 && double.IsNaN(pRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel().SelectOrifice))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(mFlowSplit[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public void CalculateRating(bool shouldUpdateSplitSetIncrease = true)
		{
			ClearRatingResults();
			if (IsUsingAPIArrangement && shouldUpdateSplitSetIncrease)
			{
				UseAPIArrangement(isFromRatingCalc: true);
			}
			if (!IsRatingCalculationReady())
			{
				return;
			}
			checked
			{
				int num = OverallScenarioModels.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = OverallScenarioModels[i];
					double num2 = pSVScenarioModel.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
					int num3 = 0;
					List<int> list = new List<int>();
					List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
					List<double> list3 = mFlowAmountUsed[i];
					List<double> list4 = mOrificeUsedFrac[i];
					while (num3 < SplitPRDModels.Count)
					{
						list.Clear();
						list.Add(num3);
						int j = num3 + 1;
						double num4 = 0.0;
						if (!double.IsNaN(SplitPRDModels[num3].GetSizingCaseModel().SelectOrifice))
						{
							PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = SplitPRDModels[num3].GetSizingCaseModel();
							num4 = ((pSVScenarioModel.DBKey.Value != GetSizingCaseModel().DBKey.Value) ? (sizingCaseModel.EffectiveOrifice / pSVScenarioModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true) * pSVScenarioModel.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true)) : sizingCaseModel.RatedFlow);
						}
						double num5 = num4;
						list2.Add(num4);
						for (; j < SplitPRDModels.Count && SplitPRDModels[j].get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true) == SplitPRDModels[num3].get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true); j++)
						{
							list.Add(j);
							num4 = 0.0;
							PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel2 = SplitPRDModels[j].GetSizingCaseModel();
							if (!double.IsNaN(sizingCaseModel2.SelectOrifice))
							{
								num4 = ((pSVScenarioModel.DBKey.Value != GetSizingCaseModel().DBKey.Value) ? (sizingCaseModel2.EffectiveOrifice / pSVScenarioModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true) * pSVScenarioModel.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true)) : sizingCaseModel2.RatedFlow);
							}
							num5 += num4;
							list2.Add(num4);
						}
						if (num5 < num2)
						{
							int num6 = num3;
							int num7 = j - 1;
							for (int k = num6; k <= num7; k++)
							{
								list3[k] = list2[k];
								list4[k] = 1.0;
							}
							num2 -= num5;
						}
						else
						{
							for (double num8 = num2; num8 > 1E-05; num8 = DistributeFlow(list3, num8, list, list2))
							{
							}
							int num9 = num3;
							int num10 = j - 1;
							for (int l = num9; l <= num10; l++)
							{
								list4[l] = list3[l] / list2[l];
							}
							for (; j < SplitPRDModels.Count; j++)
							{
								list3[j] = 0.0;
								list4[j] = 0.0;
							}
						}
						num3 = j;
					}
				}
				_UpdateRatingMessages();
			}
		}

		private double DistributeFlow(IList<double> allocatedFlow, double totalAvailFlow, IList<int> PRDid, IList<double> ratedFlows)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (int item in PRDid)
			{
				PRDModel pRDModel = mSplitPRDModels[item];
				double d = 1.0 / pRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel().EffectiveOrifice;
				num2 += 1.0 / Math.Sqrt(d);
			}
			foreach (int item2 in PRDid)
			{
				PRDModel pRDModel2 = mSplitPRDModels[item2];
				double d2 = 1.0 / pRDModel2.GetSizingCaseModel().EffectiveOrifice;
				double num3 = totalAvailFlow / Math.Sqrt(d2) / num2;
				if (num3 + allocatedFlow[item2] < ratedFlows[item2])
				{
					allocatedFlow[item2] += num3;
					continue;
				}
				allocatedFlow[item2] = ratedFlows[item2];
				num += num3 - ratedFlows[item2];
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void ClearRatingResults()
		{
			mFlowAmountUsed.Clear();
			mOrificeUsedFrac.Clear();
			checked
			{
				int num = OverallScenarioModels.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					mFlowAmountUsed.Add(new List<double>());
					mOrificeUsedFrac.Add(new List<double>());
					int num2 = SplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
					{
						mFlowAmountUsed[i].Add(0.0);
						mOrificeUsedFrac[i].Add(0.0);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsPRDSystemSizedOK(int iScenario)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				splitPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
				double num2 = splitPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel()?.EffectiveOrifice ?? double.NaN;
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					num += num2;
				}
			}
			double num3 = OverallPRDModel.ScenarioModels[iScenario].get_CalcOrifice(notify: true);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && num < num3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsPRDSystemCapacityOK(int iScenario)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in SplitPRDModels)
			{
				splitPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
				double num2 = splitPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel()?.EffectiveOrifice ?? double.NaN;
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					num += num2;
				}
			}
			double num3 = OverallPRDModel.ScenarioModels[iScenario].get_CalcOrifice(notify: true);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && num3 > 0.95 * num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void UpdateDataPath(string path)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) || string.Equals(base.Datapath, path))
			{
				return;
			}
			base.UpdateDataPath(path);
			if (Information.IsNothing(AllPRDModels))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PRDModel allPRDModel in AllPRDModels)
			{
				allPRDModel.UpdateDataPath(path);
			}
		}

		private void _PrdPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(e.PropertyName, "LiftRestriction", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				CalculateRating();
			}
			if (!_IsFrozenForUpdates && !PSVScenarioModel.PassThroughPropertyNames.Contains(e.PropertyName) && !e.PropertyName.Contains("Messages"))
			{
				((CompositePresentationEvent<SystemUpdatedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SystemUpdatedEvent>()).Publish(new SystemUpdatedEventArgs(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)base.Model).DataModel)));
			}
		}

		{
			if (!_IsFrozenForUpdates)
			{
				((CompositePresentationEvent<SystemUpdatedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SystemUpdatedEvent>()).Publish(new SystemUpdatedEventArgs(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)base.Model).DataModel)));
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSplitFluids(PSVScenarioModel refScenario)
		{
			checked
			{
				if (OverallScenarioModels.Contains(refScenario))
				{
					int num = ((SplitPRDModels.Any() && SplitPRDModels[0] == OverallPRDModel) ? 1 : 0);
					int num2 = mSplitPRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
					{
						SplitPRDModels[i].GetScenarioModel(refScenario)?.RefreshFluid();
					}
					int num3 = mSparePRDModels.Count - 1;
					for (int j = 0; j <= num3; j++)
					{
						SparePRDModels[j].GetScenarioModel(refScenario)?.RefreshFluid();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool IsWettedFireCalculation
		{
			get
			{
				if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Wetted)
				{
					if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.Rigorous)
					{
						return !double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false));
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsWettedFireCalculationSuperheated
		{
			get
			{
				if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.Rigorous && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)))
				{
					return myVM.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) == FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief
		{
			get
			{
				if (myVM.FireIsTwoPhaseRelief)
				{
					return myVM.get_FireSelectedRelief(notify: true, byUser: true).GetValueOrDefault() != FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected CalculationStatusEnum FlashHydraulicsStreamToOutletConditions(IPhysicalPropertyPackage package, IFlowStream stream, ref string msg)
		{
			CalculationStatusEnum result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_PaA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure") + UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_Pa, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_Pa, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure") + num;
			try
			{
				package.FlashStream(stream, (FlashType)2, num2, stream.GetPhaseByID(0).Enthalpy.Value);
				result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				msg = ex2.Message;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected CalculationStatusEnum FlashHydraulicsStreamToReliefConditions(IPhysicalPropertyPackage package, IFlowStream stream, ref string msg)
		{
			CalculationStatusEnum result;
			if ((IsWettedFireCalculation || IsWettedFireCalculationSuperheated || IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief) && !FlashToReliefConditions(ExpectedPhase.DontCare, MessageLocation.LineSizing))
			{
				msg = string.Empty;
				result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			else
			{
				result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_PaG, myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure") + UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_PaA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_K, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "Temperature");
				if (IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief)
				{
					num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_PaG, myVM.OverrideReliefPressure, "GaugePressure") + UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_PaA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				}
				bool flag = false;
				try
				{
					if (!IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief)
					{
						if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.Wetted || (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.Rigorous && !double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false))))
						{
							package.FlashStream(stream, (FlashType)4, num, 1.0);
							flag = true;
						}
						else if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction)
						{
							package.FlashStream(stream, (FlashType)1, num, num2);
						}
					}
					if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction || IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief || (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated && !double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)) && Math.Abs(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false) - stream.GetPhaseByID(0).MolarVapourFraction.Value) / myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0001))
					{
						package.FlashStream(stream, (FlashType)4, num, myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false));
						if (myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false) == 1.0)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						double num3 = double.NaN;
						num3 = ((!myVM.IsLineSizingRatingMode) ? UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.InID, "SmallLength") : myVM.OwnerPRD.InletPipe.GetFirstInnerDiameter_m());
						double num4 = myVM.get_LineSizingFlow(notify: false) / 3600.0;
						double num5 = Math.PI / 4.0 * num3 * num3;
						double num6 = Math.Abs(num4 / stream.GetPhaseByID(0).Density.Value / num5);
						double num7 = 0.5 * num6 * num6;
						if (!double.IsNaN(num7))
						{
							package.ReflashStreamWithSameComposition(stream, (FlashType)2, num, stream.GetPhaseByID(0).Enthalpy.Value + 1.01 * num7);
						}
					}
					result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					msg = ex2.Message;
					ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool CanFlashToReliefConditions()
		{
			if (IsWettedFireCalculation || IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief || IsWettedFireCalculationSuperheated)
			{
				return mPPPFluid.HasFireFractions && GetStoredComposition(mPPPFluid).Any([SpecialName] (double x) => x > 0.0);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool FlashToReliefConditions(ExpectedPhase expected, MessageLocation location, string wrongPhaseErrorMessage = null)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			double value = myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true);
			string unitValue = myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true);
			value = ConvertToHysysUnits("Temperature", value, unitValue);
			double value2 = myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true);
			unitValue = myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true);
			value2 = ConvertToHysysUnits("GaugePressure", value2, unitValue, myVM.AtmPress, myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true));
			if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction || (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated && !double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)) && myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false) < 1.0 && myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0))
			{
				if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction)
				{
					flag = mPPPFluid.TPFlash(value, value2);
				}
				if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction || (flag && Math.Abs(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false) - mPPPFluid.VaporFraction()) / myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0001))
				{
					flag = mPPPFluid.PVFlash(value2, myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false));
					if (!flag | double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.Temperature()))
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RelTempVFFlashFail, location);
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief)
			{
				if (!mPPPFluid.HasFireFractions)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.MissingFireComposition, location);
					return false;
				}
				value2 = ConvertToHysysUnits("GaugePressure", myVM.OverrideReliefPressure, myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), myVM.AtmPress, myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true));
				flag = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.PVFlashFire(value2, myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false));
			}
			else if (IsWettedFireCalculation)
			{
				if (!mPPPFluid.HasFireFractions)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.MissingFireComposition, location);
					return false;
				}
				flag = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.PVFlashFire(value2, 1.0);
			}
			else if (IsWettedFireCalculationSuperheated)
			{
				if (!mPPPFluid.HasFireFractions)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.MissingFireComposition, location);
					return false;
				}
				flag = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlashFire(value, value2);
			}
			else
			{
				flag = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlash(value, value2);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				FluidPhaseRegime phaseFromVaporFraction = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction());
				switch (expected)
				{
				case ExpectedPhase.Liquid:
					switch (phaseFromVaporFraction)
					{
					case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
						flag = false;
						wrongPhaseErrorMessage = wrongPhaseErrorMessage ?? FormResource.AllVapor;
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, wrongPhaseErrorMessage, location);
						break;
					default:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.TwoPhaseLiquid, location);
						break;
					case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
						break;
					}
					break;
				case ExpectedPhase.Mixed:
					switch (phaseFromVaporFraction)
					{
					case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.AllVapor, location);
						break;
					case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.AllLiquid, location);
						break;
					}
					break;
				case ExpectedPhase.Vapor:
					switch (phaseFromVaporFraction)
					{
					case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
						flag = false;
						wrongPhaseErrorMessage = wrongPhaseErrorMessage ?? FormResource.AllLiquid;
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, wrongPhaseErrorMessage, location);
						break;
					default:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.TwoPhaseVapor, location);
						break;
					case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FlashFailureAtRelief, location);
				flag = false;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool IsCommonPropertiesReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(myVM.ChosenStream))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoStream);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoVaporFraction);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SetPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMSetPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.AtmPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMAtmPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OverPress);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool IsFluidPropertiesReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			return IsCommonPropertiesReady(MessageHandler);
		}

		public bool IsReliefPropertiesReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			flag = IsCommonPropertiesReady(MessageHandler);
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RelTempIsBad);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMRelTemp);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag && !myVM.Phase.HasValue && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(myVM.ChosenStream))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoPhase);
				flag = false;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool IsOrificeSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = true;
			switch (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				result = IsVaporOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
				result = IsLiquidOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				result = IsSteamOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
				result = IsMixedAAndBOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
				result = IsMixedAAndBOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				result = IsMixedCOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				result = IsMixedDirectOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				result = IsKrMethodSizingReady(MessageHandler);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				result = IsNonCertifiedLiquidOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool IsKrMethodSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(myVM.ChosenStream))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RigPipe_NoStream);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoVaporFraction);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SetPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RelTempIsBad);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.SelRDDiam))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SelRDDiam);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool IsCommonOrificeSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMDesTemp) && double.IsNaN(myVM.DesTemp))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.DesTemp);
				result = false;
			}
			if (!IsReliefPropertiesReady(MessageHandler))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress);
				result = false;
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SuperImpConstBackPress);
				result = false;
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SuperImpVarBackPress);
				result = false;
				flag = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress);
				result = false;
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.BuiltupBackPress);
				result = false;
				flag = false;
