			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMBuiltupBackPress);
				result = false;
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag && !double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true)) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true)) && !double.IsNaN(Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar)) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true)))
			{
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "AbsolutePressure");
				double val = num + num2 + num3;
				double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar), "AbsolutePressure");
				double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure") + num4;
				if (!double.IsNaN(myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop))
				{
					num5 -= UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
				}
				if (!BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(num5, val))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.TotBPHigh);
					result = false;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kd);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoOverPr);
				result = false;
			}
			else if (myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true) < 0.0)
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NegOverPr);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && myVM.RuptDisk && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.LiftRestriction))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoLiftRestriction);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop < 0.0)
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.WarnInletDPNegative);
			}
			else if (myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop > myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.ErrorInletDPAboveRelief);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public double GetCapUncertFact()
		{
			double result = 1.0;
			if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
			{
				double capUncertFact = myVM.CapUncertFact;
				if (capUncertFact > 0.0)
				{
					result = capUncertFact;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CalculateOrificeSize(bool force, double oldsize)
		{
			myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			AddMessageDelegate messageHandler = [SpecialName] (MessageLevel level, string msg) =>
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(level, msg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			};
			if (!IsOrificeSizingReady(messageHandler))
			{
				return;
			}
			OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
			switch (orificeSizingMethod)
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				CalculateVaporOrificeSize();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
				CalculateLiquidOrificeSize();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				CalculateSteamOrificeSize();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
				CalculateMixedAAndBOrificeSize();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
				CalculateMixedAAndBOrificeSize();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				CalculateMixedCOrificeSize();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				CalculateMixedDirectOrificeSize();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				CalculateKrMethodOrificeSize();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				CalculateNonCertifiedLiquidOrificeSize();
				break;
			}
			if (!force)
			{
				if (myVM.NewOrificeSelectionRequired(oldsize))
				{
					EraseOrificeResults();
				}
				else if (orificeSizingMethod != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
				{
					myVM.CheckOrificeSelection();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CalculateReliefPropertiesCommon(ExpectedPhase phase, MessageLocation location, bool notify = false)
		{
			if (!FlashToReliefConditions(phase, location))
			{
				return false;
			}
			myVM.set_RelVapMolWeight(notify, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight());
			myVM.set_RelLiqMolWeight(notify, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight());
			myVM.set_RelVapViscosity(notify, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporViscosity());
			myVM.set_RelLiqViscosity(notify, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.LiquidViscosity());
			return true;
		}

		public void EraseLineSizingResults()
		{
			myVM.IsSPLWarning = false;
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous && (Operators.CompareString(myVM.Host, "HYSYS", TextCompare: false) == 0 || myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod))
			{
				EraseVaporLineSizingResults();
				return;
			}
			switch (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				EraseVaporLineSizingResults();
				return;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
				EraseLiquidLineSizingResults();
				return;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				EraseSteamLineSizingResults();
				return;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				EraseRigorousLineSizingResults();
				return;
			}
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Omega)
			{
				EraseOmegaLineSizingResults();
			}
			else
			{
				EraseHomogeneousLineSizingResults();
			}
		}

		private void EraseRigorousLineSizingResults()
		{
			foreach (string eRLSRStringProperty in ERLSRStringProperties)
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<string>(eRLSRStringProperty);
			}
			foreach (string eRLSRRealProperty in ERLSRRealProperties)
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<double>(eRLSRRealProperty);
			}
		}

		private void EraseVaporLineSizingResults()
		{
			foreach (string eVLSRStringProperty in EVLSRStringProperties)
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<string>(eVLSRStringProperty);
			}
			foreach (string eVLSRRealProperty in EVLSRRealProperties)
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<double>(eVLSRRealProperty);
			}
			foreach (string item in EVLSRRealPropertiesCalculated)
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<double>(item, byUser: false);
			}
		}

		private void EraseLiquidLineSizingResults()
		{
			myVM.EraseProperty<string>("DataStatus");
			foreach (string eLLSRRealProperty in ELLSRRealProperties)
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<double>(eLLSRRealProperty);
			}
		}

		private void EraseSteamLineSizingResults()
		{
			EraseVaporLineSizingResults();
		}

		private void EraseOmegaLineSizingResults()
		{
			foreach (string eOLSRRealProperty in EOLSRRealProperties)
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<double>(eOLSRRealProperty);
			}
			myVM.EraseProperty<string>("Ph2OutTypeFlow");
		}

		private void EraseHomogeneousLineSizingResults()
		{
			foreach (string eHLSRRealProperty in EHLSRRealProperties)
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<double>(eHLSRRealProperty);
			}
			myVM.EraseProperty<double>("SourceSPL", byUser: false);
		}

		public bool WouldAffectLineSizingConstraints(string propname)
		{
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous && myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				return WouldAffectRigorousLineSizingConstraints(propname);
			}
			switch (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				return WouldAffectVaporLineSizingConstraints(propname);
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				return WouldAffectLiquidLineSizingConstraints(propname);
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				return WouldAffectKrLineSizingConstraints(propname);
			default:
				if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Omega)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return WouldAffectMixedDirectLineSizingConstraints(propname);
			}
		}

		public bool WouldAffectLineSizing(string propname)
		{
			if (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				return WouldAffectKrLineSizing(propname);
			}
			if (WouldAffectCommonLineSizing(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous)
			{
				return WouldAffectRigorousLineSizing(propname);
			}
			OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
			switch (orificeSizingMethod)
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				return false;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				return false;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				return false;
			default:
				if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Omega)
				{
					return WouldAffectOmegaLineSizing(orificeSizingMethod, propname);
				}
				return WouldAffectHomogeneousLineSizing(orificeSizingMethod, propname);
			}
		}

		public bool WouldAffectCommonLineSizing(string propname)
		{
			int? num = (int?)myVM.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "NoFire", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (myVM.IsRatingCalc)
				{
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "RelFlow", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "TotalReliefLoad", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = (int?)myVM.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "SelCapacity", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, PSVScenarioModel.s_SelectOrifice, TextCompare: false) == 0 && double.IsNaN(myVM.SelectOrifice))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num = (int?)myVM.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true && Operators.CompareString(propname, PSVScenarioModel.s_UpratedFlow, TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (WACLSProperties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (WouldAffectReliefProperties(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool WouldAffectKrLineSizing(string propname)
		{
			if (WAKRLSProperties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool WouldAffectHomogeneousLineSizing(OrificeSizingMethod calcOption, string propname)
		{
			if (WAHLSProperties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool WouldAffectOmegaLineSizing(OrificeSizingMethod calcOption, string propname)
		{
			if (WAOLSProperties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (calcOption != OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3)
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "UOM_vo", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "vo", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (propname)
				{
				case "UOM_V_ls":
					return true;
				case "V_ls":
					return true;
				case "UOM_Rho_l9":
					return true;
				case "Rho_l9":
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool WouldAffectRigorousLineSizing(string propname)
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (WARLSProperties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			int? num = (int?)myVM.RigorousTeeMethod;
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != -1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
			{
				return WARLSTeeProperties.Contains(propname);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsLineSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (myVM.PRDSystem.SplitPRDModels.Count > 1 && !myVM.IsRatingCalc)
			{
				myVM.IsLineSizingReady = false;
				return false;
			}
			if (!myVM.get_IsLineSizingCalculated(notify: true))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous && myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				flag = IsHydraulicsLineSizingReady(MessageHandler);
			}
			else
			{
				OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
				switch (orificeSizingMethod)
				{
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
					flag = IsVaporLineSizingReady(MessageHandler);
					break;
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
				case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
					flag = IsLiquidLineSizingReady(MessageHandler);
					break;
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
					flag = IsSteamLineSizingReady(MessageHandler);
					break;
				case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
					flag = IsRigorousLineSizingReady(MessageHandler);
					break;
				default:
					flag = ((myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) != LineSizingMethod.Omega) ? IsHomogeneousLineSizingReady(MessageHandler) : IsOmegaLineSizingReady(orificeSizingMethod, MessageHandler));
					break;
				}
			}
			myVM.IsLineSizingReady = flag;
			return flag;
		}

		public bool IsCommonLineSizingFlowReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_LineSizingFlow(notify: false)))
			{
				int? num = (int?)myVM.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					if (!myVM.IsRatingCalc)
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.LineSizing_RatedNoFlow);
					}
					else
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.LineSizing_RatedNoFlow_Split);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, string.Format(FormResource.LineSizing_NoFlow, TranslateUiStrings.LineRatingFlowSpec.StringValue(myVM.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true))));
				}
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool IsCommonLineSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = IsReliefPropertiesReady(MessageHandler);
			if (!IsCommonLineSizingFlowReady(MessageHandler))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMRelFlow);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.InID))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.InID);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.OutID))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OutID);
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SuperImpConstBackPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SuperImpVarBackPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.BuiltupBackPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMBuiltupBackPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) != LineSizingMethod.Omega)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMRough))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMRough);
					result = false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.OutRough))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OutRough);
					result = false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.InRough))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.InRough);
					result = false;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMEquivLength))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMEquivLength);
					result = false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.OutEquivLength))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OutEquivLength);
					result = false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.InEquivLength))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.InEquivLength);
					result = false;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool IsLineSizingConstraintsReady()
		{
			if (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.AtmPress))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true)))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true)))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.InPDrop))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.OutPDrop))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous && myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				return IsRigorousLineSizingConstraintsReady();
			}
			switch (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				return IsVaporLineSizingConstraintsReady();
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				return IsLiquidLineSizingConstraintsReady();
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				return IsKrLineSizingConstraintsReady();
			default:
				if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Omega)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return IsMixedDirectLineSizingConstraintsReady();
			}
		}

		public void CalculateLineSize(bool force = false)
		{
			EraseLineSizingResults();
			myVM.ClearLineSizingMessages();
			if (!myVM.get_IsLineSizingCalculated(notify: true))
			{
				return;
			}
			AddMessageDelegate messageHandler = [SpecialName] (MessageLevel level, string msg) =>
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(level, msg);
			};
			CheckLinePiping(messageHandler);
			if (!IsLineSizingReady(messageHandler))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod && myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) != LineSizingMethod.Omega)
			{
				_CalculateSourceSPL();
			}
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous && (Operators.CompareString(myVM.Host, "HYSYS", TextCompare: false) == 0 || myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod))
			{
				CalculateHydraulicsLineSize(force);
			}
			else
			{
				OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
				switch (orificeSizingMethod)
				{
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
					CalculateVaporLineSize();
					break;
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
				case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
					CalculateLiquidLineSize();
					break;
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
					CalculateSteamLineSize();
					break;
				case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				{
					System.Windows.Forms.Cursor current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current;
					System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.WaitCursor;
					CalculateRigorousLineSize();
					if (System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current != current)
					{
						System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = current;
					}
					if (!force)
					{
						myVM.CheckOrificeSelection();
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					if (myVM.EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire && myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated && myVM.FIRECalculationType != FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted && (Math.Abs(mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight() - myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false)) > 0.05 || (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false)) ^ double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight()))))
					{
						CalculateFireReliefLoad();
					}
					if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Omega)
					{
						CalculateMixedAAndBLineSize(orificeSizingMethod);
					}
					else
					{
						CalculateMixedDirectLineSize();
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			CheckRDLinePiping();
			myVM.NotifyLineSizingMessagesPropertyChanged();
		}

		public void CalculateLineSizeConstraints()
		{
			if (!myVM.get_IsLineSizingCalculated(notify: true) || !IsLineSizingConstraintsReady())
			{
				return;
			}
			myVM.ClearLineSizingMessages(MessageLocation.LineSizingConstraints);
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous && myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				CalculateRigorousLineSizingConstraints();
				return;
			}
			switch (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				CalculateVaporLineSizingConstraints();
				return;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				CalculateLiquidLineSizingConstraints();
				return;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				CalculateKrLineSizingConstraints();
				return;
			}
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) != LineSizingMethod.Omega)
			{
				CalculateMixedDirectLineSizingConstraints();
			}
		}

		private void CheckCalcMassFlowrate()
		{
			if ((!double.IsNaN(myVM.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true)) & !double.IsInfinity(myVM.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true))) && (!double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true)) & !double.IsInfinity(myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true))) && myVM.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true) < myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true))
			{
				double value = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, myVM.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true), "MassFlow");
				double value2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
				string message = string.Format(FormResource.CalcIOFlowLessThanReq, Math.Round(value, 2), DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, Math.Round(value2, 2), DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit);
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Error, message);
			}
		}

		private void CheckLinePiping(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			if (myVM.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous && (Operators.CompareString(myVM.Host, "HYSYS", TextCompare: false) == 0 || myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod))
			{
				myVM.IsPipeDiameterWarning = false;
				if (myVM.OwnerPRD.InletPipe.CheckPipingConstraints((RigorousLineRating)myVM.LineRating, MessageHandler, FormResource.col_InletPipe) != CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK)
				{
					myVM.IsPipeDiameterWarning = true;
				}
				if (myVM.OwnerPRD.OutletPipe.CheckPipingConstraints((RigorousLineRating)myVM.LineRating, MessageHandler, FormResource.col_OutPipe) != CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK)
				{
					myVM.IsPipeDiameterWarning = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckRDLinePiping()
		{
			if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv || myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = double.NaN;
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength2_cm, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.SelRDDiam, "SmallLength");
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			double num5 = double.NaN;
			double num6 = double.NaN;
			double num7 = double.NaN;
			if (myVM.IsLineSizingRatingMode)
			{
				num = double.PositiveInfinity;
				double num8 = 0.0;
				foreach (ILineSizingPipeElement element in myVM.OwnerPRD.InletPipe.Elements)
				{
					num8 += element.ActualLength;
					if (element.NominalDiameter < num)
					{
						num = element.NominalDiameter;
					}
				}
				num2 = double.PositiveInfinity;
				double num9 = 0.0;
				foreach (ILineSizingPipeElement element2 in myVM.OwnerPRD.OutletPipe.Elements)
				{
					num9 += element2.ActualLength;
					if (element2.NominalDiameter < num2)
					{
						num2 = element2.NominalDiameter;
					}
				}
				num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, num8, "Length");
				num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, num9, "Length");
				num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, num8, "SmallLength");
				num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, num9, "SmallLength");
			}
			else
			{
				num = myVM.InND;
				num2 = myVM.OutND;
				num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.InEquivLength, "SmallLength");
				num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, myVM.InEquivLength, "Length");
				num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.OutEquivLength, "SmallLength");
				num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, myVM.OutEquivLength, "Length");
			}
			if (num4 > 8.0 * num)
			{
				double num10 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, num, "SmallLength");
				string message = string.Format(FormResource.PipeLengthDetailInlet, num5, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, 8.0 * num10, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit);
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message);
			}
			if (num6 > 5.0 * num2)
			{
				double num11 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, num2, "SmallLength");
				string message2 = string.Format(FormResource.PipeLengthDetailOutlet, num7, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, 5.0 * num11, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit);
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message2);
			}
			if (MyMath.ValueExceeds(num3, num, 1E-06, 1E-06))
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.InPipeDiamTooSmall);
			}
			if (MyMath.ValueExceeds(num3, num2, 1E-06, 1E-06))
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OutPipeDiamTooSmall);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateReliefLoad(string propName)
		{
			if (myVM.IsRatingCalc)
			{
				if (myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated && myVM.EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire && !myVM.IsFireCompositionCalculated && WouldAffectLineSizing(propName))
				{
					myVM.MasterScenarioModel.Calculate(propName);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
				switch (myVM.EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case EmergScenarioType.Control_Valve_Failure:
					CalculateCVFailureReliefLoad();
					myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetFluidComposition(mPPPFluid);
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fan_Failure:
					CalculateFanFailureReliefLoad();
					myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetFluidComposition(mPPPFluid);
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fire:
					myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					CalculateFireReliefLoad();
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Reflux_Failure:
					CalculateRefluxFailureReliefLoad();
					myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetFluidComposition(mPPPFluid);
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Thermal_Expansion:
					CalculateThermalExpansionReliefLoad();
					myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetFluidComposition(mPPPFluid);
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Exch_Tube_Rupture:
					CalculateTubeRuptureReliefLoad();
					myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetFluidComposition(mPPPFluid);
					break;
				default:
					myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetFluidComposition(mPPPFluid);
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
				myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetFluidComposition(mPPPFluid);
			}
			myVM.ComponentNames = GetFluidComponents(mPPPFluid);
		}

		public void CalculateCVFailureReliefLoad()
		{
			CalculateUpstreamAndDownstreamPhase();
			if (myVM.VFMassFlowCalcMethod != ControlValveSizingSource.PSVPlus)
			{
				CalculateCVFailureHYSYSSizingReliefLoad();
			}
			else if (myVM.VfInletPhaseRegime == FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid)
			{
				CalculateCVFailureLiquidFlowReliefLoad();
			}
			else
			{
				CalculateCVFailureVaporFlowReliefLoad();
			}
		}

		public void CalculateCVFailureLiquidFlowReliefLoad()
		{
			if (myVM.VfOutletPhaseRegime != FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Scenario_FlashPhase, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			}
			double vFCV_ = myVM.VFCV_100;
			if (vFCV_ <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.CT100, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double inputVal = myVM.VFInletPress_Rel + Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar);
			double t = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.VFInletTemp_Rel, "Temperature");
			double p = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, inputVal, "AbsolutePressure");
			double vapPress_Rel;
			if (!mPPPFluid.TVFlash(t, 0.0))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.VFLPvapFailed, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				vapPress_Rel = 0.0;
				myVM.VFLVapPress_Rel = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				vapPress_Rel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, mPPPFluid.Pressure(), "AbsolutePressure");
				myVM.VFLVapPress_Rel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, mPPPFluid.Pressure(), "AbsolutePressure");
			}
			mPPPFluid.TPFlash(t, p);
			double num = mPPPFluid.OverallDensity() / 1000.0;
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FlashFailed, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			myVM.VFUpstreamLiquidDensity = mPPPFluid.OverallDensity();
			myVM.VFLSpecGravity_Rel = num;
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, mPPPFluid.LiquidCriticalPressure(), "AbsolutePressure");
			myVM.VFLCritPress_Rel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, mPPPFluid.LiquidCriticalPressure(), "AbsolutePressure");
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) || num2 < 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoCriticalProperties, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar), "AbsolutePressure");
			double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.VFLUOMInletPress_Rel, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.VFLInletPress_rel, "GaugePressure");
			num4 += num3;
			double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			num5 += num3;
			double num6 = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			if (num6 < 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.AlOver, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double flowToProc = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.VFLUOMFlowToProc, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.VFLFlowToProc, "MassFlow");
			double cVFKm = myVM.CVFKm;
			if (cVFKm <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.CVFFl, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (MyMath.ValueExceeds((num5 - num3) * (1.0 + num6 / 100.0) + num3, num4, 1E-08, 1E-08))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.ValveNegativePressureDelta, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			bool IsCriticalFlow = false;
			double num7 = ValveFailureScenario.ValveFailureLiquidReliefFlow(ref IsCriticalFlow, num4, num5, num6, vFCV_, cVFKm, flowToProc, num, vapPress_Rel, num2);
			if (num7 < 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegRelFlow, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (IsCriticalFlow)
			{
				myVM.VFLTypeFlow_Rel = FlowType.Critical;
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.VFLTypeFlow_Rel = FlowType.Subcritical;
			}
			myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.VFLUOMRelievingFlow, num7, "MassFlow"));
			myVM.VFCalcMassFlow = myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) + myVM.VFFlowToProc;
		}

		public void CalculateCVFailureVaporFlowReliefLoad()
		{
			double vFCV_ = myVM.VFCV_100;
			if (vFCV_ <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.CT100, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double inputVal = myVM.VFInletPress_Rel + Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar);
			double t = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.VFInletTemp_Rel, "Temperature");
			double p = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, inputVal, "AbsolutePressure");
			mPPPFluid.TPFlash(t, p);
			double num = mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight();
			double num2 = mPPPFluid.VaporZFactor();
			myVM.VFCompress_Rel = num2;
			if (myVM.VFCompress_Rel <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoComp, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (num <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoMW, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			myVM.VFUpstreamVaporMolWt = num;
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.VFUOMInletTemp_Rel, UnitStrings.Temp_F, myVM.VFInletTemp_Rel, "Temperature");
			if (num3 <= -459.6)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoInTemp, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar), "AbsolutePressure");
			double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.VFUOMInletPress_Rel, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.VFInletPress_Rel, "GaugePressure");
			num5 += num4;
			if (myVM.VfInletPhaseRegime == FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.CV_MixedPhaseWarning, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			}
			double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			num6 += num4;
			double num7 = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			if (num7 < 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.AlOver, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double flowToProc = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.VFUOMFlowToProc, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.VFFlowToProc, "MassFlow");
			double cVFKm = myVM.CVFKm;
			if (cVFKm <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.EnterCfFL, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (MyMath.ValueExceeds((num6 - num4) * (1.0 + num7 / 100.0) + num4, num5, 1E-08, 1E-08))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.ValveNegativePressureDelta, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			bool IsCriticalFlow = false;
			double num8 = ValveFailureScenario.ValveFailureReliefFlow(ref IsCriticalFlow, num5, num3, num6, num7, vFCV_, cVFKm, flowToProc, num, num2);
			if (num8 < 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegRelFlow, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (IsCriticalFlow)
			{
				myVM.VFTypeFlow_Rel = FlowType.Critical;
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.VFTypeFlow_Rel = FlowType.Subcritical;
			}
			myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.VFUOMRelievingFlow, num8, "MassFlow"));
			myVM.VFCalcMassFlow = myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) + myVM.VFFlowToProc;
		}

		public void CalculateCVFailureHYSYSSizingReliefLoad()
		{
			double massFlow = double.NaN;
			double DELTA_PAllowable = double.NaN;
			bool isChokedFlow = false;
			bool isCavitating = false;
			bool isFlashing = false;
			bool isCritical = false;
			bool isNormal = false;
			bool vapEqnDominant = false;
			double pc = double.NaN;
			ControlValveSizingSource vFMassFlowCalcMethod = myVM.VFMassFlowCalcMethod;
			double cVFValveTypeOpening = myVM.CVFValveTypeOpening;
			ControlValveMaker cVFValveMaker = myVM.CVFValveMaker;
			int valueOrDefault = myVM.get_CVFValveTypeVal(notify: true).GetValueOrDefault();
			double vFCV_ = myVM.VFCV_100;
			double cVFCg = myVM.CVFCg;
			double cVFC = myVM.CVFC1;
			double cVFKm = myVM.CVFKm;
			double cVFFp = myVM.CVFFp;
			double cVFXt = myVM.CVFXt;
			double cVFKc = myVM.CVFKc;
			bool cVFModelLiqValveChoking = myVM.CVFModelLiqValveChoking;
			bool cVFDoRigorousCpCv = myVM.CVFDoRigorousCpCv;
			bool cVFDoRigorousCalc = myVM.CVFDoRigorousCalc;
			if (!IsRealAndPositive(Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar)))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.AtmPress, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double num = Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar);
			double inputVal = myVM.VFInletPress_Rel + num;
			double inputVal2 = myVM.VFOutletPress + num;
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, inputVal, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, inputVal2, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.VFInletTemp_Rel, "Temperature");
			if (cVFValveTypeOpening < 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsRealAndPositive(num2))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoP_Upstream, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (!IsRealAndPositive(num3))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoP_Downstream, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (MyMath.ValueExceeds(num3, num2, 1E-08, 1E-08))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.ValveNegativePressureDelta, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (!IsRealAndPositive(num4 + 273.15))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoT_Upstream, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (!IsRealAndPositive(vFCV_))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.VFLCV_100, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (!IsRealAndPositive(cVFCg) && vFMassFlowCalcMethod != ControlValveSizingSource.ISA)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoCg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			if (vFMassFlowCalcMethod == ControlValveSizingSource.ISA)
			{
				if (!IsRealAndPositive(cVFFp))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoFp, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				}
				if (!IsRealAndPositive(cVFXt))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoXt, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!IsRealAndPositive(cVFC))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoC1, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				}
				if (!IsRealAndPositive(cVFKm))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKm, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (myVM.VFMassFlowCalcMethod == ControlValveSizingSource.VendorSpecific && !Information.IsNothing(myVM.CVFValveTypeEnum))
			{
				int[] array = Enum.GetValues(myVM.CVFValveTypeEnum) as int[];
				if (!Information.IsNothing(array) && !array.Contains(valueOrDefault))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.BadValveTypeVal, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				}
			}
			double t = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.VFInletTemp_Rel, "Temperature");
			double p = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, inputVal, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num5 = ((myVM.VfInletPhaseRegime != FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid && myVM.VfInletPhaseRegime != FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase) ? 0.0 : ((!mPPPFluid.TVFlash(t, 0.0) || !(mPPPFluid.Pressure() > 0.0)) ? 0.0 : UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, mPPPFluid.Pressure(), "AbsolutePressure")));
			mPPPFluid.TPFlash(t, p);
			double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, mPPPFluid.LiquidMassDensity(), "Density");
			double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, mPPPFluid.VaporMassDensity(), "Density");
			double rho_T = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, mPPPFluid.OverallDensity(), "Density");
			double num8 = mPPPFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight();
			double num9 = mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
			double num10 = mPPPFluid.VaporFraction();
			double cpcv = ((!cVFDoRigorousCpCv) ? mPPPFluid.Cp_Cv_Ideal() : mPPPFluid.Cp_Cv_Rigorous());
			Dictionary<string, CalculationStatusEnum> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, CalculationStatusEnum>();
			double cpfac = default(double);
			CalculationStatusEnum num11 = ControlValveFailureScenario.CalculateMassFlow(ref massFlow, ref DELTA_PAllowable, ref isChokedFlow, ref isCavitating, ref isFlashing, ref isCritical, ref isNormal, ref vapEqnDominant, ref cpfac, ref pc, dictionary, mPPPFluid, vFMassFlowCalcMethod, cVFValveMaker, valueOrDefault, cVFValveTypeOpening, vFCV_, cVFCg, cVFC, cVFKm, cVFFp, cVFXt, cVFKc, num6, num8, num7, num9, rho_T, num10, num2, num3, num4, num5, cpcv, cVFModelLiqValveChoking, cVFDoRigorousCalc, cVFDoRigorousCpCv);
			if (num11 != CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
			{
				myVM.VFCalcMassFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, massFlow, "MassFlow");
				myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, Math.Max(myVM.VFCalcMassFlow - myVM.VFFlowToProc, 0.0));
				if (myVM.VFFlowToProc >= myVM.VFCalcMassFlow)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.VFAllFlowGoesToProcess, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				}
				myVM.CVFDELTA_PAllowable = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, DELTA_PAllowable, "DeltaPressure");
				myVM.CVFIsChoked = isChokedFlow;
				myVM.CVFIsCavitating = isCavitating;
				myVM.CVFIsFlashing = isFlashing;
				myVM.CVFIsCritical = isCritical;
				myVM.CVFVapEqnDominant = vapEqnDominant;
				myVM.CVFcpfac = cpfac;
				FluidPhaseRegime phaseFromVaporFraction = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(num10);
				if (phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor)
				{
					if (num5 > 0.0)
					{
						myVM.VFLVapPress_Rel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, num5, "AbsolutePressure");
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.VFLVapPress_Rel = double.NaN;
					}
					myVM.VFLCritPress_Rel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, pc, "AbsolutePressure");
					myVM.VFUpstreamLiquidDensity = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, num6, "Density");
					myVM.VFUpstreamLiquidMolWt = num8;
				}
				if (phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid)
				{
					myVM.VFUpstreamVaporDensity = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, num7, "Density");
					myVM.VFUpstreamVaporMolWt = num9;
				}
			}
			if (num11 == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CalculationStatusEnum> item in dictionary)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage((MessageLevel)item.Value, item.Key, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			}
		}

		protected void CalculateUpstreamAndDownstreamPhase()
		{
			double vFInletTemp_Rel = myVM.VFInletTemp_Rel;
			double num = Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar);
			double num2 = 273.15;
			double inputVal = myVM.VFInletPress_Rel + num;
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, inputVal, "AbsolutePressure");
			double inputVal2 = myVM.VFOutletPress + num;
			double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, inputVal2, "AbsolutePressure");
			if (!IsRealAndPositive(vFInletTemp_Rel + num2) || !IsRealAndPositive(num3) || Information.IsNothing(mPPPFluid))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (MyMath.ValueExceeds(num4, num3, 1E-08, 1E-08))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.ValveNegativePressureDelta, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			}
			mPPPFluid.TPFlash(vFInletTemp_Rel, num3);
			myVM.VfInletPhaseRegime = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(mPPPFluid.VaporFraction());
			if (IsRealAndPositive(num4))
			{
				mPPPFluid.IsenthalpicFlash(num4);
				myVM.VFOutletTemp = mPPPFluid.Temperature();
				myVM.VfOutletPhaseRegime = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(mPPPFluid.VaporFraction());
				if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated)
				{
					myVM.set_RelTempSource(notify: false, ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated);
				}
				myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, myVM.VFOutletTemp);
				myVM.set_VaporFraction(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporFraction());
			}
		}

		protected bool IsRealAndPositive(double d)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(d))
			{
				return d > 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CalculateFanFailureReliefLoad()
		{
			double fFDesRate = myVM.FFDesRate;
			double fFPercent = myVM.FFPercent;
			double value = fFDesRate * (1.0 - fFPercent / 100.0);
			myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, value);
		}

		public void CalculateFireReliefLoad()
		{
			if (0 == 0)
			{
				switch (myVM.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true).GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted:
				case FireCalcMethod.NFPA30:
					CalculateWettedFireReliefLoad();
					break;
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted:
					CalculateUnwettedFireReliefLoad();
					break;
				case FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous:
					CalculateSinglePhaseRigorousFire();
					break;
				case FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous:
					Calculate2PhaseRigorousFire();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum PrepareCalc(ref double dDesTemp, ref double dAtmPress, ref double dSetPress, ref double dLowSetPressLimit, ref double dOverPress, ref double dSuperImpConstBackPress, ref double dSuperImpVarBackPress, ref double dVarBackPress, ref double dNoiseDistance, [Optional][DefaultParameterValue(false)] ref bool IsUnwettedFireCase, [Optional][DefaultParameterValue(0.0)] ref double dOperPress, [Optional][DefaultParameterValue(0.0)] ref double dOperTemp, [Optional][DefaultParameterValue(0.0)] ref double dWallTemp)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(myVM.UOMDesTemp, "", TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				dDesTemp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMDesTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.DesTemp, "TankTemperature");
			}
			if (dDesTemp <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.DesTempLow, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			dAtmPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar), "AbsolutePressure");
			double num = myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				dSetPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, num, "GaugePressure") + dAtmPress;
				string left = myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true);
				if (Operators.CompareString(left, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					dLowSetPressLimit = 50.0;
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(left, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kgfcm2G, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					dLowSetPressLimit = 49.8;
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(left, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					dLowSetPressLimit = 50.78;
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(left, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					dLowSetPressLimit = 49.9;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true)))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoOverPr, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				if (myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true) < 0.0)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegOverPr, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				dOverPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
				dSuperImpConstBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				dSuperImpVarBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				dVarBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "AbsolutePressure");
				dOperPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.OperPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				dOperPress += UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar), "AbsolutePressure");
				dOperTemp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.OperTemp, "TankTemperature");
				if (IsUnwettedFireCase)
				{
					dWallTemp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.FIREUOMWallTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.get_FIREWallTemp(notify: true), "TankTemperature");
				}
				dNoiseDistance = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMNoiseDistance, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.NoiseDistance, "Length");
				if (dNoiseDistance == 0.0)
				{
					myVM.NoiseDistance = 30.0;
					dNoiseDistance = 30.0;
				}
				if (MyMath.ValueExceeds(dOperPress, dSetPress, 1E-10, 1E-10))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.PRD_SetLessThanOperPress, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			}
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			}
			return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum CalculateExposedAreas(ref string returnMsg)
		{
			double dExposedArea = 0.0;
			CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (Vessel_FireCalcModel fIREVessel in myVM.FIREVesselList)
			{
				if (!fIREVessel.get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (fIREVessel.FIREArea_IsCalculated)
				{
					calculationStatusEnum = CalculateIndividualExposedArea(ref dExposedArea, fIREVessel.FIREArea_IsCalculated, fIREVessel.FIREVesselType, fIREVessel.FIREAdditionalAreaPct, fIREVessel.get_FIREFlameHeight(notify: true), UnitStrings.Length_m, fIREVessel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), UnitStrings.Length_m, fIREVessel.get_FIREVesselElevation(notify: true), UnitStrings.Length_m, 0.0, UnitStrings.Length_m, fIREVessel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), UnitStrings.Length_m, fIREVessel.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: true), UnitStrings.Area_m2, fIREVessel.FIREAdditionalAreaFixed, checked((short)(fIREVessel.Index + 1)), fIREVessel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, fIREVessel.FIREVesselTopHeadType, fIREVessel.FIREIncludedHeads, ref returnMsg);
					if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
					{
						return calculationStatusEnum;
					}
					fIREVessel.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, dExposedArea);
				}
				num += fIREVessel.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: true);
			}
			myVM.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, num);
			return calculationStatusEnum;
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum CalculateIndividualExposedArea(ref double dExposedArea, bool FIREArea_IsCalculated, VesselTypeEnum FIREVesselType, double FIREPipingSurfaceRatio, double FIREFlameHeight, string FIREUOMFlameHeight, double FIREHeight, string FIREUOMHeight, double FIREVesselElevation, string FIREUOMVesselElevation, double FIRELiqLevel, string FIREUOMLiqLevel, double FIREDiameter, string FIREUOMDiameter, double FIREExposedArea, string FIREUOMCalcArea, double FIREAdditionalAreaFixed, short VesselNo, HeadType FIREHeadBottomType, HeadType FIREHeadTopType, HeadsInFireArea FIREIncludedHeads, ref string returnMsg)
		{
			CalculationStatusEnum result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			if (FIREArea_IsCalculated)
			{
				bool pipingContributes = ((!double.IsNaN(FIREPipingSurfaceRatio) && FIREPipingSurfaceRatio > 0.0) ? true : false);
				FIREFlameHeight = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(FIREUOMFlameHeight, UnitStrings.Length_m, FIREFlameHeight, "Length");
				FIREHeight = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(FIREUOMHeight, UnitStrings.Length_m, FIREHeight, "Length");
				FIREVesselElevation = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(FIREUOMVesselElevation, UnitStrings.Length_m, FIREVesselElevation, "Length");
				FIRELiqLevel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(FIREUOMLiqLevel, UnitStrings.Length_m, FIRELiqLevel, "Length");
				FIREDiameter = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(FIREUOMDiameter, UnitStrings.Length_m, FIREDiameter, "Length");
				HeadType fIRETopHeadType = ((FIREHeadTopType == HeadType.Same) ? FIREHeadBottomType : FIREHeadTopType);
				double FIRECalcArea = default(double);
				result = FireScenario.Calculate_Fire_Area(ref FIRECalcArea, FIREVesselType, isWetted: false, pipingContributes, VesselNo, FIREFlameHeight, FIREHeight, FIREVesselElevation, FIRELiqLevel, FIREDiameter, FIREPipingSurfaceRatio, FIREAdditionalAreaFixed, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)FIREHeadBottomType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)fIRETopHeadType, FIREIncludedHeads, FireAreaStandard.Api521, ref returnMsg);
				dExposedArea = FIRECalcArea;
			}
			else
			{
				dExposedArea = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Area_m2, FIREUOMCalcArea, FIREExposedArea, "Area");
			}
			return result;
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum ValidateReliefProperties(ref double dCompress, ref double dMolWeight, ref double dSpecHeatRatio, ref string returnMsg)
		{
			if (myVM.get_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0)
			{
				dCompress = myVM.get_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false);
				if (myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0)
				{
					dMolWeight = myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false);
					if (myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false) > 1.0)
					{
						dSpecHeatRatio = myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false);
						return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
					}
					returnMsg = FormResource.SpHRLow;
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				returnMsg = FormResource.NoMW;
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			returnMsg = FormResource.NoComp;
			return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
		}

		public void CalculateWettedFireReliefLoad()
		{
			double dAtmPress = Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar);
			double dSetPress = myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true);
			double dOverPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			bool fIREIncludeSensibleHeat = myVM.FIREIncludeSensibleHeat;
			double fIREInitialLatentHeatPercent = myVM.FIREInitialLatentHeatPercent;
			double fIREFinalLatentHeatPercent = myVM.FIREFinalLatentHeatPercent;
			string returnMsg = "";
			bool isMolBasis = true;
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, myVM.OperPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			num += UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar), "AbsolutePressure");
			double operTemp = myVM.OperTemp;
			mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
			if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Wetted)
			{
				myVM.set_RelTempSource(notify: false, ReliefTemperatureSource.Wetted);
			}
			mPPPFluid.TPFlash(operTemp, num);
			myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.Anywhere);
			if ((fIREInitialLatentHeatPercent >= fIREFinalLatentHeatPercent) & myVM.get_FIRELatHeat_Opt(notify: true))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREPctError, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double num2 = myVM.GetRefStreamRelFlow();
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) || num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 1.0;
			}
			double num3 = (1.0 - mPPPFluid.VaporFraction()) * (mPPPFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight() / mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight());
			double num4 = num2 * num3;
			double inputVal = dSetPress * (1.0 + dOverPress / 100.0);
			bool IsUnwettedFireCase = false;
			double dOperPress = 0.0;
			double dOperTemp = 0.0;
			double dWallTemp = 0.0;
			double dDesTemp = default(double);
			double dLowSetPressLimit = default(double);
			double dSuperImpConstBackPress = default(double);
			double dSuperImpVarBackPress = default(double);
			double dVarBackPress = default(double);
			double dNoiseDistance = default(double);
			CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = PrepareCalc(ref dDesTemp, ref dAtmPress, ref dSetPress, ref dLowSetPressLimit, ref dOverPress, ref dSuperImpConstBackPress, ref dSuperImpVarBackPress, ref dVarBackPress, ref dNoiseDistance, ref IsUnwettedFireCase, ref dOperPress, ref dOperTemp, ref dWallTemp);
			if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
			{
				EraseFireResults();
				return;
			}
			UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, dAtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, inputVal, "AbsolutePressure") + UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, dAtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			bool flag = mPPPFluid.PVFlashLiquid(num5, 0.0001);
			double num6 = mPPPFluid.Temperature();
			if (double.IsNaN(num6) || !flag)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FIREBPFail, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				EraseFireResults();
				return;
			}
			myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), num6, "TankTemperature"));
			num2 = num4;
			myVM.set_RelVaporMassFraction(notify: false, 1.0);
			myVM.set_RelCompress(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporZFactor());
			myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporViscosity());
			myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight());
			myVM.set_SpecHeatRatio(notify: false, byUser: false, GetSelectedCpCv(mPPPFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting));
			double num7 = 1.0;
			if (myVM.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true).GetValueOrDefault() == FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted && myVM.ApplyVolumeCorrectionForWettedAPI)
			{
				double num8 = mPPPFluid.VaporMassDensity();
				double num9 = mPPPFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
				if (!double.IsNaN(num8) && num8 != 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(num9) && num9 != 0.0)
				{
					double num10 = 1.0 / num8;
					double num11 = 1.0 / num9;
					num7 *= (num10 - num11) / num10;
				}
			}
			if (myVM.get_FIRELatHeat_Opt(notify: true))
			{
				double LatentHeat = default(double);
				calculationStatusEnum = WettedFire_CalculateLatentHeat(ref LatentHeat, fIREIncludeSensibleHeat, num6, num5, fIREInitialLatentHeatPercent, fIREFinalLatentHeatPercent, num2, isMolBasis, ref returnMsg);
				myVM.set_FIREFluidLatHeat(notify: false, LatentHeat);
			}
			myVM.set_h_vlo(notify: true, byUser: false, myVM.get_FIREFluidLatHeat(notify: true));
			double FIREHeatInput = 0.0;
			double FIRERelFlow = 0.0;
			double FIRECalcArea = 0.0;
			myVM.set_FIRECalcHeatInput(notify: false, 0.0);
			myVM.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, 0.0);
			myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: false, 0.0);
			double num12 = 0.0;
			foreach (Vessel_FireCalcModel fIREVessel in myVM.FIREVesselList)
			{
				if (!fIREVessel.get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false))
				{
					break;
				}
				switch (WettedFire_CalculateOneLoad(ref FIREHeatInput, ref FIRERelFlow, ref FIRECalcArea, fIREVessel, checked((short)(fIREVessel.Index + 1)), num6, num7, ref returnMsg))
				{
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					break;
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					EraseFireResults();
					return;
				}
				num12 += FIRERelFlow;
			}
			double num13;
			if (myVM.FireCalculateDisengagement)
			{
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
				mPPPFluid.TPFlashOverall(operTemp, num);
				num13 = ConvertToHysysUnits("GaugePressure", myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), myVM.AtmPress, myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true));
				mPPPFluid.PVFlashLiquid(num13, 0.0001);
				if (mPPPFluid.LiquidViscosity() >= 100.0)
				{
					int? num14 = (int?)myVM.FireDisengagementRegime;
					if ((num14.HasValue ? new bool?(num14 != 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREDisengagementNotBubbly, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					}
				}
				myVM.set_FireDisengagementVaporDensity(notify: false, mPPPFluid.VaporMassDensity());
				myVM.set_FireDisengagementLiquidDensity(notify: false, mPPPFluid.LiquidMassDensity());
				myVM.set_FireDisengagementLiquidSurfaceTension(notify: false, mPPPFluid.LiquidSurfaceTension());
				if (!myVM.get_FIRELatHeat_Opt(notify: true))
				{
					goto IL_073e;
				}
				double LatentHeat2 = double.NaN;
				if (WettedFire_CalculateLatentHeat(ref LatentHeat2, fIREIncludeSensibleHeat, double.NaN, num13, 0.0, 0.02, 1.0, isMolBasis: false, ref returnMsg) == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FIREDisengagementHeatOfVaporization, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.set_FireDisengagementHeatOfVaporizationAtSet(notify: false, LatentHeat2);
					if (!(myVM.get_FireDisengagementHeatOfVaporizationAtSet(notify: true) <= 0.0))
					{
						goto IL_073e;
					}
					myVM.set_FireDisengagementHeatOfVaporizationAtSet(notify: false, double.NaN);
					EraseFireDisengagementResults();
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FIREDisengagementHeatOfVaporization, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				}
				goto IL_1165;
			}
			myVM.set_FireSelectedRelief(notify: false, byUser: false, (FluidPhaseRegime?)FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor);
			goto IL_1158;
			IL_073e:
			double FIREHeatInput2 = double.NaN;
			double FIRERelFlow2 = double.NaN;
			double FIRECalcArea2 = double.NaN;
			string returnMsg2 = null;
			Vessel_FireCalcModel vessel_FireCalcModel = myVM.FIREVesselList[0];
			double fIRELiqLevel = ((vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal || vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Sphere) ? vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true) : vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true));
			if (!vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREArea_IsCalculated)
			{
				FIRECalcArea2 = myVM.get_FireDisengagementFullVesselArea(notify: true);
			}
			HeadType headType = ((vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselTopHeadType == HeadType.Same) ? vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType : vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselTopHeadType);
			calculationStatusEnum = FireScenario.VesselCalculations(ref FIREHeatInput2, ref FIRERelFlow2, ref FIRECalcArea2, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselType, isWetted: true, myVM.FIREDrainage, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREArea_IsCalculated, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREAdditionalAreaPct > 0.0, 1, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREFlameHeight(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREVesselElevation(notify: true), fIRELiqLevel, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREAdditionalAreaPct, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREAdditionalAreaFixed, myVM.get_FireDisengagementHeatOfVaporizationAtSet(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false), (FIREHeadTypeEnum)vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)headType, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREIncludedHeads, myVM.get_FIREWettedAreaExponent(notify: true), myVM.FireAreaStandardForCalcMethod, ref returnMsg2);
			if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg2, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			}
			else
			{
				if (vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREArea_IsCalculated)
				{
					myVM.set_FireDisengagementFullVesselArea(notify: false, FIRECalcArea2);
				}
				myVM.set_FireDisengagementFullVesselHeatInput(notify: false, FIREHeatInput2);
				myVM.set_FireDisengagementVaporGenerationRate(notify: false, FIRERelFlow2);
				double finalTwoPhaseMassFraction = double.NaN;
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel;
				dWallTemp = (pSVScenarioModel = myVM).FireSuperficialVaporVelocity;
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel2;
				dOperTemp = (pSVScenarioModel2 = myVM).FireCharacteristicBubbleRiseVelocity;
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel3;
				dOperPress = (pSVScenarioModel3 = myVM).FireDisengagementLiquidLevelForSwell;
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel4;
				double onsetLiquidLevelForEntrainment = (pSVScenarioModel4 = myVM).FireDisengagementLiquidLevelForEntrainment;
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel5;
				double onsetLiquidLevel = (pSVScenarioModel5 = myVM).FireDisengagementLiquidLevel;
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel6;
				IsUnwettedFireCase = (pSVScenarioModel6 = myVM).FireIsTwoPhaseRelief;
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel7;
				double initialTwoPhaseMassFraction = (pSVScenarioModel7 = myVM).FireInitialTwoPhaseVaporMassFraction;
				CalculationStatusEnum num15 = FireScenario.CalculateDisengagement(ref dWallTemp, ref dOperTemp, ref dOperPress, ref onsetLiquidLevelForEntrainment, ref onsetLiquidLevel, ref IsUnwettedFireCase, ref initialTwoPhaseMassFraction, ref finalTwoPhaseMassFraction, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)headType, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREIncludedHeads, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true), myVM.get_FireDisengagementVaporGenerationRate(notify: true), myVM.get_FireDisengagementVaporDensity(notify: true), myVM.get_FireDisengagementLiquidDensity(notify: true), myVM.get_FireDisengagementLiquidSurfaceTension(notify: true), myVM.FireDisengagementRegime.GetValueOrDefault(), myVM.FireDisengagementVesselFlowModel.GetValueOrDefault(), myVM.FireSelectedC0, ref returnMsg);
				pSVScenarioModel7.FireInitialTwoPhaseVaporMassFraction = initialTwoPhaseMassFraction;
				pSVScenarioModel6.FireIsTwoPhaseRelief = IsUnwettedFireCase;
				pSVScenarioModel5.FireDisengagementLiquidLevel = onsetLiquidLevel;
				pSVScenarioModel4.FireDisengagementLiquidLevelForEntrainment = onsetLiquidLevelForEntrainment;
				pSVScenarioModel3.FireDisengagementLiquidLevelForSwell = dOperPress;
				pSVScenarioModel2.FireCharacteristicBubbleRiseVelocity = dOperTemp;
				pSVScenarioModel.FireSuperficialVaporVelocity = dWallTemp;
				calculationStatusEnum = num15;
				if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)

				{

					}
					if (!myVM.FireIsTwoPhaseRelief)
					{
						myVM.set_FireSelectedRelief(notify: false, byUser: false, (FluidPhaseRegime?)FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor);

					}
					mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
					mPPPFluid.TPFlashOverall(operTemp, num);
					mPPPFluid.PVFlashLiquid(num5, 0.0001);
					mPPPFluid.PVFlashVapor(num5, 1.0);
					double calcRequiredArea_cm = double.NaN;
					double num16 = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: false);
					double num17 = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: false);
					if (myVM.KdSource.GetValueOrDefault() == ProcessDataSource.Reference)
					{
						num16 = myVM.GetReferenceKd(OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor);
						num17 = myVM.GetReferenceKd(OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1);
					}
					else if (myVM.get_FireSelectedRelief(notify: true, byUser: true).GetValueOrDefault() == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor)
					{
						num17 = myVM.GetReferenceKd(OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1);
						string message = string.Format(FormResource.FireDisengagementSpecifiedKdAssumedToBeVapor, num16, num17);
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					}
					else
					{
						num16 = myVM.GetReferenceKd(OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor);
						string message2 = string.Format(FormResource.FireDisengagementSpecifiedKdAssumedToBeMixed, num17, num16);
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message2, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);

					calculationStatusEnum = CalculateValveResultsEx(ref calcRequiredArea_cm, num12, 1.0, num16);

					mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
					mPPPFluid.TPFlashOverall(operTemp, num);

					double relievingTemp_C = double.NaN;
					double fullFlowOverpressurePctForFire = myVM.GetFullFlowOverpressurePctForFire();

					}
					else

						double insulationConductivity_USC = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMInsThermCond, UnitStrings.TCond_EN, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREInsThermCond, "ThermalCond");

						double totalBackpressure_psia = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_TotBackPress(notify: true) + myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");

							{

							}
							myVM.FireTwoPhaseReliefRate = requiredRelief_kgh;
							myVM.FireTwoPhaseRequiredArea = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, requiredArea_in, "SmallArea");
							if (myVM.FireTwoPhaseReliefRate == 0.0)
							{

							}
							else
							{
								if (myVM.get_FireSelectedReliefSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
								{
									if (myVM.FireTwoPhaseRequiredArea > myVM.FireVaporRequiredArea)
									{
										if (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct)

										}
										else
										{
											myVM.set_FireSelectedRelief(notify: false, byUser: false, (FluidPhaseRegime?)FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase);
										}
									}
									else
									{
										myVM.set_FireSelectedRelief(notify: false, byUser: false, (FluidPhaseRegime?)FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor);
									}
								}
								else if (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct)
								{
									string message4 = string.Format(FormResource.FireDisengagementChangedToVapor, TranslateUiStrings.OrificeSizingMethod.StringValue(OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct));
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message4, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
									myVM.set_FireSelectedRelief(notify: false, byUser: false, (FluidPhaseRegime?)FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor);
								}
								int? num14 = (int?)myVM.get_FireSelectedRelief(notify: true, byUser: true);
								if ((num14.HasValue ? new bool?(num14.GetValueOrDefault() != 0) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
