									myVM.set_VaporFraction(notify: false, byUser: false, requiredReliefVaporFraction);
									myVM.OverrideReliefPressure = num18;
								}
							}
							goto IL_1158;
						}
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						myVM.set_FireSelectedRelief(notify: false, byUser: false, (FluidPhaseRegime?)FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor);
					}
				}
			}
			goto IL_1165;
			IL_1158:
			myVM.UpdateReliefPhase(notify: false);
			goto IL_1165;
			IL_1165:
			if (!myVM.FireCalculateDisengagement || myVM.get_FireSelectedRelief(notify: true, byUser: true).GetValueOrDefault() == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor)
			{
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
				mPPPFluid.TPFlashOverall(operTemp, num);
				mPPPFluid.PVFlashLiquid(num5, 0.0001);
				mPPPFluid.StoreFireFractions();
				myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetStoredComposition(mPPPFluid);
				mPPPFluid.PVFlashFire(num5, 1.0);
				myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight());
				myVM.set_VaporFraction(notify: false, byUser: false, 1.0);
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetStoredComposition(mPPPFluid);
				FlashToReliefConditions(ExpectedPhase.DontCare, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight());
				num12 = myVM.FireTwoPhaseReliefRate;
			}
			myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, num12);
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum WettedFire_CalculateOneLoad(ref double FIREHeatInput, ref double FIRERelFlow, ref double FIRECalcArea, Vessel_FireCalcModel vessel, short VesselNumber, double RelievingTemp, double VolumeCorrectionFactor, ref string returnMsg)
		{
			bool pipingContributes = false;
			if (vessel.FIREAdditionalAreaPct > 0.0)
			{
				pipingContributes = true;
			}
			if (!vessel.FIREArea_IsCalculated)
			{
				FIRECalcArea = vessel.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: true);
			}
			CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum;
			if (vessel.FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated)
			{
				calculationStatusEnum = CalculateAndSetCoeff_F(vessel, VesselNumber, RelievingTemp, ref returnMsg);
				if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
				{
					return calculationStatusEnum;
				}
			}
			HeadType fIREHeadTopType = ((vessel.FIREVesselTopHeadType == HeadType.Same) ? vessel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType : vessel.FIREVesselTopHeadType);
			calculationStatusEnum = FireScenario.VesselCalculations(ref FIREHeatInput, ref FIRERelFlow, ref FIRECalcArea, vessel.FIREVesselType, isWetted: true, myVM.FIREDrainage, vessel.FIREArea_IsCalculated, pipingContributes, VesselNumber, vessel.get_FIREFlameHeight(notify: true), vessel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), vessel.get_FIREVesselElevation(notify: true), vessel.get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true), vessel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), vessel.FIREAdditionalAreaPct, vessel.FIREAdditionalAreaFixed, myVM.get_FIREFluidLatHeat(notify: true), vessel.get_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false), (FIREHeadTypeEnum)vessel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)fIREHeadTopType, vessel.FIREIncludedHeads, myVM.get_FIREWettedAreaExponent(notify: true), myVM.FireAreaStandardForCalcMethod, ref returnMsg);
			if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
			{
				return calculationStatusEnum;
			}
			FIRERelFlow *= VolumeCorrectionFactor;
			vessel.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, FIRECalcArea);
			vessel.set_FIRECalcRelFlow(notify: false, FIRERelFlow);
			vessel.set_FIRECalcHeatInput(notify: false, FIREHeatInput);
			if (FIRECalcArea < 0.0)
			{
				returnMsg = string.Format(FormResource.FIREExposedAreaNegative, VesselNumber);
				vessel.set_FIRECalcRelFlow(notify: false, double.NaN);
				vessel.set_FIRECalcHeatInput(notify: false, double.NaN);
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: false) += FIRECalcArea;
				myVM.get_FIRECalcHeatInput(notify: false) += FIREHeatInput;
			}
			return calculationStatusEnum;
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum CalculateAndSetCoeff_F(Vessel_FireCalcModel vessel1, int vesselNumber, double relTemp, ref string returnMsg)
		{
			double Coeff_F = 0.0;
			CalculationStatusEnum result;
			if ((vessel1.FIREInsThermCond == 0.0) | (vessel1.FIREInsThk == 0.0))
			{
				vessel1.set_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false, double.NaN);
				result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				returnMsg = FormResource.FIREThkK;
				return result;
			}
			double fIREInsThermCond = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(vessel1.FIREUOMInsThermCond, UnitStrings.TCond_EN, vessel1.FIREInsThermCond, "ThermalCond") * 12.0;
			double fIREInsThk = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(vessel1.FIREUOMInsThk, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, vessel1.FIREInsThk, "SmallLength");
			double fIREFluidTemp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_F, relTemp, "TankTemperature");
			result = FireScenario.Calculate_F(ref Coeff_F, fIREInsThermCond, fIREFluidTemp, fIREInsThk, vesselNumber, ref returnMsg);
			if (result == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
			{
				vessel1.set_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false, double.NaN);
				return result;
			}
			vessel1.set_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false, Coeff_F);
			return result;
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum WettedFire_CalculateLatentHeat(ref double LatentHeat, bool IncludeSensibleHeat, double RelievingTemp, double RelPress, double InitialPct, double FinalPct, double dOverallFlow, bool isMolBasis, ref string returnMsg)
		{
			CalculationStatusEnum result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			double num = 0.0;
			if (InitialPct > 0.0 && (!mPPPFluid.PVFlashLiquid(RelPress, InitialPct / 100.0) || double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.Temperature())))
			{
				returnMsg = FormResource.FIREBPFail;
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			double num2 = mPPPFluid.Temperature();
			double num3 = mPPPFluid.LiquidMassHeatCapacity();
			double num4 = mPPPFluid.VaporMassFraction() * dOverallFlow;
			double num5 = dOverallFlow - num4;
			double num6 = mPPPFluid.LiquidMassEnthalpy() * num5;
			if (!mPPPFluid.PVFlashOverall(RelPress, FinalPct / 100.0) || double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.Temperature()))
			{
				returnMsg = FormResource.FIRELatentHeatFlashFailed;
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			double num7 = dOverallFlow * mPPPFluid.OverallMassEnthalpy() - num4 * mPPPFluid.VaporMassEnthalpy();
			mPPPFluid.OverallMassHeatCapacity();
			double num8 = mPPPFluid.Temperature();
			double num9 = mPPPFluid.VaporMassFraction() * dOverallFlow - num4;
			double num10 = num7 - num6;
			num = ((!IncludeSensibleHeat) ? (num5 * num3 * (num8 - num2)) : 0.0);
			LatentHeat = (num10 - num) / num9;
			return result;
		}

		public bool TerminationCondition(SemiDynFlashType flashBasis, int iter, int numberOfFlashes, double totalVaporized)
		{
			if (flashBasis == SemiDynFlashType.PctVap)
			{
				return totalVaporized < 99.999 && iter <= numberOfFlashes;
			}
			return iter <= numberOfFlashes;
		}

		public void Calculate2PhaseRigorousFire()
		{
			Vessel_FireCalcModel vessel_FireCalcModel = myVM.FIREVesselList[0];
			myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true);
			_ = (double)myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true);

			double dSetPress = myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true);
			double dOverPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			_ = myVM.FIREInitialLatentHeatPercent;
			_ = myVM.FIREFinalLatentHeatPercent;
			string returnMsg = "";
			int num = 0;
			_ = (double)myVM.get_FIRENumberOfFlashes(notify: true);
			double value = vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true);
			double InitMass = 0.0;
			double InitBulkDensity = 0.0;

			double VesselVF = 0.0;
			double num2 = (((vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Vertical_BotHead) | (vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Vertical_NoBotHead)) ? vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true) : vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true));

			}
			else
			{
				myVM.FIREComponentNames = null;
			}
			myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.Anywhere);
			if (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid || myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid || myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1 || myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2 || myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3)

			}
			double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, myVM.OperPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			num6 += UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar), "AbsolutePressure");
			mPPPFluid.TPFlash(myVM.OperTemp, num6);
			if (PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(mPPPFluid.VaporFraction()) == FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid && MyMath.ValueExceeds(num2, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true), 1E-12, 1E-12))
			{
				if (fIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal || fIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Sphere)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIRELiqLevelEqualDiameter, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIRELiqLevelEqualHeight, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				}
				return;
			}
			double inputVal = dSetPress * (1.0 + dOverPress / 100.0);
			bool IsUnwettedFireCase = true;
			double dOperPress = 0.0;
			double dOperTemp = 0.0;
			double dDesTemp = default(double);
			double dLowSetPressLimit = default(double);
			double dSuperImpConstBackPress = default(double);
			double dSuperImpVarBackPress = default(double);
			double dVarBackPress = default(double);

			double dWallTemp = default(double);

			switch (calculationStatusEnum)
			{
			case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				break;
			case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				EraseFireResults();
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
				return;
			}
			calculationStatusEnum = CalculateInitialVesselProperties(ref InitMass, ref InitBulkDensity, ref VesselVF, vessel_FireCalcModel, ref returnMsg);
			if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				EraseFireResults();
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
				return;
			}
			mPPPFluid.SetLiquidVaporRatio(VesselVF, myVM.OperTemp, num6);
			double relTemp = 0.0;
			calculationStatusEnum = ConstantDensityFlash(ref relTemp, InitBulkDensity, num7, myVM.OperTemp + 500.0, ref returnMsg);
			if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				EraseFireResults();
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
			}
			double num8 = mPPPFluid.VaporFraction();
			double num9 = InitMass * (1.0 - num8) * (mPPPFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight() / mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight());
			if (num9 <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoLiquidInventory, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				EraseFireResults();
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
				return;
			}
			mPPPFluid.TPFlashLiquid(relTemp, num7);
			InitMass = num9;
			double num10 = InitMass / mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight();
			int num11 = -1;
			double num12 = 0.0;
			double num13 = mPPPFluid.OverallMassEnthalpy() * InitMass;
			double HeatInput = 0.0;
			double num14 = 0.0;
			bool flag = false;
			double num15 = 0.0;
			double num16 = 0.0;
			double value2 = vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false);
			int i = 1;
			double totalVaporized = 0.0;
			mPPPFluid.OverallMassEnthalpy();
			mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight();
			double num17 = InitMass / mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight();
			double num18 = 0.0;
			checked
			{
				double num19 = default(double);
				if (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash == SemiDynFlashType.FinalTemp)
				{
					switch (TemperatureValidation(ref MaxIterTemp, relTemp, num7, ref returnMsg))
					{
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						EraseFireResults();
						vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
						return;
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						break;
					}
					num = myVM.get_FIRENumberOfFlashes(notify: true);
					num15 = (MaxIterTemp - relTemp) / (double)num;
					if (num15 < 0.0)
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, string.Format(FormResource.FIREMaxIterTempRelTemp, relTemp), MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						EraseFireResults();
						vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
						return;
					}
					num16 = relTemp + num15;
					myVM.set_FIREDeltaT(notify: false, num15);
				}
				else if (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash == SemiDynFlashType.PctVap)
				{
					num15 = myVM.FIREUserPctVap / 100.0;
					num19 = InitMass * num15 / mPPPFluid.OverallMolecularWeight();
					num16 = num15;
					num = (int)Math.Round(100.0 / myVM.FIREUserPctVap);
				}
				else
				{
					num15 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Energy_Btuh, UnitStrings.Energy_kJh, myVM.FIREUserHeatFlow, "Energy");
					num = myVM.get_FIRENumberOfFlashes(notify: true);
				}
				switch (CalculateWettedArea(ref dCalcArea, InitMass, ref returnMsg))
				{
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					break;
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
					return;
				}
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, dCalcArea);
				myVM.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, dCalcArea);
				for (; TerminationCondition(myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash, i, num, totalVaporized); i++)
				{
					IterationResultRLCFireModel iterationResultRLCFireModel = myVM.CreateIterationResult(i, multiphase: true);
					if (flag)
					{
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.WettedSurfaceArea = 0.0;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.HeatInput = 0.0;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.TotalHeatFlow = 0.0;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.IterTime = 0.0;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow = 0.0;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.Temperature = mPPPFluid.Temperature();
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporVolFlow = 0.0;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.PctVap = num3 / num17 * 100.0;
					}
					else
					{
						mPPPFluid.OverallMassHeatCapacity();
						bool flag2;
						if (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash == SemiDynFlashType.FinalTemp)
						{
							flag2 = mPPPFluid.TPFlashLiquid(num16, num7);
						}
						else if (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash == SemiDynFlashType.PctVap)
						{
							flag2 = ((!(num19 < num10)) ? mPPPFluid.PVFlashLiquid(num7, 0.99999) : mPPPFluid.PVFlashLiquid(num7, num19 / num10));
						}
						else
						{
							num16 = (num13 + num15) / InitMass * mPPPFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight();
							flag2 = mPPPFluid.PHFlashLiquid(num7, num16);
						}
						if (!flag2 || double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.Temperature()))
						{
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FIREMaxIterFlashFailed, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
							vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
							return;
						}
						myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, mPPPFluid.Temperature());
						if (vessel_FireCalcModel.FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated)
						{
							switch (CalculateAndSetCoeff_F(vessel_FireCalcModel, 1, mPPPFluid.Temperature(), ref returnMsg))
							{
							case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
								EraseFireResults();
								vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
								return;
							case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
								break;
							}
							num14 = vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false);
						}
						else
						{
							num14 = vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false);
						}
						if (mPPPFluid.VaporFraction() == 0.0)
						{
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow = 0.0;
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.PctVap = num3 / num17 * 100.0;
							if (i > 1)
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FireSemidynamicStillLiquid, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							num5 = num10 * mPPPFluid.VaporFraction();
							num3 += num5;
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow = num5 * mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.PctVap = num3 / num17 * 100.0;
							totalVaporized = iterationResultRLCFireModel.PctVap;
						}
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.IsMultiphaseCalc = true;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.Temperature = mPPPFluid.Temperature();
						switch (FireScenario.FireHeatInput(ref HeatInput, FireAreaStandard.Api521, myVM.FIREDrainage, CalcF: false, ref num14, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREInsThermCond, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREInsThk, relTemp, dCalcArea, 1, myVM.get_FIREWettedAreaExponent(notify: true), ref returnMsg))
						{
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
							break;
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
							vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);

						}
						HeatInput = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.FireHeatInputEN, UnitStrings.FireHeatInputSI, HeatInput, "FireHeatFlow");
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.WettedSurfaceArea = dCalcArea;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.HeatInput = HeatInput;
						double num20 = mPPPFluid.OverallMassEnthalpy();
						double num21 = Math.Abs(num13 - num20 * InitMass);
						num4 = num21 * 60.0 / iterationResultRLCFireModel.HeatInput;
						if (i == 1)
						{
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.IterTime = num4;
						}
						else
						{
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.IterTime = myVM.FIREIterationList[i - 2].IterTime + num4;
						}
						InitMass -= iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow;
						iterationResultRLCFireModel.TotalHeatFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.FireEnergy_kJ, UnitStrings.FireEnergy_kcal, num21, "FireEnergy");
						if (num4 != 0.0)
						{
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow /= num4 / 60.0;
						}
						double num22 = mPPPFluid.VaporMassDensity();
						double num23 = mPPPFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
						if (!double.IsNaN(num22) && num22 != 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(num23) && num23 != 0.0)
						{
							double num24 = 1.0 / num22;
							double num25 = 1.0 / num23;
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow *= (num24 - num25) / num24;
						}
						if (double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.VaporMassDensity()) | (mPPPFluid.VaporMassDensity() == 0.0))
						{
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporVolFlow = 0.0;
						}
						else
						{
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporVolFlow = iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow / mPPPFluid.VaporMassDensity();
						}
						double CalcOrifice = 0.0;
						UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_R, iterationResultRLCFireModel.Temperature, "TankTemperature");
						double compress = mPPPFluid.VaporZFactor();
						double selectedCpCv = GetSelectedCpCv(mPPPFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting);
						double molWeight = mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
						if (iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow == 0.0)
						{
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area = 0.0;
						}
						else
						{
							calculationStatusEnum = CalculateValveResults(ref CalcOrifice, iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow, dSetPress, dOverPress, dAtmPress, dLowSetPressLimit, selectedCpCv, compress, molWeight, dSuperImpConstBackPress, dSuperImpVarBackPress, dVarBackPress, dNoiseDistance);
							if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
							{
								EraseFireResults();
								return;
							}
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area = CalcOrifice;
						}
						if (iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area > num12)
						{
							num12 = iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area;
							num11 = i;
							myVM.set_RelVaporMassFraction(notify: false, 1.0);
							myVM.set_RelCompress(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporZFactor());
							myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporViscosity());
							myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight());
							myVM.set_SpecHeatRatio(notify: false, byUser: false, GetSelectedCpCv(mPPPFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting));
							myVM.set_h_vlo(notify: true, byUser: false, HeatInput / iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow);
							mPPPFluid.StoreFireFractions();
							value2 = num14;
							num18 = iterationResultRLCFireModel.PctVap;
							if (myVM.FIREStoreStepCompositions)
							{
								iterationResultRLCFireModel.Compositions = GetStoredComposition(mPPPFluid);
							}
						}
						else if (iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area > 0.0 && myVM.FIREStoreStepCompositions)
						{
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.Compositions = mPPPFluid.VaporComposition;
						}
						if (iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area > 0.0)
						{
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporZ = mPPPFluid.VaporZFactor();
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMolWt = mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
							iterationResultRLCFireModel.Vapork = GetSelectedCpCv(mPPPFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting);
						}
						num9 = InitMass;
						num10 = InitMass * (1.0 / mPPPFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight());
						if (unchecked((InitMass <= 0.0 || mPPPFluid.VaporFraction() == 1.0) && i != num) & (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash != SemiDynFlashType.PctVap))
						{
							dCalcArea = 0.0;
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREMaxIterTempLiqVaporize, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
							flag = true;
						}
						else if ((iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow > 0.0) & myVM.FIREVaryWettedSA)
						{
							switch (CalculateWettedArea(ref dCalcArea, InitMass, ref returnMsg))
							{
							case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
								vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
								return;
							case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
								calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
								returnMsg = null;
								break;
							}
						}
						num13 = mPPPFluid.LiquidMassEnthalpy() * InitMass;
					}
					num16 += num15;
				}
				if (num11 == -1)
				{
					num11 = 1;
				}
				if (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash == SemiDynFlashType.PctVap)
				{
					myVM.set_FIRENumberOfFlashes(notify: false, i - 1);
				}
				myVM.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: true));
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, value);
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false, value2);
				if (myVM.FIREIterationList[num11 - 1].VaporMassFlow == 0.0)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIRE_No_relieving_flow_calculated, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, myVM.FIREIterationList[num11 - 1].Temperature);
				}
				else
				{
					if (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash == SemiDynFlashType.FinalTemp && num18 > 99.99999)
					{
						myVM.set_VaporFraction(notify: false, byUser: false, double.NaN);
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.set_VaporFraction(notify: false, byUser: false, 1.0);
					}
					myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, myVM.FIREIterationList[num11 - 1].Temperature);
				}
				myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetStoredComposition(mPPPFluid);
				myVM.FIREIterationList[num11 - 1].IsMaxIteration = true;
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRECalcRelFlow(notify: false, myVM.FIREIterationList[num11 - 1].VaporMassFlow);
				myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, myVM.FIREIterationList[num11 - 1].VaporMassFlow);
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
			}
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum TemperatureValidation(ref double MaxIterTemp, double RelTemp_C, double RelPress_kPa, ref string returnMsg)
		{
			CalculationStatusEnum result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			if (PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(mPPPFluid.VaporFraction()) == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor)
			{
				returnMsg = FormResource.NoLiquidInventory;
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning;
			}
			mPPPFluid.PVFlashOverall(RelPress_kPa, 0.0);
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.FIREUOMWallTemp, mPPPFluid.Temperature(), "Temperature");
			if (num > myVM.get_FIREMaxIterTemp(notify: true))
			{
				returnMsg = string.Format(FormResource.FIREBubbleMaxIterTemp, num);
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			mPPPFluid.TPFlashOverall(RelTemp_C, RelPress_kPa);
			return result;
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum CalculateWettedArea(ref double dCalcArea, double LiquidMass, ref string returnMsg)
		{
			Vessel_FireCalcModel vessel_FireCalcModel = myVM.FIREVesselList.ElementAt(0);
			CalculationStatusEnum result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			double num = mPPPFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
			if (LiquidMass > 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				VesselTypeEnum fIREVesselType = vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselType;
				bool pipingContributes = false;
				double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMFlameHeight, UnitStrings.Length_m, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREFlameHeight(notify: true), "Length");
				double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMHeight, UnitStrings.Length_m, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), "Length");
				double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMDiameter, UnitStrings.Length_m, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), "Length");
				double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMVesselElevation, UnitStrings.Length_m, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREVesselElevation(notify: true), "Length");
				double fIREAdditionalAreaPct = vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREAdditionalAreaPct;
				double fIREAdditionalAreaFixed = vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREAdditionalAreaFixed;
				double num6 = num3;
				if (fIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal || fIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Sphere)
				{
					num6 = num4;
				}
				if (fIREAdditionalAreaPct > 0.0)
				{
					pipingContributes = true;
				}
				double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMLiqLevel, UnitStrings.Length_m, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true), "Length");
				double num8 = LiquidMass / num;
				double num9 = PartialVolume(vessel_FireCalcModel, num7);
				HeadType headType = ((vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselTopHeadType == HeadType.Same) ? vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType : vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselTopHeadType);
				if (!MyMath.ValueExceeds(num6, num7, 1E-12, 1E-12) && num8 > num9)
				{
					result = FireScenario.Calculate_Fire_Area(ref dCalcArea, fIREVesselType, isWetted: true, pipingContributes, 1, num2, num3, num5, num7, num4, fIREAdditionalAreaPct, fIREAdditionalAreaFixed, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)headType, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREIncludedHeads, FireAreaStandard.Api521, ref returnMsg);
				}
				else
				{
					double calcLevel = double.NaN;
					(CalculationStatusEnum, string) tuple = FireScenario.CalculateAreaFromVolume(ref dCalcArea, ref calcLevel, num8, fIREVesselType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)headType, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREIncludedHeads, 1, num2, num3, num4, num5, num7, pipingContributes, fIREAdditionalAreaPct, fIREAdditionalAreaFixed, myVM.FireAreaStandardForCalcMethod);
					returnMsg = tuple.Item2;
					(result, _) = tuple;
					if (tuple.Item1 != CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
					{
						vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRELiqLevel(notify: false, calcLevel);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dCalcArea = 0.0;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum CalculateInitialVesselProperties(ref double InitMass, ref double InitBulkDensity, ref double VesselVF, Vessel_FireCalcModel Vessel, ref string returnMsg)
		{
			CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			double num = mPPPFluid.VaporFraction();
			if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValuesAreClose(num, 1.0))
			{
				calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				returnMsg = FormResource.BadCalcMethod;
				return calculationStatusEnum;
			}
			double p = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, myVM.OperPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			_ = myVM.OperTemp;
			double num2 = mPPPFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
			double num3 = mPPPFluid.VaporMassDensity();
			mPPPFluid.OverallDensity();
			double liquidLevel = Vessel.get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true);
			calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(num, 0.0) && double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				mPPPFluid.PVFlash(p, 0.001);
				mPPPFluid.Temperature();
				num3 = mPPPFluid.VaporMassDensity();
			}
			HeadType headTopType = ((Vessel.FIREVesselTopHeadType == HeadType.Same) ? Vessel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType : Vessel.FIREVesselTopHeadType);
			double num4 = FireScenario.TotalVolume(Vessel.FIREVesselType, Vessel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), Vessel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), (FIREHeadTypeEnum)Vessel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)headTopType);
			double num5 = PartialVolume(Vessel, liquidLevel);
			double num6 = num5 * num2;
			double num7 = num6 / mPPPFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight();
			if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(num, 0.0))
			{
				double num8 = Math.Abs(FireScenario.TotalVolume(Vessel.FIREVesselType, Vessel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), Vessel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), (FIREHeadTypeEnum)Vessel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)headTopType) - num5) * num3;
				double num9 = num8 / mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
				VesselVF = num9 / (num9 + num7);
				if (double.IsNaN(VesselVF) | (VesselVF < 0.0) | (VesselVF > 1.0))
				{
					calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					returnMsg = FormResource.NoProps;
					return calculationStatusEnum;
				}
				InitMass = num6 + num8;
			}
			else
			{
				InitMass = num6;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(InitMass) | (InitMass < 0.0))
			{
				calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				returnMsg = FormResource.NoProps;
				return calculationStatusEnum;
			}
			InitBulkDensity = InitMass / num4;
			if (double.IsNaN(InitBulkDensity) | (InitBulkDensity < 0.0))
			{
				calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				returnMsg = FormResource.NoProps;
				return calculationStatusEnum;
			}
			return calculationStatusEnum;
		}

		private CalculationStatusEnum ConstantDensityFlash(ref double relTemp, double initDensity, double relPress, double maxTemp, ref string returnMsg)
		{
			double errorTol = 0.01;
			double num = mPPPFluid.Temperature();
			double xmin = Math.Max(num - 500.0, -273.0);
			double initialStepSize = 10.0;
			double value = 30.0;
			CalculationStatusEnum result;
			try
			{
				relTemp = RootFinder.RootFinder([SpecialName] (double T) =>
				{
					mPPPFluid.TPFlashOverall(T, relPress);
					return mPPPFluid.OverallDensity() - initDensity;
				}, num, xmin, maxTemp, initialStepSize, value, errorTol);
			}
			catch (RootFinder.RootFailedException ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				RootFinder.RootFailedException ex2 = ex;
				relTemp = double.NaN;
				if (ex2.Reason == RootFinder.RootFailureType.OutOfBoundsHigh)
				{
					returnMsg = FormResource.FIREConstantDensityFlashUpperBound;
				}
				else
				{
					returnMsg = FormResource.FIREConstantDensityFlashError;
				}
				result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
				goto IL_00c2;
			}
			result = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			goto IL_00c2;
			IL_00c2:
			return result;
		}

		public double PartialVolume(Vessel_FireCalcModel vessel, double liquidLevel)
		{
			double diameter = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, vessel.FIREUOMDiameter, vessel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), "Length");
			double height = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, vessel.FIREUOMHeight, vessel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), "Length");
			HeadType headTopType = ((vessel.FIREVesselTopHeadType == HeadType.Same) ? vessel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType : vessel.FIREVesselTopHeadType);
			return FireScenario.PartialVolume(vessel.FIREVesselType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)vessel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)headTopType, height, diameter, liquidLevel);
		}

		public void CalculateUnwettedFireReliefLoad()
		{
			double dSetPress = myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true);
			double dOverPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			string returnMsg = "";
			double num = 0.0;
			bool flag = false;
			myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.Anywhere);
			if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Unwetted)
			{
				myVM.set_RelTempSource(notify: false, ReliefTemperatureSource.Unwetted);
			}
			CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			try
			{
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
				double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, dSetPress * (1.0 + dOverPress / 100.0), "AbsolutePressure");
				bool IsUnwettedFireCase = true;
				double dDesTemp = default(double);
				double dAtmPress = default(double);
				double dLowSetPressLimit = default(double);
				double dSuperImpConstBackPress = default(double);
				double dSuperImpVarBackPress = default(double);
				double dVarBackPress = default(double);
				double dNoiseDistance = default(double);
				double dOperPress = default(double);
				double dOperTemp = default(double);
				double dWallTemp = default(double);
				calculationStatusEnum = PrepareCalc(ref dDesTemp, ref dAtmPress, ref dSetPress, ref dLowSetPressLimit, ref dOverPress, ref dSuperImpConstBackPress, ref dSuperImpVarBackPress, ref dVarBackPress, ref dNoiseDistance, ref IsUnwettedFireCase, ref dOperPress, ref dOperTemp, ref dWallTemp);
				if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
				{
					return;
				}
				UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, dAtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				double relPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, num2, "AbsolutePressure") + UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, dAtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				double relTemp = default(double);
				double UpstrPress = default(double);
				if (myVM.FIREUseIdealGasAssumption)
				{
					calculationStatusEnum = VaporRelief.CalculateReliefTemperatureVapor(ref relTemp, ref UpstrPress, dOperPress, dOperTemp, dWallTemp, dSetPress, dOverPress, dAtmPress, ref returnMsg);
					relTemp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), relTemp, "TankTemperature");
				}
				else
				{
					double p = ConvertToHysysUnits("GaugePressure", myVM.OperPress, myVM.UOMOperPress, myVM.AtmPress, myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true));
					double t = ConvertToHysysUnits("Temperature", myVM.OperTemp, myVM.UOMOperTemp);
					if (!mPPPFluid.TPFlash(t, p) || double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.OverallDensity()))
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FlashFailed, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
						return;
					}
					double maxTemp = Math.Max(myVM.OperTemp + 500.0, myVM.get_FIREWallTemp(notify: true));
					calculationStatusEnum = ConstantDensityFlash(ref relTemp, mPPPFluid.OverallDensity(), relPress, maxTemp, ref returnMsg);
					if (myVM.OperTemp > myVM.get_FIREWallTemp(notify: true))
					{
						myVM.set_TotalReliefLoad(notify: true, double.NaN);
						myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, relTemp);
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.OpTHigh, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
						return;
					}
					if (relTemp > myVM.get_FIREWallTemp(notify: true))
					{
						myVM.set_TotalReliefLoad(notify: true, double.NaN);
						myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, relTemp);
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RelTHigh, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
						return;
					}
					UpstrPress = num2 + dAtmPress;
				}
				if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
				{
					myVM.set_TotalReliefLoad(notify: true, double.NaN);
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				}
				flag = true;
				if (!myVM.IsRatingCalc)
				{
					myVM.FIREFluidTemp = relTemp;
					myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, relTemp);
				}
				if (!CalculateVaporReliefProperties(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc))
				{
					calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
					return;
				}
				double dCompress = myVM.get_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false);
				double dMolWeight = myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false);
				double dSpecHeatRatio = myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false);
				calculationStatusEnum = ValidateReliefProperties(ref dCompress, ref dMolWeight, ref dSpecHeatRatio, ref returnMsg);
				switch (calculationStatusEnum)
				{
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					break;
				}
				if (dCompress < 0.8 || dCompress > 1.1)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREZ, dCompress, 0.8, 1.1), MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				}
				calculationStatusEnum = CalculateExposedAreas(ref returnMsg);
				switch (calculationStatusEnum)
				{
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					break;
				}
				num = 0.0;
				double RelievingFlow = default(double);
				foreach (Vessel_FireCalcModel fIREVessel in myVM.FIREVesselList)
				{
					if (!fIREVessel.get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false))
					{
						break;
					}
					calculationStatusEnum = VaporRelief.CalculateReliefUnwettedFire(ref RelievingFlow, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, UnitStrings.Temp_R, relTemp, "TankTemperature"), UpstrPress, dOperTemp, dWallTemp, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(fIREVessel.FIREUOMExposedArea, UnitStrings.Area_ft2, fIREVessel.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: true), "Area"), dMolWeight, dSpecHeatRatio, ref returnMsg);
					switch (calculationStatusEnum)
					{
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						return;
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						break;
					}
					RelievingFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.get_UOMRelFlow(notify: true), RelievingFlow, "MassFlow");
					num += RelievingFlow;
					if (!myVM.IsRatingCalc)
					{
						fIREVessel.set_FIRECalcRelFlow(notify: false, RelievingFlow);
					}
				}
				myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetFluidComposition(mPPPFluid);
				myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, num);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
				{
					EraseFireResults(!flag);
				}
			}
		}

		public void CalculateSinglePhaseRigorousFire()
		{
			Vessel_FireCalcModel vessel_FireCalcModel = myVM.FIREVesselList[0];
			double relTemp = myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true);
			_ = (double)myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true);
			double dAtmPress = Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar);
			double dSetPress = myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true);
			double dOverPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			double fIREGasCorrectionFactor = myVM.FIREGasCorrectionFactor;
			string returnMsg = "";
			if (!(myVM.get_FIREMaxIterTemp(notify: true) > -273.15))
			{
				myVM.set_FIREMaxIterTemp(notify: false, myVM.get_FIREWallTemp(notify: true));
			}
			double num = myVM.get_FIREMaxIterTemp(notify: true);
			int num2 = myVM.get_FIRENumberOfFlashes(notify: true);
			if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Rigorous)
			{
				myVM.set_RelTempSource(notify: true, ReliefTemperatureSource.Rigorous);
			}
			mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
			myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, double.NaN);
			myVM.set_VaporFraction(notify: false, byUser: false, double.NaN);
			if (vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREArea_IsCalculated)
			{
				HeadType headTopType = ((vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselTopHeadType == HeadType.Same) ? vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType : vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselTopHeadType);
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIREExposedVolume(notify: false, FireScenario.TotalVolume(vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselType, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), (FIREHeadTypeEnum)vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, (FIREHeadTypeEnum)headTopType));
				vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREExposedVolume(notify: true);
				mPPPFluid.OverallDensity();
			}
			else
			{
				vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREExposedVolume(notify: true);
				mPPPFluid.OverallDensity();
			}
			double inputVal = dSetPress * (1.0 + dOverPress / 100.0);
			bool IsUnwettedFireCase = false;
			double dOperPress = 0.0;
			double dOperTemp = 0.0;
			double dWallTemp = 0.0;
			double dDesTemp = default(double);
			double dLowSetPressLimit = default(double);
			double dSuperImpConstBackPress = default(double);
			double dSuperImpVarBackPress = default(double);
			double dVarBackPress = default(double);
			double dNoiseDistance = default(double);
			CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = PrepareCalc(ref dDesTemp, ref dAtmPress, ref dSetPress, ref dLowSetPressLimit, ref dOverPress, ref dSuperImpConstBackPress, ref dSuperImpVarBackPress, ref dVarBackPress, ref dNoiseDistance, ref IsUnwettedFireCase, ref dOperPress, ref dOperTemp, ref dWallTemp);
			if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, dAtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, inputVal, "GaugePressure") + num3;
			UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, myVM.get_TotBackPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			double operTemp = myVM.OperTemp;
			double p = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, myVM.OperPress, "GaugePressure") + num3;
			if (!mPPPFluid.TPFlash(operTemp, p))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FlashFailed, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
				return;
			}
			double maxTemp = Math.Max(myVM.OperTemp + 500.0, myVM.get_FIREWallTemp(notify: true));
			switch (ConstantDensityFlash(ref relTemp, mPPPFluid.OverallDensity(), num4, maxTemp, ref returnMsg))
			{
			case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
				return;
			case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				break;
			}
			_ = 1.0 / mPPPFluid.OverallDensity();
			mPPPFluid.OverallMassEnthalpy();
			operTemp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.FIREUOMWallTemp, operTemp, "Temperature");
			double num5 = (num - relTemp) / (double)num2;
			if (relTemp > num)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FIREMaxIterIncrease, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
				return;
			}
			myVM.set_FIREDeltaT(notify: false, num5);
			FluidPhaseRegime fluidPhaseRegime = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(mPPPFluid.VaporFraction());
			if (fluidPhaseRegime == FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FIREWrongMethod, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
				return;
			}
			int num6 = 0;
			int num7 = 1;
			double num8 = 0.0;
			switch (myVM.ValveType.GetValueOrDefault())
			{
			}
			IterationResultRLCFireModel iterationResultRLCFireModel = myVM.CreateIterationResult(1, multiphase: false);
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.IsMultiphaseCalc = false;
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.HeatInput = 0.0;
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area = 0.0;
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.Temperature = mPPPFluid.Temperature();
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.Entropy = mPPPFluid.OverallMassEntropy();
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.Enthalpy = mPPPFluid.OverallMassEnthalpy();
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.Density = mPPPFluid.OverallDensity();
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.IterTime = 0.0;
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.MassFlux = 0.0;
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow = 0.0;
			iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporVolFlow = 0.0;
			double setPressure_psia = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true) + myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double atmPressure_psia = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double totalBackpressure_psia = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_TotBackPress(notify: true) + myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double upstreamPressure_psia = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true) + myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double overPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			double num9 = myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true);
			double coeffKc = myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true);
			if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk || !myVM.RuptDisk)
			{
				coeffKc = 1.0;
			}
			double coeffKd = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true);
			double coeffKv = myVM.get_Coeff_Kv(notify: true);
			bool flag = myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
			ValveTypeEnum valueOrDefault = (ValveTypeEnum)myVM.ValveType.GetValueOrDefault();
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			double value = vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false);
			checked
			{
				int num10 = num2 + 1;
				for (num6 = 2; num6 <= num10; num6++)
				{
					iterationResultRLCFireModel = myVM.CreateIterationResult(num6, multiphase: false);
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.IsMultiphaseCalc = false;
					double dExposedArea = 0.0;
					switch (CalculateIndividualExposedArea(ref dExposedArea, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREArea_IsCalculated, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselType, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREAdditionalAreaPct, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREFlameHeight(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMFlameHeight, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMHeight, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREVesselElevation(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMVesselElevation, 0.0, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMLiqLevel, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMDiameter, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: true), vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMExposedArea, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREAdditionalAreaFixed, 1, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselBottomHeadType, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREVesselTopHeadType, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREIncludedHeads, ref returnMsg))
					{
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						return;
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						break;
					}
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.WettedSurfaceArea = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Area_m2, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREUOMExposedArea, dExposedArea, "Area");
					mPPPFluid.TPFlash(mPPPFluid.Temperature() + num5, num4);
					FluidPhaseRegime phaseFromVaporFraction = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(mPPPFluid.VaporFraction());
					if (phaseFromVaporFraction == FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase)
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FIREWrongMethod, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
						return;
					}
					if (phaseFromVaporFraction != fluidPhaseRegime)
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.FIREPhaseChange, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					}
					fluidPhaseRegime = phaseFromVaporFraction;
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.Temperature = mPPPFluid.Temperature();
					double HeatInput = 0.0;
					if (vessel_FireCalcModel.FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated)
					{
						switch (CalculateAndSetCoeff_F(vessel_FireCalcModel, 1, iterationResultRLCFireModel.Temperature, ref returnMsg))
						{
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
							mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
							return;
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
							break;
						}
					}
					double Coeff_F = vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false);
					calculationStatusEnum = FireScenario.FireHeatInput(ref HeatInput, FireAreaStandard.Api521, myVM.FIREDrainage, CalcF: false, ref Coeff_F, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREInsThermCond, vessel_FireCalcModel.FIREInsThk, mPPPFluid.Temperature(), iterationResultRLCFireModel.WettedSurfaceArea, 1, myVM.get_FIREWettedAreaExponent(notify: true), ref returnMsg);
					HeatInput *= fIREGasCorrectionFactor;
					switch (calculationStatusEnum)
					{
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
						return;
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						break;
					}
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.HeatInput = HeatInput * 1.055;
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.Density = mPPPFluid.OverallDensity();
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.Enthalpy = mPPPFluid.OverallMassEnthalpy();
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.Entropy = mPPPFluid.OverallMassEntropy();
					double num11 = Math.Abs(1.0 / myVM.FIREIterationList[num6 - 2].Density - 1.0 / iterationResultRLCFireModel.Density);
					double num12 = Math.Abs(myVM.FIREIterationList[num6 - 2].Enthalpy - iterationResultRLCFireModel.Enthalpy);
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporVolFlow = iterationResultRLCFireModel.HeatInput * (num11 / num12);
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow = iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporVolFlow * iterationResultRLCFireModel.Density;
					double num13 = (1.0 / iterationResultRLCFireModel.Density + (1.0 / iterationResultRLCFireModel.Density - num11)) / 2.0;
					double num14 = vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREExposedVolume(notify: true) / num13;
					double iterTime = myVM.FIREIterationList[num6 - 2].IterTime;
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.IterTime = iterTime + num14 * num12 / (iterationResultRLCFireModel.HeatInput / 60.0);
					relTemp = iterationResultRLCFireModel.Temperature;
					double selectedCpCv = GetSelectedCpCv(mPPPFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting);
					double value2 = 520.0 * Math.Pow(selectedCpCv * Math.Pow(2.0 / (selectedCpCv + 1.0), (selectedCpCv + 1.0) / (selectedCpCv - 1.0)), 0.5);
					double calcOrifice_in = double.NaN;
					double calcMassFlux_lbhin = double.NaN;
					double coeffKb = double.NaN;
					if (!flag)
					{
						coeffKb = num9;
					}
					double relievingFlow_lbh = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, iterationResultRLCFireModel.VaporMassFlow, "MassFlow");
					double relievingTemp_R = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, UnitStrings.Temp_R, iterationResultRLCFireModel.Temperature, "Temperature");
					switch (Mixed_Relief.CalculateOrificeSize_HDIShortcut(ref calcOrifice_in, ref calcMassFlux_lbhin, relievingFlow_lbh, relievingTemp_R, double.NaN, valueOrDefault, ref coeffKb, coeffKc, coeffKd, coeffKv, flag, setPressure_psia, overPress, atmPressure_psia, totalBackpressure_psia, upstreamPressure_psia, mPPPFluid, isFireCalc: false, shouldReflash: false, ref returnMsg))
					{
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						return;
					case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
						if (hashSet.Add(returnMsg))
						{
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
						}
						break;
					}
					double area = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, calcOrifice_in, "SmallArea");
					double massFlux = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlux_lbhin2, UnitStrings.MassFlux_kghcm2, calcMassFlux_lbhin, "MassFlux");
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area = area;
					iterationResultRLCFireModel.MassFlux = massFlux;
					if (iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area > num8)
					{
						num8 = iterationResultRLCFireModel.Area;
						num7 = num6;
						myVM.set_RelVaporMassFraction(notify: false, 1.0);
						myVM.set_RelCompress(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporZFactor());
						myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporViscosity());
						myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: false, byUser: false, mPPPFluid.VaporMolecularWeight());
						myVM.set_SpecHeatRatio(notify: false, byUser: false, selectedCpCv);
						myVM.set_Coeff_C(notify: false, value2);
						if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
						{
							myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: false, coeffKb);
						}
						mPPPFluid.StoreFireFractions();
						value = Coeff_F;
					}
				}
				myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, myVM.FIREIterationList[num7 - 1].Temperature);
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, myVM.FIREIterationList[num7 - 1].WettedSurfaceArea);
				myVM.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, vessel_FireCalcModel.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: false));
				myVM.FIREIterationList[num7 - 1].IsMaxIteration = true;
				vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false, value);
				double vaporMassFlow = myVM.FIREIterationList[num7 - 1].VaporMassFlow;
				if (myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true) > myVM.get_FIREWallTemp(notify: true))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.WarnRelTemp, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				}
				myVM.ReliefCompositions = GetFluidComposition(mPPPFluid);
				if (!myVM.IsRatingCalc)
				{
					vessel_FireCalcModel.set_FIRECalcRelFlow(notify: false, vaporMassFlow);
					myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, vaporMassFlow);
				}
			}
		}

		public CalculationStatusEnum CalculateValveResults(ref double CalcOrifice, double RelFlow, double SetPress, double OverPress, double AtmPress, double LowSetPLimit, double SpecHeatRatio, double Compress, double MolWeight, double SuperImpConstBackPress, double SuperImpVarbackPress, double VarbackPress, double NoiseDistance)
		{
			CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
			bool calculateKb = false;
			bool calculateKsh = false;
			myVM.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true);
			AddMessageDelegate messageHandler = [SpecialName] (MessageLevel level, string msg) =>
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(level, msg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			};
			if (!IsOrificeSizingReady(messageHandler))
			{
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			ValveTypeEnum valveType = (ValveTypeEnum)(myVM.ValveType ?? PsvType.Conventional);
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, RelFlow, "MassFlow");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "TankTemperature");
			double num3 = ((myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk) ? 1.0 : ((!myVM.RuptDisk) ? 1.0 : ((!(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true) > 0.0)) ? 1.0 : myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true))));
			double num4 = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true);
			if (double.IsNaN(num4) || num4 <= 0.0)
			{
				num4 = 1.0;
			}
			double num5 = myVM.get_Coeff_Kv(notify: true);
			if (double.IsNaN(num5) || num5 <= 0.0)
			{
				num5 = 1.0;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				calculateKb = true;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_Ksh_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				calculateKsh = true;
			}
			_ = myVM.Coeff_kw_opt;
			_ = 1;
			double inletLoss = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			double num6 = Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.psi);
			double num7 = ValveUtilities.CalcTotBackPress(SuperImpConstBackPress, SuperImpVarbackPress, VarbackPress);
			if (double.IsNaN(num7) || num7 <= 0.0)
			{
				num7 = num6;
			}
			string txtMsg = null;
			double Coeff_Kb = myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true);
			double Coeff_Kn = double.NaN;
			double Coeff_Ksh = myVM.get_Coeff_Ksh(notify: true);
			double CriticPress = double.NaN;
			double calcMassFlux_lbhin = double.NaN;
			bool isCriticalFlow = default(bool);
			double Coeff_C = default(double);
			switch (orificeSizingMethod)
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				calculationStatusEnum = VaporRelief.CalculateOrificeSize(ref CalcOrifice, ref isCriticalFlow, ref CriticPress, ref Coeff_C, num, num2, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, num3, num4, calculateKb, SetPress, OverPress, AtmPress, inletLoss, num7, LowSetPLimit, SpecHeatRatio, Compress, MolWeight, ref txtMsg);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.AllVapor, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.MixedModelSinglePhase, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
			{
				mPPPFluid.StoreOverallFractions();
				double num8 = mPPPFluid.Pressure();
				double h = FluidExtensions.OverallMolarEnthalpy(mPPPFluid);
				double num9 = num8;
				double num10 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_kPa, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
				if (!double.IsNaN(num10))
				{
					num9 -= num10;
				}
				try
				{
					mPPPFluid.PVFlashVapor(num8, 1.0);
					mPPPFluid.IsenthalpicFlash(num9);
					calculationStatusEnum = Mixed_Relief.CalculateOrificeSize_HDIShortcut(ref CalcOrifice, ref calcMassFlux_lbhin, num, num2, double.NaN, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, num3, num4, num5, calculateKb, SetPress, OverPress, num6, num7, double.NaN, mPPPFluid, isFireCalc: false, shouldReflash: false, ref txtMsg);
				}
				finally
				{
					mPPPFluid.RevertOverallFractions();
					mPPPFluid.PHFlash(num8, h);
				}
				break;
			}
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				calculationStatusEnum = SteamRelief.CalculateOrificeSize(ref CalcOrifice, ref isCriticalFlow, ref CriticPress, ref Coeff_C, num, num2, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, num3, num4, ref Coeff_Kn, ref Coeff_Ksh, calculateKb, calculateKsh, myVM.Api520Part1EditionSetting, SetPress, OverPress, AtmPress, inletLoss, num7, SpecHeatRatio, Compress, MolWeight, ref txtMsg);
				break;
			}
			if (txtMsg != null)
			{
				switch (calculationStatusEnum)
				{
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, txtMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					break;
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, txtMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					break;
				}
			}
			CalcOrifice = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, myVM.UOMCalcOrifice, CalcOrifice, "SmallArea");
			return calculationStatusEnum;
		}

		internal CalculationStatusEnum CalculateValveResultsEx(ref double calcRequiredArea_cm2, double relievingFlow_kg_h, double relievingVF, double? overrideKd = null)
		{
			double CalcOrifice = double.NaN;
			double CriticPress = double.NaN;
			bool isCriticalFlow = true;
			double Coeff_C = double.NaN;
			double MassFlux_Design = double.NaN;
			double Coeff_Kb = ((myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated) ? double.NaN : myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true));
			double Coeff_Kn = double.NaN;
			double Coeff_Ksh = ((myVM.Coeff_Ksh_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated) ? double.NaN : myVM.get_Coeff_Ksh(notify: true));
			double valueOrDefault = overrideKd.GetValueOrDefault(myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true));
			OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
			CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
			string txtMsg = null;
			ValveTypeEnum valveType = (ValveTypeEnum)(myVM.ValveType ?? PsvType.Conventional);
			double relievingFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, relievingFlow_kg_h, "MassFlow");
			double relievingTemp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "TankTemperature");
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true) + myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double setPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true) + myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double atmPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double totBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_TotBackPress(notify: true) + myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			switch (orificeSizingMethod)
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				calculationStatusEnum = VaporRelief.CalculateOrificeSize(ref CalcOrifice, ref isCriticalFlow, ref CriticPress, ref Coeff_C, relievingFlow, relievingTemp, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true), valueOrDefault, myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated, setPress, myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true), atmPress, num2, totBackPress, 50.0, myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false), myVM.get_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false), myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false), ref txtMsg);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				calculationStatusEnum = SteamRelief.CalculateOrificeSize(ref CalcOrifice, ref isCriticalFlow, ref CriticPress, ref Coeff_C, relievingFlow, relievingTemp, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true), valueOrDefault, ref Coeff_Kn, ref Coeff_Ksh, myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated, myVM.Coeff_Ksh_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated, myVM.Api520Part1EditionSetting, setPress, myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true), atmPress, num2, totBackPress, myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false), myVM.get_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false), myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false), ref txtMsg);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					double pout = ConvertToHysysUnits("AbsolutePressure", num - num2, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA);
					PhysicalPropPkgFluid.IsenthalpicFlash(pout);
				}
				List<Mixed_Relief.DirectIntegrationStep> integrationResults = new List<Mixed_Relief.DirectIntegrationStep>();
				calculationStatusEnum = Mixed_Relief.CalculateOrificeSize_4(ref CalcOrifice, ref isCriticalFlow, ref MassFlux_Design, integrationResults, relievingFlow, relievingTemp, relievingVF, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true), valueOrDefault, myVM.get_Coeff_Kv(notify: true), myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated, setPress, myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true), totBackPress, num, num2, PhysicalPropPkgFluid, IsFireCalc: false, shouldReflash: false, ref txtMsg);
				break;
			}
			}
			if (txtMsg != null)
			{
				switch (calculationStatusEnum)
				{
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, txtMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					CalcOrifice = double.NaN;

				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:

					break;
				}
			}
			calcRequiredArea_cm2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, CalcOrifice, "SmallArea");
			return calculationStatusEnum;
		}
