		public void CalculateThermalExpansionReliefLoad()
		{
			double num = default(double);
			if (Operators.CompareString(myVM.TEUOMHeatInput, UnitStrings.Energy_kcalh, TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				num = myVM.TEHeatInput * 3.9683207;
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(myVM.TEUOMHeatInput, UnitStrings.Energy_Btuh, TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				num = myVM.TEHeatInput;
			}
			if (num <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.EnterHeatInput, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double num2 = default(double);
			if (myVM.TECoeff_B_Source == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
			{
				num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.TEUOMCoeff_B, UnitStrings.Coeff_EN, myVM.get_TECoeff_B(notify: true), "ExpansionCoeff");
			}
			else
			{
				CubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod cubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod = myVM.get_TECoeff_B_Method(notify: true);
				if (cubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod == CubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod.Equation)
				{
					if (CalculateThermalExpansionCoefficient() == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
					{
						return;
					}
					num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.TEUOMCoeff_B, UnitStrings.Coeff_EN, myVM.get_TECoeff_B(notify: true), "ExpansionCoeff");
				}
			}
			if (num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.TEInvalidCoefficient, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			}
			else if (FlashToReliefConditions(ExpectedPhase.Liquid, MessageLocation.FlowCalc, FormResource.TEAllVapor))
			{
				double tESpecGravity = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity() / 1000.0;
				double num3 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassHeatCapacity();
				double tECp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Cp_SI, UnitStrings.Cp_EN, num3, "CoeffCp");
				double inputVal = ThermalExapansionScenario.CalculateTERelievingFlow(num2, num, tESpecGravity, tECp);
				myVM.TESpecGravity = tESpecGravity;
				myVM.TECp = num3;
				myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.TEUOMRelievingFlow, inputVal, "MassFlow"));
			}
		}

		private CalculationStatusEnum CalculateThermalExpansionCoefficient()
		{
			bool flag = true;
			double p = ConvertToHysysUnits("GaugePressure", myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true), myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), myVM.AtmPress, myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true));
			double t = ConvertToHysysUnits("Temperature", myVM.TETemperature1, UnitStrings.Temp_C);
			double t2 = ConvertToHysysUnits("Temperature", myVM.TETemperature2, UnitStrings.Temp_C);
			DoubleRepresentation doubleRepresentation = new DoubleRepresentation(NumberFormat.Decimals, 1);
			if (true)
			{
				if (!PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlash(t, p) || double.IsNaN(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.Temperature()))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FIRE_TP_Flash_Failure, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction() > 0.0)
				{
					string arg = doubleRepresentation.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, DefaultUnits.Instance.TempDisplayUnit, myVM.TETemperature1, "Temperature"), NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo);
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, string.Format(FormResource.TEVaporPresent, arg, DefaultUnits.Instance.TempDisplayUnit), MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				myVM.set_TEDensity1(notify: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity());
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlash(t2, p) || double.IsNaN(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.Temperature()))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.FIRE_TP_Flash_Failure, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction() > 0.0)
				{
					string arg2 = doubleRepresentation.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, DefaultUnits.Instance.TempDisplayUnit, myVM.TETemperature2, "Temperature"), NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo);
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, string.Format(FormResource.TEVaporPresent, arg2, DefaultUnits.Instance.TempDisplayUnit), MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
				}
				myVM.set_TEDensity2(notify: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity());
			}
			double density = myVM.get_TEDensity1(notify: true);
			double density2 = myVM.get_TEDensity2(notify: true);
			double num = ThermalExapansionScenario.CalculateRigorousCubicalExpansionCoefficient(myVM.TETemperature1, myVM.TETemperature2, density, density2);
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.TEInvalidCoefficient, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError;
			}
			myVM.set_TECoeff_B(notify: false, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Coeff_SI, myVM.TEUOMCoeff_B, num, "ExpansionCoeff"));
			return CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK;
		}

		public void CalculateTubeRuptureReliefLoad()
		{
			double num = CalculateUpStreamPress(myVM.TROperPress, myVM.TRUOMOperPress, Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar), myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), 0.0);
			double tROperTemp = myVM.TROperTemp;
			string unitValue = myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true);
			tROperTemp = ConvertToHysysUnits("Temperature", tROperTemp, unitValue);
			if (!PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlash(tROperTemp, num) || double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.Temperature()))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.TubeRupture_TPFlashFail, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			double num2 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction();
			FluidPhaseRegime fluidPhaseRegime = ((num2 == 0.0) ? FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid : ((num2 != 1.0) ? FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase : FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor));
			myVM.TROperPhase = fluidPhaseRegime;
			double num3 = default(double);
			if (num2 > 0.0)
			{
				myVM.TRSpecHeatRatio = GetSelectedCpCv(PhysicalPropPkgFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting);
				myVM.TRMolWeight = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
				myVM.TRCompress = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporZFactor();
				myVM.TRVaporDensity = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassDensity();
				num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassDensity(), "Density");
			}
			double num4 = default(double);
			if (num2 < 1.0)
			{
				myVM.TRSpecGravity = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity() / 1000.0;
				myVM.TRLiquidDensity = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
				num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity(), "Density");
			}
			double num5 = CalculateUpStreamPress(myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar), myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true));
			double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, num5, "AbsolutePressure");
			PhysicalPropPkgFluid.IsenthalpicFlash(num5);
			if (double.IsNaN(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction()) | double.IsNaN(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.Temperature()))
			{
				myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, double.NaN);
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.TubeRupture_IsenthalpicFlashFail, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				return;
			}
			FluidPhaseRegime fluidPhaseRegime2 = ((PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction() == 0.0) ? FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid : ((PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction() != 1.0) ? FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase : FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor));
			myVM.set_VaporFraction(notify: false, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction());
			if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated)
			{
				myVM.set_RelTempSource(notify: false, ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated);
			}
			myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.Temperature());
			FluidPhaseRegime fluidPhaseRegime3 = fluidPhaseRegime2;
			double num8 = default(double);
			if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction() > 0.0)
			{
				myVM.TRSpecHeatRatio = GetSelectedCpCv(PhysicalPropPkgFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting);
				double tRSpecHeatRatio = myVM.TRSpecHeatRatio;
				double num7 = num * Math.Pow(2.0 / (tRSpecHeatRatio + 1.0), tRSpecHeatRatio / (tRSpecHeatRatio - 1.0));
				if (num7 > num5)
				{
					PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlash(tROperTemp, num);
					PhysicalPropPkgFluid.IsenthalpicFlash(num7);
					if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction() == 0.0)
					{
						myVM.TRChokePhase = FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid;
						PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TVFlash(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.Temperature(), 0.0);
						num7 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.Pressure();
					}
					else if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction() == 1.0)
					{
						myVM.TRChokePhase = FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor;
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.TRChokePhase = FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase;
					}
					fluidPhaseRegime3 = myVM.TRChokePhase.GetValueOrDefault();
					myVM.TRChokeTemperature = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.Temperature();
				}
				num8 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, num7, "AbsolutePressure");
				double num9 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, num7, "AbsolutePressure");
				myVM.TRChokePressure = num9 - Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar);
			}
			myVM.TRVaporRatio = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction();
			switch (fluidPhaseRegime)
			{
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
				if (myVM.TRVaporRatio == 1.0)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.TubeRupture_PhaseChange, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				}
				if ((myVM.TRVaporRatio >= 0.0) & (myVM.TRVaporRatio < 1.0))
				{
					myVM.TRSpecGravity = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity() / 1000.0;
					myVM.TRCompress = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporZFactor();
					myVM.TRMolWeight = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
					if (myVM.TRVaporRatio > 0.0)
					{
						myVM.TRVaporDensity = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassDensity();
						num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassDensity(), "Density");
					}
					else
					{
						num3 = 0.0;
					}
					myVM.TRLiquidDensity = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
					num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity(), "Density");
				}
				break;
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
				if (fluidPhaseRegime3 != FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor)
				{
					myVM.TRLiquidDensity = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
					num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, myVM.TRLiquidDensity, "Density");
				}
				break;
			}
			if ((myVM.TRVaporRatio >= 0.0) & (myVM.TRVaporRatio <= 1.0))
			{
				double tRVaporRatio = myVM.TRVaporRatio;
				double num10 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, num, "AbsolutePressure");
				double num11 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_mm, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.TRID, "SmallLength");
				short num12 = (short)((!myVM.TRTubeToShell) ? 1 : 2);
				string returnMsg = "";
				bool TRMIsCriticalFlow = false;
				double TRMRelievingFlow = default(double);
				double TRMDp = default(double);
				CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = ((fluidPhaseRegime == FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid && fluidPhaseRegime3 == FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid) ? TubeRuptureScenario.TubeRuptureLiquidReliefFlow(ref TRMRelievingFlow, ref TRMDp, ref TRMIsCriticalFlow, num11, num12, num10, num6, num8, num4, myVM.TRFlowCoefficient, ref returnMsg) : ((!(fluidPhaseRegime == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor && fluidPhaseRegime3 == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor)) ? TubeRuptureScenario.TubeRuptureMixedReliefFlow(ref TRMRelievingFlow, ref TRMDp, ref TRMIsCriticalFlow, num11, num12, num10, num6, num8, num3, num4, tRVaporRatio, myVM.TRFlowCoefficient, ref returnMsg) : TubeRuptureScenario.TubeRuptureVaporReliefFlow(ref TRMRelievingFlow, ref TRMDp, ref TRMIsCriticalFlow, num11, num12, num10, num6, num8, num3, myVM.TRFlowCoefficient, ref returnMsg)));
				if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
					return;
				}
				myVM.set_RelievingFlow(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, TRMRelievingFlow, "MassFlow"));
				myVM.TRDeltaP = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, TRMDp, "DeltaPressure");
				if (TRMIsCriticalFlow)
				{
					myVM.TRTypeFlow = FlowType.Critical;
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.TRTypeFlow = FlowType.Subcritical;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.VR01, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete]
		public bool IsEmpty(double val)
		{
			if (val != -32767.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private double CalculateUpStreamPress(double SetPress, string SetPressUnits, double AtmPress, string AtmPressUnits, double OverPress)
		{
			double value = SetPress * (1.0 + OverPress / 100.0);
			return ConvertToHysysUnits("GaugePressure", value, SetPressUnits, AtmPress, AtmPressUnits);
		}

		public static double ConvertToHysysUnits(string UnitType, double Value, string UnitValue, double AtmPressIn = 14.7, string UOMAtmPressIn = "psi")
		{
			switch (UnitType)
			{
			case "GaugePressure":
			{
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMAtmPressIn, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, AtmPressIn, "AbsolutePressure");
				return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitValue, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, Value, "GaugePressure") + num;
			}
			case "AbsolutePressure":
				return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitValue, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, Value, "AbsolutePressure");
			case "Temperature":
				return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitValue, UnitStrings.Temp_C, Value, "Temperature");
			case "MassEnthalpy":
				return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitValue, UnitStrings.MassEnthalpy_kJkg, Value, "MassEnthalpy");
			default:
			{
				double result = default(double);
				return result;
			}
			}
		}

		public void OnRaiseRunCalculations(string propname)
		{
			AutoRunCalculations(propname);
		}

		public void AutoRunCalculations(string propname, bool force = false)
		{
			checked
			{
				try
				{
					myVM.CalculationsInFlightCount++;
					if (force)
					{
						myVM.ForcedCalculationInFlight = true;
					}
					else if (myVM.ForcedCalculationInFlight)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "NoFire", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						myVM.ShouldRaiseRanCalculations = true;
						myVM.ShouldRecalculateRatingModels = true;
					}
					double oldsize = myVM.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true);
					double oldload = myVM.get_RelFlow(notify: true);
					CalculatePrerequisites(propname, force);
					AutoRunReliefLoadCalculations(propname, force, oldload);
					AutoRunOrificeCalculations(propname, force, oldsize);
					if (force || (propname != null && WouldAffectLineSizing(propname)))
					{
						myVM.CalculateLineSize();
						if (!myVM.get_IsLineSizingCalculated(notify: true))
						{
							myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.ScenarioLineSizingNotCalculated);
						}
						myVM.ShouldRaiseRanCalculations = true;
						myVM.ShouldRecalculateRatingModels = true;
					}
					else if (propname != null && (WouldAffectReliefProperties(propname) | WouldAffectReliefLoadCalculations(propname) | WouldAffectOrificeSizing(propname)))
					{
						myVM.ShouldRaiseRanCalculations = true;
						myVM.ShouldRecalculateRatingModels = true;
					}
					if (force || (propname != null && WouldAffectLineSizingConstraints(propname)))
					{
						if (myVM.get_IsLineSizingCalculated(notify: true))
						{
							CalculateLineSizeConstraints();
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.ClearLineSizingMessages(MessageLocation.LineSizingConstraints);
						}
						myVM.ShouldRaiseRanCalculations = true;
					}
					myVM.NotifyScenarioMessagesPropertyChanged();
					myVM.NotifyLineSizingMessagesPropertyChanged();
				}
				finally
				{
					myVM.CalculationsInFlightCount--;
					if (myVM.CalculationsInFlightCount == 0)
					{
						if (myVM.ShouldRaiseRanCalculations)
						{
							RanCalculations?.Invoke(this, new RanCalculationsEventArgs(myVM.ShouldRecalculateRatingModels));
							myVM.ShouldRaiseRanCalculations = false;
							myVM.ShouldRecalculateRatingModels = false;
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.CatchPropertyChanged();
						}
					}
					if (force)
					{
						myVM.ForcedCalculationInFlight = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool WouldAffectReliefProperties(string propname)
		{
			return WARProperties.Contains(propname);
		}

		public void AutoRunOrificeCalculations(string propname, bool force, double oldsize = double.NaN)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (force)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (!Information.IsNothing(propname))
			{
				flag = WouldAffectOrificeSizing(propname);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				AddMessageDelegate messageHandler = [SpecialName] (MessageLevel level, string msg) =>
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(level, msg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				};
				flag2 = IsOrificeSizingReady(messageHandler);
				EraseOrificeCalcResults();
				if (flag2)
				{
					CalculateOrificeSize(force, oldsize);
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
					if (!force)
					{
						myVM.EraseSelectedOrificeResults();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (WouldAffectOrificeSelection(propname))
			{
				myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
				myVM.SelectedOrificeChanged();
			}
			if ((myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk) & (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod))
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(myVM.SelRDDiam) && flag2)
				{
					myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
				AddMessageDelegate messageHandler2 = [SpecialName] (MessageLevel level, string msg) =>
				{
				};
				if (flag2 && (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true)) & !IsLineSizingReady(messageHandler2)))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.DoLineSizing, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
				if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "TotalReliefLoad", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					myVM.UpdateLOverDPercOrificeUsed();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool WouldAffectOrificeSelection(string propname)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "ValveMaterial", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool WouldAffectOrificeSizing(string propname)
		{
			if (WAOSProperties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "RelFlowSource", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "IsSizingCase", TextCompare: false) == 0 && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelFlow(notify: true)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk) & (Operators.CompareString(propname, "CapUncertFact", TextCompare: false) == 0))
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool result = true;
			switch (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				result = WouldAffectVaporOrificeSizing(propname);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
				result = WouldAffectLiquidOrificeSizing(propname);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				result = WouldAffectSteamOrificeSizing(propname);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
				result = WouldAffectMixedAAndBOrificeSizing(propname);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
				result = WouldAffectMixedAAndBOrificeSizing(propname);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				result = WouldAffectMixedCOrificeSizing(propname);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				result = WouldAffectMixedDirectOrificeSizing(propname);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				result = WouldAffectKrMethodOrificeSizing(propname);
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				result = WouldAffectNonCertifiedLiquidOrificeSizing(propname);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool WouldAffectCommonOrificeSizing(string propname)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "NoFire", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (WouldAffectReliefProperties(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
			{
				if (myVM.IsRatingCalc)
				{
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "RelFlow", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "TotalReliefLoad", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (WACOSProperties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified && Operators.CompareString(propname, "Coeff_kb", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (myVM.PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && myVM.RuptDisk && Operators.CompareString(propname, "Coeff_Kc", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void EraseOrificeResults()
		{
			myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeSelection);
			myVM.EraseSelectedOrificeResults();
		}

		private void EraseOrificeCalcResults()
		{
			myVM.EraseProperty<double>("CalcOrifice");
			myVM.EraseProperty<double>("CalcRDDiam");
			myVM.EraseProperty<double>("MassFlux");
			if (!myVM.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true).HasValue || (myVM.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true).GetValueOrDefault() == LineRatingFlowSpec.RatedArea && myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod))
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<double>("UpratedFlow");
			}
			switch (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true))
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				EraseVaporOrificeCalcProperties();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
				EraseLiquidOrificeCalcProperties();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				EraseSteamOrificeCalcProperties();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
				EraseMixedAAndBOrificeCalcProperties();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
				EraseMixedAAndBOrificeCalcProperties();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				EraseMixedCOrificeCalcProperties();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				EraseMixedDirectOrificeCalcProperties();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				EraseKrMethodCalcProperties();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				EraseNonCertifiedLiquidOrificeCalcProperties();
				break;
			}
		}

		}

		public void AutoRunReliefLoadCalculations(string propname, bool force, double oldload = double.NaN)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (((Operators.CompareString(propname, "OperTemp", TextCompare: false) == 0) | (Operators.CompareString(propname, "OperPress", TextCompare: false) == 0)) || force)
			{
				myVM.UpdateOpPhase();
			}
			if (force)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (!Information.IsNothing(propname))
			{
				flag = WouldAffectReliefLoadCalculations(propname);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			AddMessageDelegate messageHandler = (myVM.IsRatingCalc ? ((AddMessageDelegate)([SpecialName] (MessageLevel level, string msg) =>
			{
			})) : ((AddMessageDelegate)([SpecialName] (MessageLevel level, string msg) =>
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(level, msg, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			})));
			bool num = IsReliefLoadCalculationReady(messageHandler);
			EraseReliefLoadResults();
			if (num)
			{
				CalculateReliefLoad(propname);
				if (WouldAffectOrificeSizing(propname))
				{
					double val = myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
					if (!force && BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValuesAreDifferent(oldload, val))
					{
						EraseOrificeCalcResults();
					}
					return;
				}
				double num2 = myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
				if (double.IsNaN(num2) || num2 < 0.0)
				{
					EraseOrificeCalcResults();
					EraseOrificeResults();
				}
			}
			else if (!force)
			{
				EraseOrificeCalcResults();
				EraseOrificeResults();
				myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.Elsewhere);
			}
		}

		public void EraseReliefLoadResults()
		{
			if (myVM.IsRatingCalc)
			{
				return;
			}
			myVM.EraseReliefComposition();
			myVM.EraseReliefProperties();
			if (myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				switch (myVM.EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case EmergScenarioType.Control_Valve_Failure:
					EraseCVFailureResults();
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fan_Failure:
					EraseFanFailureResults();
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fire:
					EraseFireResults();
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Reflux_Failure:
					EraseRefluxFailureResults();
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Thermal_Expansion:
					EraseThermalExpansionResults();
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Exch_Tube_Rupture:
					EraseTubeRuptureResults();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void EraseTotalReliefLoad()
		{
			if (!myVM.IsRatingCalc || !((PRDModel)myVM.Owner).IfSpare)
			{
				myVM.EraseRelievingFlow();
			}
		}

		private void EraseFireResults(bool EraseRelTemp = true)
		{
			mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
			mPPPFluid.ClearFireFractions();
			myVM.EraseIterationList();
			myVM.FIREComponentNames = null;
			myVM.EraseProperty<double>("FIRECalcRelFlow");
			myVM.EraseProperty<double>("FIRECalcHeatInput");
			myVM.EraseProperty<double>("FIREExposedArea");
			EraseTotalReliefLoad();
			if (EraseRelTemp)
			{
				myVM.EraseProperty<double>("RelTemp");
				myVM.EraseProperty<double>("FIREFluidTemp");
			}
			myVM.EraseProperty<double>("FIREDeltaT");
			myVM.EraseProperty<double>("h_vlo", byUser: false);
			EraseFireDisengagementCalculatedInputs();
			EraseFireDisengagementResults();
			using IEnumerator<Vessel_FireCalcModel> enumerator = myVM.FIREVesselList.GetEnumerator();
			Vessel_FireCalcModel current;
			for (; enumerator.MoveNext(); current.set_FIRECalcHeatInput(notify: false, double.NaN), current.set_FIRECalcRelFlow(notify: false, double.NaN))
			{
				current = enumerator.Current;
				if (!current.get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (current.FIREArea_IsCalculated)
				{
					current.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, double.NaN);
					current.set_FIREExposedVolume(notify: false, double.NaN);
				}
				int? num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
				{
					num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 4) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (current.FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated)
				{
					current.set_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false, double.NaN);
				}
			}
		}

				else
				{

									{
										flag = IsTubeRuptureReliefLoadReady(MessageHandler);

					}

		}

		private bool CheckFireVessel(Vessel_FireCalcModel vessel, int vn, AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = true;
			int? num;
			if (!vessel.FIREArea_IsCalculated)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(vessel.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: true)) | (vessel.get_FIREExposedArea(notify: true) == 0.0))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREExposedArea_1, vn.ToString()));
					return false;
				}
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				bool? obj = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 3) : ((bool?)null));
				if (((double.IsNaN(vessel.get_FIREExposedVolume(notify: true)) | (vessel.get_FIREExposedVolume(notify: true) == 0.0)) & obj) == true)
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREExposedVolumeMissing, vn.ToString()));
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (vessel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true) == 0.0 || (vessel.FIREVesselType != VesselTypeEnum.Sphere && vessel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true) == 0.0))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIRECalcAreaZero, vn.ToString()));
					vessel.set_FIREExposedArea(notify: false, 0.0);
					vessel.set_FIRECalcRelFlow(notify: true, 0.0);
					myVM.set_TotalReliefLoad(notify: true, 0.0);
					vessel.set_FIRECalcHeatInput(notify: false, 0.0);
					return false;
				}
				checked
				{
					if (double.IsNaN(vessel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true)))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREDiameter, vss[vn - 1]));
						return false;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(vessel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true)) && vessel.FIREVesselType != VesselTypeEnum.Sphere)
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREHeight, vss[vn - 1]));
						return false;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(vessel.get_FIREVesselElevation(notify: true)))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREVesselElevation, vss[vn - 1]));
						return false;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(vessel.get_FIREFlameHeight(notify: true)))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREFlameHeight, vss[vn - 1]));
						return false;
					}
					if (vessel.get_FIREFlameHeight(notify: true) < vessel.get_FIREVesselElevation(notify: true))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREFlameLow, vn.ToString()));
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (vn == 1)
			{
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					goto IL_03a8;
				}
			}
			if (vn > 1)
			{
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
				{
					num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 4) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
					{
						goto IL_05e3;
					}
				}
				goto IL_03a8;
			}
			goto IL_05e3;
			IL_03a8:
			if (vessel.FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(vessel.FIREInsThk) | (vessel.FIREInsThk == 0.0))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREInsThk, vn.ToString()));
					return false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(vessel.FIREInsThermCond) | (vessel.FIREInsThermCond == 0.0))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIREInsThermCond, vn.ToString()));
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (double.IsNaN(vessel.get_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false)) | (vessel.get_FIRECoeff_F(notify: false) == 0.0))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIRECoeff_F, vss[checked(vn - 1)]));
				return false;
			}
			num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != 3) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
			{
				VesselTypeEnum fIREVesselType = vessel.FIREVesselType;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				num2 = ((!(fIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal || fIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Sphere)) ? vessel.get_FIREHeight(notify: true) : vessel.get_FIREDiameter(notify: true));
				if (vessel.FIREArea_IsCalculated)
				{
					if (MyMath.ValueExceeds(vessel.get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true), num2, 1E-12, 1E-12))
					{
						string text = "";
						text = ((!(fIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal || fIREVesselType == VesselTypeEnum.Sphere)) ? "height" : "diameter");
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIRELiqLevelHigh, vn.ToString(), text));
						return false;
					}
					if (myVM.FIRECalculationType != FireCalcMethod.NFPA30)
					{
						if (double.IsNaN(vessel.get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true)))
						{
							MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FireLiqLevelNan, vn.ToString()));
							return false;
						}
						if (vessel.get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true) == 0.0)
						{
							MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.FIRELiqLevelMissing, vn.ToString()));
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			goto IL_05e3;
			IL_05e3:
			return result;
		}

		public bool IsFireReliefLoadReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SetPress);
				flag = false;
			}
			int? num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
			bool? flag3;
			bool? flag2 = (flag3 = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() != 0) : ((bool?)null)));
			bool? obj;
			if (!flag2.HasValue || flag3 == true)
			{
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				bool? flag4;
				flag2 = (flag4 = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != 4) : ((bool?)null)));
				obj = ((!flag2.HasValue) ? ((bool?)null) : ((flag4 == true) & flag3));
			}
			else
			{
				obj = false;
			}
			bool? flag5 = obj;
			if (flag5 ?? true)
			{
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true && flag5.HasValue && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_FIREWallTemp(notify: true)))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREWallTemp);
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
			{
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 4) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
				{
					num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 3) : ((bool?)null)) == true && myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					goto IL_0330;
				}
			}
			if (!myVM.get_FIRELatHeat_Opt(notify: true) & ((myVM.get_FIREFluidLatHeat(notify: true) == 0.0) | double.IsNaN(myVM.get_FIREFluidLatHeat(notify: true))))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREFluidLatHeat);
				flag = false;
			}
			goto IL_0330;
			IL_06ce:
			foreach (Vessel_FireCalcModel fIREVessel in myVM.FIREVesselList)
			{
				if (!fIREVessel.get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (!CheckFireVessel(fIREVessel, checked(fIREVessel.Index + 1), MessageHandler))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (myVM.FireCalculateDisengagement)
			{
				if (!myVM.FireDisengagementRegime.HasValue)
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREMissingDisengagementRegime);
					flag = false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.FireSelectedC0))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREMissingDisengagementC0);
					flag = false;
				}
				if (!myVM.FireDisengagementVesselFlowModel.HasValue)
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREMissingDisengagementVesselModel);
					flag = false;
				}
				else if (myVM.FireDisengagementVesselFlowModel == DisengagementVesselFlowModel.Custom)
				{
					if (double.IsNaN(myVM.FireDisengagementLiquidLevelForSwell))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREMissingDisengagementLiquidLevelForSwell);
						flag = false;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(myVM.FireDisengagementLiquidLevelForEntrainment))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREMissingDisengagementLiquidLevelForEntrainment);
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kv(notify: true)))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FireDisengagementMissingKv);
				}
				if (myVM.FIRECalculationType == FireCalcMethod.NFPA30 && !(myVM.FIREVesselList.First().get_FIRELiqLevel(notify: true) > 0.0))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREMissingDisengagementLiquidLevel);
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			return flag;
			IL_0330:
			if (myVM.FIREVesselList == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (myVM.FIREVesselList.ElementAt(0).get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false))
			{
				Vessel_FireCalcModel vessel = myVM.FIREVesselList.ElementAt(0);
				if (!CheckFireVessel(vessel, 1, MessageHandler))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				if ((flag & (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != 1) : ((bool?)null))) == true)
				{
					if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kv(notify: true)) & (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kv);
						flag = false;
					}
					num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
					if ((flag & (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != 3) : ((bool?)null))) == true)
					{
						num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
						if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
						{
							if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_FIREMaxIterTemp(notify: true)) & (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash == SemiDynFlashType.FinalTemp))
							{
								MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREMaxIterTempMissing);
								flag = false;
							}
							if (double.IsNaN(myVM.FIREUserPctVap) & (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash == SemiDynFlashType.PctVap))
							{
								MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREPctVapMissing);
								flag = false;
							}
							if ((double.IsNaN(myVM.FIREUserHeatFlow) | (myVM.FIREUserHeatFlow == 0.0)) & (myVM.FIRETypeOfFlash == SemiDynFlashType.HeatFlow))
							{
								MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREHeatFlowMissing);
								flag = false;
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
							if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
							{
								num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
								if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 4) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
								{
									goto IL_06ce;
								}
							}
							if (myVM.get_FIRELatHeat_Opt(notify: true))
							{
								if (double.IsNaN(myVM.FIREInitialLatentHeatPercent))
								{
									MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIRELatentInitPct);
									flag = false;
								}
								if (double.IsNaN(myVM.FIREFinalLatentHeatPercent))
								{
									MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIRELatentFinalPct);
									flag = false;
								}
								if (myVM.FIREInitialLatentHeatPercent > myVM.FIREFinalLatentHeatPercent)
								{
									MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FIREPctError);
									flag = false;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			goto IL_06ce;
		}

		public bool IsTubeRuptureReliefLoadReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool isOK = true;

			AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true), FormResource.OverPress, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.TROperPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.TubeRupture_OperPress);
				isOK = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.TROperTemp))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.TubeRupture_OperTemp);
				isOK = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.TRID))

			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.TRFlowCoefficient))

				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.TubeRupture_FlowCoefficient);
				isOK = false;
			}
			return isOK;
		}

		public bool IsThermalExpansionReliefLoadReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoVaporFraction);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.TEHeatInput))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.TEHeatInput);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.TECoeff_B_Source == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_TECoeff_B(notify: true)))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.TECoeff_B);
					result = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod cubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod = myVM.get_TECoeff_B_Method(notify: true);
				if (cubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod == CubicalExpansionCoefficientMethod.Equation)
				{
					if (double.IsNaN(myVM.TETemperature1))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.TEMissingTemperature1);
						result = false;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(myVM.TETemperature2))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.TEMissingTemperature2);
						result = false;
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(myVM.TETemperature1) && !MyMath.ValuesDiffer(myVM.TETemperature1, myVM.TETemperature2, 1E-06, 1E-12))
					{
						MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.TETemperaturesSame);
						result = false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SetPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OverPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RelTempIsBad);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.AtmPress);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool IsCVFailureReliefLoadReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool isOK = true;
			AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), FormResource.SetPress, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
			AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true), FormResource.OverPress, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
			AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.VFInletPress_Rel, FormResource.VFInletPress_Rel, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
			AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.VFInletTemp_Rel, FormResource.VFInletTemp_Rel, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
			AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.VFFlowToProc, FormResource.VFLFlowToProc, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
			if (myVM.VFMassFlowCalcMethod == ControlValveSizingSource.PSVPlus)
			{
				AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.CVFKm, FormResource.CVFFl, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
				AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.VFCV_100, FormResource.VFLCV_100, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
			}
			else
			{
				AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.VFOutletPress, FormResource.VFOutletPress, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
				if (myVM.VFMassFlowCalcMethod == ControlValveSizingSource.ISA)
				{
					AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.VFCV_100, FormResource.VFLCV_100, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
					AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.CVFKm, FormResource.CVFFl, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
					AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.CVFFp, FormResource.CVFFp, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
					AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.CVFXt, FormResource.CVFXt, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
				}
				else if (myVM.VFMassFlowCalcMethod == ControlValveSizingSource.Universal || myVM.VFMassFlowCalcMethod == ControlValveSizingSource.VendorSpecific)
				{
					AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.CVFC1, FormResource.CVFC1, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
					AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.CVFKm, FormResource.CVFKm, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
					AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.CVFCg, FormResource.CVFCvCg, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
					AddErrorMsgIfNaN(myVM.VFCV_100, FormResource.CVFCvCg, ref isOK, MessageHandler);
				}
			}
			return isOK;
		}

		protected void AddErrorMsgIfNaN(double d, string msg, ref bool isOK, AddMessageDelegate msgHandler)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(d))
			{
				isOK = false;
				msgHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, msg);
			}
		}

		private bool WouldAffectTemperatureCalculation(string propname)
		{
			if ((Operators.CompareString(propname, "RelTempSource", TextCompare: false) == 0) | (Operators.CompareString(propname, "VaporFraction", TextCompare: false) == 0))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CalculateReliefTemperatureFromVF()
		{
			if (!myVM.IsRatingCalc)
			{
				double num = Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.kPa);
				double p = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure") + num;
				if (!mPPPFluid.PVFlash(p, myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)) || double.IsNaN(mPPPFluid.Temperature()))
				{
					myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: true, double.NaN);
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RelTempVFFlashFail, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.set_RelTemp(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), mPPPFluid.Temperature(), "TankTemperature"));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool WouldAffectReliefLoadCalculations(string propname)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "NoFire", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (myVM.RelFlowCanBeCalculated)
			{
				if ((Operators.CompareString(propname, "PRDType", TextCompare: false) == 0) | (Operators.CompareString(propname, "OrificeCalcModel", TextCompare: false) == 0))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "RelFlowSource", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) != ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (myVM.EmergencyType.GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case EmergScenarioType.Control_Valve_Failure:
					result = WouldAffectCVFailureReliefLoad(propname);
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fan_Failure:
					result = WouldAffectFanFailureReliefLoad(propname);
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fire:
					result = WouldAffectFireReliefLoad(propname);
					if (!myVM.IsFireCompositionCalculated && !double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true)) && (WouldAffectOrificeSizing(propname) || WouldAffectLineSizing(propname)))
					{
						result = true;
					}
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Reflux_Failure:
					result = WouldAffectRefluxFailureReliefLoad(propname);
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Thermal_Expansion:
					result = WouldAffectThermalExpansionReliefLoad(propname);
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Exch_Tube_Rupture:
					result = WouldAffectTubeRuptureReliefLoad(propname);
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool WouldAffectFireReliefLoad(string propname)
		{
			if ((Operators.CompareString(propname, "RelFlowSource", TextCompare: false) == 0) & (myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) != ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (V1Properties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((myVM.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) ?? FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted) == FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted && WAFRLWettedApiProperties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			IReadOnlyList<Vessel_FireCalcModel> fIREVesselList = myVM.FIREVesselList;
			int? num;
			if (fIREVesselList != null && fIREVesselList.Count > 0)
			{
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				bool? flag2;
				bool? flag = (flag2 = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)));
				bool? obj;
				if (!flag.HasValue || flag2 != true)
				{
					num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
					bool? flag3;
					flag = (flag3 = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 3) : ((bool?)null)));
					obj = ((!flag.HasValue) ? ((bool?)null) : ((flag3 == true) | flag2));
				}
				else
				{
					obj = true;
				}
				bool? flag4 = obj;
				if ((flag4 ?? true) && V1DynamicProperties.Contains(propname) && flag4.HasValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				bool? obj2 = (num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != 1) : ((bool?)null));
				if ((myVM.FIREVesselList.ElementAt(0).get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false) & obj2) == true)
				{
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (myVM.FIREVesselList.ElementAt(0).FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated)
					{
						if (VOpt2.Contains(propname))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIRECoeff_F", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					if ((Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIREFluidLatHeat", TextCompare: false) == 0) | (Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIREUOMFluidLatHeat", TextCompare: false) == 0))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (V1OptUnWet.Contains(propname))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (myVM.FIREVesselList.ElementAt(0).get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false) && ((Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIREUOMExposedArea", TextCompare: false) == 0) | (Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIREExposedArea", TextCompare: false) == 0)))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (myVM.FireCalculateDisengagement)
				{
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "Coeff_Kd", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (myVM.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct && Operators.CompareString(propname, "Coeff_Kv", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (!myVM.get_FIRELatHeat_Opt(notify: true) && Operators.CompareString(propname, "FireDisengagementHeatOfVaporizationAtSet", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (!myVM.FIREVesselList.First().FIREArea_IsCalculated && Operators.CompareString(propname, "FireDisengagementFullVesselArea", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num != 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					if ((Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIREFluidLatHeat", TextCompare: false) == 0) | (Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIREUOMFluidLatHeat", TextCompare: false) == 0))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (V1OptUnWet.Contains(propname))
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (Vessel_FireCalcModel item in myVM.FIREVesselList.Skip(1))
				{
					if (!item.get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false))
					{
						break;
					}
					num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
					{
						num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
						if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 4) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (item.FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated)
					{
						if (VOpt2.Contains(propname))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIRECoeff_F", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
			{
				num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 4) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
				{
					num = (int?)myVM.FIRECalculationType;
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 3) : ((bool?)null)) == true && Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIREGasCorrectionFactor", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					goto IL_072e;
				}
			}
			if (Operators.CompareString(propname, "FIREIncludeSensibleHeat", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			goto IL_072e;
			IL_072e:
			return false;
		}

		private void CalculatePrerequisites(string propname, bool force)
		{
			bool notify = !force;
			if (myVM.PRDSystem.DesPressSource == ProcessDataSource.Reference && myVM.PRDSystem.OverallPRDModel.get_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: true))
			{
				PRDSystemModel pRDSystem = myVM.PRDSystem;
				double curValue = double.NaN;
				pRDSystem.VerifyDesignPress(ref curValue);
			}
			if (propname != null && Operators.CompareString(propname, "RelTemp", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
			}
			if (force || (propname != null && Operators.CompareString(propname, "RelTemp", TextCompare: false) == 0))
			{
				myVM.UpdateReliefPhase(notify);
			}
			if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!force)
			{
				switch (propname)
				{
				default:
					return;
				case "VaporFraction":
				case "OverPress":
				case "SetPress":
				case "AtmPress":
					break;
				}
			}
			bool flag = true;
			myVM.ClearScenarioMessages(MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoVaporFraction, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true)))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.SetPress, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar)))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.AtmPress, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true)))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OverPress, MessageLocation.FlowCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				CalculateReliefTemperatureFromVF();
			}
		}

		private bool CalculateLiquidReliefProperties(MessageLocation location, bool notify = false)
		{
			bool num = CalculateReliefPropertiesCommon(ExpectedPhase.Liquid, location, notify);
			if (num)
			{
				double value = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporZFactor();
				double selectedCpCv = GetSelectedCpCv(PhysicalPropPkgFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting);
				double num2 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight();
				double value2 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidViscosity();
				double value3 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity() / 1000.0;
				myVM.set_RelVaporMassFraction(notify, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction());
				myVM.set_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false, value);
				myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false, value2);
				myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false, num2);
				myVM.set_RelDensity(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.OverallDensity());
				myVM.set_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false, selectedCpCv);
				myVM.set_SpecGravity(notify: true, byUser: false, value3);
				double num3 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.HeatOfVaporization();
				myVM.set_h_vlo(notify: true, byUser: false, num3 / num2);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public bool IsLiquidOrificeSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = IsCommonOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
			if ((myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) < 0.0) | double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RelFlow);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.RuptDisk && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_kw_opt != ProcessDataSource.Calculated && double.IsNaN(myVM.Coeff_kw))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_kw);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void CalculateLiquidOrificeSize()
		{
			double num = 14.69;
			string returnMsg = "";
			bool flag = false;
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
			checked
			{
				if (myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) >= 0.0)
				{
					num2 /= GetCapUncertFact();
					CalculateLiquidReliefProperties(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					if (myVM.get_SpecGravity(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0)
					{
						double specGravity = myVM.get_SpecGravity(notify: true, byUser: false);
						if (myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0)
						{
							double fluidVisc = myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false);
							num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
							double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
							if (num3 > 0.0 - num)
							{
								double num4 = num3 + num;
								double overPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
								double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
								double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
								double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
								if (myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true) > 0.0)
								{
									double coeff_Kd = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true);
									double Coeff_Kw = default(double);
									if (myVM.Coeff_kw_opt != ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
									{
										if (myVM.Coeff_kw == 0.0)
										{
											myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKw, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
											return;
										}
										Coeff_Kw = myVM.Coeff_kw;
										if (myVM.Coeff_kw != 1.0 && myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
										{
											myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.BadKw, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
										}
									}
									else if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
									{
										Coeff_Kw = 1.0;
									}
									double coeff_Kc;
									if (myVM.PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && myVM.RuptDisk)
									{
										if (!(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true) > 0.0))
										{
											myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKc, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
											return;
										}
										coeff_Kc = myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true);
									}
									else
									{
										coeff_Kc = 1.0;
									}
									ValveTypeEnum valveType = myVM.ValveType.GetValueOrDefault() switch
									{
										PsvType.Conventional => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
										PsvType.BalancedBellows => ValveTypeEnum.BalancedBellows, 
										PsvType.PilotOperated => ValveTypeEnum.PilotOperated, 
										_ => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
									};
									myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct(notify: false);
									double maxPercent = myVM.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true);
									double num8 = ValveUtilities.CalcTotBackPress(num5, num6, num7);
									double p = ConvertToHysysUnits("AbsolutePressure", num8, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psi);
									double num9 = myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true);
									num9 = ConvertToHysysUnits("Temperature", myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true));
									if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlash(num9, p))
									{
										if ((PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction() > 0.0) & (myVM.get_RelVaporMassFraction(notify: true) == 0.0))
										{
											myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.PRD_LiquidFlash, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
										}
									}
									else
									{
										myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FlashFailed, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
									}
									double maxAllowBackpressure = ValveUtilities.GetMaxAllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num4, num5 + num6, num);
									if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && !ValveUtilities.AllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num4, num7, num8, num, ref returnMsg))
									{
										myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
										flag = true;
									}
									bool calculatedKw = myVM.Coeff_kw_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
									double[] orificeSizes = myVM.GetOrificeSizes(myVM.PRDType);
									int num10 = orificeSizes.Length - 1;
									for (int i = 0; i <= num10; i++)
									{
										orificeSizes[i] = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, orificeSizes[i], "SmallArea");
									}
									double inletLoss = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
									double CalcOrifice = default(double);
									double Coeff_Kv = default(double);
									switch (LiquidRelief.CalculateOrificeSize(ref CalcOrifice, ref Coeff_Kw, ref Coeff_Kv, num2, valveType, myVM.Api520Part1EditionSetting, coeff_Kc, coeff_Kd, calculatedKw, num4, overPress, num8, num, inletLoss, specGravity, fluidVisc, myVM.LiftRestriction, orificeSizes, ref returnMsg))
									{
									case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
										flag = true;
										myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
										break;
									case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
										myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
										return;
									}
									if (!flag)
									{
										myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
									}
									else if (flag)
									{
										myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResWarn;
									}
									myVM.set_Coeff_Kv(notify: true, Coeff_Kv);
									if (myVM.Coeff_kw_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
									{
										myVM.Coeff_kw = Coeff_Kw;
									}
									myVM.set_CalcOrifice(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, myVM.UOMCalcOrifice, CalcOrifice, "SmallArea"));
									num8 -= num;
									myVM.set_TotBackPress(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMTotBackPress, num8, "GaugePressure"));
									maxAllowBackpressure -= num;
									myVM.set_MaxAllowBP(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, maxAllowBackpressure, "GaugePressure"));
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OrComp, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								}
								else
								{
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKd, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								}
							}
							else if (num3 == 0.0 || double.IsNaN(num3))
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							}
							else
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoFV, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoSG, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoRelFlow, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsNonCertifiedLiquidOrificeSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if ((myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) < 0.0) | double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RelFlow);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.RuptDisk && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_kw_opt != ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.Coeff_kw))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_kw);
					result = false;
				}
				else if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows && myVM.Coeff_kw != 1.0)
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.BadKw);
				}
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_Kp_opt != ProcessDataSource.Calculated && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kp(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kp);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true) <= 0.0)
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoKd);
				result = false;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop) && myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop != 0.0 && myVM.Coeff_Kp_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.WarnInletDPForNoncertifiedLiquid);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool AreNonCertifiedLiquidOrificeSizingPropertiesReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
			if (num < 0.0 || double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoRelFlow);
				return false;
			}
			if (myVM.get_SpecGravity(notify: true, byUser: false) <= 0.0 || double.IsNaN(myVM.get_SpecGravity(notify: true, byUser: false)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoSG);
				return false;
			}
			if (myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false) <= 0.0 || double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoFV);
				return false;
			}
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			if (num2 == 0.0 || double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVSP);
				return false;
			}
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegVSP);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void CalculateNonCertifiedLiquidOrificeSize()
		{
			CalculateLiquidReliefProperties(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			if (!AreNonCertifiedLiquidOrificeSizingPropertiesReady([SpecialName] (MessageLevel level, string msg) =>
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(level, msg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			}))
			{
				return;
			}
			double relievingFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure") + num;
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
			double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
			double num6 = ValveUtilities.CalcTotBackPress(num3, num4, num5);
			double p = ConvertToHysysUnits("AbsolutePressure", num6, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psi);
			double t = ConvertToHysysUnits("Temperature", myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true));
			if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlash(t, p) && !double.IsNaN(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.Temperature()))
			{
				if ((PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction() > 0.0) & (myVM.get_RelVaporMassFraction(notify: true) == 0.0))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.PRD_LiquidFlash, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.FlashFailed, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			}
			double Coeff_Kw = myVM.Coeff_kw;
			if (myVM.Coeff_kw_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated && myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
			{
				Coeff_Kw = 1.0;
			}
			double coeff_Kc = myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true);
			if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk || !myVM.RuptDisk)
			{
				coeff_Kc = 1.0;
			}
			ValveTypeEnum valveType = _ConvertPsvTypeToValveType(myVM.ValveType ?? PsvType.Conventional);
			bool flag = false;
			myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct(notify: false);
			double inletLoss = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			double num7 = myVM.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true);
			double maxAllowBackpressure = ValveUtilities.GetMaxAllowBackpressure(valveType, num7, num2, num3 + num4, num);
			string returnMsg = null;
			if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && !ValveUtilities.AllowBackpressure(valveType, num7, num2, num5, num6, num, ref returnMsg))
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.ExceededBPLimit, num7), MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				flag = true;
			}
			double CalcOrifice = double.NaN;
			double Coeff_Kp = myVM.get_Coeff_Kp(notify: true);
			double Coeff_Kv = myVM.get_Coeff_Kv(notify: true);
			double[] orificeSizes = myVM.GetOrificeSizes(myVM.PRDType);
			switch (LiquidRelief.CalculateOrificeSizeNonCertified(ref CalcOrifice, ref Coeff_Kw, ref Coeff_Kp, ref Coeff_Kv, relievingFlow, valveType, myVM.Api520Part1EditionSetting, coeff_Kc, myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true), myVM.Coeff_kw_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated, myVM.Coeff_Kp_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated, num2, myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true), num6, num, inletLoss, myVM.get_SpecGravity(notify: true, byUser: false), myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false), myVM.LiftRestriction, orificeSizes.ToArray(), ref returnMsg))
			{
			case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				return;
			case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				flag = true;
				break;
			default:
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(returnMsg))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResWarn;
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
			}
			myVM.set_Coeff_Kv(notify: true, Coeff_Kv);
			if (myVM.Coeff_kw_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				myVM.Coeff_kw = Coeff_Kw;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_Kp_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				myVM.set_Coeff_Kp(notify: true, Coeff_Kp);
			}
			myVM.set_CalcOrifice(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, myVM.UOMCalcOrifice, CalcOrifice, "SmallArea"));
			myVM.set_TotBackPress(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMTotBackPress, num6 - num, "GaugePressure"));
			myVM.set_MaxAllowBP(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, maxAllowBackpressure - num, "GaugePressure"));
			myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OrComp, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
		}

		private ValveTypeEnum _ConvertPsvTypeToValveType(PsvType psvType)
		{
			return psvType switch
			{
				PsvType.Conventional => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
				PsvType.BalancedBellows => ValveTypeEnum.BalancedBellows, 
				PsvType.PilotOperated => ValveTypeEnum.PilotOperated, 
				_ => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
			};
		}

		public bool IsLiquidLineSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			return IsCommonLineSizingReady(MessageHandler);
		}

		public void CalculateLiquidLineSize()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			_ = myVM.OutAvgVel;
			UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
			double upratedFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMUpratedFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, myVM.get_LineSizingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
			if (myVM.OutID > 0.0)
			{
				double outID = myVM.OutID;
				if (myVM.InID > 0.0)
				{
					double inID = myVM.InID;
					if (myVM.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true) > 0.0)
					{
						myVM.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true);
						if (myVM.SelectOrifice > 0.0)
						{
							_ = myVM.SelectOrifice;
							UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
							UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
							UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
							CalculateLiquidReliefProperties(MessageLocation.LineSizing);
							if (myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0)
							{
								double fluidVisc = myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false);
								double outRough = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRough, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.OutRough, "SmallLength");
								double inRough = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRough, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.InRough, "SmallLength");
								double outEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMEquivLength, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.OutEquivLength, "Length");
								double inEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMEquivLength, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.InEquivLength, "Length");
								double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
								UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
								string returnMsg = "";
								myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct();
								myVM.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true);
								double outAvgDensity = myVM.get_SpecGravity(notify: true, byUser: false) * 1000.0;
								double inAvgDensity = myVM.get_SpecGravity(notify: true, byUser: false) * 1000.0;
								double InPressDrop = default(double);
								double InAvgVelocity = default(double);
								double OutPressDrop = default(double);
								double OutAvgVelocity = default(double);
								if (LineSizing.LiquidSizeLines(ref InPressDrop, ref InAvgVelocity, ref OutPressDrop, ref OutAvgVelocity, inID, inAvgDensity, inEquivLength, inRough, outID, outAvgDensity, outRough, outEquivLength, upratedFlow, fluidVisc, ref returnMsg) == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
								{
									myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg);
									return;
								}
								myVM.InPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMPDrop, InPressDrop, "DeltaPressure");
								myVM.InCalcVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMCalcVel, InAvgVelocity, "Velocity");
								if (!flag)
								{
									if (Operators.CompareString(myVM.DataStatus, FormResource.ResWarn, TextCompare: false) != 0)
									{
										myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResLSErr;
								}
								myVM.OutCalcVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMCalcVel, OutAvgVelocity, "Velocity");
								myVM.OutPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMPDrop, OutPressDrop, "DeltaPressure");
								myVM.NotifyLineSizingMessagesPropertyChanged();
							}
							else
							{
								myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVisc);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.SelOr);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RunVS);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoPipeID);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoPipeID);
			}
		}

			return _WALLSCProps.Contains(propname);
		}
