		}

		public void CalculateLiquidLineSizingConstraints()
		{
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
			double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
			bool flag = Operators.CompareString(myVM.DataStatus, FormResource.ResAvail, TextCompare: false) == 0;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (myVM.SourceSPL > 155.0)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.AIVHighSPLforAPI);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMPDrop, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.InPDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMPDrop, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.OutPDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct();
			double num8 = num2 * myVM.InMaxPDropLimit / 100.0;
			myVM.InMaxPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMMaxPDrop, num8, "DeltaPressure");
			double num9 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.get_MaxAllowBP(notify: true), "GaugePressure") - (num3 + num4 - num);
			myVM.OutMaxPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMMaxPDrop, num9, "DeltaPressure");
			bool flag3 = num6 > num8;
			if (flag3 && myVM.PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				flag3 = false;
			}
			if (flag3 && ((PSVValveModel)myVM.OwnerPRD).IsRemoteSensingPilot && !double.IsNaN(myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop))
			{
				flag3 = false;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.MaxPDropError);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop) && BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(num6, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop))
			{
				string dPDisplayUnit = DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit;
				double num10 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, dPDisplayUnit, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
				double num11 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMPDrop, dPDisplayUnit, myVM.InPDrop, "DeltaPressure");
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.CalcInletPDrop, num11, dPDisplayUnit, num10, dPDisplayUnit));
				flag2 = true;
				flag3 = true;
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.PDropOK);
			}
			bool flag4 = true;
			if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				if (num7 > num9)
				{
					flag4 = false;
					myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OutletBack);
				}
				if (num7 > num5)
				{
					flag4 = false;
					string dPDisplayUnit2 = DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit;
					double num12 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, dPDisplayUnit2, num7, "DeltaPressure");
					double num13 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, dPDisplayUnit2, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
					myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.CalcPDrop, num12, dPDisplayUnit2, num13, dPDisplayUnit2));
				}
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OutletOK);
			}
			if (flag && (!flag4 || flag2))
			{
				myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResLSErr;
			}
			myVM.NotifyLineSizingMessagesPropertyChanged();
		}

		public bool CalculateMixedAAndBReliefProperties(MessageLocation location, bool notify = false)
		{
			double num = myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true);
			double num2 = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
			double value = num * (1.0 + num2 / 100.0);
			string unitValue = myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true);
			value = ConvertToHysysUnits("GaugePressure", value, unitValue, myVM.AtmPress, myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true));
			if (!CalculateReliefPropertiesCommon(ExpectedPhase.Mixed, location, notify))
			{
				return false;
			}
			myVM.set_RelVaporMassFraction(notify, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction());
			myVM.set_RelDensity(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.OverallDensity());
			myVM.set_SpecHeatRatio(notify: false, byUser: false, GetSelectedCpCv(mPPPFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting));
			myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction() * PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMolecularWeight() + (1.0 - PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction()) * PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight());
			FluidPhaseRegime phaseFromVaporFraction = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction());
			if (phaseFromVaporFraction == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor || phaseFromVaporFraction == FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical)
			{
				myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify, byUser: false, double.NaN);
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidViscosity());
			}
			if (phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid)
			{
				myVM.set_RelCompress(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporZFactor());
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.set_RelCompress(notify, byUser: false, double.NaN);
			}
			myVM.set_h_vlo(notify: true, byUser: false, double.NaN);
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_kPa, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && num3 != 0.0)
			{
				value -= num3;
				if (!PhysicalPropPkgFluid.IsenthalpicFlash(value))
				{
					return false;
				}
				phaseFromVaporFraction = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction());
			}
			double value2 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction();
			myVM.set_xo(notify, value2);
			double num4 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassDensity();
			double num5 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
			double num6 = 1.0 / num4;
			double num7 = 1.0 / num5;
			switch (phaseFromVaporFraction)
			{
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
				myVM.set_vo(notify: true, num6);
				break;
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
				myVM.set_vo(notify: true, num7);
				break;
			default:
				myVM.set_vo(notify: true, myVM.get_xo(notify: true) * num6 + (1.0 - myVM.get_xo(notify: true)) * num7);
				break;
			}
			double num8 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassHeatCapacity();
			myVM.set_Cp(notify: true, byUser: false, num8 / 4.1868);
			if (!PhysicalPropPkgFluid.IsenthalpicFlash(0.9 * value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			phaseFromVaporFraction = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction());
			value2 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction();
			num4 = 1.0 / PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassDensity();
			num5 = 1.0 / PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
			switch (phaseFromVaporFraction)
			{
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
				myVM.v9 = num4;
				break;
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
				myVM.v9 = num5;
				break;
			default:
				myVM.v9 = value2 * num4 + (1.0 - value2) * num5;
				break;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsMixedAAndBOrificeSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = IsCommonOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
			if ((myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) < 0.0) | double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RelFlow);
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMRelFlow);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.RuptDisk && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_kb);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void CalculateMixedAAndBOrificeSize()
		{
			string returnMsg = "";
			bool flag = false;
			if (myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) >= 0.0)
			{
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
				num /= GetCapUncertFact();
				double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "Temperature");
				if (num2 <= 0.0)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RelTemp0, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					return;
				}
				double num3 = ((Operators.CompareString(myVM.UOMDesTemp, "", TextCompare: false) == 0) ? num2 : UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMDesTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.DesTemp, "Temperature"));
				if (num3 <= 0.0)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.DesTempLow, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					return;
				}
				CalculateMixedAAndBReliefProperties(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				if ((myVM.get_xo(notify: true) == 1.0) | (myVM.get_xo(notify: true) == 0.0))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.MixedModelSinglePhase, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					return;
				}
				double num4 = Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.psi);
				double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
				if (num5 > 0.0 - num4)
				{
					double num6 = num5 + num4;
					double lowSetPressLimit = 50.0;
					double overPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
					double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
					double num8 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
					double num9 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
					if (myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true) > 0.0)
					{
						double coeff_Kd = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true);
						double Coeff_Kb = default(double);
						if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
						{
							if (myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true) == 0.0)
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								return;
							}
							Coeff_Kb = myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true);
							if (myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true) != 1.0 && myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.BadKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							}
						}
						else if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
						{
							Coeff_Kb = 1.0;
						}
						double coeff_Kc;
						if (myVM.PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && myVM.RuptDisk)
						{
							if (!(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true) > 0.0))
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKc, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								return;
							}
							coeff_Kc = myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true);
						}
						else
						{
							coeff_Kc = 1.0;
						}
						double xo = myVM.get_xo(notify: true);
						double v_vo = double.NaN;
						double v_lo = double.NaN;
						double vo = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOM_vo, UnitStrings.MassVolume_ft3lb, myVM.get_vo(notify: true), "Volume");
						double h_vlo = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOM_h_vlo, UnitStrings.MassEnthalpy_Btulb, myVM.get_h_vlo(notify: true, byUser: false), "MassEnthalpy");
						double cp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOM_Cp, UnitStrings.Cp_EN, myVM.get_Cp(notify: true, byUser: false), "CoeffCp");
						double v = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOM_v9, UnitStrings.MassVolume_ft3lb, myVM.v9, "Volume");
						short opt_150_State = 2;
						ValveTypeEnum valveType = myVM.ValveType.GetValueOrDefault() switch
						{
							PsvType.Conventional => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
							PsvType.BalancedBellows => ValveTypeEnum.BalancedBellows, 
							PsvType.PilotOperated => ValveTypeEnum.PilotOperated, 
							_ => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
						};
						myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct(notify: false);
						double maxPercent = myVM.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true);
						double num10 = ValveUtilities.CalcTotBackPress(num7, num8, num9);
						double maxAllowBackpressure = ValveUtilities.GetMaxAllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num6, num7 + num8, num4);
						if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && !ValveUtilities.AllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num6, num9, num10, num4, ref returnMsg))
						{
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							flag = true;
						}
						bool flag2 = myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
						double inletLoss = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
						returnMsg = "";
						double CalcOrifice = default(double);
						double MassFlux = default(double);
						double CriticPress = default(double);
						double UpstrPress = default(double);
						double Omega = default(double);
						double Eta_calc = default(double);
						bool flowType_isCritical = default(bool);
						double specHeatRatio = default(double);
						CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = Mixed_Relief.CalculateOrificeSize_1(ref CalcOrifice, ref MassFlux, ref CriticPress, ref UpstrPress, ref Omega, ref Eta_calc, ref flowType_isCritical, num, num2, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, coeff_Kc, coeff_Kd, flag2, num6, lowSetPressLimit, overPress, num4, inletLoss, num10, specHeatRatio, opt_150_State, xo, v_vo, v_lo, cp, vo, h_vlo, v, ref returnMsg);
						if (flag2)
						{
							myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, Coeff_Kb);
						}
						switch (calculationStatusEnum)
						{
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							flag = true;
							break;
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							return;
						}
						if (flowType_isCritical)
						{
							myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Critical;
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Subcritical;
						}
						myVM.Omega = Omega;
						myVM.Eta_c = Eta_calc;
						if (!flag)
						{
							myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
						}
						else if (flag)
						{
							myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResWarn;
						}
						myVM.MassFlux = MassFlux / 0.04;
						myVM.CriticalPressure = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.UOMCriticalPressure, CriticPress, "AbsolutePressure");
						myVM.UpstrPress = UpstrPress;
						myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, Coeff_Kb);
						myVM.set_CalcOrifice(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, myVM.UOMCalcOrifice, CalcOrifice, "SmallArea"));
						num10 -= num4;
						myVM.set_TotBackPress(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMTotBackPress, num10, "GaugePressure"));
						maxAllowBackpressure -= num4;
						myVM.set_MaxAllowBP(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, maxAllowBackpressure, "GaugePressure"));
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OrComp, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
						_ = myVM.SelectOrifice;
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKd, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					}
				}
				else if (num5 == 0.0 || double.IsNaN(num5))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
			}
			else if ((myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) == 0.0) & (myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated))
			{
				myVM.set_CalcOrifice(notify: true, 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoRelFlow, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			}
		}

		public bool IsOmegaLineSizingReady(OrificeSizingMethod calcOption, AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = IsCommonLineSizingReady(MessageHandler);
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.RatingValveArea))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoSelectedOrifice);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.RatingValveInSize))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.ValveInSize);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.RatingValveOutSize))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.ValveOutSize);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.UpstrPress))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UpstrPress);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.MassFlux))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.MassFlux);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.Omega))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Omega);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kd);
				result = false;
			}
			if (calcOption != OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOM_vo))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOM_vo);
					result = false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_vo(notify: true)))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.vo);
					result = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOM_Rho_l9))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOM_Rho_l9);
					result = false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(myVM.Rho_l9))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Rho_l9);
					result = false;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void CalculateMixedAAndBLineSize(OrificeSizingMethod calcOption)
		{
			string returnMsg = "";
			double g = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlux_lbhin2, UnitStrings.MassFlux_kgsm2, myVM.MassFlux, "MassFlux");
			double kd = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true);
			double vo;
			if (calcOption != OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3)
			{
				vo = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOM_vo, UnitStrings.MassVolume_m3kg, myVM.get_vo(notify: true), "Volume");
			}
			else
			{
				vo = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOM_Rho_l9, UnitStrings.MassDensity_kgm3, myVM.Rho_l9, "Density");
				vo = 1.0 / vo;
			}
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			num2 += num;
			num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_PaA, num2, "AbsolutePressure");
			double po = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_PaA, myVM.UpstrPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num3;
			if (Operators.CompareString(myVM.UOMSelectOrifice, UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				num3 = myVM.SelectOrifice * 0.00064516;
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(myVM.UOMSelectOrifice, UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				num3 = myVM.SelectOrifice * 0.155 * 0.00064516;
			}
			num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSelectOrifice, UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, myVM.RatingValveArea, "SmallArea");
			num3 *= 0.0001;
			if (myVM.get_UpratedFlow(notify: false) > 0.0)
			{
				double w = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMUpratedFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgs, myVM.get_UpratedFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
				double omega = myVM.Omega;
				double superImpConstBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				double superImpVarBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
				double varBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
				double ph2InID = myVM.Ph2InID;
				double ph2InK_Entrance = myVM.Ph2InK_Entrance;
				double ph2OutID = myVM.Ph2OutID;
				double INK_in = default(double);
				double Ph2InEquivLength = default(double);
				double Ph2OutEquivLength = default(double);
				bool Ph2Out_isChoked = default(bool);
				double iNK_pipe = default(double);
				switch (LineSizing.CalculateTwoPhaseLine_Leung(ref INK_in, ref Ph2InEquivLength, ref Ph2OutEquivLength, ref Ph2Out_isChoked, ph2InID, ph2OutID, iNK_pipe, ph2InK_Entrance, g, po, vo, kd, num3, num2, w, omega, superImpConstBackPress, superImpVarBackPress, varBackPress, ref returnMsg))
				{
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
					myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg);
					break;
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
					myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg);
					return;
				}
				if (Ph2Out_isChoked)
				{
					myVM.Ph2OutTypeFlow = FlowType.Critical;
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.Ph2OutTypeFlow = FlowType.Subcritical;
				}
				myVM.Ph2InK_In = INK_in;
				myVM.Ph2InEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_ft, myVM.Ph2InUOMEquivLength, Ph2InEquivLength, "Length");
				myVM.Ph2OutEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_ft, myVM.Ph2OutUOMEquivLength, Ph2OutEquivLength, "Length");
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.NoRelFlow);
			}
		}

		public void CalculateMixedCReliefProperties(MessageLocation location, bool notify = false)
		{
			double value = myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true);
			string unitValue = myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true);
			value = ConvertToHysysUnits("Temperature", value, unitValue);
			if (!CalculateReliefPropertiesCommon(ExpectedPhase.Liquid, location, notify))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
			myVM.set_SpecGravity(notify: true, byUser: false, num / 1000.0);
			myVM.Rho_l0 = num;
			double num2 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassHeatCapacity();
			myVM.set_Cp(notify: true, byUser: false, num2 / 4.1868);
			myVM.set_RelVaporMassFraction(notify, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction());
			if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction() == 0.0)
			{
				myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight());
			}
			else if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction() == 1.0)
			{
				myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMolecularWeight());
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction() * PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMolecularWeight() + (1.0 - PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction()) * PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight());
			}
			myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidViscosity());
			myVM.set_RelDensity(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.OverallDensity());
			double vf = 0.0;
			PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TVFlash(value, vf);
			double num3 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.Pressure();
			double appliedInletPressureDrop = myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop;
			double num4 = myVM.get_RelPress(notify: true);
			if (!double.IsNaN(appliedInletPressureDrop))
			{
				double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, num4 - appliedInletPressureDrop, "AbsolutePressure");
				if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(num3, num5))
				{
					double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit, num5, "AbsolutePressure");
					double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit, num3, "AbsolutePressure");
					string message = string.Format(FormResource.WarnInletDPSubcooled, num6, DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit, num7, DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit);
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message, location);
				}
			}
			myVM.set_Ps(notify: true, byUser: false, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, num3, "AbsolutePressure"));
			double num8 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMolecularWeight();
			myVM.set_h_vls(notify: true, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.HeatOfVaporization() * (1.0 / num8));
			PhysicalPropPkgFluid.IsentropicFlash(0.9 * num3);
			double num9 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction();
			double num10 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassDensity();
			double num11 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
			double num12 = 1.0 / num10;
			double num13 = 1.0 / num11;
			myVM.v9 = num9 * num12 + (1.0 - num9) * num13;
			myVM.Rho_l9 = 1.0 / myVM.v9;
		}

		public bool IsMixedCOrificeSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = IsCommonOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
			if ((myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) < 0.0) | double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RelFlow);
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMRelFlow);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.RuptDisk && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_kb);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void CalculateMixedCOrificeSize()
		{
			string returnMsg = "";
			bool flag = false;
			if (myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) >= 0.0)
			{
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
				num /= GetCapUncertFact();
				double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "Temperature");

					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RelTemp0, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);

					double num4 = Session.Instance.AmbientPressure.ValueIn(Units.psi);
					double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
					if (num5 > 0.0 - num4)
					{

						double num8 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
						double num9 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");

									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.BadKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								}
							}
							else if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
							{
								Coeff_Kb = 1.0;
							}
							double coeff_Kc;
							if (myVM.PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && myVM.RuptDisk)
							{
								if (!(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true) > 0.0))
								{
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKc, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
									return;
								}
								coeff_Kc = myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true);
							}
							else
							{
								coeff_Kc = 1.0;
							}
							double num10 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOM_Ps, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_Ps(notify: true, byUser: false), "AbsolutePressure");
							double v_vs = double.NaN;

							double cp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOM_Cp, UnitStrings.Cp_EN, myVM.get_Cp(notify: true, byUser: false), "CoeffCp");
							double rho_L = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOM_Rho_l9, UnitStrings.MassDensity_lbft3, myVM.Rho_l9, "Density");
							if (double.IsNaN(num10))
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.Ps, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								return;
							}
							short opt_150_state = 2;
							ValveTypeEnum valveType = myVM.ValveType.GetValueOrDefault() switch
							{
								PsvType.Conventional => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
								PsvType.BalancedBellows => ValveTypeEnum.BalancedBellows, 
								PsvType.PilotOperated => ValveTypeEnum.PilotOperated, 
								_ => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
							};
							myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct(notify: false);
							double maxPercent = myVM.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true);
							double num11 = ValveUtilities.CalcTotBackPress(num7, num8, num9);
							double maxAllowBackpressure = ValveUtilities.GetMaxAllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num6, num7 + num8, num4);
							if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && !ValveUtilities.AllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num6, num9, num11, num4, ref returnMsg))
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								flag = true;
							}
							bool flag2 = myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
							double inletLoss = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
							returnMsg = "";
							double CalcOrifice = default(double);
							double MassFlux = default(double);
							double CriticPress = default(double);
							double UpstrPress = default(double);
							double Omega_s = default(double);
							double Eta_c = default(double);
							bool flowType_isCritical = default(bool);
							CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = Mixed_Relief.CalculateOrificeSize_2(ref CalcOrifice, ref MassFlux, ref CriticPress, ref UpstrPress, ref Omega_s, ref Eta_c, ref flowType_isCritical, num, num2, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, coeff_Kc, coeff_Kd, flag2, num6, overPress, num4, inletLoss, num11, lowSetPressLimit, specGravity, opt_150_state, v_vs, v_ls, cp, num10, h_vls, rho_L, ref returnMsg);
							if (flag2)
							{
								myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, Coeff_Kb);
							}
							switch (calculationStatusEnum)
							{
							case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								flag = true;
								break;
							case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								return;
							}
							if (flowType_isCritical)
							{
								myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Critical;
							}
							else
							{
								myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Subcritical;
							}
							myVM.Omega = Omega_s;
							myVM.Eta_c = Eta_c;
							if (!flag)
							{
								myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
							}
							else if (flag)
							{
								myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResWarn;
							}
							myVM.MassFlux = MassFlux / 0.04;
							myVM.CriticalPressure = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.UOMCriticalPressure, CriticPress, "AbsolutePressure");

							maxAllowBackpressure -= num4;
							myVM.set_MaxAllowBP(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, maxAllowBackpressure, "GaugePressure"));

						{
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKd, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
						}
					}
					else if (num5 == 0.0)
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					}

					}

			else

			}
		}

		public bool CalculateMixedDirectReliefProperties(MessageLocation location, bool notify = false)
		{
			bool num = CalculateReliefPropertiesCommon(ExpectedPhase.DontCare, location, notify);
			if (num)
			{
				myVM.set_RelVaporMassFraction(notify, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction());
				FluidPhaseRegime phaseFromVaporFraction = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction());
				bool flag = false;
				if (!double.IsNaN(myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false)))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag || phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor)
				{
					myVM.set_SpecGravity(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity() / 1000.0);
				}
				if (flag || phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid)
				{
					myVM.set_RelCompress(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporZFactor());
					myVM.set_SpecHeatRatio(notify, byUser: false, GetSelectedCpCv(PhysicalPropPkgFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting));
				}
				if (phaseFromVaporFraction == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor || phaseFromVaporFraction == FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical)
				{
					myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporViscosity());
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidViscosity());
				}
				myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.OverallMolecularWeight());
				myVM.set_RelDensity(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.OverallDensity());
			}
			return num;
		}

		public bool IsMixedDirectOrificeSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{

			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RelFlow);
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMRelFlow);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.RuptDisk && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Kv(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Kv);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_kb);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void CalculateMixedDirectOrificeSize()
		{
			string returnMsg = null;
			bool flag = false;
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			checked
			{
				if (myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) >= 0.0)
				{
					double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
					num2 /= GetCapUncertFact();
					double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "TankTemperature");
					if (myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true) == double.NaN)
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoRelTemp, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
						return;
					}
					if (num3 <= 0.0)
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RelTemp0, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
						return;
					}
					double num4 = ((Operators.CompareString(myVM.UOMDesTemp, "", TextCompare: false) == 0) ? num3 : UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMDesTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.DesTemp, "TankTemperature"));
					if (num4 <= 0.0)
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.DesTempLow, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
						return;
					}
					CalculateMixedDirectReliefProperties(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					double num5 = myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true);
					if (num5 > 0.0)
					{
						double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, num5, "GaugePressure") + num;
						double num7 = ((!IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief) ? myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true) : myVM.GetFullFlowOverpressurePctForFire());
						double num8 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
						double num9 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
						double num10 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "AbsolutePressure");
						if (myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true) > 0.0)
						{
							double coeff_Kd = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true);
							double Coeff_Kb = default(double);
							if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
							{
								if (myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true) == 0.0)
								{
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKw, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
									return;
								}
								Coeff_Kb = myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true);
								if (myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true) != 1.0)
								{
									if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
									{
										myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.BadKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
									}
									else if (myVM.EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire && myVM.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) == FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted)
									{
										myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UnWetFireKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
									}
								}
							}
							else if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
							{
								Coeff_Kb = 1.0;
							}
							double coeff_Kc;
							if (myVM.PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && myVM.RuptDisk)
							{
								if (!(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true) > 0.0))
								{
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKc, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
									return;
								}
								coeff_Kc = myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true);
							}
							else
							{
								coeff_Kc = 1.0;
							}
							if (myVM.get_Coeff_Kv(notify: true) > 0.0)
							{
								double coeff_Kv = myVM.get_Coeff_Kv(notify: true);
								double num11 = (num6 - num) * (1.0 + num7 / 100.0) + num;
								myVM.UpstrPress = num11;
								ValveTypeEnum valveType = myVM.ValveType.GetValueOrDefault() switch
								{
									PsvType.Conventional => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
									PsvType.BalancedBellows => ValveTypeEnum.BalancedBellows, 
									PsvType.PilotOperated => ValveTypeEnum.PilotOperated, 
									_ => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
								};
								myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct(notify: false);
								double maxPercent = myVM.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true);
								bool flag2 = myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
								double num12 = ValveUtilities.CalcTotBackPress(num8, num9, num10);
								double maxAllowBackpressure = ValveUtilities.GetMaxAllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num6, num8 + num9, num);
								if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && !ValveUtilities.AllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num6, num10, num12, num, ref returnMsg))
								{
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
									flag = true;
								}
								double num13 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
								if (!double.IsNaN(num13) && IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief)
								{
									double value = num11 - num13;
									double pout = ConvertToHysysUnits("AbsolutePressure", value, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA);
									PhysicalPropPkgFluid.IsenthalpicFlash(pout);
								}
								List<Mixed_Relief.DirectIntegrationStep> list = new List<Mixed_Relief.DirectIntegrationStep>();
								returnMsg = "";
								double CalcOrifice = default(double);
								bool flowType_isCritical = default(bool);
								double MassFlux_Design = default(double);
								CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = Mixed_Relief.CalculateOrificeSize_4(ref CalcOrifice, ref flowType_isCritical, ref MassFlux_Design, list, num2, num3, myVM.get_VaporFraction(notify: true, byUser: false), valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, coeff_Kc, coeff_Kd, coeff_Kv, flag2, num6, num7, num12, num11, num13, PhysicalPropPkgFluid, IsWettedFireCalculation, !IsWettedFireTwoPhaseRelief, ref returnMsg);
								if (flag2)
								{
									myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, Coeff_Kb);
								}
								switch (calculationStatusEnum)
								{
								case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
									return;
								case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
									flag = true;
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
									break;
								}
								int num14 = 0;
								foreach (Mixed_Relief.DirectIntegrationStep item in list)
								{
									num14++;
									myVM.CreateDirectIntegrationStep(num14, item);
								}
								if (!flag)
								{
									myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
								}
								else if (flag)
								{
									myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResWarn;
								}
								if (flowType_isCritical)
								{
									myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Critical;
									myVM.CriticalPressure = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.UOMCriticalPressure, list[list.Count - 2].Pressure, "AbsolutePressure");
								}
								else
								{
									myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Subcritical;
									myVM.CriticalPressure = double.NaN;
								}
								if (flag2)
								{
									myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, Coeff_Kb);
								}
								myVM.MassFlux = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlux_lbsft2, UnitStrings.MassFlux_lbhin2, MassFlux_Design, "MassFlux");
								myVM.set_CalcOrifice(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, myVM.UOMCalcOrifice, CalcOrifice, "SmallArea"));
								num12 -= num;
								myVM.set_TotBackPress(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMTotBackPress, num12, "GaugePressure"));
								maxAllowBackpressure -= num;
								myVM.set_MaxAllowBP(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, maxAllowBackpressure, "GaugePressure"));
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OrComp, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							}
							else
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKv, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKd, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
						}
					}
					else if (num5 == 0.0)
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					}
				}
				else if ((myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) == 0.0) & (myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated))
				{
					myVM.set_CalcOrifice(notify: true, 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoRelFlow, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
			}
		}

		public void CalculateMixedDirectLineSize()
		{
			if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			if (myVM.PL2SetPress > 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOMSetPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.PL2SetPress, "GaugePressure") + num;
				double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMUpratedFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, myVM.get_LineSizingFlow(notify: false), "MassFlow");
				if (myVM.PL2OverPress >= 0.0)
				{
					_ = myVM.PL2OverPress;
					if (UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOMRelievingTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.PL2RelievingTemp, "Temperature") < -273.15)
					{
						myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RelTempLow);
						return;
					}
					double num4 = myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress + myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress;
					if (num4 > 0.0)
					{
						num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOMBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, num4, "AbsolutePressure");
						if (!CalculateMixedDirectReliefProperties(MessageLocation.LineSizing))
						{
							return;
						}
						myVM.PL2_In_VapQual = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction();
						if (myVM.PL2_In_VapQual != double.NaN)
						{
							double pL2_In_VapQual = myVM.PL2_In_VapQual;
							FluidPhaseRegime phaseFromVaporFraction = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction());
							double pL2_In_LiqDens = default(double);
							double pL2_In_LiqFluidVisc = default(double);
							if (phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor && phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical)
							{
								myVM.PL2_In_LiqDens = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
								if (!(myVM.PL2_In_LiqDens > 0.0))
								{
									myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoLiqDen);
									return;
								}
								pL2_In_LiqDens = myVM.PL2_In_LiqDens;
								myVM.PL2_In_LiqFluidVisc = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidViscosity();
								if (!(myVM.PL2_In_LiqFluidVisc > 0.0))
								{
									myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoLiqVisc);
									return;
								}
								pL2_In_LiqFluidVisc = myVM.PL2_In_LiqFluidVisc;
							}
							double pL2_In_GasDens = default(double);
							double pL2_In_GasFluidVisc = default(double);
							if (phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid)
							{
								myVM.PL2_In_GasDens = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassDensity();
								if (!(myVM.PL2_In_GasDens > 0.0))
								{
									myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoGasDen);
									return;
								}
								pL2_In_GasDens = myVM.PL2_In_GasDens;
								myVM.PL2_In_GasFluidVisc = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporViscosity();
								if (!(myVM.PL2_In_GasFluidVisc > 0.0))
								{
									myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoGasVisc);
									return;
								}
								pL2_In_GasFluidVisc = myVM.PL2_In_GasFluidVisc;
							}
							double pout = num4 * 100.0;
							if (myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Wetted && myVM.get_RelTempSource(notify: true) != ReliefTemperatureSource.Rigorous)
							{
								PhysicalPropPkgFluid.IsentropicFlash(pout);
							}
							else
							{
								PhysicalPropPkgFluid.IsentropicFlashFire(pout);
							}
							myVM.PL2_Out_VapQual = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction();
							if (myVM.PL2_Out_VapQual != double.NaN)
							{
								double pL2_Out_VapQual = myVM.PL2_Out_VapQual;
								phaseFromVaporFraction = PSVDictionaries.GetPhaseFromVaporFraction(PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction());
								double pL2_Out_LiqDens = default(double);
								double viscLiq = default(double);
								if (phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor && phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical)
								{
									myVM.PL2_Out_LiqDens = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidMassDensity();
									if (!(myVM.PL2_Out_LiqDens > 0.0))
									{
										myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoLiqDenOut);
										return;
									}
									pL2_Out_LiqDens = myVM.PL2_Out_LiqDens;
									myVM.PL2_Out_LiqFluidVisc = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.LiquidViscosity();
									if (!(myVM.PL2_Out_LiqFluidVisc > 0.0))
									{
										myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoLiqVisOut);
										return;
									}
									viscLiq = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOM_Out_LiqFluidVisc, UnitStrings.Viscosity_cP, myVM.PL2_Out_LiqFluidVisc, "Viscosity");
								}
								double pL2_Out_GasDens = default(double);
								double pL2_Out_GasFluidVisc = default(double);
								if (phaseFromVaporFraction != FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid)
								{
									myVM.PL2_Out_GasDens = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassDensity();
									if (!(myVM.PL2_Out_GasDens > 0.0))
									{
										myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.GasDenOut);
										return;
									}
									pL2_Out_GasDens = myVM.PL2_Out_GasDens;
									myVM.PL2_Out_GasFluidVisc = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporViscosity();
									if (!(myVM.PL2_Out_GasFluidVisc > 0.0))
									{
										myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoGasVisOut);
										return;
									}
									pL2_Out_GasFluidVisc = myVM.PL2_Out_GasFluidVisc;
								}
								if (myVM.PL2_In_ID > 0.0)
								{
									double pL2_In_ID = myVM.PL2_In_ID;
									if (myVM.PL2_In_Rough > 0.0)
									{
										double rough = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOM_Rough, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.PL2_In_Rough, "SmallLength");
										if (myVM.PL2_In_EquivLength > 0.0)
										{
											double equivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOM_EquivLength, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.PL2_In_EquivLength, "Length");
											if (myVM.PL2_Out_ID > 0.0)
											{
												double pL2_Out_ID = myVM.PL2_Out_ID;
												if (myVM.PL2_Out_Rough > 0.0)
												{
													double rough2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOM_Rough, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.PL2_Out_Rough, "SmallLength");
													if (myVM.PL2_Out_EquivLength > 0.0)
													{
														double equivLength2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOM_EquivLength, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.PL2_Out_EquivLength, "Length");
														_ = myVM.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true) / 100.0;
														LinesPressDrop_2Ph(pL2_In_VapQual, pL2_In_GasDens, pL2_In_LiqDens, pL2_In_ID, num3, pL2_In_GasFluidVisc, pL2_In_LiqFluidVisc, equivLength, rough);
														if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.PL2UOM_Flow))
														{
															myVM.PL2_In_FLow = num3;
														}
														else
														{
															myVM.PL2_In_FLow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, myVM.PL2UOM_Flow, num3, "MassFlow");
														}
														if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.PL2UOM_PDrop))
														{
															myVM.PL2_In_PDrop = PressDrop;
														}
														else
														{
															myVM.PL2_In_PDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.PL2UOM_PDrop, PressDrop, "DeltaPressure");
														}
														if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.PL2UOM_AvgVel))
														{
															myVM.PL2_In_AvgVel = AvgVel;
														}
														else
														{
															myVM.PL2_In_AvgVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.PL2UOM_AvgVel, AvgVel, "Velocity");
														}
														if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.PL2UOM_RhoV2))
														{
															myVM.PL2_In_RhoV2 = AvgRhoV2;
														}
														else
														{
															myVM.PL2_In_RhoV2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.RhoV2_kgms2, myVM.PL2UOM_RhoV2, AvgRhoV2, "RhoV2");
														}
														LinesPressDrop_2Ph(pL2_Out_VapQual, pL2_Out_GasDens, pL2_Out_LiqDens, pL2_Out_ID, num3, pL2_Out_GasFluidVisc, viscLiq, equivLength2, rough2);
														myVM.PL2_Out_FLow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, myVM.PL2UOM_Flow, num3, "MassFlow");
														myVM.PL2_Out_AvgVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.PL2UOM_AvgVel, AvgVel, "Velocity");
														myVM.PL2_Out_RhoV2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.RhoV2_kgms2, myVM.PL2UOM_RhoV2, AvgRhoV2, "RhoV2");
														myVM.PL2_Out_PDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.PL2UOM_PDrop, PressDrop, "DeltaPressure");
													}
													else
													{
														myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.EquLenOut);
													}
												}
												else
												{
													myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoRoughOut);
												}
											}
											else
											{
												myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoOutID);
											}
										}
										else
										{
											myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.EquLenIn);
										}
									}
									else
									{
										myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoRoughIn);
									}
								}
								else
								{
									myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoInID);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVFOut);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVF);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoBackPres);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.EnterOverPr);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.EnterSetPres);
			}
		}

		public void CalculateMixedDirectLineSizingConstraints()
		{
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOMSetPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.PL2SetPress, "GaugePressure") + num;
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOM_PDrop, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.PL2_In_PDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.PL2UOM_PDrop, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.PL2_Out_PDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
			double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
			bool flag = Operators.CompareString(myVM.DataStatus, FormResource.ResAvail, TextCompare: false) == 0;
			bool flag2 = myVM.IsSPLWarning;
			double num8 = (num2 - num) * myVM.InMaxPDropLimit / 100.0;
			myVM.InMaxPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMMaxPDrop, num8, "DeltaPressure");
			double num9 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.get_MaxAllowBP(notify: true), "GaugePressure") - (num5 + num6 - num);
			myVM.OutMaxPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMMaxPDrop, num9, "DeltaPressure");
			bool flag3 = true;
			bool flag4 = num3 > num8;
			if (flag4 && myVM.PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				flag4 = false;
			}
			if (flag4 && ((PSVValveModel)myVM.OwnerPRD).IsRemoteSensingPilot && !double.IsNaN(myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop))
			{
				flag4 = false;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.MaxPDropError);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop) && BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(num3, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop))
			{
				string dPDisplayUnit = DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit;
				double num10 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, dPDisplayUnit, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
				double num11 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMPDrop, dPDisplayUnit, myVM.InPDrop, "DeltaPressure");
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.CalcInletPDrop, num11, dPDisplayUnit, num10, dPDisplayUnit));
				flag2 = true;
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (!flag4)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.InletOK);
			}
			if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				if (num4 > num9)
				{
					flag3 = false;
					myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OutletBack);
				}
				if (num4 > num7)
				{
					flag3 = false;
					string dPDisplayUnit2 = DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit;
					double num12 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, dPDisplayUnit2, myVM.OutPDrop, "DeltaPressure");
					double num13 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, dPDisplayUnit2, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
					myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.CalcPDrop, num12, dPDisplayUnit2, num13, dPDisplayUnit2));
				}
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OutletOK);
			}
			if (flag && (!flag3 || flag2))
			{

		public bool IsHydraulicsLineSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (myVM.OwnerPRD.InletPipe.ValidatePiping((RigorousLineRating)myVM.LineRating, MessageHandler, FormResource.col_InletPipe) != CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.OwnerPRD.OutletPipe.ValidatePiping((RigorousLineRating)myVM.LineRating, MessageHandler, FormResource.col_OutPipe) != CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationOK)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(myVM.ChosenStream))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RigPipe_NoStream);
				result = false;
			}
			if (!IsReliefPropertiesReady(MessageHandler))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			if (!IsCommonLineSizingFlowReady(MessageHandler))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

				}
				else

		private (double velocity, double density) _CalculatePortDetails(IPort port)
		{
			double num = Math.PI / 4.0 * Math.Pow(port.Diameter.Value, 2.0);
			double value = port.FlowStream.GetPhaseByID(0).Density.Value;
			double item = port.FlowStream.MassFlowrate.Value / num / value;
			return (velocity: item, density: value);
		}

		private double _CalculatePortSonicVelocity(IPort port, IPhysicalPropertyPackage pkg, double refCritFlowPressure, double refOutletPressure, double expectedVaporFraction)
		{
			double value = port.FlowStream.GetPhaseByID(0).Enthalpy.Value;
			pkg.ReflashStreamWithSameComposition(port.FlowStream, (FlashType)2, refCritFlowPressure, value);
			if ((expectedVaporFraction == 0.0 || expectedVaporFraction == 1.0) && MyMath.ValuesDiffer(expectedVaporFraction, port.FlowStream.GetPhaseByID(0).MolarVapourFraction.Value, 1E-06, 1E-12) && refCritFlowPressure < refOutletPressure)
			{
				try
				{
					pkg.ReflashStreamWithSameComposition(port.FlowStream, (FlashType)4, refCritFlowPressure, expectedVaporFraction);
				}
				catch (Exception projectError)
				{
					ProjectData.SetProjectError(projectError);
					pkg.ReflashStreamWithSameComposition(port.FlowStream, (FlashType)2, refCritFlowPressure, value);
					ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
				}
			}
			return HTFSUtility.CalcSonicVelocity(pkg, port.FlowStream);
		}

		private LiquidGasMethodResult _CheckForLiquidFlowWithGasMethod(IFlowStream stream)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (stream.GetPhaseByID(0).MolarVapourFraction.Value > 0.5)
			{
				return LiquidGasMethodResult.Calculate;
			}
			foreach (IUnitOp item in (IEnumerable<IUnitOp>)Network.UnitOps)
			{
				if (!(item is PipeSegment))
				{
					continue;
				}
				MethodType val = (MethodType)((IEnumProperty)((UnitOpSolver)(PipeSegmentSS)item.SolverUnitOp).UnitOpSolverData.GetItem(0)).Value;
				if ((int)val == 14 || (int)val == 13)
				{
					if (System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(FormResource.RigPipe_VaporMethodWithLiquidPresent, myVM.ScenarioName, TranslateUiStrings.PressureDropCorrelation.StringValue((MethodType)14), TranslateUiStrings.PressureDropCorrelation.StringValue((MethodType)13)), FormResource.RigPipe_VaporMethodWithLiquidPresent_Title, MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation, MessageBoxResult.No) == MessageBoxResult.No)
					{
						return LiquidGasMethodResult.Cancel;
					}
					return LiquidGasMethodResult.Calculate;
				}
			}
			return LiquidGasMethodResult.Calculate;
		}

		private bool _IsNegligibleSegment(PipeSegment segment)
		{
			if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValuesAreClose(segment.Length.Value, 0.001) && BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValuesAreClose(segment.FittingCoeffA.Value, 0.0))
			{
				return BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValuesAreClose(segment.FittingCoeffB.Value, 0.0);
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		private void _LogAndPostError(Exception ex, string failMsg = null)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IStringProperty val = (IStringProperty)((CSolver)NetworkSolver).SolverStatus[5];
			string text = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(val.Value))
			{
				text = val.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				text = FormResource.RigPipe_HydraulicsErrorPrefix;
				while (ex != null)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ex.Message))
					{
						text = text + "\r\n" + ex.Message;
					}
					ex = ex.InnerException;
				}
			}
			ILoggerFacade val2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ILoggerFacade>(myVM.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				val2.Log(text, (Category)0, (Priority)3);
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(failMsg))
			{
				failMsg = FormResource.RigPipe_CalculationFailed;
			}
			myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, failMsg);
		}

		private void _CalculateSourceSPL()
		{
			if (FlashToReliefConditions(ExpectedPhase.DontCare, MessageLocation.LineSizing))
			{
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure") + UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
				double totalBackpressure_bara = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure") + num;
				string msg = null;
				double CalcSPL = double.NaN;
				if (LineSizing.CalculateSourceSoundPowerLevel(ref CalcSPL, myVM.get_LineSizingFlow(notify: true), mPPPFluid, totalBackpressure_bara, myVM.AIVMixedPhaseSetting, myVM.AIVMixedPhaseVaporFractionSetting, myVM.AIVMixedPhaseVaporFractionLimitPct / 100.0, ref msg) == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
				{
					myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, msg);
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(msg))
				{
					myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, msg);
				}
				myVM.SourceSPL = CalcSPL;
				if (myVM.SourceSPL > 155.0)
				{
					myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.AIVHighSPLforAPI);
					myVM.IsSPLWarning = true;
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.IsSPLWarning = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsSteamOrificeSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			bool result = IsCommonOrificeSizingReady(MessageHandler);
			if (((myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) < 0.0) | double.IsNaN(myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true))) & (myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) != ProcessDataSource.Calculated))

				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.RelFlow);
				result = false;
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow))
				{
					MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UOMRelFlow);
					result = false;
				}
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_Ksh_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_Ksh(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_Ksh);
				result = false;
			}
			if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified && double.IsNaN(myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true)))
			{
				MessageHandler(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Coeff_kb);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void CalculateSteamOrificeSize()
		{
			string returnMsg = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) >= 0.0)
			{
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
				num /= GetCapUncertFact();
				double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "Temperature");
				if (num2 <= 0.0)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RelTemp0, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					return;
				}
				CalculateSteamReliefProperties(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				double dCompress = default(double);
				double dMolWeight = default(double);
				double dSpecHeatRatio = default(double);
				CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = ValidateReliefProperties(ref dCompress, ref dMolWeight, ref dSpecHeatRatio, ref returnMsg);
				if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					return;
				}
				double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
				if (num4 > 0.0)
				{
					double num5 = num4 + num3;
					double overPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
					double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
					double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
					double num8 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
					if (myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true) > 0.0)
					{
						double coeff_Kd = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true);
						bool flag2;
						double Coeff_Kb = default(double);
						if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
						{
							flag2 = false;
							if (myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true) == 0.0)
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								return;
							}
							Coeff_Kb = myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true);
							if (myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true) != 1.0)
							{
								if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
								{
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.BadKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								}
								else if (myVM.EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire && myVM.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) == FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted)
								{
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UnWetFireKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
							{
								Coeff_Kb = 1.0;
							}
							flag2 = true;
						}
						double coeff_Kc;
						if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
						{
							coeff_Kc = 1.0;
						}
						else if (!myVM.RuptDisk)
						{
							coeff_Kc = 1.0;
						}
						else
						{
							if (!(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true) > 0.0))
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKc, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								return;
							}
							coeff_Kc = myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true);
						}
						double Coeff_Ksh;
						bool calculateKsh;
						if (myVM.Coeff_Ksh_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
						{
							if (!(myVM.get_Coeff_Ksh(notify: true) > 0.0))
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKsh, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								return;
							}
							Coeff_Ksh = myVM.get_Coeff_Ksh(notify: true);
							calculateKsh = false;
						}
						else
						{
							Coeff_Ksh = 1.0;
							calculateKsh = true;
						}
						double noiseDistance = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMNoiseDistance, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.NoiseDistance, "Length");
						ValveTypeEnum valveType = myVM.ValveType.GetValueOrDefault() switch
						{
							PsvType.Conventional => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
							PsvType.BalancedBellows => ValveTypeEnum.BalancedBellows, 
							PsvType.PilotOperated => ValveTypeEnum.PilotOperated, 
							_ => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
						};
						myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct(notify: false);
						double maxPercent = myVM.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true);
						double num9 = ValveUtilities.CalcTotBackPress(num6, num7, num8);
						double maxAllowBackpressure = ValveUtilities.GetMaxAllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num5, num6 + num7, num3);
						if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && !ValveUtilities.AllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num5, num8, num9, num3, ref returnMsg))
						{
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							flag = true;
						}
						double inletLoss = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
						returnMsg = "";
						double CalcOrifice = default(double);
						bool isFlowCritical = default(bool);
						double CriticPress = default(double);
						double Coeff_C = default(double);
						double Coeff_Kn = default(double);
						calculationStatusEnum = SteamRelief.CalculateOrificeSize(ref CalcOrifice, ref isFlowCritical, ref CriticPress, ref Coeff_C, num, num2, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, coeff_Kc, coeff_Kd, ref Coeff_Kn, ref Coeff_Ksh, flag2, calculateKsh, myVM.Api520Part1EditionSetting, num5, overPress, num3, inletLoss, num9, dSpecHeatRatio, dCompress, dMolWeight, ref returnMsg);
						if (flag2)
						{
							myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, Coeff_Kb);
						}
						double value = VaporRelief.CalculateNoise(noiseDistance, num, num2, dSpecHeatRatio, dMolWeight, num5, overPress, num9, num3);
						switch (calculationStatusEnum)
						{
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							flag = true;
							break;
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							return;
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
						}
						else if (flag)
						{
							myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResWarn;
						}
						myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, Coeff_Kb);
						myVM.set_Coeff_Ksh(notify: true, Coeff_Ksh);
						myVM.set_Coeff_Kn(notify: true, Coeff_Kn);
						if (isFlowCritical)
						{
							myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Critical;
							myVM.CriticalPressure = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.UOMCriticalPressure, CriticPress, "AbsolutePressure");
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Subcritical;
							myVM.CriticalPressure = double.NaN;
						}
						myVM.set_CalcOrifice(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, myVM.UOMCalcOrifice, CalcOrifice, "SmallArea"));
						num9 -= num3;
						myVM.set_TotBackPress(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMTotBackPress, num9, "GaugePressure"));
						maxAllowBackpressure -= num3;
						myVM.set_MaxAllowBP(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, maxAllowBackpressure, "GaugePressure"));
						myVM.set_Noise(notify: true, value);
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OrComp, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
						if (Operators.CompareString(myVM.UOMCalcOrifice, "", TextCompare: false) != 0)
						{
							_ = myVM.UOMCalcOrifice;
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoCOUN, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKd, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					}
				}
				else if (num4 == 0.0 || double.IsNaN(num4))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoRelFlow, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			}
		}
