		public void CalculateSteamLineSize()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			double relievingFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
			double upRatedFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMUpratedFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, myVM.get_LineSizingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
			double relievingTemp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "Temperature");
			double molWeight = myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false);
			if (myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0)
			{
				double specHeatRatio = myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false);
				if (myVM.OutID > 0.0)
				{
					double outID = myVM.OutID;
					if (myVM.InID > 0.0)
					{
						double inID = myVM.InID;
						if (myVM.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true) > 0.0)
						{
							myVM.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true);
							if (myVM.SelectOrifice > 0.0)
							{
								_ = myVM.SelectOrifice;
								double superImpConstBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
								double superImpVarBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
								double varBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
								if (myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0)
								{
									double fluidVisc = myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false);
									double outRough = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRough, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.OutRough, "SmallLength");
									double inRough = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRough, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.InRough, "SmallLength");
									double outEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMEquivLength, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.OutEquivLength, "Length");
									double inEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMEquivLength, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.InEquivLength, "Length");
									double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
									double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
									num2 += num;
									double compress = myVM.get_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false);
									string returnMsg = "";
									double InPressDrop = default(double);
									double InAvgDensity = default(double);
									double InAvgVelocity = default(double);
									double OutPressDrop = default(double);
									double OutAvgDensity = default(double);
									double OutAvgVelocity = default(double);
									double OutExitVelocity = default(double);
									double CritVel = default(double);
									double CriticPress = default(double);
									bool ChokedFlag = default(bool);
									if (LineSizing.VaporSizeLines(ref InPressDrop, ref InAvgDensity, ref InAvgVelocity, ref OutPressDrop, ref OutAvgDensity, ref OutAvgVelocity, ref OutExitVelocity, ref CritVel, ref CriticPress, ref ChokedFlag, inID, inEquivLength, inRough, outID, outEquivLength, outRough, upRatedFlow, relievingTemp, num2, specHeatRatio, compress, molWeight, fluidVisc, superImpConstBackPress, superImpVarBackPress, varBackPress, ref returnMsg) == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
									{
										myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg);
										return;
									}
									double inputVal = LineSizing.CalculateReactionForce(relievingFlow, relievingTemp, CriticPress, superImpConstBackPress, superImpVarBackPress, num, outID, specHeatRatio, molWeight);
									myVM.InPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMPDrop, InPressDrop, "DeltaPressure");
									myVM.InCalcVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMCalcVel, InAvgVelocity, "Velocity");
									double inputVal2 = InAvgDensity * Math.Pow(InAvgVelocity, 2.0);
									myVM.InRhoV2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.RhoV2_kgms2, myVM.UOMRhoV2, inputVal2, "RhoV2");
									if (ChokedFlag)
									{
										myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OutChoked);
									}
									if (!flag)
									{
										if (Operators.CompareString(myVM.DataStatus, FormResource.ResWarn, TextCompare: false) != 0)
										{
											myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
										}
									}
									else
									{
										myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResLSErr;
									}
									myVM.OutCalcVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMCalcVel, OutAvgVelocity, "Velocity");
									myVM.OutCritVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMOutCritVel, CritVel, "Velocity");
									double inputVal3 = OutAvgDensity * Math.Pow(OutAvgVelocity, 2.0);
									myVM.OutRhoV2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.RhoV2_kgms2, myVM.UOMRhoV2, inputVal3, "RhoV2");
									myVM.OutExitVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMOutExitVel, OutExitVelocity, "Velocity");
									myVM.LineSizingCriticalPressure = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.UOMCriticalPressure, CriticPress, "AbsolutePressure");
									myVM.ReactForces = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Force_N, myVM.UOMReactForces, inputVal, "Force");
									myVM.OutPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMPDrop, OutPressDrop, "DeltaPressure");
								}
								else
								{
									myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoFV);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.SelOr);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RunVS);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoPipeID);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoPipeID);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoK);
			}
		}

		private bool CalculateVaporReliefProperties(MessageLocation location, bool notify = false)
		{
			bool num = CalculateReliefPropertiesCommon(ExpectedPhase.Vapor, location, notify);
			if (num)
			{
				double value = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporZFactor();
				double selectedCpCv = GetSelectedCpCv(PhysicalPropPkgFluid, myVM.CpCvSelectionSetting);
				double value2 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
				double value3 = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporViscosity();
				myVM.set_RelVaporMassFraction(notify, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMassFraction());
				myVM.set_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false, value);
				myVM.set_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false, value3);
				myVM.set_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false, value2);
				myVM.set_RelDensity(notify, byUser: false, PhysicalPropPkgFluid.OverallDensity());
				myVM.set_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false, selectedCpCv);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void CalculateVaporOrificeSize()
		{
			string returnMsg = "";
			bool flag = false;
			mPPPFluid.ResetFluid();
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.OperPress, "GaugePressure");
			UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMOperTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.OperTemp, "Temperature");
			double num2 = default(double);
			if (myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) >= 0.0)
			{
				num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_lbh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
				num2 /= GetCapUncertFact();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!((myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated) & (myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true) == 0.0)))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoRelFlow, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					return;
				}
				myVM.set_CalcOrifice(notify: true, 0.0);
			}
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "TankTemperature");
			if (num3 <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.RelTemp0, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				return;
			}
			double num4 = ((Operators.CompareString(myVM.UOMDesTemp, "", TextCompare: false) == 0) ? num3 : UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMDesTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_R, myVM.DesTemp, "TankTemperature"));
			if (num4 <= 0.0)
			{
				myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.DesTempLow, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!CalculateVaporReliefProperties(MessageLocation.OrificeCalc))
				{
					return;
				}
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel;
				double dCompress = (pSVScenarioModel = myVM).get_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false);
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel2;
				double dMolWeight = (pSVScenarioModel2 = myVM).get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false);
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel3;
				double dSpecHeatRatio = (pSVScenarioModel3 = myVM).get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false);
				CalculationStatusEnum num5 = ValidateReliefProperties(ref dCompress, ref dMolWeight, ref dSpecHeatRatio, ref returnMsg);
				pSVScenarioModel3.set_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false, dSpecHeatRatio);
				pSVScenarioModel2.set_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false, dMolWeight);
				pSVScenarioModel.set_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false, dCompress);
				CalculationStatusEnum calculationStatusEnum = num5;
				if (calculationStatusEnum == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					return;
				}
				double num6 = myVM.get_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false);
				double molWeight = myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false);
				double specHeatRatio = myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false);
				if (myVM.EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire && myVM.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true).HasValue && myVM.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) == FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted && myVM.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
				{
					num6 = 1.0;
				}
				if (num6 < 0.8 || num6 > 1.1)
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.Vapor_NonIdealGas, num6, 0.8, 1.1), MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
				double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
				if (num7 > 0.0)
				{
					double num8 = num7 + num;
					double lowSetPressLimit = 50.0;
					double overPress = myVM.get_OverPress(notify: true, DoChainUpdates: true);
					double num9 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
					double num10 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
					double num11 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "AbsolutePressure");
					if (myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true) > 0.0)
					{
						double coeff_Kd = myVM.get_Coeff_Kd(notify: true);
						bool flag2;
						double Coeff_Kb = default(double);
						if (myVM.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified)
						{
							flag2 = false;
							if (myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true) == 0.0)
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								return;
							}
							Coeff_Kb = myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true);
							if (myVM.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true) != 1.0)
							{
								if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
								{
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.BadKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								}
								else if (myVM.EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire && myVM.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) == FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted)
								{
									myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.UnWetFireKb, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (myVM.ValveType != PsvType.BalancedBellows)
							{
								Coeff_Kb = 1.0;
							}
							flag2 = true;
						}
						double coeff_Kc;
						if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
						{
							coeff_Kc = 1.0;
						}
						else if (!myVM.RuptDisk)
						{
							coeff_Kc = 1.0;
						}
						else
						{
							if (!(myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true) > 0.0))
							{
								myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKc, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
								return;
							}
							coeff_Kc = myVM.get_Coeff_Kc(notify: true);
						}
						double noiseDistance = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMNoiseDistance, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.NoiseDistance, "Length");
						ValveTypeEnum valveType = myVM.ValveType.GetValueOrDefault() switch
						{
							PsvType.Conventional => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
							PsvType.BalancedBellows => ValveTypeEnum.BalancedBellows, 
							PsvType.PilotOperated => ValveTypeEnum.PilotOperated, 
							_ => ValveTypeEnum.Conventional, 
						};
						myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct(notify: false);
						double maxPercent = myVM.get_MaxAllowBPPercent(notify: true);
						double num12 = ValveUtilities.CalcTotBackPress(num9, num10, num11);
						double maxAllowBackpressure = ValveUtilities.GetMaxAllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num8, num9 + num10, num);
						if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && !ValveUtilities.AllowBackpressure(valveType, maxPercent, num8, num11, num12, num, ref returnMsg))
						{
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							flag = true;
						}
						double inletLoss = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_psi, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
						returnMsg = "";
						double CriticPress = double.NaN;
						double CalcOrifice = default(double);
						bool isCriticalFlow = default(bool);
						double Coeff_C = default(double);
						calculationStatusEnum = VaporRelief.CalculateOrificeSize(ref CalcOrifice, ref isCriticalFlow, ref CriticPress, ref Coeff_C, num2, num3, valveType, ref Coeff_Kb, coeff_Kc, coeff_Kd, flag2, num8, overPress, num, inletLoss, num12, lowSetPressLimit, specHeatRatio, num6, molWeight, ref returnMsg);
						if (flag2)
						{
							myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, Coeff_Kb);
						}
						double value = VaporRelief.CalculateNoise(noiseDistance, num2, num3, specHeatRatio, molWeight, num8, overPress, num12, num);
						switch (calculationStatusEnum)
						{
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							flag = true;
							break;
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
							myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
							return;
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
						}
						else if (flag)
						{
							myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResWarn;
						}
						myVM.set_Coeff_C(notify: true, Coeff_C);
						if (flag2)
						{
							myVM.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, Coeff_Kb);
						}
						if (isCriticalFlow)
						{
							myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Critical;
							myVM.CriticalPressure = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_psiA, myVM.UOMCriticalPressure, CriticPress, "AbsolutePressure");
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.TypeFlow = FlowType.Subcritical;
							myVM.CriticalPressure = double.NaN;
						}
						myVM.set_CalcOrifice(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_in2, myVM.UOMCalcOrifice, CalcOrifice, "SmallArea"));
						num12 -= num;
						myVM.set_TotBackPress(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMTotBackPress, num12, "GaugePressure"));
						maxAllowBackpressure -= num;
						myVM.set_MaxAllowBP(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, maxAllowBackpressure, "GaugePressure"));
						myVM.set_Noise(notify: true, value);
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OrComp, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoKd, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
					}
				}
				else if (num7 == 0.0 || double.IsNaN(num7))
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddScenarioMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NegVSP, MessageLocation.OrificeCalc);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsVaporLineSizingReady(AddMessageDelegate MessageHandler)
		{
			return IsCommonLineSizingReady(MessageHandler);
		}

		public void CalculateVaporLineSize()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			_ = myVM.OutAvgVel;
			double relievingFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRelievingFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, myVM.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
			double upRatedFlow = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMUpratedFlow, UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, myVM.get_LineSizingFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");
			double relievingTemp = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMRelTemp(notify: true), UnitStrings.Temp_C, myVM.get_RelTemp(notify: true), "Temperature");
			if (!CalculateVaporReliefProperties(MessageLocation.LineSizing))
			{
				return;
			}
			double molWeight = myVM.get_RelMolWeight(notify: true, byUser: false);
			if (myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0)
			{
				double specHeatRatio = myVM.get_SpecHeatRatio(notify: true, byUser: false);
				if (myVM.OutID > 0.0)
				{
					double outID = myVM.OutID;
					if (myVM.InID > 0.0)
					{
						double inID = myVM.InID;
						double superImpConstBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
						double superImpVarBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
						double varBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
						if (myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false) > 0.0)
						{
							double fluidVisc = myVM.get_RelViscosity(notify: true, byUser: false);
							double outRough = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRough, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.OutRough, "SmallLength");
							double inRough = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMRough, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, myVM.InRough, "SmallLength");
							double outEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMEquivLength, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.OutEquivLength, "Length");
							double inEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMEquivLength, UnitStrings.Length_m, myVM.InEquivLength, "Length");
							double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
							double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
							num2 += num;
							double compress = myVM.get_RelCompress(notify: true, byUser: false);
							string returnMsg = "";
							double InPressDrop = default(double);
							double InAvgDensity = default(double);
							double InAvgVelocity = default(double);
							double OutPressDrop = default(double);
							double OutAvgDensity = default(double);
							double OutAvgVelocity = default(double);
							double OutExitVelocity = default(double);
							double CritVel = default(double);
							double CriticPress = default(double);
							bool ChokedFlag = default(bool);
							if (LineSizing.VaporSizeLines(ref InPressDrop, ref InAvgDensity, ref InAvgVelocity, ref OutPressDrop, ref OutAvgDensity, ref OutAvgVelocity, ref OutExitVelocity, ref CritVel, ref CriticPress, ref ChokedFlag, inID, inEquivLength, inRough, outID, outEquivLength, outRough, upRatedFlow, relievingTemp, num2, specHeatRatio, compress, molWeight, fluidVisc, superImpConstBackPress, superImpVarBackPress, varBackPress, ref returnMsg) == CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError)
							{
								myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg);
								return;
							}
							double inputVal = LineSizing.CalculateReactionForce(relievingFlow, relievingTemp, CriticPress, superImpConstBackPress, superImpVarBackPress, num, outID, specHeatRatio, molWeight);
							myVM.InPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMPDrop, InPressDrop, "DeltaPressure");
							myVM.InCalcVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMCalcVel, InAvgVelocity, "Velocity");
							double inputVal2 = InAvgDensity * Math.Pow(InAvgVelocity, 2.0);
							myVM.InRhoV2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.RhoV2_kgms2, myVM.UOMRhoV2, inputVal2, "RhoV2");
							if (ChokedFlag)
							{
								myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OutChoked);
							}
							if (!flag)
							{
								if (Operators.CompareString(myVM.DataStatus, FormResource.ResWarn, TextCompare: false) != 0)
								{
									myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResAvail;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResLSErr;
							}
							myVM.OutCalcVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMCalcVel, OutAvgVelocity, "Velocity");
							myVM.OutCritVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMOutCritVel, CritVel, "Velocity");
							double inputVal3 = OutAvgDensity * Math.Pow(OutAvgVelocity, 2.0);
							myVM.OutRhoV2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.RhoV2_kgms2, myVM.UOMRhoV2, inputVal3, "RhoV2");
							myVM.OutExitVel = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.UOMOutExitVel, OutExitVelocity, "Velocity");
							myVM.LineSizingCriticalPressure = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.UOMLineSizingCriticalPressure, CriticPress, "AbsolutePressure");
							myVM.ReactForces = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Force_N, myVM.UOMReactForces, inputVal, "Force");
							myVM.OutPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMPDrop, OutPressDrop, "DeltaPressure");
							myVM.NotifyLineSizingMessagesPropertyChanged();
						}
						else
						{
							myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoFV);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoPipeID);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoPipeID);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.NoK);
			}
		}

		public bool WouldAffectVaporLineSizingConstraints(string propname)
		{
			return _WAVLSCProps.Contains(propname);
		}

		public bool IsVaporLineSizingConstraintsReady()
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.OutExitVel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.OutCritVel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(myVM.OutExitVelLimit))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void CalculateVaporLineSizingConstraints()
		{
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.get_SetPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, myVM.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			double num4 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
			double num5 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
			double num6 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMPDrop, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.InPDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			double num7 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMPDrop, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.OutPDrop, "DeltaPressure");
			double num8 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMOutExitVel, UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.OutExitVel, "Velocity");
			double num9 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMCalcVel, UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.OutCalcVel, "Velocity");
			double num10 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMOutCritVel, UnitStrings.Velocity_ms, myVM.OutCritVel, "Velocity");
			bool flag = Operators.CompareString(myVM.DataStatus, FormResource.ResAvail, TextCompare: false) == 0;
			bool flag2 = myVM.IsSPLWarning || myVM.IsPipeDiameterWarning;
			double num11 = num2 * myVM.InMaxPDropLimit / 100.0;
			myVM.InMaxPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMMaxPDrop, num11, "DeltaPressure");
			double outExitVelLimit = myVM.OutExitVelLimit;
			double outAvgVel = myVM.OutAvgVel;
			myVM.AssignMaxAllowedBackpressurePct();
			double num12 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMMaxAllowBP, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, myVM.get_MaxAllowBP(notify: true), "GaugePressure") - (num3 + num4 - num);
			myVM.OutMaxPDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, myVM.UOMMaxPDrop, num12, "DeltaPressure");
			bool flag3 = num6 > num11;
			if (flag3 && myVM.PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				flag3 = false;
			}
			if (flag3 && ((PSVValveModel)myVM.OwnerPRD).IsRemoteSensingPilot && !double.IsNaN(myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop))
			{
				flag3 = false;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.MaxPDropError);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop) && BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(num6, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop))
			{
				string dPDisplayUnit = DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit;
				double num13 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, dPDisplayUnit, myVM.AppliedInletPressureDrop, "DeltaPressure");
				double num14 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMPDrop, dPDisplayUnit, myVM.InPDrop, "DeltaPressure");
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.CalcInletPDrop, num14, dPDisplayUnit, num13, dPDisplayUnit));
				flag2 = true;
				flag3 = true;
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.PDropOK);
			}
			if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(myVM.InRhoV2, myVM.RhoV2LimitFlange))
			{
				string message = string.Format(FormResource.FlangeRhoV2High, FormResource.LinePrefixInlet);
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(myVM.InMaxLineRhoV2, myVM.RhoV2LimitLine))
			{
				string message2 = string.Format(FormResource.LineRhoV2High, FormResource.LinePrefixInlet);
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message2);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			bool flag4 = true;
			if (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				if ((num7 > num12) & (myVM.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv))
				{
					flag4 = false;
					myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.OutletBack);
				}
				if (num7 > num5)
				{
					flag4 = false;
					string dPDisplayUnit2 = DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit;
					double num15 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, dPDisplayUnit2, num7, "DeltaPressure");
					double num16 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, dPDisplayUnit2, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
					myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.CalcPDrop, num15, dPDisplayUnit2, num16, dPDisplayUnit2));
				}
				if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(num10, num8, 1E-08, 1E-08))
				{
					if (outExitVelLimit < 100.0 && num8 > num10 * outExitVelLimit / 100.0)
					{
						myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.OutVelHigh, myVM.OutExitVelLimit));
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OutVelOK);
					}
					if (outAvgVel < 100.0 && num9 > num10 * outAvgVel / 100.0)
					{
						myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.OutVelAvHigh, myVM.OutAvgVel));
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else if (!double.IsNaN(num9))
					{
						myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OutVelAvOK);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (num7 > num5)
			{
				flag4 = false;
				string dPDisplayUnit3 = DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit;
				double num17 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, dPDisplayUnit3, num7, "DeltaPressure");
				double num18 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(myVM.UOMBuiltupBackPress, dPDisplayUnit3, myVM.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, string.Format(FormResource.CalcPDrop, num17, dPDisplayUnit3, num18, dPDisplayUnit3));
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Ok, FormResource.OutletOK);
			}
			if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(myVM.OutRhoV2, myVM.RhoV2LimitFlange))
			{
				string message3 = string.Format(FormResource.FlangeRhoV2High, FormResource.LinePrefixOutlet);
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message3);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (BaseModel<PrdConstraintsDefinition>.ValueExceeds(myVM.OutMaxLineRhoV2, myVM.RhoV2LimitLine))
			{
				string message4 = string.Format(FormResource.LineRhoV2High, FormResource.LinePrefixOutlet);
				myVM.AddLineSizingConstraintMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, message4);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (flag && (!flag4 || flag2))
			{
				myVM.DataStatus = FormResource.ResLSErr;

			{
				Initialize(storageTank);

				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (value.HasValue && !_allowedSwageMethods.Contains(value.GetValueOrDefault()))
				{
					value = null;
				}
				SetPreferencesValue(SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveDefaultDefiner.RigorousLineRating_TeeSwageMethod, value, notify: false, "TeeSwageMethod");
			}
		}

		public double TeeSwageTransitionFactor
		{

			{
				return SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveDefaultDefiner.RigorousLineRating_TeeSwageTransitionFactor.Number;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPreferencesValue(SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveDefaultDefiner.RigorousLineRating_TeeSwageTransitionFactor, Fraction.FromNumber(value), notify: false, "TeeSwageTransitionFactor");
			}
		}

	public class PSVValveModel : PRDModel
	{
		internal const string s_ValveType = "ValveType";

		internal const string s_ValveMaterial = "ValveMaterial";

		internal const string s_RuptDisk = "RuptDisk";

		internal const string s_Coeff_Kc = "Coeff_Kc";

		private List<string> _materials;

		private List<string> _vtypes;

		private int _type;

		private int _material;

		private PressureSafetyValve _myModel => (PressureSafetyValve)base.Model;

		public List<string> Materials => _materials;

		public List<string> Types => _vtypes;

		public PsvType? ValveType
		{
			get
			{
				return _myModel.PsvType.Value ?? PsvType.Conventional;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!SetProperty("ValveType", value))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel in base.ScenarioModels)
				{
					scenarioModel.OnValveTypeChanged();
				}
				CalculateAllScenarios("ValveType");
			}
		}

		public AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ApiValveMaterial? ValveMaterial
		{
			get
			{
				return _myModel.ValveMaterial.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (SetProperty("ValveMaterial", value))
				{
					CalculateAllScenarios("ValveMaterial");
				}
			}
		}

		public int VType
		{
			get
			{
				return _type;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_type != value)
				{
					_type = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int Material
		{
			get
			{
				return _material;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_material != value)
				{
					_material = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public double Coeff_Kc
		{
			get
			{
				if (RuptDisk)
				{
					return _myModel.Kc.Value;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
			set
			{
				if (RuptDisk)
				{
					SetProperty("Coeff_Kc", value);
					CalculateAllScenarios("Coeff_Kc");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool RuptDisk
		{
			get
			{
				return _myModel.UpstreamRuptureDisk.Value ?? false;
			}
			set
			{
				bool ruptDisk = RuptDisk;
				if (value != ruptDisk)
				{
					SetProperty("RuptDisk", (bool?)value, notify: true, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null);
					if (value & (Coeff_Kc == 1.0))
					{
						Coeff_Kc = 0.9;
					}
					else
					{
						CalculateAllScenarios("RuptDisk");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public double TotalBackPress
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
				{
					return GetSizingCaseModel().get_TotBackPress(notify: true);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double SelOrifice
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
				{
					return GetSizingCaseModel().SelectOrifice;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double PercOrificeUsed
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
				{
					return GetSizingCaseModel().PercOrificeUsed;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double ValveInSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
				{
					return GetSizingCaseModel().ValveInSize;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public string ValveName
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
				{
					return GetSizingCaseModel().ValveName;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public double ValveInRating
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
				{
					return GetSizingCaseModel().ValveInRating;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double ValveOutRating
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
				{
					return GetSizingCaseModel().ValveOutRating;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double ValveOutSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetSizingCaseModel() != null)
				{
					return GetSizingCaseModel().ValveOutSize;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public bool IsRestrictedLift
		{
			get
			{
				return _myModel.IsRestrictedLift.Value ?? false;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty((bool?)value, notify: true, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null, "IsRestrictedLift");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("LiftRestriction");
			}
		}

		public double LiftRestriction
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsRestrictedLift)
				{
					return _myModel.LiftRestriction.Number;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsRestrictedLift)
				{
					SetProperty(value, notify: true, null, byUser: true, null, "LiftRestriction");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsRemoteSensingPilot
		{
			get
			{
				if (ValveType == PsvType.PilotOperated)
				{
					return _myModel.IsRemoteSensingPilot.Value ?? false;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ValveType == PsvType.PilotOperated)
				{
					SetProperty((bool?)value, notify: true, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null, "IsRemoteSensingPilot");
				}
			}
		}

		public PSVValveModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			_materials = null;
			_vtypes = null;
			_type = 0;
			_material = 0;
		}

		public override void Initialize(ref PsvKey dbKey, string CXSDatapath, IBaseModel owner, ReliefDevice datamodel)
		{
			if (!(datamodel is PressureSafetyValve))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("datamodel passed to PSVValveModel.Initialize was not a PressureSafetyValve", "datamodel");
			}
			base.Initialize(ref dbKey, CXSDatapath, owner, datamodel);
			Properties.Add("ValveType", _myModel.PsvType);
			Properties.Add("ValveMaterial", _myModel.ValveMaterial);
			Properties.Add("RuptDisk", _myModel.UpstreamRuptureDisk);
			Properties.Add("Coeff_Kc", _myModel.Kc);
			Properties.Add("IsRestrictedLift", _myModel.IsRestrictedLift);
			Properties.Add("LiftRestriction", _myModel.LiftRestriction);
			Properties.Add("IsRemoteSensingPilot", _myModel.IsRemoteSensingPilot);
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(IBaseModel source)
		{
			PSVValveModel pSVValveModel = (PSVValveModel)source;
			if (pSVValveModel != null)
			{
				CopyFromHelper(pSVValveModel);
			}
		}

		private void CopyFromHelper(PSVValveModel source)
		{
			base.CopyFrom((IBaseModel)source);
		}
	}

	}

		public double RDOperRatio
		{
			get
			{
				double num = _myModel.OperatingRatio.Number;
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					RuptureDiskType? rDSelDiskType = RDSelDiskType;
					int? num2 = (int?)rDSelDiskType;
					if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
					{
						num = 70.0;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = (int?)rDSelDiskType;
						if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2 == 1) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
						{
							num = 85.0;
						}
						else
						{
							num2 = (int?)rDSelDiskType;
							if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2 == 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
							{
								num = 50.0;
							}
							else
							{
								num2 = (int?)rDSelDiskType;
								if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2 == 3) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
								{
									num = 80.0;
								}
								else
								{
									num2 = (int?)rDSelDiskType;
									if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2 == 4) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
									{
										num = 90.0;
									}
									else
									{
										num2 = (int?)rDSelDiskType;
										if ((num2.HasValue ? new bool?(num2 == 5) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
										{
											num = 80.0;
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(s_RDOperRatio, Fraction.FromNumber(value));
			}
		}

		}

		public override void Initialize(ref PsvKey dbKey, string CXSDatapath, IBaseModel owner, ReliefDevice datamodel)
		{
			if ((object)datamodel.GetType() != typeof(RuptureDisk))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("datamodel passed to RuptureDiskModel.Initialize was not a RuptureDisk", "datamodel");
			}
			base.Initialize(ref dbKey, CXSDatapath, owner, datamodel);
			Properties.Add(s_RDSelDiskType, _myModel.DiskType);
			Properties.Add(s_RDSelBodyMtl, _myModel.BodyMaterial);
			Properties.Add(s_RDPosDesPRange, _myModel.PositiveDesignPressureRange);
			Properties.Add(s_RDNegDesPRange, _myModel.NegativeDesignPressureRange);
			Properties.Add(s_RDBurstTol, _myModel.BurstTolerance);
			Properties.Add(s_RDOperRatio, _myModel.OperatingRatio);
			Properties.Add(s_RDMaxBurstP, _myModel.MaxBurstPressure);
			Properties.Add(s_RDMaxMarkedP, _myModel.MaxMarkedPressure);
			Properties.Add(s_RDSpecBurstP, _myModel.SpecifiedBurstPressure);
			Properties.Add(s_RDMinMarkedBurstP, _myModel.MinMarkedBurstPressure);
			Properties.Add(s_RDMinBurstP, _myModel.MinBurstPressure);
			Properties.Add(s_RDCalcMaxOpP, _myModel.CalculatedMaxOperatingPressure);
			Properties.Add(s_RDNormMaxOpP, _myModel.NormalMaxOperatingPressure);
			Properties.Add(s_RDPosDesPPercent, _myModel.PositiveDesignPressurePercentage);
			Properties.Add(s_RDNegDesPPercent, _myModel.NegativeDesignPressurePercentage);
			Properties.Add(s_RDBurstTolPercent, _myModel.BurstTolerancePercentage);
			Properties.Add(s_RDPosDesPType, _myModel.PositiveDesignPressureDataSource);
			Properties.Add(s_RDNegDesPType, _myModel.NegativeDesignPressureDataSource);
			Properties.Add(s_RDBurstTolType, _myModel.BurstToleranceDataSource);
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(IBaseModel source)
		{
			RuptureDiskModel ruptureDiskModel = (RuptureDiskModel)source;
			if (ruptureDiskModel != null)
			{
				CopyFromHelper(ruptureDiskModel);
			}
		}

		private void CopyFromHelper(RuptureDiskModel source)
		{
			base.CopyFrom((IBaseModel)source);
		}
	}

		public new string Datapath

		public int TankID
		{
			get
			{
				string propName = s_TKID;
				bool byUser = true;
				return GetProperty<int>(propName, null, ref byUser);
			}
		}

		public string TankName
		{
			get
			{
				string propName = s_TKTankItem;
				bool byUser = true;
				return GetProperty<string>(propName, null, ref byUser);
			}
			set
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(TankName, value, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				string tankName = TankName;
				if (!(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) & base.Model.NewItemIsUnique(value)))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!IsAllowedName(value))
				{
					System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.TankNameErrorPrompt_NONASCII, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
				}
				else if (UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).SetTankName(Datapath, value))
				{
					SetProperty(s_TKTankItem, value);
					Datapath = base.HostInterface.GetTankUpdatedId(Datapath, value);
					UpdateFluidPath();
					RenameEventArgs e = new RenameEventArgs
					{
						OldName = tankName,
						NewName = value,
						Path = Datapath,
						ObjectType = "TankName",
						Key = DBKey
					};
					if (uContainer.Parent != null)
					{
						IEventAggregator obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
						((RoutedCompositePresentationEvent<RenameEventArgs>)obj.GetEvent<RenameEvent>()).Publish(e);
						object objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)base.Model).DataModel);
						((CompositePresentationEvent<TankRenamedEventArgs>)obj.GetEvent<TankRenamedEvent>()).Publish(new TankRenamedEventArgs(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue), tankName));
					}
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("FullName");
				}
				else
				{
					System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.TankNameErrorPrompt_NONASCII, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
				}
			}
		}

		public string FullName => TankName;

		public bool Coeff_F_Calculate
		{
			get
			{
				string propName = s_TKCoeff_F_Opt;
				bool byUser = true;
				return ProcessDataSource.Calculated == GetProperty<ProcessDataSource?>(propName, null, ref byUser).GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			set
			{
				ProcessDataSource value2 = ProcessDataSource.Specified;
				if (value)

					value2 = ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
				}
				SetProperty(s_TKCoeff_F_Opt, (ProcessDataSource?)value2, notify: true, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null);
			}
		}

		public MessageLevel TankMessageLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Information.IsNothing(mTankMessages))
				{
					PSVMessage displayMessage = GetDisplayMessage();
					if (displayMessage != null)
					{
						return displayMessage.MessageLevel;
					}
				}
				return MessageLevel.Ok;
			}
		}

		public string TankMessages
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Information.IsNothing(mTankMessages))
				{
					PSVMessage displayMessage = GetDisplayMessage();
					if (displayMessage != null)
					{
						return displayMessage.Message;
					}
					return FormResource.CalculationOK;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateFluidPath()
		{
			IPSVCXSModel iPSVCXSModel = (IPSVCXSModel)_PPPFluid;
			if (iPSVCXSModel != null)
			{
				if (string.Equals(Host, "ASPENPLUS"))
				{
					iPSVCXSModel.CXSDataPath = Datapath;
				}
				else
				{
					iPSVCXSModel.CXSDataPath = Datapath + "." + base.Simulator.PSVNavigationStrings.TankFluid;
				}
			}
		}

		public PSVMessage GetDisplayMessage()
		{
			return mTankMessages.GetHighestLevelMessage(this);
		}

		public void AutoRunCalculations(string propname, bool force = false)
		{
			if (force | WouldAffectCalculation(propname))
			{
				base.HostInterface.SetTankDirtyState(Datapath, value: false);
				EraseTankResults();
				ClearTankMessages(MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				if (IsReady())
				{
					Calculate();
				}
				CatchRanCalculations(this, new RanCalculationsEventArgs(recalculateRatingModels: true));
			}
			else
			{
				CatchPropertyChanged();
			}
		}

		private bool WouldAffectCalculation(string propname)
		{
			if (CommonProperties.Contains(propname))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TankType != VesselTypeEnum.Sphere && Operators.CompareString(propname, s_TKHeight, TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (NormVent)
			{
				if (NormalProperties.Contains(propname))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!UsePropertyPackage && Operators.CompareString(propname, s_TKVapSpaceMolWeight, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (EmergVent)
			{
				if (EmergencyProperties.Contains(propname))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!Coeff_F_Calculate & (Operators.CompareString(propname, s_TKCoeff_F, TextCompare: false) == 0))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!UsePropertyPackage)
				{
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, s_TKEmergDevGasTemp, TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (Operators.CompareString(propname, s_TKEmergDevGasMolWeight, TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (UsePropertyPackage && (base.HostInterface.GetTankDirtyState(Datapath) ?? true))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsReady()
		{
			bool flag = true;
			_IsNormalBreathingReady = false;
			_IsEmergencyBreathingReady = false;
			if (double.IsNaN(AtmPress) || AtmPress < 0.0)
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_AtmPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(DesPress))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_DesPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			else if (DesPress + AtmPress <= 0.0)
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_DesPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			else
			{
				double value = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, 15.0, "GaugePressure");
				if (DesPress > Math.Round(value, 6, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero))
				{
					AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_API2000DesPress_Warning, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				}
				int? num = (int?)CalcCode;
				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					double value2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, 2.5, "GaugePressure");
					if (DesPress > Math.Round(value2, 6, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero))
					{
						AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.Tank_API650DesPress_Warning, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					}
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(OperPress))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_OperPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			else if (OperPress + AtmPress <= 0.0)
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_OperPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (BaseModel<StorageTank>.ValueExceeds(OperPress, DesPress))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_DesPressLowerThanOp, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(DesVacuum))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_VacPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
			}
			else if (DesVacuum < 0.0 - AtmPress)
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_VacPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
			}
			if ((Diameter <= 0.0) | double.IsNaN(Diameter))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_Diameter_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (TankType != VesselTypeEnum.Sphere && ((Height <= 0.0) | double.IsNaN(Height)))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_Height_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(EvaporRate))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_EvapRate_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(InsRatio) | (InsRatio < 0.0) | (InsRatio > 1.0))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_InsulationRatio_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (InsRatio > 0.0)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(InsThk) | (InsThk <= 0.0))
				{
					AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_InsThick_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					flag = false;
				}
				if (NormVent && double.IsNaN(InsThermCond))
				{
					AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_ThermCondIns_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					flag = false;
				}
				if (EmergVent && double.IsNaN(InsThermCondFire))
				{
					AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_ThermCondFire_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (NormVent)
			{
				_IsNormalBreathingReady = GetIsNormalBreathingReady();
			}
			if (EmergVent)
			{
				_IsEmergencyBreathingReady = GetIsEmergencyBreathingReady();
			}
			if (!NormVent & !EmergVent)
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_NoCalculation, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!_IsNormalBreathingReady)
				{
					return _IsEmergencyBreathingReady;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetIsNormalBreathingReady()
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (double.IsNaN(NormDevSetPress))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_NormDevSetPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(NormDevSetVacPress))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_NormDevVacSetPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			double val = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMDesPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, DesPress, "GaugePressure");
			double val2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMOperPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, OperPress, "GaugePressure");
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMNormDevSetPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, NormDevSetPress, "TankPressure1");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMAtmPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			if (num + num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_NormDevSetPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (BaseModel<StorageTank>.ValueExceeds(num, val))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_DesPressLowerThanDevSetPress, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (BaseModel<StorageTank>.ValueExceeds(val2, num))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_OperPressHigherNormDevSetPress, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			double val3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMDesVacuum, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, DesVacuum, "TankPressure1");
			double num3 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMNormDevSetVacPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, NormDevSetVacPress, "TankPressure1");
			if (num3 + num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_NormDevVacSetPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (BaseModel<StorageTank>.ValueExceeds(val3, num3))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_DesVacuumHigherThanDevVacSetPress, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (BaseModel<StorageTank>.ValueExceeds(num3, val))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_DesPressLowerThanDevVacSetPress, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(InFlow) | (InFlow < 0.0))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_InFlow_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(OutFlow) | (OutFlow < 0.0))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_OutFlow_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (!UsePropertyPackage && (double.IsNaN(VapSpaceMolWeight) | (VapSpaceMolWeight <= 0.0)))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_VapSpaceMW_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(InitialTemp))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_MaxOperTemp_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			else if (UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMInitialTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_K, InitialTemp, "Temperature") <= 0.0)
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_MaxOperTemp_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool GetIsEmergencyBreathingReady()
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (double.IsNaN(EmergDevSetPress))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_EmergDevSetPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			double val = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMDesPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, DesPress, "GaugePressure");
			double val2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMOperPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, OperPress, "GaugePressure");
			double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMEmergDevSetPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, EmergDevSetPress, "TankPressure1");
			double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMAtmPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			if (num + num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_EmergDevSetPress_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (BaseModel<StorageTank>.ValueExceeds(num, val))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_DesPressLowerThanEmergSetPress, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (BaseModel<StorageTank>.ValueExceeds(val2, num))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_OperPressHigherEmergSetPress, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(VesselElevation))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_Elevation_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(FlameHeight))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_FlameHeight_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (!Coeff_F_Calculate && (double.IsNaN(Coeff_F) | (Coeff_F < 0.0)))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_CoeffF_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			if (!UsePropertyPackage)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(EmergDevGasTemp))
				{
					AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_EmergDevGasTemp_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					result = false;
				}
				else if (UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMEmergDevGasTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_K, EmergDevGasTemp, "Temperature") <= 0.0)
				{
					AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_EmergDevGasTemp_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					result = false;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(EmergDevGasMolWeight))
				{
					AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_EmergDevGasMW_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					result = false;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(FluidLatHeat) | (FluidLatHeat <= 0.0))
			{
				AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_LatentHeat_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool CalculateFluidProperties()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (UsePropertyPackage)
			{
				if (NormVent && _IsNormalBreathingReady)
				{
					double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMAtmPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, AtmPress, "DeltaPressure");
					double p = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMNormDevSetPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, NormDevSetPress, "TankPressure1") + num;
					double t = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMInitialTemp, UnitStrings.Temp_C, InitialTemp, "TankTemperature");
					PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlash(t, p);
					if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction() > 0.0)
					{
						VapSpaceMolWeight = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
						result = true;
					}
					else
					{
						AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_NormVentNoVapor, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
						_IsNormalBreathingReady = false;
					}
				}
				if (EmergVent && _IsEmergencyBreathingReady)
				{
					double num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMAtmPress, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_kPa, AtmPress, "DeltaPressure");
					double p2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMEmergDevSetPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_kPaG, EmergDevSetPress, "TankPressure1") + num2;
					double streamTemperature = StreamTemperature;
					if (double.IsNaN(streamTemperature))
					{
						AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_EmergDevGasTemp_Invalid, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
						return false;
					}
					EmergDevGasTemp = streamTemperature;
					PhysicalPropPkgFluid.TPFlash(streamTemperature, p2);
					if (PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporFraction() > 0.0)
					{
						EmergDevGasMolWeight = PhysicalPropPkgFluid.VaporMolecularWeight();
						result = true;
					}
					else
					{
						AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, FormResource.tank_EmergVentNoVapor, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
						_IsEmergencyBreathingReady = false;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Calculate()
		{
			string returnMsg = "";
			if (!CalculateFluidProperties())
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = _IsNormalBreathingReady;
			bool flag2 = _IsEmergencyBreathingReady;
			double tKInsThk = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMInsThk, UnitStrings.Length_m, InsThk, "SmallLength");
			double tKInsThermCond = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMInsThermCond, UnitStrings.TCond_WMK, InsThermCond, "ThermalCond");
			double tKNormDevSetPress = default(double);
			double tKNormDevSetVacPress = default(double);
			double tKInsFactor = default(double);
			if (NormVent && flag)
			{
				tKNormDevSetPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMNormDevSetPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, NormDevSetPress, "TankPressure1");
				tKNormDevSetVacPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMNormDevSetVacPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, NormDevSetVacPress, "TankPressure1");
				tKInsFactor = TankVent.InsulationFactor(InsRatio, tKInsThk, tKInsThermCond, AreaFractionNotContained);
			}
			double tKEmergDevSetPress = default(double);
			double tKFluidLatHeat = default(double);
			double emergDevGasMolWeight = default(double);
			double TKCoeff_F = default(double);
			if (EmergVent && flag2)
			{
				tKEmergDevSetPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMEmergDevSetPress, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, EmergDevSetPress, "TankPressure1");
				tKFluidLatHeat = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMFluidLatHeat, UnitStrings.MassEnthalpy_Jkg, FluidLatHeat, "MassEnthalpy");
				emergDevGasMolWeight = EmergDevGasMolWeight;
				double tKInsThermCondFire = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMInsThermCondFire, UnitStrings.TCond_WMK, InsThermCondFire, "ThermalCond");
				TKCoeff_F = Coeff_F;
				if (flag2)
				{
					if (InsRatio > 0.0)
					{
						switch (TankVent.Calculate_Coeff_F(ref TKCoeff_F, EmergVent, Coeff_F_Calculate, tKInsThermCondFire, tKInsThk, ref returnMsg))
						{
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
							AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
							break;
						case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
							AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
							flag2 = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (InsRatio == 0.0 && Coeff_F_Calculate)
					{
						TKCoeff_F = 1.0;
						AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, FormResource.tank_NeedInsulationForFCalc, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag && !flag2)
			{
				return;
			}
			double evaporRate = EvaporRate;
			double TKCapacity = default(double);
			double TKRoofSurface = default(double);
			double TKWettedHeight = default(double);
			double TKCalcArea = default(double);
			double TKTotVesselArea = default(double);
			double TKShellSurface = default(double);
			double TKHeadsSurface = default(double);
			double TKTotalSurfaceVap = default(double);
			TankVent.TankGeometryCalculation(ref TKCapacity, ref TKRoofSurface, ref TKWettedHeight, ref TKCalcArea, ref TKTotVesselArea, ref TKShellSurface, ref TKHeadsSurface, ref TKTotalSurfaceVap, Diameter, Height, VesselElevation, FlameHeight, TankType, NormVent, EmergVent);
			double TKNormOutArea = default(double);
			double TKNormOutSize = default(double);
			double TKNormInArea = default(double);
			double TKNormInSize = default(double);
			double TKThermInBreath = default(double);
			double TKThermOutBreath = default(double);
			double TKInbreathing = default(double);
			double TKOutBreathing = default(double);
			double TKTotInBreathing = default(double);
			double TKTotOutBreathing = default(double);
			if (NormVent && flag)
			{
				switch (TankVent.CalcNormalScenario(ref TKNormOutArea, ref TKNormOutSize, ref TKNormInArea, ref TKNormInSize, ref TKThermInBreath, ref TKThermOutBreath, ref TKInbreathing, ref TKOutBreathing, ref TKTotInBreathing, ref TKTotOutBreathing, TKCapacity, tKInsFactor, InFlow, evaporRate, OutFlow, Latitude, VapPress, InitialTemp, tKNormDevSetPress, AtmPress, VapSpaceMolWeight, tKNormDevSetVacPress, NormalAPIEdition, IsVolatileLiquid, ref returnMsg))
				{
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationWarning:
					AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Warning, returnMsg, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					break;
				case CalculationStatusEnum.CalculationError:
					AddTankMessage(MessageLevel.Error, returnMsg, MessageLocation.TankCalc);
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			double TKEmergOutArea = default(double);
			double TKEmergOutSize = default(double);
			double TKCalcHeatInput = default(double);
			double TKCalcRelFlow = default(double);
			if (EmergVent && flag2)
			{
				TankVent.CalcEmergencyScenario(ref TKEmergOutArea, ref TKEmergOutSize, ref TKCalcHeatInput, ref TKCalcRelFlow, TKCalcArea, DesPress, TKCoeff_F, tKFluidLatHeat, EmergDevGasTemp, emergDevGasMolWeight, tKEmergDevSetPress, AtmPress);
			}
			if (NormVent && flag)
			{
				NormOutArea = TKNormOutArea;
				NormOutSize = TKNormOutSize;
				NormInArea = TKNormInArea;
				NormInSize = TKNormInSize;
				ThermInBreath = TKThermInBreath;
				ThermOutBreath = TKThermOutBreath;
				InBreathing = TKInbreathing;
				OutBreathing = TKOutBreathing;
				TotInBreathing = TKTotInBreathing;
				TotOutBreathing = TKTotOutBreathing;
			}
			if (EmergVent && flag2)
			{
				EmergOutArea = TKEmergOutArea;
				EmergOutSize = TKEmergOutSize;
				CalcArea = TKCalcArea;
				CalcHeatInput = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Energy_W, UOMCalcHeatInput, TKCalcHeatInput, "Energy");
				CalcRelFlow = TKCalcRelFlow;
				if (Coeff_F_Calculate)
				{
					Coeff_F = TKCoeff_F;
				}
			}
		}

		private void EraseTankResults()
		{
			NormOutArea = double.NaN;
			NormOutSize = double.NaN;
			NormInArea = double.NaN;
			NormInSize = double.NaN;
			EmergOutArea = double.NaN;
			EmergOutSize = double.NaN;
			ThermInBreath = double.NaN;
			ThermOutBreath = double.NaN;
			InBreathing = double.NaN;
			OutBreathing = double.NaN;
			TotInBreathing = double.NaN;
			TotOutBreathing = double.NaN;
			CalcHeatInput = double.NaN;
			CalcRelFlow = double.NaN;
			CalcArea = double.NaN;
			if (Coeff_F_Calculate)
			{
				Coeff_F = double.NaN;
			}
			if (UsePropertyPackage)
			{
				if (NormVent)
				{
					VapSpaceMolWeight = double.NaN;
				}
				if (EmergVent)
				{
					EmergDevGasTemp = double.NaN;
					EmergDevGasMolWeight = double.NaN;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public double FIREFlameHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if ((((PSVScenarioModel)base.Owner).get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) ?? FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted) != FireCalcMethod.NFPA30)
				{
					return base.Model.MaxFlameHeight.ValueIn(Units.m);
				}
				return base.Model.MaxFlameHeightNFPA.ValueIn(Units.m);
			}
			set
			{
				if (((((PSVScenarioModel)base.Owner).get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true) ?? FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted) == FireCalcMethod.NFPA30) ? base.Model.MaxFlameHeightNFPA.Specify(value, Units.m, new UserSpecifier()) : base.Model.MaxFlameHeight.Specify(value, Units.m, new UserSpecifier()))
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged("FIREMaxFlameHeight");
				}
			}
		}

		public double FIREAdditionalAreaPct
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Model.AdditionalAreaFraction.Percent;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("FIREAdditionAreaFrac", Fraction.FromPercent(value));
			}
		}

		public double FIREAdditionalAreaFixed
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Model.AdditionalArea.ValueIn(Units.m2);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(value, notify: true, Units.m2, byUser: true, null, "FIREAdditionalAreaFixed");
			}
		}

		public double FIRECoeff_F
		{
			get
			{
				bool byUser = true;
				return GetProperty<double>("FIRECoeff_F", null, ref byUser);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("FIRECoeff_F", value, notify);
			}
		}

		public bool FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated
		{
			get
			{
				bool byUser = true;
				return ProcessDataSource.Calculated == (GetProperty<ProcessDataSource?>("FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated", null, ref byUser) ?? ProcessDataSource.Specified);
			}
			set
			{
				ProcessDataSource value2 = ProcessDataSource.Specified;
				if (value)
				{
					value2 = ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
				}
				SetProperty("FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated", (ProcessDataSource?)value2, notify: true, (IUnitOfMeasure)null, byUser: true, (PressureReference?)null);
			}
		}

		public double FIREInsThermCond
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Model.InsulationThermalConductivity.ValueIn(Units.kcal_per_m_h_C);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("FIREInsThermCond", value, notify: true, Units.kcal_per_m_h_C);
			}
		}

		public double FIREInsThk
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Model.InsulationThickness.ValueIn(Units.mm);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("FIREInsThk", value, notify: true, Units.mm);
			}
		}

		public string FIREUOMDiameter => UnitStrings.Length_m;

		public Vessel_FireCalcModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
		}

		public override void Initialize(ref PsvKey Row, string CXSDatapath, IBaseModel owner, VesselExposedToFire datamodel)
		{
			base.Initialize(ref Row, CXSDatapath, owner, datamodel);
			Properties.Add("FIREVesselActive", base.Model.IsActive);
			Properties.Add("FIRECalcRelFlow", base.Model.CalculatedReliefFlow);
			Properties.Add("FIRECalcHeatInput", base.Model.CalculatedHeatInput);
			Properties.Add("FIREArea_IsCalculated", base.Model.CalculateArea);
			Properties.Add("FIREExposedArea", base.Model.ExposedArea);
			Properties.Add("FIREExposedVolume", base.Model.ExposedVolume);
			Properties.Add("FIREVesselType", base.Model.VesselType);
			Properties.Add("FIREVesselTopHeadType", base.Model.TopHeadType);
			Properties.Add("FIREVesselBottomHeadType", base.Model.BottomHeadType);
			Properties.Add("FIREIncludedHeads", base.Model.HeadsExposed);
			Properties.Add("FIREDiameter", base.Model.Diameter);
			Properties.Add("FIREHeight", base.Model.Height);
			Properties.Add("FIRELiquidLevel", base.Model.LiquidLevel);
			Properties.Add("FIREElevation", base.Model.Elevation);
			Properties.Add("FIREMaxFlameHeight", base.Model.MaxFlameHeight);
			Properties.Add("FIREAdditionAreaFrac", base.Model.AdditionalAreaFraction);
			Properties.Add("FIRECoeff_F", base.Model.F);
			Properties.Add("FIRECoeff_F_IsCalculated", base.Model.FDataSource);
			Properties.Add("FIREInsThermCond", base.Model.InsulationThermalConductivity);
			Properties.Add("FIREInsThk", base.Model.InsulationThickness);
			Properties.Add("FIREAdditionalAreaFixed", base.Model.AdditionalArea);
		}
	}
